rows.name: Cyber Rush
rows.short_description: Shoot your way through endless plagues of robots and use the game's advanced parkour and movement system to survive. Purchase special weapons and character upgrades to get stronger and survive more rooms!
rows.description_html: Welcome to the adrenaline-fueled world of Cyber Rush, a fast-paced Rogue-Like FPS set in a dystopian future where survival is the ultimate goal. Dive into procedurally generated levels filled with relentless enemies, powerful bosses, and a vast array of futuristic weaponry to clear as many rooms as you possibly can!

rows.name: Twistingo Free
rows.short_description: Explore three captivating games in one free package! Bird Paradise, Turtle Bay, and Hummingbird Haven await with an array of puzzles, adventures, and mini-games. Dive into a world filled with challenges and exciting discoveries!
rows.description_html: Embark on an extraordinary journey across three captivating games in this exclusive free edition! 1. Twistingo: Bird Paradise: Dive into a world where puzzles reign supreme. Test your skills in a variety of challenging games, from hidden objects to bingo, and exciting marble-popping adventures. Each level is a unique blend of fun and cleverness - are you ready to meet the challenge? 2. Twistingo: Turtle Bay: Join Kanoa and Malia in Turtle Bay, a paradise under threat. Team up to rescue endangered turtles, discover hidden treasures, and unravel the island's ancient legends. With a series of enthralling puzzles and delightful mini-games, you'll help the locals and breathe new life into Turtle Bay. 3. Twistingo: Hummingbird Haven: After a devastating storm, it's up to you to rescue the hummingbirds in this tropical adventure. Solve puzzles, uncover hidden objects, and rebuild the hummingbirds' homes. Collect mystical amulets, engage in entertaining mini-games, and unlock the secrets of the island. Additional Features: Free access to a couple of levels of each game. A variety of mini-games to keep you entertained. A unique opportunity to preview the full experience of three sequels. Get a taste of the adventure, puzzles, and mysteries that await you in the full versions. Download now and start your journey in [Your Game's Title] - Free Edition!

rows.name: BoardLand
rows.short_description: BoardLand is a turn-based strategy board game where you use the numbers rolled by dice to grow your own board and battle monsters.
rows.description_html: Create your own strategy with the dice The dice is rolled! Are you going to move? Are you going to act? Different effects are applied to each die, and the numbers determine your behavior. How do you combine numbers to get the best results? Every time you pick a number, you'll have to choose carefully. Make a powerful board by strengthening the tiles. Tiles get more and more powerful! Every time you act on a tile, the tile gains experience, and the tile with enough experience is upgradeable. Combine tiles with multiple properties to create the best strategy, your own board Defeat the monsters and bosses Monsters disturb you! Monsters can summon Fireballs, or they can curse and cause obstacles to certain tiles. You have to move and act with the dice, avoiding these patterns every time.

rows.name: Frostrain
rows.short_description: Be the last train conductor roaming the postapocalyptic frozen world! Expand, strengthen, and build synergies on your train. The promised land beyond the toxic zone awaits you and your passengers.
rows.description_html: Roam the frozen world Climate change has turned the world white and frozen, and the only thing moving on the planet is you, your passengers, and your train. It's a dead world, but ironically, it's all the more fascinating for it. A vivid landscape awaits you to explore. Keep your passengers happy The passengers on your train will work diligently at your command, but be careful: if you don't manage their happiness properly, they might throw you off the train. Build your own train with card decks Each time you pass through a city, you'll be able to add new train cars by launching a heavy lift drone. Be careful with each choice you make. If you are lucky, you'll be able to build a better, more synergized, happily-ever-after train deck, but it won't always go as you planned. Reach the Promised Land Lead your passengers in search of the Promised Land, somewhere on the eastern edge of the world. But the journey to the Promised Land isn't all smooth and pleasant. You'll have to pass through toxic areas, and a severe storm is brewing behind you. Pay attention to your passengers' happiness levels and lead them safely to the Promised Land. The journey is in your hands.

rows.name: Gravitia
rows.short_description: Gravitia is an adventure game about manipulating gravity to escape a unique world full of mystery.
rows.description_html: Gravitia is a unique adventure game that utilizes gravity to escape a mysterious world. The gun creates a gravity field centered on the point of impact, which attracts the environment and objects except for gravity bullets. This allows you to move objects that are out of reach or move walls that are in your way to move forward. Try this unique interaction that defies the laws of nature for a different experience. It is unclear where this mysterious place is located and how it came to be. Explore the unknown and approach the secrets of the space as they unfold in the fog. As the fog slowly clears, you will gradually reach the secrets of the space.

rows.name: Maneuver
rows.short_description: Maneuver is a 3D FPP melee action game where you fight by switching characters you manipulate through 'Hacking'. Experience fast tempo combat with strategies through hacking.
rows.description_html: Maneuver is a fast-paced, melee-focused, first-person perspective (FPP) action game featuring captivating synthwave art styles and innovative gameplay that allows players to heist opponent's body through hacking. Embark on a Journey Take on the role of the first mercenary, known as 'Knight,' on a quest for revenge against the 'Syndicate' that sealed your freedom. Unleash chaos in this unstable cyber realm and liberate yourself from those seeking to imprison you. Hacking Mechanics Use your shuriken to hack targets. Heist bodies, transform objects, and gain an advantage that can assist you in battle. Hack in-game objects strategically to turn the tide in your favor. First-Person Combat Experience Engage in swift combat through dashing and hacking, immersing yourself in gameplay from a first-person perspective. Navigate the cyber realm with dynamic and immersive gameplay. Hit Satisfaction in Synthwave Art Style In the synthwave art style, wield your weapon and experience the sense of impact, observing enemy debris scattering across the cybernetic landscape.

rows.name: Underminer
rows.short_description: Welcome to Underminer, an underground adventure game set in a subterranean world. Mine minerals, earn money, upgrade your drill machine and descend deeper into the earth. The truth about 'legendary minerals' and an exciting underground world are waiting for you!
rows.description_html: Welcome. New miner! Interesting underground world! Different minerals and formations, underground caves and treasure maps. There's a lot of interesting stuff under the ground! Get stronger to explore! Get closer to the 'King of Miner' rank. The more powerful drill machines you upgrade to, the deeper underground you can explore! Legendary Minerals in the Veil! Find clues to the legendary minerals hidden in ancient air defenses. Help the people of the underworld and you'll be one step closer to the secret. Adventure awaits!

rows.name: Necro Rumble
rows.short_description: Master the dark art of necromancy in a 2D top-down strategy game. Unleash and lead your undead legions to defeat and dominate enemy waves in this action-packed adventure.
rows.description_html: Necro Rumble! About the Game Resurrect the corpses to build your army, defeat the mortals, and survive to the end! Lead the army of the undead. In our game, the Necromancer doesn't engage in direct combat. Instead, utilize undead units to fend off enemies approaching from all directions. For the Necromancer, the corpses of enemies are potential troops. Revive these bodies at critical moments to turn the tide of battle in your favor. Special enemies will appear to challenge you. However, once defeated and turned into corpses, they too can be resurrected as part of your undead legion. Do whatever it takes to survive until the last. Choose your rewards wisely to evolve into the ultimate Necromancer! Every Necromancer has a unique approach to combat. As you create and sacrifice undead, you'll be presented with choices to strengthen your undead forces. Through these enhancements, decide which type of undead in your legion will become more powerful and how to boost their abilities. Consider the synergies between different undead types to build a formidable army and engage in battle.

rows.name: Dwarfs Delight
rows.short_description: Join the adventure of Dwarfs Delight, an explosive multiplayer game where dwarves battle in a tavern for glory and beer! Face off against your friends in this couch game, where every mug counts. Get ready for laughter and unforgettable moments. Ideal for nights with friends!
rows.description_html: Welcome to the world of Dwarfs Delight, a thrilling local multiplayer game for 2 to 4 players, where humor, strategy, and action meet in a fantasy world populated by dwarves. Key Features Dynamic Local Multiplayer Join your friends in a battle for supremacy in lively taverns. Perfect for game nights with friends or family. Rich and Varied Environments From the classic tavern to the mysterious dragon's cave, each environment offers unique challenges and strategic opportunities. Strategic Gameplay Master the art of keeping your beer mug while dodging obstacles and countering your opponents. Each game is a new drinking session! Power-ups and Surprises Use random power-ups and avoid traps to gain an edge over your rivals. Customizable Passives At the end of each round, choose unique passives to strengthen your dwarf - gain speed, increase your throwing range, or withstand an extra hit. Charming and Immersive Graphics Dive into a world of dwarves with colorful graphics and captivating character design. Guaranteed Laughter Enjoy a hilarious and unpredictable gaming experience, where each game is filled with memorable and fun moments. Whether you are a fierce competitor or a casual player, Dwarfs Delight offers a unique and captivating gaming experience. Get ready to enter the legend of the dwarves, take on challenges, and share moments of joy with your friends. Download now and let the party begin!

rows.name: Moon Rider
rows.short_description: Moon Rider is a road adventure not only through picturesque landscapes but also within the depths of the human soul. You are a motorcyclist fleeing from your problems. Encounter strangers in visual novels and answer soul-searching questions.
rows.description_html: Immerse yourself in a road adventure, leaving problems behind and delving into the depths of the human soul. Confront the storm of emotions and overcome all psychological stages. In this journey, every question, every dialogue is a conflict between decisions and doubts, revealing the depths of your own essence. Are you ready to embark on this adventure, or will you once again escape from your problems? Features: Narrative immersion — Explore the depths of the human soul, meeting strangers and answering questions, revealing your essence in visual novels. Psychological questions — Answer questions that can help you understand and delve into the depths of your feelings. Unique atmosphere and visual style — Enjoy beautiful, melancholic landscapes accompanied by soothing music and the sound of a motorcycle. Moon Rider is not just a game. It's a meeting with yourself, a dive into your own human soul. Do you think you are ready to confront your own 'self'?

rows.name: Home Path
rows.short_description: Home Path is a Rogue-Like Action game where you play as a Slime that has to go to different platforms to save a Little Girl that she has found.
rows.description_html: Home Path is a rogue-like Game where you have to help the Slime to Reach her Home. You have to survive 10 floors and help the little girl to not be hungry. Get Random power-ups when you travel to the next Floor. The floors are randomly generated so every playthrough has a new layout.

rows.name: Beer Run
rows.short_description: Beer Run is an Indie game created to steal beers from supermarkets.
rows.description_html: Beer Run is an Indie game created to steal beers from supermarkets. Three guys with a plan to steal more beer after running out, they go into multiple grocery stores to rob beer. Security guards are the enemy while the characters intend to rob from a store. As you progress throughout the game, each level gets harder by improving their security system. Multiple security guards in certain levels that make it tough to steal without being caught. As you collect more beers the character starts to slow down from all the weight being carried, creating another challenge besides evading the security. Features include - Limited carrying supply Slowed down speed when carrying beers. Can drop beers to gain speed. 3-star reward system Story 3 different characters

rows.name: The Lancaster Leak - Entity Exam
rows.short_description: YOU CONTROL THE FOUND FOOTAGE. Another tape has been leaked, this time a recording of a training protocol. By answering questions and resisting jumpscares, can you beat the Entity Exam?
rows.description_html: Episode 3 - Entity Exam The whistle-blowers have kept their promise and have leaked another tape. It seems to be some sort of training protocol used by the E.R.D. to train their agents on not only entities but field skills to improve their chances of survival. WARNING: This game is not suitable for children or those easily disturbed Multiple Modules There are 6 sections to prepare you for the final exam. Learn and practice the skills that cover this text, image, and audio-based game. Features 30-40 minutes long Linear Story Minor Jumpscares Playing the other games is recommended but not required.

rows.name: Phantom Ascension
rows.short_description: Dive into the intense 'Phantom Ascension,' a single-player action game set in a dystopian 20XX. With unchecked corporate power, crumbling governments, and rampant lawlessness, the Blacklight Gang, a coalition of criminals and mercenaries, seizes control, plunging the world into chaos.
rows.description_html: Unleash Chaos in a Dystopian World: Embark on a heart-pounding journey through a dystopian landscape ravaged by cataclysmic events. As humanity teeters on the edge of extinction, dive into the chaos that is the Blacklight Gang territory. Your Mission: In 'Phantom Ascension,' take on the role of a silent mercenary on a perilous quest to retrieve the stolen Quantum Orb. Navigate the disintegrating reality of the Blacklight Gang's domain, facing off against the tyrannical Bryce and his ruthless thugs. Advanced Prototype Suit: Equip yourself with an advanced prototype suit, a technological marvel that sets you apart in the midst of the apocalypse. Face overwhelming odds armed with a deadly melee weapon and cutting-edge capabilities. Intense First-Person Hack and Slash: Engage in relentless first-person hack and slash combat, where precision and strategy are your allies. Experience a unique blend of fast-paced action and strategic maneuvering as you confront the calamity head-on. Specialized Techniques: Master specialized techniques to outclass your adversaries. Use your high-tech suit to its full potential, executing nimble moves and devastating attacks that will leave enemies in awe. Save Humanity, Confront the Chaos: In 'Phantom Ascension,' you are always outnumbered but never outclassed. Confront the chaos head-on, employing your skills and advanced equipment to save what remains of humanity. Key Features: Intense first-person hack and slash gameplay Navigate a disintegrating dystopian world Advanced prototype suit with unique capabilities Face off against the tyrannical Blacklight Gang Master specialized techniques for strategic advantage Dive into the chaos and emerge as the silent savior humanity desperately needs in 'Phantom Ascension.'

rows.short_description: Legendary Hoplite: Arachne’s Trial is a combination of Tower Defense and Action RPG. Upgrade your army, get the best gear, and craft unique strategies across 10 levels. Face Arachne, and seamlessly transfer progress to the main game.

rows.name: NOVA CORE CHAOS
rows.short_description: NOVA CORE CHAOS is a chaotic co-op cooking game for one to five players. Play as one of five unique classes and follow the recipes to make energy cores. Give these to your customers to help them evolve into Novas!
rows.description_html: NOVA CORE CHAOS is a chaotic co-op cooking game for one to five players. You and your fellow robot friends need to work as a team to prep and fill energy cores with their designated elements to help customers evolve into the Novas they want to be! But be fast, these customers don't like waiting too long! CUSTOMERS NEED CORES, YOU NEED TO CRAFT! Robots will come flooding in, asking for a energy core, so they too can have awesome powers just like you. It's your job to grab the empty energy cores, refine their shape and fill them with the correct energy sources. If you give a customer the wrong Nova-core, they'll end up angry! Make too many customers angry and you'll lose the game! So stay focused while making your energy cores. There's a total of 20 different combinations for you to make! 5 UNIQUE NOVAS, 5 UNIQUE PLAYSTYLES Every playable Nova has their own unique ability to help make the energy cores. Use these to speed up the workflow! Each Nova can only be picked once, but every Nova can help out with every task! UP TO 5 PLAYERS Work alone or together with up to 5 friends to help the customers evolve into a Nova! Just invite a friend from you friends list and start making energy cores!

rows.name: Planet Mort
rows.short_description: Adapt and live
rows.description_html: As soon as you wake up, life does not wait and you start to struggle. Choose to eat whatever you can find and stick with what you learn. Controls: - WASD/L-Stick: Move - Mouse/R-Stick: Move Camera - E/B: Interact - Shift/X: Crouch - Space/A: Jump ++ Crouch + Jump: Long Jump - LMB/RT(/RB): Attack ++ Jump + Attack: S-Jump ++ Move Back + Attack: S-Attack - RMB/LT(/LB): Aim Mode ++ Aim Mode + Attack: Shoot - MMB/R-Stick-In: Target Lock - Q/Select: Check Watch - Esc/Start: Pause Stranded on Planet Mort you go through one single day trying to stay alive. Every passing hour of that day breeds a new scenario with another problem to be solved. Your sole goal is to avoid starvation, your status is indicated in the top right of the HUD. To progress through the day, use mechanics such as running, jumping, diving, melee fighting, driving and shooting. There are multiple minigames and secret areas waiting to be found. The game supports manual saving and lets you create up to three save slots.

rows.name: PvPillman
rows.short_description: A topdown and 3rd person game for ideally 5 players.
rows.description_html: A short-run time game for preferably 5 players (I did not set a max number of players). Everyone will hunt the host player while the host tries to collect every pellet on the screen. The host is also going to play a top-down version of the game while everyone else is playing from a third person viewpoint. The host gains health from eating the other players, but also losses health when getting eaten by players. Doesn't seem to work for everyone, I had to mess around with UPNP settings on my router to let the game run normally.

rows.name: of the Devil
rows.short_description: Immerse yourself in neon, smoke, and high-stakes legal gambles as a Defense Attorney with uniquely Killer insights in this episodic, diabolically stylish visual novel adventure game.
rows.description_html: AN EPISODIC CYBERPUNK MURDER MYSTERY GAME Download 'of the Devil' for Free to play the entirety of the fully-fleshed out prologue chapter: When Morgan finds herself assigned as Public Defender for the man the police say has shot six people through the heart, she'll need to leverage all her wits and the full force of her 'unique insight' into the case to come out unscathed and on-top. Purchase additional Episodes at your leisure to pursue other self-contained mysteries. Follow along as Morgan battles mega-corporations, cyberpunk gangs, VR cultists, aristocratic secret-society conspiracies, and government weapons projects, both inside and outside the courtroom. Fight for the truth-  and the freedom to do whatever the Hell you want. THE YEAR IS 2086. There's a camera in every device and a half dozen devices on every citizen. There are tracking implants in every cybernetic and location tags on every bullet. No stone goes unturned- and every stone is accounted for. Violent crimes are cleared in 97% of cases. The few cases that make it to trial result in a guilty verdict 98% of the time. People are safer now than at any other time in history, and getting away with murder is nearly impossible. So if you find yourself wrongly accused... Better hope you've got a Killer Lawyer. KILLER PROTAGONIST, ESQUIRE Examine 3D crime scenes, question multifaceted characters, and take advantage of Morgan's own unique killer insight to pursue the truth for your clients in this episodic series of murder mystery stories. HIGH-STAKES DEDUCTIONS Build up your CREDIT by investigating thoroughly and asking the right questions- Then read your opponents' hands, call their bluffs, avoid their haymakers and slam down the right evidence to upend their logic. RICH WORLD, PERSONALITIES, AND STORIES Explore an atmospheric and vibrant world where cyberpunk rebels clash against the surveillance state, from both inside the justice system and far beyond the reach of the law.

rows.name: Mahjong Soul
rows.short_description: Mahjong Soul is an online game that adopted the classic Japanese Mahjong gameplay. Here, you can hone your mahjong skills with players from worldwide or spend leisure time with friends, bond with various charismatic characters, and experience an abundance of unique stories.
rows.description_html: Mahjong Soul is an online game that adopted the classic Japanese Mahjong gameplay. Here, you can hone your mahjong skills with players from worldwide or spend leisure time with friends, bond with various charismatic characters, and experience an abundance of unique stories. Classic Japanese Mahjong Mahjong Soul preserves the features of classic Japanese Mahjong (also known as Riichi Mahjong). You can play against opponents at similar skill levels to hone your skills. Easy tutorial for beginners Beginners are welcomed with easy-to-understand tutorials, which cover not just the basics but also teach you how to handle various game scenarios. With step-by-step guides, even beginners can become proficient in no time. Enjoy yourself with pals, or engage in global matches You can not only create private rooms to play with friends in Friend Room, but also battle players from around the world. Test each other's skills, and enjoy a variety of special and amusing mahjong modes. Meet an abundance of charismatic characters Interact with a range of charming characters that bring unique stories to life, enhancing your gaming experience as you form bonds and explore the world of Mahjong Soul with them. Fancy-up matches with decorations Immerse yourself in dynamic effects that make every mahjong match a thrilling game. From a tiny tile to an entire tablecloth, every detail can be customized to suit your taste. Expressive character emotes Make use of the emotes to liven up your matches. Engage in mischief and mayhem with hilarious character emotes!

rows.name: Oil Strike '75
rows.short_description: Get ready to earn while you learn in Oil Strike ’75, a fun, exciting, and educational new game from Cadal Corp! Run an oil rig and discover new oil deposits at the bottom of the sea – no matter the cost. Who knows what you’ll find in the official prequel to Still Wakes the Deep?
rows.description_html: Oil Strike '75 X WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation Oil Strike ’75 now supports optional charity donations via DLC sales.  Please note that Oil Strike '75's DLC packs do not contain any content or unlocks, in-game or otherwise. These are charity donation payments, and 95% of net publisher and developer revenue Secret Mode receives from these purchases will be donated to WDC, Whale and Dolphin Conservation. About the Game Experience the official prequel to Still Wakes the Deep , originally released in secret ahead of the BAFTA-winning horror masterpiece.  WHAT WILL YOU DISCOVER BELOW? Get ready to earn while you learn in Oil Strike ’75, a fun, exciting, and educational new game from Cadal Corp. where you’re tasked with running a rig and discovering new oil deposits at the bottom of the sea – no matter the cost. Who knows what you’ll find! Utilise super-safe seismic exploration to discover oil wells deep beneath the ground. Hop in and pilot a helicopter to bring vital supplies from shore. Run, jump, and climb your way to the top of the rig as you build your drill longer and longer – just be sure to avoid the totally normal health hazards! Then use the money you’ve earned from completing jobs to drill as deep as you can and discover brand new oil deposits that will help keep your rig afloat and most importantly make your shareholders super happy. Oh and don’t worry, there’s no such thing as too deep when you drill with Cadal! Learn the business of drilling for oil as you complete three fun yet increasingly tricky tasks to earn money to make your drill longer The more you complete, the longer your drill becomes, and the deeper you can go! Earn exclusive Steam achievements! Keep playing and who knows what you’ll discover! Please note: If you should discover any bugs, please call our bug hotline on: 0325 75

rows.name: La Bestia: The Migrant's Long Journey
rows.short_description: Imagine having to leave your home and everything you know behind. Live the experience of a migrant immersed in a lonely journey while listening to the stories of your companions.
rows.description_html: La Bestia: The Migrant's Long Journey is a virtual reality game that provides an immersive experience of the challenges faced by migrants on their journey from South America to the United States of America. The game is set on a train called La Bestia, where you take on the role of a migrant. You will encounter many other migrants on the train, each with their own unique story to share. These stories are based on real events and offer insights into the difficulties and experiences of migrants. You need to move around the environment and get closer to each migrant to hear their story. The game consists of two scenes. The first scene places you in a train car with other immigrants. It is a contemplative experience where you can interact with the migrants, who are represented as statues, by simply moving around. The second scene takes place inside a train car, and the mechanics are the same as in the first scene. The game automatically switches between the two scenes. It is a moving experience that offers a glimpse into the harsh reality of the migrant journey. In this version, all the migrant dialogues are in Spanish.

rows.name: Project Tape
rows.short_description: Experience the arrival of The Last Tape's protagonist in this short horror adventure that reveals what happened before the main events. Explore Lurmont’s abandoned facilities, avoid the mysterious creature, and descend step by step into a hell you might not escape from
rows.description_html: The Last Tape A Hidden Truth For over 50 years, Lurmont has kept dark and disturbing events hidden from the public eye. But everything changes when, during an exploration, tapes are discovered revealing the atrocities committed by the company. Only You After months of investigating Lurmont’s clandestine activities, you decide to venture alone into an abandoned estate that once belonged to the company. Unaware of what awaits you, you step into a place where the truth has been buried for years. Horror Without Horror? The Last Tape aims to immerse you in a constant psychological horror atmosphere, creating a sense of unease and suspense at all times. However, the game does not rely on cheap jump scares or extreme tension... or does it? The Story Doesn't End with the Prologue The narrative of The Last Tape will continue to evolve through chapters released periodically from the same launcher. Each new episode will offer unique experiences in found footage format, although the prologue will take a different approach. All the stories are connected, but it’s up to you to discover how. A Game Created by Two Passionate Developers This project was developed by two students passionate about the horror genre, aiming to deliver an innovative psychological horror experience. We use the powerful Unreal Engine 5 to bring this eerie adventure to life, keeping the price accessible to everyone. Plus, the prologue will be available completely free. Proyect Tape The story will begin with the Prologue of the same, every X time new chapters will be released

rows.name: Cat Got Your Tongue
rows.short_description: Cat Got Your Tongue is a vertical platformer where you play a mischievous black cat, jumping and attacking across a tongue to stop the protagonist from speaking, with quirky art, playful interactions, and fast-paced, challenging yet casual gameplay.
rows.description_html: Cat Got Your Tongue is a quirky little platformer inspired by the classic phrase “Cat got your tongue?” — a saying used when someone’s too shy or hesitant to speak. But in this game, you’re not the nervous human — you’re the mischief-making cat! You play as a naughty little black cat jumping and scrambling across a human’s tongue, determined to snatch his tiny voice and stop him from expressing his inner thoughts. Go get your claws and join our evil kitty crew! 🎮 Controls: Hold Arrow Keys or A & D to control jump direction Press Spacebar to attack enemies ✨ Features: Fun & Whimsical Interactions A vertical jumping game packed with surprises: dodging oral bacteria, avoiding tartar-blasting toothpaste, riding guinea pigs, slipping on buttered toast, or catching sight of mysterious waving kitties — all await your discovery. Cute and Grotesque Art Style A mix of adorable and weird visuals, with hand-drawn comic scenes between stages and alternate endings depending on your success or failure. Short and Snackable Gameplay Each round lasts just a few minutes — perfect for quick, casual play sessions. Endless Mode for Hardcore Cats An Endless level awaits players who crave a real challenge! 🐾 The game can be tricky — don’t lose your temper (or your keyboard)! ⚠️ Note: The game launches in fullscreen by default, which might affect resolution. Please adjust screen settings manually in “Setting.” Credits: Shanshan – Design, Art Finn – Design, Blueprint, Music

rows.name: Sunflower Pie
rows.short_description: A short story about a parasitic sunflower and her loyal son. Eat everything you can. Enjoy the sunshine. Do whatever it takes to make her happy. This is a prequel to Siren's Call: Escape Velocity.
rows.description_html: The worst thing about Oliver’s breakfast is that it wants to be eaten. Inspired by early RPGmaker horror games and Adult Swim bumpers, Sunflower Pie is a bite-sized visual novel with extra parasites (for flavor). Much like real life, it oscillates violently between discomfort and sincerity. Unlike real life, however, there is only one correct choice. Features: *You can beat this visual novel in 25 minutes *Oliver’s speech therapist is good at her job and owns a revolver *Learn about all the cool ways to remove ticks from your body *Made with love (sincerely)

rows.name: MUZY
rows.short_description: Explore the mystery behind a once-loved and hugely popular children's toy, also known as MUZY, in this terrifying horror adventure game. Several reports detail frightening incidents connected to accidents. Your job is to solve the puzzles and find the cause of these unsettling occurrences.
rows.description_html: This game was developed in collaboration with a Rybis Games, who has been unreachable for several months. Out of respect of our players, and Rybis Games, we’ve decided to make MUZY free to play. The events of MUZY take place in an abandoned industrial complex. Let me introduce 'NeuroWorld,' a trailblazing business that has effectively integrated artificial intelligence into toys for kids. For many children, these toys were first true friends, but when mishaps started to ruin their once joyful relationships, the beautiful story took a terrible turn. 'NeuroWorld' became a trailblazing company, becoming the first to successfully integrate artificial intelligence into a kid's toy. These creative toys were more than just playthings; they became true friends for a lot of kids. After experiencing great success, the business set up production facilities, which led to the development of the massive industrial complex known as 'Maybedi.' Many industries produce cutting-edge products within the complex, which is also home to NeuroWorld offices, a special daycare for the children of staff, and a large play area. Children actively participate in this situation by contributing comments on the company's continuing advances, going above and beyond simply providing amusement. The Maybedi complex is located in a quiet area a few miles from the closest populated area, strategically placed miles away from busy urban hubs. You're a private investigator, and one day you get an assignment to inspect the abandoned Maybedi Industrial Complex. You accept the offer after giving it some thought. You begin the game by entering the play area, where employees can leave their children to enjoy themselves. But why had the complex been closed? What lurks behind those rooms' doors? Why did a seemingly successful company decide to abandon this location? These are the questions you must answer. MUZY is a well-known character from the 'NeuroWorld' toy line. This amazing invention combines a robotic foundation wrapped in a soft knit cloth with an advanced artificial intelligence system. MUZY, one of the company's most notable projects, was incredibly successful and won over kids' hearts with its endearing appearance and amazing ability to move and interact on its own. A source of great success for the business, MUZY was essential in helping kids make friends, which was especially helpful for those who were shy. Because of its interactive features, which made it possible for meaningful connection in addition to providing entertainment, many people saw it as their best friend. At one point in time, word spread throughout the entire crew regarding the complex's imminent closure, a development that shocked and confused them all. There are still a lot of objects and traces of the once-bustling factory inside its walls. The complex was first gated off and guarded, which gave its abandoned grounds a sense of mystery. But eventually, for no apparent reason, the guards left their positions. Then, neighbors walking by the condominium started telling stories of a mix of eerie noises coming from its empty lot. There were also reports of strange animals seen nearby. In an attempt to solve the mystery surrounding the abandoned facility, it was decided to hire a private investigator in light of these odd circumstances. The detective enters the abandoned Maybedi Industrial Complex brandishing a toy gun. The detective uses the toy gun with small balls loaded to maneuver through the abandoned building and solve puzzles by firing precisely. The detective's path through the complex is distinguished by a calculated combination of puzzle-solving and exploration. The puzzles become more difficult as the detective goes along, necessitating strategic thinking to discover the truth behind the complex's closure. The toy gun is used by the detective in the third person as a dependable ally, a lighthearted but crucial component in the investigation into Maybedi's secrets. The investigator gets closer to comprehending the reasons for the complex's abandonment and the shadows that lurk in its forgotten corners with every picture. 1. Compelling Detective Story: Assume the role of a seasoned detective tasked with solving a series of mysterious and unsettling incidents connected to MUZY, some with fatal consequences. 2. Eerie Atmosphere: Explore a hauntingly atmospheric world filled with suspense, tension, and supernatural occurrences that will keep you on the edge of your seat. 3. Cryptic Puzzles: Challenge your wits with a variety of cryptic puzzles and riddles, each leading you closer to unraveling the true cause behind the terrifying events tied to MUZY. 4. Immersive Gameplay: Engage in an immersive gameplay experience with intuitive controls, realistic environments, and a gripping narrative that unfolds as you progress through the game. 5. Dark Secrets: Uncover the dark and hidden secrets surrounding MUZY, delving deep into its past and discovering the malevolent force that now lurks within this once-innocent children's toy. 6. Stunning Visuals: Enjoy high-quality graphics and visual effects that bring the nightmarish world of MUZY to life, intensifying the horror elements and enhancing the overall gaming experience. 7. Fear-Inducing Soundtrack: Immerse yourself further into the terror with a haunting soundtrack that enhances the atmosphere, keeping you on edge and heightening the suspense.

Many industries produce cutting-edge products within the complex, which is also home to NeuroWorld offices, a special daycare for the children of staff, and a large play area. Children actively participate in this situation by contributing comments on the company's continuing advances, going above and beyond simply providing amusement. The Maybedi complex is located in a quiet area a few miles from the closest populated area, strategically placed miles away from busy urban hubs. You're a private investigator, and one day you get an assignment to inspect the abandoned Maybedi Industrial Complex. You accept the offer after giving it some thought. You begin the game by entering the play area, where employees can leave their children to enjoy themselves. But why had the complex been closed? What lurks behind those rooms' doors? Why did a seemingly successful company decide to abandon this location? These are the questions you must answer. MUZY is a well-known character from the 'NeuroWorld' toy line. This amazing invention combines a robotic foundation wrapped in a soft knit cloth with an advanced artificial intelligence system. MUZY, one of the company's most notable projects, was incredibly successful and won over kids' hearts with its endearing appearance and amazing ability to move and interact on its own. A source of great success for the business, MUZY was essential in helping kids make friends, which was especially helpful for those who were shy. Because of its interactive features, which made it possible for meaningful connection in addition to providing entertainment, many people saw it as their best friend. At one point in time, word spread throughout the entire crew regarding the complex's imminent closure, a development that shocked and confused them all. There are still a lot of objects and traces of the once-bustling factory inside its walls. The complex was first gated off and guarded, which gave its abandoned grounds a sense of mystery. But eventually, for no apparent reason, the guards left their positions. Then, neighbors walking by the condominium started telling stories of a mix of eerie noises coming from its empty lot. There were also reports of strange animals seen nearby. In an attempt to solve the mystery surrounding the abandoned facility, it was decided to hire a private investigator in light of these odd circumstances. The detective enters the abandoned Maybedi Industrial Complex brandishing a toy gun. The detective uses the toy gun with small balls loaded to maneuver through the abandoned building and solve puzzles by firing precisely. The detective's path through the complex is distinguished by a calculated combination of puzzle-solving and exploration. The puzzles become more difficult as the detective goes along, necessitating strategic thinking to discover the truth behind the complex's closure. The toy gun is used by the detective in the third person as a dependable ally, a lighthearted but crucial component in the investigation into Maybedi's secrets. The investigator gets closer to comprehending the reasons for the complex's abandonment and the shadows that lurk in its forgotten corners with every picture. 1. Compelling Detective Story: Assume the role of a seasoned detective tasked with solving a series of mysterious and unsettling incidents connected to MUZY, some with fatal consequences. 2. Eerie Atmosphere: Explore a hauntingly atmospheric world filled with suspense, tension, and supernatural occurrences that will keep you on the edge of your seat. 3. Cryptic Puzzles: Challenge your wits with a variety of cryptic puzzles and riddles, each leading you closer to unraveling the true cause behind the terrifying events tied to MUZY. 4. Immersive Gameplay: Engage in an immersive gameplay experience with intuitive controls, realistic environments, and a gripping narrative that unfolds as you progress through the game. 5. Dark Secrets: Uncover the dark and hidden secrets surrounding MUZY, delving deep into its past and discovering the malevolent force that now lurks within this once-innocent children's toy. 6. Stunning Visuals: Enjoy high-quality graphics and visual effects that bring the nightmarish world of MUZY to life, intensifying the horror elements and enhancing the overall gaming experience. 7. Fear-Inducing Soundtrack: Immerse yourself further into the terror with a haunting soundtrack that enhances the atmosphere, keeping you on edge and heightening the suspense.

rows.name: Saturn
rows.short_description: Saturn is a tactical RPG set on the moons of Saturn and on Earth. The protagonist controls robots on the moons of Saturn and explores an underground city where one can find keys to the secrets of deep space.
rows.description_html: 'Saturn' is a tactical RPG set on Earth and the moons of Saturn. A mysterious signal from space causes the AI of machines to rebel against their creators across the entire Solar System. Defend Earth from the threat and connect with the robots on Saturn's moons to stop the apocalypse. You only have 3 days to save the world. Explore the World of the Future The year is 2062, a new era in space exploration. ARKA from Russia, Huang-Di from China, and BUF from Britain have established research stations throughout the Solar System. The discovery of a new form of communication—ether threads—has enabled more efficient space exploration using robots and drones. From Earth, operators of the 'Reflection' program remotely control machines in real time. Thanks to their work, research stations have been built on the major moons of Saturn, where international expeditions have been working for the past twenty years. Stop the End of the World Scanners indicate that a malicious signal is traveling through the ether threads from somewhere in Saturn’s orbit. Only through the 'Reflection' program on Earth can the source of the threat be discovered, the mystery of the disaster that has struck humanity unraveled, and the world saved. Time is running out. There is no escape from the crazed robots, neither on Earth nor in space. A civilization dependent on robots and new technologies faces disaster with significant human casualties unless the catastrophe is averted. On Earth and Saturn You are Akim Kovalev, a scientist and one of the top operators of the 'Reflection' program. Your life's work was deemed obsolete and shut down two years ago. Stop the catastrophe and prove that both 'Reflection' and you still have a place in this world. Save your colleagues and friends on Earth while gathering information about what's happening. Connect to and control robots on Saturn’s moons through 'Reflection' to uncover the mysterious signal that is driving the machines insane. Experiment and Think Tactically Time in combat flows only for you. Use it to carefully plan your tactics and strategy. You have a wide array of weapons at your disposal, ranging from melee to powerful laser and electromagnetic cannons. Fight on Earth yourself and through robots on Saturn. Death is not the end. Failures along the way will return you to the start of the cycle. Use this to try different weapons and combat approaches. As many times as it takes... Make Important Decisions Solve emerging problems in different ways. The lives on Earth and the fate of the entire world depend on your choices. Negotiate or take an aggressive approach—the outcome of the game is shaped by your actions. Restart the cycle, make different decisions, and experience different outcomes. Experiment and find your own way to stop the catastrophe!

rows.name: LISA: The First
rows.short_description: A memory of madness.
rows.description_html: Explore Lisa Armstrong’s mind as she tries to cope with the burden caused by her father Marty. Traverse a slipping reality as you attempt to leave home and recover your memories. Only, escape is not so easy. Features and Gameplay - LISA the First is a short and surreal exploration game reminiscent of retro-RPGs. - Navigate the twisting world of Lisa’s mind, finding hidden doors and pathways to strange and exotic places. - Explore these spaces to uncover Lisa’s memories and unveil the sinister forces laying in wait. - Interact with a cast of dark and strange characters who persist across multiple memories. - Collect faded thoughts as VHS tapes, and seek a way to replay them in order to gain insight into the sights and sounds you encounter.

rows.name: My Friend The Spider
rows.short_description: A small 'horror' narrative game about isolation and depression.
rows.description_html: A small 'horror' narrative game about isolation and depression. My Friend The Spider is a 10-15 minute walking simulator where the player finds themselves voluntarily locked in a room to escape and isolate due to their current emotional state and befriending a spider that grows in size with the story's progression. I originally worked on the game for a month and a half around October 2022. My idea was to experiment with the Unity engine in order to practice my coding and get used to the engine. I had a short story in mind based on personal experiences and thought it would be a good idea to flesh it out as a narrative 'game' instead. Everything bar the art assets was done by me. My wife helped with the voice acting (and emotional support). After releasing it, it got quite a few number of views and plays - seeing people's comments about how they were moved by it, I realized a Steam release was in order. I took my time, but after sitting down and fixing some nasty bugs and others (white text on a white background? Really dude?) I am now happy to release it on Steam and let it be free with a nice, deserved final update. I hope you enjoy it. Take care.

rows.name: Njuma
rows.short_description: Njuma is a 2D narrative driven pixel game with multiple endings. Be the difference your family needs as they draw their final breath.
rows.description_html: What is Njuma? Njuma is a narrative driven pixel art game with an offbeat interpretation of the Game Jam’s theme: Take a Deep Breath. Draw your last breath and become the family's Spirit-Guide and Guardian of the Ancestral Tree . Help your descendents in their final moments by bringing them comfort and serenity as they transition to the afterlife. The Ancestral Tree withers, generational trauma lurking in its shadow. You must piece together a tragedy and soothe a soul-scar which refuses to heal. The Fate of the family is in your hands. What you can expect A short walking simulator game, where you interact and get help from items and NPC's in the environment to interpret the story. The NPC's interact with you as you walk close to objects, giving you clues of what they are seeking. Pick up items, and place them to make a choice. Your choice matters! About development This game was developed as a submission for the Lv. 99 Game Jam in 2023. It was developed in the span of 10 days, and worked on further for 3 days for an update including bugfixes and a dialogue system unlocked by completing the game.

rows.name: The Zhukov Line
rows.short_description: A short one-room-horror which takes place on a livestock train in a dystopian Soviet state
rows.description_html: The Zhukov Line is a short one-room-horror which takes place on a livestock train in a dystopian Soviet state. First day on the job... Accepting a new job as a transport supervisor for the Chernovar Oversight Division you have been tasked with transporting a special livestock specimen. As you awake on a cold iron train, you hear ungodly screams from the coaches behind you. Scrambling to your computer, you read your mission statement and learn that the only way to survive is by keeping the specimen restrained, by maintaining industrial grade systems built into the train Keep the train running... Can you keep the systems repaired long enough to reach your destination and escape the aberrant monstrosity tearing its way through the train carriages to meet you?

rows.name: Gamebox
rows.short_description: Gamebox is a free and open source sandbox game centered on user generated content. You decide what you want to play, be it in 3D or 2D, single-player or multiplayer, or create and upload your own games.
rows.description_html: Gamebox is a free and open source sandbox game centered on user generated content. You decide what you want to play, be it in 3D or 2D, single-player or multiplayer, or create and upload your own games. Features and content: * Included are two very basic games in 3D and 2D featuring basic physics to demonstrate how Gamebox can load games * Single-player and multiplayer games created by the community available in the Steam Workshop * Create and upload your own games to the Workshop (read the Help section in-game for instructions) * Both 3D and 2D are supported * Games may be moddable by using the Workshop * Some mods on the Workshop may be cross-compatible with multiple Gamebox games * Made with Godot Engine

rows.name: Road Toad
rows.short_description: Embark on a whimsical journey with Road Toad, a charming arcade adventure featuring a goofy toad navigating minimalist landscapes, collecting power-ups, and facing quirky challenges.
rows.description_html: Road Toad invites players into a world where whimsy meets challenge, delivering a unique twist on the classic arcade experience. As the goofy amphibian protagonist, navigate through captivating minimalist landscapes, encountering a variety of obstacles and dynamic challenges. Charming Minimalism: Road Toad boasts a visually appealing, minimalist art style that adds a touch of charm to the gameplay. Quirky Soundtrack: Immerse yourself in the world of Road Toad with a playful and goofy musical backdrop that complements the game's silly atmosphere. Dynamic Gameplay: Encounter a variety of obstacles and challenges as you guide your toad through themed levels, each offering a unique and engaging experience. Power-Up Bonanza: Experiment with an array of power-ups, and stay on your toes as we continue to introduce new strategic elements based on player feedback. Community-Driven Development: Join us in shaping the future of Road Toad! Engage with the community, share your thoughts, and witness the game evolve through regular updates and additions.

rows.description_html: ABOUT 'Detective Kiwi' is a free to play multiplayer puzzle game that designed up to 6 players, featuring a simple rule: There will be 4 images every round. You need to find them as fast as you can. PURPOSE Simple and entertaining gameplay allows you to improve your finding skills and memory. Every round, you need to find 4 images in a bunch of others and press ring button as fast as you can. The player who find more images fastly, will get more score. CUSTOMIZABLES You can customize your avatar, avatar frames, emotes and icons.

rows.description_html: It's the day after Christmas, following another successful night of delivering presents, Santa must endure one more challenge, The Elf Kicking contest. This relaxing 2D game features a player character kicking and punching Santa's elves through a variety of winter backdrops with a singular goal, to hit the target object and advance to the next level.

rows.name: Grabbers in the Woods
rows.short_description: A unique first person atmospheric exploration game set in a surreal woods nestled within the confines of a bizarre dream known as the Collective Reverie, a nexus of all dreamers where their individual hopes and fears coalesce into a bizarre nightmare.
rows.description_html: A unique first person atmospheric exploration game set in a surreal woods nestled within the confines of a bizarre dream known as the Collective Reverie, a nexus of all dreamers where their individual hopes and fears coalesce into a bizarre nightmare. In this eerie landscape, you're not just a visitor but a catalyst for change. Your interactions—whether with the ethereal phantoms, the inexplicable creatures, or horrors that defy the limits of human comprehension—will shape the world around you. Each choice you make reveals a new path, offering a glimmer of hope to escape the nightmarish reality or, alternatively, seducing you further into the unfathomable depths of darkness. The world of your dream is an ever-shifting maze, generated anew with each step you take. The environment and its inhabitants respond dynamically to your actions, making every journey unique. The items you choose to interact with determine the creatures and challenges that will emerge, crafting a personalized tale of terror and wonder. Hidden within this dream are nine distinct endings, each a conclusion to the story you weave with your choices. These endings range from finding a way to break free from the grip of the nightmare, to surrendering to its sinister allure and plunging deeper into the abyss. Uncovering these conclusions requires keen observation, puzzle-solving prowess, and the courage to face the unknown. Discover the secrets hidden in plain sight, solve obscure puzzles that challenge your understanding, and decipher cryptic messages that hint at a deeper mystery. Your journey through the surreal woods is a quest for truth, a search for answers in a place where questions multiply with every whispered wind. Will you find your way out, or will you become a permanent resident of the dream?

rows.name: Pepa's Adventure
rows.short_description: Pepa's Adventure: a papercut point-and-click book. The characters and backgrounds are crafted from handmade papercut art. Pepa, a paper fairy girl, lived with book fairy Lex. One day, scissor fairy Slash cut and stole his pages. Pepa embarks on an adventure to recover stolen pages.
rows.description_html: Story The paper fairy Pepa lived harmoniously with the book fairy Lex. However, one day, the scissor fairy Slash intruded into their home and snatched away pages from Lex's book. Deprived of strength, Lex returned to being a silent book. To reclaim the stolen pages, Pepa rises to the occasion. Using the power to manipulate paper freely, Pepa embarks on a journey to the scissor fairy's lair, overcoming various challenges along the way. About this game Pepa's Adventure is a point-and-click picture book made with papercut art. The story unfolds through pictures alone, progressing the narrative without words. Characters and backgrounds are crafted from handmade papercut art. Embark on an adventure with Pepa, meeting the enchanting inhabitants of the papercut world along the way.

rows.name: Cyclic Warriors
rows.short_description: Cyclic Warriors is a movement shooter focused on time travel and speed. Wall-run, slide, kick and bunny-hop to build up massive momentum. Time travel to dodge bullets and flank your enemies. Slow down time for easy kills!
rows.description_html: Enter the mind-bending, adrenaline-fueled world of 'Cyclic Warriors,” where time is just as deadly as a gun. With a click of a button, propel yourself through time, or freeze time completely and watch as bullets hover mid-air! But whatever you do, don’t stand still. You might have all the time in the world, but so do your enemies! Time Travel Use time travel to flank enemies, dodge bullets or manipulate the world around you. The world was destroyed and lies in ruins, walls are missing, roofs have fallen out, and devices are on fire. Use this to your advantage. Time travel to the future, where a once solid wall now has a gaping hole. Use the ruins to your advantage to prevent the destruction. Be careful though! Your enemies have sent their own Cyclic Warriors back in time to stop you! Advanced Movement Wall-run, slide, bunny hop and kick off walls to build up incredible speed. Source style air-strafe to change directions mid-air! The game is focused on allowing players to chain movement mechanics. The speed limit is your skill. Multiplayer Hop into intense multiplayer PVP battles, or play with bots of your skill level! The game is FREE, so there are no official servers, instead any player can host their own game. Anyone in your country can join your game, or you can just play with friends! Cyclic Warriors Early Access is a very casual experience, currently with no competitive game modes, just to have some quick fun! Inspiration The game is inspired by my favorite FPS mission of all time, Effect and Cause, as well as quite a few different arena shooters. I hope you enjoy!

rows.short_description: A fun simulation/puzzle game combining elements of chess puzzles and stock trading. Complete challenging missions and puzzles or simply play a quick game vs AI on multiple difficulties. Personalize your experience with card backs and more in-game rewards.
rows.description_html: A turn-based, strategic puzzle game about creating and expanding companies and trading stocks! It combines strategic depth elements of chess with a fun and challenging stock trading experience. Wisely place tiles on the board to force lucrative mergers. You may want to invest in the involved companies first though! Solve various puzzles and missions on pre-defined maps vs other competitors Earn in-game rewards (Achievements, Leaderboards, Levels, Ranks) Customize your gameplay experience with different card backs and other cosmetics, unlockable through gameplay

rows.name: Intergalactic Pawn Shop: Prologue
rows.short_description: Intergalactic Pawn Shop is a single-player, story rich, pawn shop simulation game. In your hands lies a powerful trading network, making you a magnet for those seeking your services. Will you use this influence wisely? Remember, the outcomes of your decisions will rest solely on your shoulders.
rows.description_html: WISHLIST THE FULL GAME OTHER GAMES About the Game Dive into 'Intergalactic Pawn Shop,' a captivating, story-rich pawn shop simulation game! Imagine being the key player in a bustling interstellar economy, where each customer brings a piece of the cosmos to your counter. 'Intergalactic Pawn Shop' melds the intricate management of a pawn shop—encompassing repairs, auctions, and the creation of compelling displays—with the significant decisions and ethical dilemmas of operating such an establishment in a futuristic setting. Will you emerge as a beacon of prosperity in the galaxy, or will your choices propel you into a web of intrigue and shadowy transactions? Envision yourself negotiating with an alien over a mysterious artifact, then meticulously repairing a damaged starship component. 'Intergalactic Pawn Shop' fuses the day-to-day mechanics of pawn shop operations with the expansive narrative arcs of a sci-fi saga. This game invites players to step into the role of a pawn shop clerk in a science fiction universe, blending detailed simulation with a branching narrative that culminates in multiple endings. Features - Immerse yourself in a detailed pawn shop simulation, overseeing repairs, auctions, and the display area to attract a diverse clientele. - Embark on a non-linear adventure with choices that dictate your path, leading to unique endings and determining not only the destiny of your shop but the wider universe as well. A powerful trading network is at your disposal, positioning you as a magnet for those in search of your services. The question remains: How will you wield this influence?

rows.name: Swing Into Zero-G: Space Parkour Race
rows.short_description: Fast-paced multiplayer racing game set in the vastness of space. Compete against friends or online rivals in intense races, where quick reflexes and strategic use of diverse skills determine the victor. Embrace the challenge of swinging your way to victory in this exhilarating space-themed race!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Swing Into Zero-G, space racers! An adrenaline-pumping multiplayer racing adventure game set in the endless expanse of space. In this game, you’ll experience the excitement of defying gravity and soaring through cosmic environments, where skill, strategy, and quick reflexes reign supreme. The Thrill of Space Racing: Embark on a high-speed journey through a series of space-themed racetracks. Each track is filled with unique obstacles and challenges that require mastery of the swing and gravity mechanics. Whether you're dodging asteroids or navigating through intricate space stations, every race is an exhilarating new experience. Swing Mechanics and Gravity Manipulation: At the heart of 'Swing Into Zero-G' is its innovative swinging mechanic. Players must use their grappling hook-like tool to swing from point to point, creating a thrilling and fluid racing experience. Combine this with the ability to manipulate gravity, and you have a race that's not just about speed, but about clever movement and strategy. Competitive Multiplayer: Racing is more fun with friends, and Swing Into Zero-G delivers an intense multiplayer experience. Compete in casual races with friends, or dive into solo matches for a more competitive thrill. With support for up to four players, every race is a chaotic and fun-filled battle for first place. Diverse Skills and Abilities: To give you an edge in races, Swing Into Zero-G features a variety of skills and abilities. From firing homing missiles to laying traps, freezing opponents, or blinding them temporarily. Use these skills wisely to disrupt your competitors and secure your victory. Customizable Controls: The game offers a variety of control schemes to suit your playstyle. Whether you prefer a keyboard and mouse setup or a controller, you can customize your controls for optimal comfort and performance. Vibrant Visuals and Immersive Environments: Each race takes place against the backdrop of stunningly rendered cosmic landscapes. From the vibrant colors of alien flora to the metallic sheen of space stations, the visuals in Swing Into Zero-G are a feast for the eyes. Key Features: Fast-paced multiplayer races set in space Unique swinging and gravity mechanics Competitive & casual multiplayer modes A variety of skills and abilities to master Customizable controls for keyboard and mouse or controller Stunning space-themed environments and racetracks Swing Into Zero-G is more than just a race; it's an unforgettable adventure across the stars. Are you ready to swing into action?

rows.name: Nuclear Day
rows.short_description: Nuclear Day is a story-based role-playing game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Explore the secrets of this world. Fight monsters. Pass tests and solve puzzles. Become your own in this tragic world.
rows.description_html: A mesmerizing survival game with a unique atmosphere. Survive in a city that has been hit by a nuclear strike. Can you survive in a world where there was a nuclear explosion? There is radiation, hunger, disease and suffering all around you. Your goal is to escape from the dying city and find the love of your youth. A unique atmosphere and a poignant storyline. Uncover the mystery of the missing documents and make a choice: save the people around you or leave them to perish. What awaits you in the game: — Unique story. Along the way, you will find many stories of different people, fascinating puzzle quests and the right to choose during the passage of quests. — Hard survival. You will be haunted by typical survivor problems such as hunger, disease, thirst, the gradually approaching nuclear winter and bandits. Eliminate enemies to survive and avoid unnecessary attention. — Dynamic game world. In the game world, weather conditions, the alignment of forces of groups of people outside, and so on will change. Get a loyal companion who will help you in your search and protect you from danger. — Fistfights. Engage in fierce duels with other survivors, where only strength and agility decide the outcome. The Demo Version Is Available Now.

rows.name: Nova Hearts: The Spark
rows.short_description: Join Luce and her friends in this FREE first chapter: The Spark! A mysterious force transforms you and other residents of Vermillion into heroes and villains. TEXT, DATE and FIGHT in this turn-based combat dating adventure!
rows.description_html: Experience the first chapter of Nova Hearts for FREE! As Luce, become a superhero in your hometown of Vermillion after a mysterious force magically transforms some of its residents. Reconnect with friends, family and new people, building your relationships as you progress. TEXT, DATE and FIGHT in this turn-based combat dating adventure. Express your relationships with strategic turn-based combat Transform into your cosmic alter-egos and utilize your unique powers to battle enemies from another dimension. Using the time-line feature, plan and set up attacks and combos with your team of super powered allies, then unleash your embodied emotions on enemies to do immense damage to them! Work together using combos to really maximize your strategy and unlock new powers as you grow to take down bosses and their goons. Connect to the world Your phone is a lifeline to your community and to your powers! Gain insight into the world, your town and your connections through a collection of apps in the phone interface. Gain affection, approval and dislike through your choices in the narrative and see how your relationships are growing. Check in on your crush, develop your magical skills and get the latest gossip in town. Discover the cosmic mystery of your powers When returning to your home town, you don’t expect things to be much different than when you left but now, things couldn’t be more different. With new power coursing through the town, reconnect with old friends, meet new ones and pursue the strange origins of the cosmic madness prowling the streets. Where did this come from? Why did this happen? And why is everyone so incredibly hot now!?

rows.name: Elemental Engagements
rows.short_description: Wield god powers and command legions of elemental thralls against your friends! Elemental Engagements is a split-screen, versus, real-time-strategy game. Gain favor with the elemental gods to use their 16 powers, battle on 3 maps, and play with either Keyboard or Controller!
rows.description_html: Wield god powers and command legions of elemental thralls against your friends! Elemental Engagements is a split screen, versus, real-time-strategy game. Gain favor with the elemental gods to use their 16 powers, battle on 3 maps, and play with either Keyboard or Controller! Elemental God Powers As a major wind god, you'll wield wind powers. However, winning the favor of the other gods will grant you fire, water, and earth god powers. Use wind to control the battlefield! Use fire to damage your opponent! Use water to support your units! Use earth to deny enemy movement! Sacrifice and Gain Favor As a match progresses, you can choose which elements you will sacrifice your thralls to. The more territory you capture, the more favor and god powers you will gain for the associated elements, but you can only have a limited amount! This means that no game will play the same and each player must choose their sacrifices wisely. Pick Up & Play Elemental Engagements is a progressively-faster paced game on match by match basis. This means that most matches will last 5-20 minutes. The controls are designed specifically for the gamepad and split-screen gameplay, so RTS veterans and casual players alike will find tons of fun and room to strategize!

rows.name: Conor Origins - T Trilogy
rows.short_description: Experience Conor's first three visual novels. There's a story about a lonely man going for a walk, a guy getting tapped in a prison cell on an island, and a girl trying to confess to her weird crush.
rows.description_html: Conor's first three visual novels have been rereleased in one package! See the world through the eyes of a lonely man talking a walk, try to escape from a secluded prison, or help a girl confess to her crush. While one on them is a kinetic visual novel, there won't be any choices to make, but the other two will have a big impact on the world the characters are in. They Cannot Hear Me It's the middle on winter and a lonely man goes for a walk late at night. He spends the time thinking about how sad his life has become and how things will likely never change for the better for him. Will anything interesting happen on his walk or is he doomed to spend the rest of his life alone? As he walks around town he'll be reminded of events from his past. The man in the story doesn't have a name because it's not really important, so you can assume it to be whatever you want. Since this is a short kinetic visual novel there really isn't much else to say. There are no choices, it's just a really short story. Trapped When you wake up in a prison cell, you have no memory of who you are or how you even got there. If you don't want to rot to death, it's up to you to find a way out and explore the island you've been trapped on with a girl you'll meet outside named Mila. Like you, she has no idea how she got to the island or what's going on. If you want to get out of there, both of you are going to have to work to together to escape! If you're not careful, your choices could lead to your death or you'll just have to die of old age alone. Whichever comes first. The Weird One Camille has made up her mind and plans to confess her feelings to a friend of hers. However, what she doesn't know is that this guy is much weirder than she thinks. Whatever choices she makes will have a huge effect on whatever universe she's in. Some decisions may allow her to continue to have a normal life but others will throw her in all kinds of weird situations. rows.about_html: Conor's first three visual novels have been rereleased in one package! See the world through the eyes of a lonely man talking a walk, try to escape from a secluded prison, or help a girl confess to her crush. While one on them is a kinetic visual novel, there won't be any choices to make, but the other two will have a big impact on the world the characters are in. They Cannot Hear Me It's the middle on winter and a lonely man goes for a walk late at night. He spends the time thinking about how sad his life has become and how things will likely never change for the better for him. Will anything interesting happen on his walk or is he doomed to spend the rest of his life alone? As he walks around town he'll be reminded of events from his past. The man in the story doesn't have a name because it's not really important, so you can assume it to be whatever you want. Since this is a short kinetic visual novel there really isn't much else to say. There are no choices, it's just a really short story. Trapped When you wake up in a prison cell, you have no memory of who you are or how you even got there. If you don't want to rot to death, it's up to you to find a way out and explore the island you've been trapped on with a girl you'll meet outside named Mila. Like you, she has no idea how she got to the island or what's going on. If you want to get out of there, both of you are going to have to work to together to escape! If you're not careful, your choices could lead to your death or you'll just have to die of old age alone. Whichever comes first. Will Camille be able to tell Dave how he she feels about him or will he drag him into whatever weird things are going on with him? All of these stories aren't very long which is way they've been bundled together in one collection.

rows.name: DarkStorm
rows.short_description: Play as MARS (Machine of Absolute Retaliation and Safeguard), a robot programmed to exterminate the treacherous aliens who have taken over Razor City. As MARS, you must free Razor City from its domination in order to save the survivors from their doom.
rows.description_html: Long ago, humanity was ambushed by a mysterious alien race. Many perished—while those who survived were forced to find refuge in the mountains. Many years have passed, and the survivors cannot continue their refuge in the mountains. They must return home... Play as MARS (Machine of Absolute Retaliation and Safeguard), a robot programmed to exterminate the treacherous aliens who have taken over Razor City. As MARS, you must free Razor City from its domination in order to save the survivors from their doom. In DarkStorm, you must fight endless waves of aliens. As you pass each wave, the map grows larger, allowing you to explore more. Random collectibles will be spawned throughout the map, including health, ammo, weapon upgrades, and random weapon crates. There are three types of enemies, a Bat, Brute, and Crab. Each enemy has a special set of skills, so you have to watch out as you fighting them. The game includes only one gamemode, which is the endless wave. Once you pass wave 8, the map is completely open for you to explore.

rows.description_html: Overdrive Warfare is an FPS shooter developed by Dynamite Games. Immerse yourself in the first chapter of the Overdrive universe as Task Force Scorpion unite with the Lumar Republic to fight a relentless threat known as the Zarya Group. Fight your way through the war-torn environments of the once peaceful Lumar Isle in this fast-paced arena shooter with a variety of weapon attachments, player modifications and customization options becoming available as you level up. Drop into the hottest Zarya Group occupied territory, Zarya Isle, to be the last one standing. Collect loot, explore the military-occupied isle and survive against a rapidly shrinking safe zone.

rows.name: THANATOS
rows.short_description: THANATOS is a first-person psychological horror mystery game that involves finding clues, solving puzzles, and uncovering secrets to prevent a friend from taking their own life.
rows.description_html: In a chilling moment, your phone rings with an anonymous caller saying they are about to take their own life. Faced with this critical situation, what will you do? Will you embark on a mission to rescue them from the depths of despair? Move quickly because time is running out. IMMERSIVE EXPERIENCE Semi-realistic graphics, minimal user interfaces, and a creepy ambience work together to create an immersive experience. SOLVE PUZZLES Puzzles and clues serve as gateways to uncover the hidden truth. Whether deciphering cryptic messages or navigating surreal mindscapes, every puzzle is designed to be mentally stimulating and integral to the progression of the narrative. UNIQUE LEVELS Embark on a journey across three different floors, each with increasing difficulty. To complete each floor, you must unlock the stairway exit and enter it. Each floor features new puzzles, clues, and sounds that will help you reach your final destination to save a life. RANDOMIZED JUMPSCARES This element of surprise ensures that no two playthroughs are ever the same. Brace yourself for the unexpected as every corner turned and every dark corridor becomes a potential breeding ground for heart-pounding moments. DISTURBING SOUNDTRACK With a haunting musical score and meticulously designed sound effects that intensify the atmosphere, the soundscape will create a sense of dread and unease, ensuring you that you will remain on the edge of your seat

rows.name: Grim's Gambit
rows.short_description: Get ready for a tale where every cup poured is a step closer to unraveling the mysteries that bind the afterlife. Take on a soul-stirring quest as you serve lost souls, piece together your forgotten past, and unveil the chilling secrets of the Stygian Keep.
rows.description_html: Take a Coffee Break While Death Awaits. In Grim's Gambit, step into the shoes of Nox, who faces an unexpected twist of fate—trading death for a life behind the counter of an enigmatic coffee shop within the eerie Stygian Keep. As Nox, you're sentenced to an otherworldly coffee shop in the desolate Stygian Keep instead of facing death. With amnesia clouding your past, you'll navigate a series of interactive puzzles and engage with unique characters to piece together your story. Experience a blend of dark mystery and quirky humor as you uncover secrets, confront existential themes, and redefine what it means to be alive in a world suspended between realms. Death Denied, Coffee Supplied: Your New Role in the Underworld! In Chapter 2 of Grim's Gambit, players continue Nox's thrilling journey through the Stygian Keep. Following the chaotic and darkly humorous events of the coffee shop, Nox faces new challenges and uncovers deeper mysteries. As he navigates through the Stygian Keep, he must manage the bustling demands of the coffee shop, meet intriguing new characters, and investigate the hidden secrets of this eerie realm. chapter 1 & 2 Available Now! For development and game updates, follow our official Instagram Page: @grimsgambit

rows.name: Building Block Cities - Fire Copter Drills
rows.short_description: This game includes two major parts: building a city scene using the given building blocks and finishing fire copter drills on the scene. The building blocks can be assembled by matching color-coded faces on the blocks, and a drill is finished after the fire copter flies through all waypoint gates.
rows.description_html: This game includes two major parts: building a city scene using the given building blocks and finishing fire copter drills on the scene. Initially, an example city scene is included in the game. Players can build their own city scenes by editing this example. The building blocks can be assembled by matching color-coded faces on the blocks. Waypoint gates (also a type of the given building blocks) should be included in a city scene, and these gates can be connected to form a closed loop. This loop is for fire copter drills just like racetracks are for car races. A drill is finished after the fire copter flies through all waypoint gates (three laps of the loop).
