rows.name: Picker Bot 42
rows.short_description: Explore, discover items, find Wassie lore, upgrade PB42 to gloriously defeat mutant plants and fly back home
rows.description_html: Explore, discover items, find Wassie lore, upgrade PB42 to gloriously defeat mutant plants and fly back home PB42 Your peaceful work assignment goes wrong as your navigation system gets damaged by some pesky space debris. Luckily, the picker bot spaceships have one backup route to the Merchant Bay, a big trade hub. After the emergency landing on a seemingly lifeless planet, PB42 discovers that it is full of artifacts from its former inhabitants. A perfect job for a picker bot. But the sound sensors detect some rustle from beneath. Something is lurking… Upgrade to return home Platform you way through the underground rift, which changes every time you enter. But listen carefully, as something is lurking in the dark and you as a picker bot are not equipped for those encounters yet. Find and pick up various collectibles, check their values and drop what's worth less, but such precious artifacts will always sell well at the Merchant Bay. The Merchant Bay offers scrap parts from different types of bots. If you have credits, of course. Thrusters, blasters, homing missiles, illumination, extra durability, you name it. And what’s that over there in the back, behind the gruesome Merchant Wassie? A shiny new navigation system to replace your damaged one? How in the universe can an ordinary picker bot afford it though... Splurge on a blaster and you want regret it, as those angry mutant plants hold lots of extraordinary artifcats and guard chests with even more valuable loot. And completing the item sets can definitely be lucrative. Upgrade PB42 into a formidable machine to finally navigate back home.

rows.name: LIO
rows.short_description: Unravel the story of a boy who wakes up in a mysterious world without any memories.
rows.description_html: Lio was just a regular college student, until one day he found himself in a twisted alternative reality without any memories. Break the fourth wall and collaborate with him to find out his story. With almost 2 years of active development on his back, 'LIO' aims to stand out as unique experience by using multiple artstyles and forms of gameplay. Play and solve riddles across full 3D and isometric-2D sequences, all while uncovering Lio's story across 2D-pixel art and 3D cutscenes. Along with multiple ways of exploring the videogame medium, 'LIO' also puts together the work of 11 different musical and SFX artists, while also featuring 3 vocal perfomances. The soundtrack will surely get you caught in a unique atmosphere. Reaching 'the end' means nothing, or pehaps it does? With two main endings and 3 small sub-endings, those with an high enough attention span will be able to play from 3 to 6 hours before the full story is unravelled. (Not including the easter eggs... hehehehe). 'LIO' is a completely free game developed by a single person with the only intent of sharing passion for this incredible entertainment medium we all love and to celebrate creative endeavor without caring too much about nowadays standards. It's simple, very authorial and without too many premises, but i still hope you'll love it as much as i do! Created by Fili - In loving memory and dedicated to S.B. (1968 - 2022)

rows.name: Solemn Knights: Entirely Ours Definitive Edition
rows.short_description: A 2D, turned-based, story driven RPG.
rows.description_html: 'Solemn Knights: Entirely Ours Definitive Edition' is an engaging 2D turn-based RPG that takes players on a journey with Thelonius, a valiant knight of the kingdom of Astoria, who suddenly awakes in a completely unknown world. As Thelonius embarks on his adventure, players will experience a captivating story of mystery, loss, discovery, and friendship. Throughout the game, players will guide Thelonius on his path to unravel the secrets of this new realm and aid him in his quest to return home. With nostalgic driven visuals, classic turn-based gameplay, and a compelling story, 'Solemn Knights: Entirely Ours' offers a captivating and thought provoking indie RPG experience. Whether you are a seasoned fan of the classics, or a newcomer to the genre, Solemn Knights: Entirely Ours is certain to grab your attention. Are you ready to embark on an epic adventure with Thelonius, and discover the secrets that lie ahead? For more content, community resources and bug reports, please visit our discord.

rows.name: Liquid Light
rows.short_description: A relaxing 1bit puzzle game set in a world where all the light is liquid. There are all sorts of creatures in the darkness, waiting for the light to bring them form, but no need to worry, they are quite tame.
rows.description_html: A relaxing 1bit puzzle game set in a world where all the light is liquid. There are all sorts of creatures in the darkness, waiting for the light to bring them form, but no need to worry, they are quite tame. This puzzle game revolves around utilizing the liquid light and liquid dark to gain the curiosity and cooperation of the other creatures in the world. The Lightposts and Darkposts will be tools for your success, but with the help of the other creatures in the world, can you progress. While sometimes the creatures are covered in darkness and lack physical form, that can sometimes be advantageous as they no longer block the way. Sometimes though, you need a creature who's body is covered in light that allows it to take a physical form and help you cross gaps that would otherwise spell your doom. This is a puzzle game inspired by the classic game Lode Runner, but capitalizing on the puzzle aspect and downplaying the franticness of the game. The Creatures in the world also feature incredibly simple AI so they always do exactly what you intend for them to do. This game also features a level select which is accessible through the pause menu just in case you get hung up on one particular puzzle. Complete with 8-bit sound effects and peculiar creatures, this game is certain to tickle your brain! This game currently features: - 1 Tutorial - 16 Levels - Five Creature variants - Levers - Two Lamppost Variants - Light Platforms - Also a home screen... because of course

rows.name: Dumb Castle
rows.short_description: The Dumb Castle is just made to bully players! Jump into the castle with your friends and get bullied by the various maps and levels waiting for you with some horror elements!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Dumb Castle , where logic takes a backseat and chaos reigns supreme! In this hilarious and unpredictable adventure, you're one of many quirky contestants tasked with surviving absurd challenges, navigating wacky obstacles, and battling your way through the most ridiculous castle ever built. Key Features 🏰 Outlandish Levels : Dash, dodge, and dive through a series of wild rooms, from collapsing bridges to rotating platforms, each designed to keep you on your toes. 💥 Slapstick Physics : Trip, slip, and stumble your way to victory as your character flails through chaos with hilariously exaggerated physics. 🎭 Colorful Characters : Play as a cast of wacky characters, each with their own silly animations and emotes. ⚔️ Compete or Collaborate : Form uneasy alliances with friends or betray them for glory in chaotic multiplayer modes. 🎉 Non-Stop Fun : Packed with laugh-out-loud moments, unexpected surprises, and enough dumb decisions to keep you coming back for more. Are You Ready for the Madness? In Dumb Castle , thinking too hard is your greatest weakness, and embracing the chaos is the only way to succeed. Do you have what it takes to emerge as the ultimate champion, or will you become just another royal fool? Step inside the castle and find out if you dare! What's In The Game? 15+ Levels To Play Upto 10 Players Can Compete P2P Lobbies Adventure With Different Levels And Aesthetics

rows.name: Bitty Knight
rows.short_description: A fast-paced, challenging 2D top-down mini-roguelike with random levels and 30+ powerups. No two plays are ever the same and completely free-to-play. Avoid the many perils, collect copious loot and slay the final boss to escape the mini dungeon in Bitty Knight...
rows.description_html: Bitty Knight is a fast-paced, challenging 2D top-down mini-roguelike with random levels and 30+ powerups. No two plays are ever the same and it is completely free-to-play. The game centers on a tiny knight stuck in a small dungeon and you have to reach the final boss to escape. Collect upgrades to survive as you make your way to the final level, there are no saves and if your character dies you will have to restart. Collect keys, unlock chests, find gems, kill enemies and shop to upgrade or smash power-up blocks to find loot and your way to the end. Be warned, some loot has negative effects and collecting loot blindly can have consequences that will make the game much harder. Note: if you have issues, find a bug or have something to say then please post in the Community Hub for assistance Completely free-to-play Random dungeons & loot - no game is ever the same 2D Top-down retro pixel graphics 30+ Power-ups to collect with stacking Permadeath - no character upgrades or saves Hardcore mode if you prefer a real challenge Low system requirements - should run on most PCs

rows.name: Meteora's Mystic Merge
rows.short_description: Meteora's Mystic Merge is a puzzle game based on the famous Suika game but with abilities added on top. Instead of fruits it uses a variety of vtubers as assets. Combine two characters to slowly get to the final one.
rows.description_html: Meteora's Mystic Merge is a puzzle game based on the famous Suika game. Instead of fruits it uses a variety of vtubers as assets. Meteora's Mystic Merge features currently only a new game mode with a playable character (namely Meteora) who has a special ability, and a classic mode coming soon which plays a lot like the original though with some changes. This game is similar to the cult game '2048' as well as 'Suika Game' which is a switch exclusive. It does seem easy on the surface but difficulty rises with progression into the game... Gameplay: Combine two of the same character/object to get to the next one. Combining orbs charges the chararacter's ability which helps you to progress further. Try to get to the final Meteora without exceeding the glass or throwing any objects outside of it. On the right side you can see a little graph which explains the progression levels. Though the first ones seem rather easy, getting to the final Meteora is challenging to say the least... By playing games you earn MeteCoins which you can use to roll in the build in Gacha to unlock skins and other playable characters. Can you reach the final orb on them all? Do you prefer to unlock it all or try to get a high leaderboard ranking? Credits: Art by Rune Gravity++ by Excelsus

rows.name: Secrets Under Eco
rows.short_description: Explore Melior's military base in Secrets Under Eco; a 3D FPS pure metroidvania experience. Find equipment and fight enemies with unique wall-bouncing combat to escape the building and country that was once called home.
rows.description_html: Secrets Under Eco is a story driven first person metroidvania with a unique spin on fps combat. Explore the military base of Melior and its surrounding area while collecting equipment and powerful upgrades. Game Features Fully Voice Acted Story: Melior is about to win the war against The Others. Ready to fight with his people, Jay wakes up alone in a jail cell in his own military base. Labeled a spy, and with an unknown voice in his head, will Jay be able to escape his captors he once called his friends? Unique First Person Shooter Combat: Enemies take damage by slamming into walls and obstacles. Defeat combatants by launching them into whatever you can using your equipment and wits. Exploration: Search for a way out of Melior's expansive military base. Find equipment, vending machines, audio diaries, and combat boosting upgrades along the way. Visuals: Secrets Under Eco features a pleasing low poly, mostly grayscale art style.

rows.name: Bounce ASMR
rows.short_description: Relax your brain with some geometric bouncing. Bounce ASMR is right here!
rows.description_html: You're having a boring day and don't know what to do? Did your teacher give you a failing grade in math because you didn't know the area of the square? Then the best solution to relax is Bounce ASMR! You can simulate the movements and jumps of the geometric shape as you like! In total you have the Square, Circle, Triangle, Pentagon and Hexagon. (only the Square you get, the others are included in the DLCs, but that's ok, they are only worth one euro! ) What are you waiting for? I say start the game and relax your eyes a bit.

rows.name: The Children of The Woods - Lost Tape
rows.short_description: Playable trailer for the upcoming horror found footage movie 'The Children of The Woods'
rows.description_html: 'The Children of The Woods - Lost Tape' serves as a playable teaser of what can be expected from the upcoming found footage franchise called 'The Children of The Woods'. Through this first installment, viewers can explore events following the disappearances and the missing 5 individuals from a fresh viewpoint. It offers an immersive experience that delves deeper into the lore and history, providing insights into the origins of the featured footage in the forthcoming installments. It is crucial to remember that the truth is within the woods. Game synopsis / story You are Private Detective Dale Lincoln, and you are investigating the aftermath of the incident occurred in January of 1999. Use your night vision function on your camcorder to see details you may have missed with your naked eye. the deeper you go ,the closer you get to the truth . Examine items, collect evidence, connect the dots, and beware, something is lurking in the woods. Playtime 5-15 mins

rows.name: Adapta Solva: Legacy
rows.short_description: Absorb elements from magical shrines to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles in this cute and short little adventure where you follow a magical creature in a world laid to ruin by an unknown cause.
rows.description_html: Absorb elements from magical shrines to solve puzzles and overcome obstacles in this cute and short little adventure where you follow a magical creature in a world laid to ruin by an unknown cause. On your adventure you can collect any of the following three elements from different elemental shrines and use their unique properties and abilities to solve the puzzles and unlock the next areas. Stone is the heaviest and the strongest of the elements, use your ground slam or punch ability to break certain walls and floors or to punch heavy boulders around Slime is a sticky but bouncy element, use it to jump higher, pass through grates and climb up sticky walls. You can also leave behind a gooey slimeball that will disappear after a short time. You also have to be careful though, since slime isn't fully solid it will dissolve into water! Crysta l is the final collectable element and it's surprisingly slippery, use it to crystalize bodies of water so you can walk across and be able to push boulders and slimeballs on top of it. Uncover the mysteries as you follow a magical creature capable of absorbing elements from magical shrines, as they uncover more and more about how they were created and why the world has fallen into ruin. Explore your surroundings to find ancient artifacts and items from the locals as well as murals drawn by the ancient civilization that depict the story of world. This game was made by 6 students as a group project assignment for their third year at Digital Arts & Entertainment at Hogeschool West-Vlaanderen in Belgium. We want to give a special thanks to our supervisors, Dave Van Verdegem and Tristan Clarysse who helped us through the 11 week process of making the game.

rows.name: Beyond the Breach
rows.short_description: Discover a world overrun with robots, and play as a defective bot who tries to find a way to flee the facility. Find others who are the same kind, free them, and escape the laboratory!
rows.description_html: Beyond The Breach is a 3D, sci-fi, single-player, first-person, narrative, puzzle where you as a player will take on the role of an AI robot who is undergoing a seemingly ordinary test in a dystopian world, only to realize that you exist in a society where they mistreat robots who defy their rules. This leads you to become a deviant robot who will gain special abilities like detecting electrical energy, hacking into scientists, and controlling them to aid your escape. Your mission is to break free from this oppressive environment and rescue other robots like yourself who are also imprisoned. The game combines stealth and puzzle gameplay, presenting players with the challenge of escaping from society while also giving them the responsibility to save other robots.

rows.name: Shadowbyte Survivors
rows.short_description: Immerse in a virtual world, battle hordes, and level up in our roguelike game. Face intense challenges, upgrade your character, unlock unique abilities, and acquire powerful gear. Ready for the adventure? Gear up, and explore this captivating roguelike realm for a new challenge in every game!
rows.description_html: Dive into the intense world of ' Shadowbyte Survivors ,' a captivating Rogue-Like game that challenges players to blast through hordes of adversaries. Take control of three distinct characters on three unique maps, each offering a thrilling and unpredictable experience. As you embark on your journey, engage in relentless combat, honing your skills and upgrading your abilities to face increasingly challenging enemies. ' Shadowbyte Survivors ' promises an ever-evolving gameplay experience, with each match presenting a fresh set of obstacles and enemies. The game introduces individual character progression and advancements between levels, ensuring that even the most formidable challenges can be conquered with strategic planning and skillful play. Immerse yourself in the dynamic world of ' Shadowbyte Survivors ' and prove your survival skills as you navigate through waves of foes, uncover unique character abilities, and triumph over the ever-changing landscape. Are you ready to face the shadows and emerge as the ultimate survivor? The game contains: 3 unique characters with their unique weapons. 3 unique and different maps. Lots of enemies who want to destroy you! Dozens of different passive and active skills. Map events that make every your game unique. Upgrade your skills between your missions.

rows.name: TOREROWA
rows.short_description: Explore dungeons in your spare time! Roguelike dungeon RPG with a party of up to 3 players to challenge dungeons!
rows.description_html: ■ Explore Dungeons with a 3-Player Party! Embark on dungeon adventures with a party of up to three members. You can easily team up with other players through matchmaking or join forces with friends. Collaborate with your party members to collect treasures and aim to escape through the portals that appear within the dungeons! ■ Battle Monsters While Searching for Treasure Dungeons are filled with various treasure chests and numerous monsters guarding valuable loot. Defeating monsters grants experience points, allowing you to level up. Work together with your allies to defeat monsters and safely open treasure chests. ■ Encounter Other Parties Within the Dungeon Up to five parties, including your own, can explore the dungeon simultaneously. As your exploration progresses, you may encounter other parties. You can choose to pass by each other peacefully, but defeating players from other parties allows you to seize the treasures they've collected. However, other parties possess strength comparable to your own, so you'll need to decide whether to fight or flee. ■ Enhance Equipment with Treasures Obtained from Exploration Treasures acquired in the dungeon are appraised upon your return, and can be converted into equipment, materials, or gold. Since you can bring equipment into the dungeon, strengthen your gear in preparation for your next exploration!

Dig up treasures buried deep underground. If you can make it out alive, they will all be yours. Gather your friends and join together in a hunting team.
rows.description_html: Action Sports, Multiplayer Combat Intense multiplayer battles where you can go solo or team up, but there's only one ultimate goal - to get out alive! Choose Your Profession Freely Professions with distinct styles to suit your different combat preferences. A variety of weapons for free combination, fighting to the last moment. Diverse Map Styles, Rich Rewards Creepy towns, mysterious tombs... Various maps, different styles, all equally dangerous! Enjoy the Fun of Treasure Hunting Kill monsters to uncover treasures, or plunder from other players. As long as you make it out alive, the spoils are yours! Science, Mystery, Treasure, Monsters, Companions, Plunder... In the dangerous underworld, who will be the ultimate ruler? The vast treasure lying dormant, whose hands will it fall into?

rows.name: Dodecadone
rows.short_description: A physics & logic puzzler about merging shapes and traits, similar to Suika games. A triangle might be bouncy, your septagon sick & coughing, or an ennenagon defying the laws of physics.
rows.description_html: 28 traits, tons of shapes Press space for a triangle, one of many variety. That shape might be Bouncy Spinning Racist Protesting gravity Sick Or one of many others... Your task is to gather them all, make sense of it, and merge your geometric friends and foes to a square. Then, a pentagon, a septagon, a hexagon... Many others, then... you're dodecadone. Features Full modding support- anything from new traits to entirely new games! 9 Unique themes, including full transparency Custom themes with CSS Cheats menu Scoring system & speedrunning timer Practically every language ever via automatic translation Silly english for the goofsters 100% free, only with donations. Open-source under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

rows.description_html: Welcome to our vibrant and addictive fruit puzzle. The objective is simple yet captivating: launch and align fruits vertically on a dynamic board. As you match these delicious fruits, you'll accumulate points and climb the global rankings. Immerse yourself in a world where strategy and quick thinking are key to success. Join players from around the world and find out if you have what it takes to become the ultimate Kudamono Party master!

Compete with friends in a race to become the party champion by navigating absurd obstacles, using clever tactics, and outsmarting opponents. Key Features: Hilarious Multiplayer Action: Dive into a world of laughter as you navigate absurd obstacles with friends. Island Party Chaos isn't your average game; it's your gateway to unfiltered fun and friendly competition. Perfect for casual gamers and party enthusiasts, where the game starts the party, and the party never stops!

rows.name: The Twilight Witch
rows.short_description: The Twilight Witch is a 2D pixel art RPG where you play as Mael, a young man from the village of New Larton. After your home-town is attacked and ravaged by a mysterious figure, you venture forth to tell of what happened and maybe, just maybe, find a way to stop the hooded aggressor…
rows.description_html: A village attacked by a mysterious figure. A Guardian, dead in it's defense. And you, left to tell the wider world of what happened. In this top-down RPG, you play as Mael, a young human whose home is befell by foul forces, only to find themselves tasked with finding help in the aftermath. Quickly, the situation escalates as you find yourself investigating what is shown to be only one piece of a far larger plan... Face a variety of enemies in either random encounters of in the overworld, climbing your way up to their leader! Find weapons and armour for your character, with sprites that change and adapt to your equipped armour! Unlock powerful skills to help your offence, defence and movement in the bullet-hell style combat, with each of the three styles of magic excelling in their domains! Restore the light of the Lumiars for extra skill points, and perhaps something more…

rows.name: OBSCURIA
rows.short_description: After the largest cruise ship in the world suffered a shipwreck and was invaded by ghosts, you must find Captain Blackhood after he disappeared, enter the great Nocturne and investigate all the secrets and mysteries.
rows.description_html: WELCOME TO OBSCURIA The large cruise ship Nocturne has been evacuated due to a shipwreck, everyone has been evacuated except one person, Captain Blackhood. Since he gave the order to evacuate he has not been seen again, your mission as an agent is to find him alive, or dead, but to find him, in addition an invasion of ghosts has invaded the cruise ship. Genre: Horror, Exploration, Scare, Tension Price: Free to play In OBSCURIA, you will embark on a terrifying experience aboard the 'Nocturne', a state-of-the-art cruise ship that hides dark secrets. Armed only with a flashlight, your bravery will be tested as you explore dark hallways and solve puzzles to reveal the truth behind an ancient curse. The ship, desolate and silent, immerses you in an atmosphere of mystery and danger. You must face The Consuming Shadow, a terrifying entity that patrols the dark areas. Avoiding direct encounters and hiding will become crucial for your survival. Sudden scares, creepy apparitions and challenging puzzles will keep you guessing throughout the journey. Discover the dark history of the 'Nocturne' through scattered notes and diaries, revealing the tragedy that has left the ship in a state of abandonment. The great cruise ship of 2023 has suffered a unexpected evacuation, Captain Blackwood ordered to the entire crew that the ship was evacuated, this Because the Nocturne fell under the curse of the Nightmare, a old cruise ship from the same company that had a shipwreck in 1993 OBSCURIA offers an immersive and terrifying experience, at no cost. Will you dare to brave the wrath of the eternal sea aboard the 'Nocturne'? Enter to discover the mysteries and find the secrets from Captain Blackhood. rows.short_description: Skyfish has to bubble-shoot and blast his way through tons of cartoon levels in a strange and tough-as-nails 2D shooter game!
rows.description_html: Skyfish Rising is a run-n-gun 2D cartoony platformer that features tons of enemies and bosses! After over a decade, Skyfish has returned with a new entry in the series, and old foes may appear in this wacky not-so-normal romp!! A long time ago, Skyfish, an original character, fought the forces of parody and became lost in the zone of checkerboard. Now over 10 years later, he's found his way out, but the New Parody Order has taken over the world with their original and unoriginal wacky designs for the entire world. Skyfish can shoot bubbles to blow up enemies as well as run n' jump just like the old school platform games. Skyfish is a taste of old school retro gameplay with new types of enemies, environments, and fun. You'll be able to warp through over 4 unique zones to defeat the forces of evil and save the world from obscure artform.

rows.name: Gothic Virtual Tabletop
rows.short_description: Gothic Virtual Tabletop is a virtual tabletop application that can be customized to support nearly any TTRPG or Wargame.
rows.description_html: Gothic Virtual Tabletop is a virtual tabletop application that can be customized to support most TTRPG systems, including wargames. Built-in System-agnostic Character Sheets Customizable character sheets support any system from the ever-present D&D, to that fantasy heartbreaker from the 90s. Easily access character sheets by double clicking on a token, not by switching to another tab. Revolutionary Hotbar System When you select a token, a state-of-the-art Hotbar appears at the bottom of the screen. The Hotbar displays all the information a player or GM cares about in one compact space, making GM-ing large combats or managing multiple playable characters a breeze. Gone are the days of dozens of tabs worth of stat blocks cluttering your monitor! Robust Macro System Roll dice, edit your character sheet, send predefined messages in chat, and even play sounds at one press of a button. Customize the color and text of any macro button, and where they should be shown on the Hotbar Support for user-defined variables, which can include mathematical equations and/or any value on a token's character sheet. Support For Almost Any TTRPG System or Wargame Default Character Sheet values and macros, as well as compendium weapons, armour, spells, and tables are defined in .json files and stored independently on a per-campaign basis. Easily customize Gothic Virtual Tabletop to suit each and every one of your needs. Built-In Compendium Define weapons, armour, abilities, spells, and rollable tables present in your system of choice and easily add them to a token at the press of a button. Built-in Jukebox Browse your campaign's music library and add queue up the perfect songs for the occasion! Absolutely Sublime Text Chat Rolls always show what the individual die rolls were, even when part of a complex equation or macro. Easily whisper to other players, or the GM. Roll dice for all to see, or just to the GM in secret. Roll on tables and show the result in chat. Support for robes and wizard hats. Per-map whiteboard layer for drawing up battle strategies or doodling while that player takes the slowest turn ever. Feature-rich Map editor Quick and easy fog-of-war tools to keep curious players from scouting out secret rooms and ambushes. Adjust the grid to fit any image, whether it has a baked-in grid or not. Turn grid lines on and off. Supports Common types of map grids, including square, hex (horizontal), hex (vertical), and no grid. No Loading Screens Okay, there is one loading screen that appears when a player first connects to the server and downloads assets. After that, you're free to game in peace. Self Hosted All your maps, tokens, sounds, and music files are stored locally, on your computer. Gone are the days of juggling storage space when trying to upload a new map for your next encounter! Password Protected Lobbies Easily view who is connected to the server in the bottom left, a green bubble means connected, and yellow means connecting.

rows.name: Blast Processed
rows.short_description: Blast Processed is a first-person platformer built around an infamous movement quirk of early FPS games: Rocket Jumping.
rows.description_html: Blast Processed is a first-person platformer built around an infamous movement quirk of early FPS games: Rocket Jumping. Key Features: Movement mechanics inspired by the full suite of Source Engine movement gamemodes like Surf and BHop. Enhancements have been made to key aspects of movement to be more welcoming for new players while not compromising on the depth of high-level play. Consistent, fully deterministic gameplay where specific inputs consistently return the same results, allowing for pure tests of skill where the player is in full control of their character at all times. Seven official maps with level design inspired by Team Fortress 2's community-made jump maps & other Source movement gamemodes. Visuals inspired by the early 3D PC games of the late 90s and early 2000s, designed to never infringe on the readability of the environments. A full replay system which saves your best times on maps to watch back or race against as a ghost. More features to come over the course of Early Access. Visit my YouTube channel to keep up with development through my devlog series. NOTE: This game is hard. While the mechanics of rocket jumping and advanced movement mechanics are tutorialized, it is highly recommended that you at minimum have an understanding of first-person movement mechanics and controls before playing.

rows.name: Mine? Sweeper
rows.short_description: In this twist on minesweeper, find all treasures while avoiding mines to clear stages. Use items, deduce from nearby counts, or guess to identify tiles. Features a large-scale mode with multiple stages leading to a final treasure, and a small-scale mode focused on deducing a single stage.
rows.description_html: Game Description 'Avoid the mines, find all the treasures, and clear the stage!' The primary goal of traditional minesweeper is to locate all the mines on the stage. This involves distinguishing tiles with mines from those without, and game completion is achieved upon identifying all mine locations. However, this game's objective is not to find mines. It's about avoiding mines to discover treasures, and the game is cleared when all treasures are found. Even if you can discern which tiles are not empty, you cannot know whether they are treasure tiles or mine tiles. Therefore, you can: Use items to identify the nature of a tile, or Deduce from the surrounding numbers of mines and treasures, or Guess based on the current number of remaining mines and traps, or Just take a wild guess, to determine whether a tile is a treasure or a mine. A large-scale tomb raiding game mode with multiple stages forming one dungeon In each stage, finding all treasures lets you acquire one piece of equipment. With each piece of equipment aiding in clearing stages, complete all stages to find the final treasure and clear the dungeon! A small-scale tomb raiding game mode focusing on clearing a single stage This game mode involves solving a single stage using deduction alone. Controller Support No device other than a mouse is needed to play the game! In fact, using a controller other than a mouse for minesweeper feels awkward. (Gamepads are not supported.)

rows.name: Training Elves
rows.short_description: You are an adventurer of some renown that has grown tired of adventuring. After losing almost all of your money gambling, you meet two elves that seek you out and put you to task of training them into adventurers. In exchange, they give you amorous nights.
rows.description_html: You are an adventurer of some renown that has grown tired of adventuring. After losing almost all of your money gambling, you meet two elves that seek you out and put you to task of training them into adventurers. In exchange, they give you amorous nights. The game is an RPG featuring simple foraging, fishing, mining, and crafting, which are easily accessible even for the most casual players. Manually level up and spec your party, using various equipment to customize their skills in combat. The game features party turn-based combat. Players will explore different areas to fight monsters and do tasks to progress the plot. Tasks can range from taking down a certain monster or collecting a specific item in the field. Players gain experience and level up from doing these things, as well as gain loot. Grinding is completely optional and is unnecessary to beat the game. The game features uncensored, adult scenes.

rows.description_html: BUY THE FULL GAME WISHLIST OTHER GAMES About the Game Embark on an intergalactic adventure as Rina, a cunning thief in the year 2512 within the corrupt Galactic Empire. Get a preview of the game's start and tackle some tricky levels. Can you beat the challenges and triumph in this futuristic journey? Get ready for a wild ride in a tricky platformer with mind-bending challenges and seamless portals that'll keep you on your toes! Check out Ingression: The Portal Trial - free prologue with 25 levels to get a feel for what the game is all about! Stay grounded as you navigate through the mind-bending levels that play tricks on your sense of direction. Race against the clock as you tackle challenging levels – can you beat the timer? Easy-to-use controls – just jump, use portals, think ahead, and climb. Yet, beneath the simplicity lies layers of expressive depth to master, turning every death into a valuable lesson. Swift respawns ensure you're back in action in the blink of an eye, always ready for another go.

rows.name: Aurora Hills: Chapter 1
rows.short_description: Aurora Hills: Chapter 1 is the first part in series of point and click puzzle adventure games. Follow the journey of Ethan Hill, a park ranger tasked with investigating strange disappearances from the region to uncover the mystery of Aurora Hills!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Aurora Hills! Nestled deep within the Appalachian Mountains, Aurora Hills was known for its thriving industry and its picturesque landscape. Owing to the region's natural resources, Aurora Hills was looking to become one of the most prosperous towns in the state. All is not how it seems, however. A series of disappearances of residents and tourists alike have plagued the region over the past few years, sparking a mass exodus from the small town. Now, in October 1981, the town is a shell of its former self. The prosperity that once blessed Aurora Hills has all but evaporated. Working as a park ranger, you must investigate what's going on with these disappearances and answer questions that have tormented residents for years. Why has there been an increase in disappearances over the past 6 months? Why are there no traces of the people who went missing? Perhaps most importantly, who, or what, could be behind all of this? It's up to you to venture forth, deep into the national park, to uncover the mysteries of Aurora Hills... Developed by the creators of Meridian 157, Aurora Hills: Chapter 1 is the first part in series of point and click puzzle adventure games. Based in the year 1981 in a small West Virginian community, Aurora Hills follows the journey of Ethan Hill, a park ranger tasked with investigating strange disappearances from the region. Explore the rolling hills of West Virginia, find clues of the whereabouts of the missing people and solve intriguing puzzles to uncover the mystery of Aurora Hills! Features: • Custom soundtrack and sound effects designed for a creepy in-game atmosphere • Challenging and clever puzzles • A logical hint system for some of the most difficult riddles • Available in 9 languages, including English, French, Russian, German, Chinese (Simplified), Spanish, Portuguese, Italian and Japanese! • New colour blind mode available for people who might have trouble with colour based puzzles

rows.name: AlchePot
rows.short_description: A fantastic but difficult Bullet Hell. Shoot enemies all around. Experience the unique 'Bullet Absorb' system by stop firing, change threaten to your energy. Get ability upgrade through 8 levels with well-designed atmosphere.
rows.description_html: A fantastic but difficult Bullet Hell. - Bullet Absorb - You can absorb enemy bullets by stop firing, for each bullet you absorbed, energy points will be got. For each wave of yellow-marked enemies you killed, your experience gets refreshed.

rows.name: Revolution Idle
rows.short_description: Join an experience where each revolution takes you further into the unknown! Revolution Idle challenges you to multiply your accumulators to reach unimaginable heights. Will you manage to reach infinity?
rows.description_html: Welcome to Revolution Idle! GAME DESCRIPTION Dive into an adventure where filling circles becomes an obsession! Revolution Idle challenges you to multiply your numbers and reach unimaginable heights. Developed by Nu Games and Oni Gaming, Revolution Idle offers a unique experience in the idle game universe. Will you manage to reach infinity? KEY FEATURES Multipliers and Prestige Purchase color spectrums to speed up circle filling and increase your multipliers. Each of them multiplies to increase your score. At the certain point you can prestige. You will get another multiplier and increase your exponent. Infinity When you reach ~1.79e308 score you can infinity. You are gaining infinities and infinity points. With these points you can buy some different upgrades that will boost your progress. Eternity : Reach eternity to unlock new mechanics and shatter the limits. Addictive Gameplay : Watch circles fill up and numbers increases, each revolution brings you closer to your goal. Colors : Buy color spectrums to increase the speed of filling circles and get distinctions for each ascent. Automations : Automate your actions to optimise your progress. Achievements : Complete achievements to earn bonuses. Time Flow : Earn offline time to accelerate your progression. Leaderboard : Compare your progress with other players and become the best. Statistics and Options : Track your progress with statistics and customize your gaming experience with various options. Multiplatform Support : Play on your PC or from your mobile device (Android/iOS) to progress even faster. IN-GAME HELP Immerse yourself in the detailed tutorial to master the game mechanics. Learn how to multiply your multipliers, optimize your upgrades, and efficiently progress towards the final goal. ABOUT THE DEVELOPER Nu Games and Oni Gaming are creators passionate about idle games. Join our Discord community, which boasts over 30.000 active players, and participate in the game's evolution! Embark on the adventure today and let yourself be carried away by the captivating universe of Revolution Idle!

rows.name: Stellar Reflections
rows.short_description: Aurelia is a nobody living out her life on a space station orbiting Earth, spending her days working in a junkyard, frequenting a bar, or retreating to her cabin. She will confront a life-altering decision that challenges her perception of the world. Can she change and grow, or is she too far gone?
rows.description_html: ~~A sci-fi short story about overcoming problems and changing perspectives~~ Stellar Reflections is a short story visual novel set in a dystopian future, within a sprawling space station. In this bleak era, personal freedoms have been suppressed, and life choices are dictated by the all-powerful regime. Delve into the narrative through the eyes of the protagonist, Aurelia, a nobody spending her days at her junkyard job, in a bar, or holed up in her cabin. She'll come to face a life-altering decision that will challenge her perception of the world. In the distant future, Earth and Mars are used exclusively as mining facilities, and most of human population resides in space stations around the planets and the Moon. The world is governed by a centralized, autocratic government managing most of life choices for every existing human. The government just made a decision directly affecting the life of the protagonist - Aurelia. And she's far from being a fan. How will she handle it? Length Stellar Reflections is a short story, consisting of about 17000 words, divided into 15 bits. Reaching all endings takes about 1 hour, depending on the reading speed. Audio There are 16 original tracks created specifically for this novel. Endings The novel features a couple of choices which lead to one of three possible endings: bad, neutral, or good.

rows.name: Summoneer
rows.short_description: Summoneer is a platformer and puzzle game, where you engineer your own designs.
rows.description_html: About Summoneer Summoneer is a physics based puzzle platformer that allows you to draw and craft anything your heart desires. Climb a mythical castle while overcoming challenges with vehicles and contraptions of your own design. Use creative platforming, drawing and engineering to summon your way to the top! Solve puzzles with your own creations Create more and more complex designs in the editor and pilot them with custom controls that you can assign without limitations, while using wall jumps and momentum to maneuver both yourself and your summons through increasingly difficult puzzles. Features The Puzzles Every level of the game provides a new puzzle for you to solve. The further you go, the harder they get, going from making your way past a chasm to complex challenges that require detailed thinking and design work. The Editor Use the editor to create any vehicle or contraption you can think of. Draw your summoned design over multiple layers, then pin the many individual elements of your drawing together to connect them. Your pins come with a menu that offers a large variety of options, including assignable keys to motorize your creation. This simple combination offers a near infinite range of possibilities and creative solutions for you to explore through complex physics and engineering. Design Sharing You can save all of your designs, which allows you to reuse and improve them in later levels. The design files are easily accessible outside the game via a folder, allowing you to share them with other players without any hassle. Are you creative enough to summon your way to the top?

Heroes with unique chambers, skills and powers. Dungeons led by the legendary skeleton wizard, MASTER KAY ! MASTER KAY controls fire and ice. rows.name: Smash Cup
rows.short_description: Dive into the Smash Cup universe! This genre-blending top-down shooter allows you to craft your own base, combining MOBA, tower defense and deck-building elements for a unique battle experience!
rows.description_html: Smash Cup is a PvP & PvE arena brawler with a unique blend of multiple game genres, an ever-growing selection of upgradeable characters and supportive units. This fast-paced, adrenaline-fueled action game has 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, tower defense and even battle royale mods, all to challenge new players in a highly competitive chase to become the ultimate smasher. Each Smash Cup game is a test of strategy and quick thinking as you construct an impenetrable fortress. Use a variety of units for base building, each offering unique defensive and offensive capabilities. Choose carefully and optimize your base to withstand waves of relentless attacks. Choose between joining forces with friends for intense 2v2, 3v3 battles, or going solo in 1v1 duels. Perfect your tactics, adapt to your opponents, and dominate the arena – together or alone. With over eight playable characters boasting unique abilities, and more than 15 units for base building, you’ll upgrade your strategies. Every new character and unit brings you one step closer to becoming the ultimate Smasher. From the strategic depth of Tower Defense to the adrenaline-fueled Battle Royale mode, there's a challenge for every type of player. Participate in daily tournaments, display your prowess, and reap grand prizes. Are you ready to take on the Smash Cup challenge? Key Features 8+ Playable characters with unique abilities that will determine your way of action. 15+ Units for base building strategies to help you change the course of the game. 3 MOBA modes to choose from intense 1v1, 2v2, and 3v3 multiplayer battles. Tower defense to challenge your base building strategy. Battle Royale mode that will test your ability to survive in an endless fight for victory. Daily tournaments to win grand prizes, and stand out as the ultimate Smasher. Upgrade your smashers and bases and advance further in the game. Customize with new skins and arena themes to personalize your gaming experience. Fresh Content Every Month New game mechanics New smashers and base units Exclusive skins and rewards Join the thrilling universe of Smash Cup today, where every Smasher is a star! We're constantly evolving and bringing fresh updates to the game regularly. Download now to start your journey!

rows.name: Slipstream: Rogue Space
rows.short_description: A multiplayer roguelike about teamwork, survival...and cute animals in space! Play with a few friends or join a streamer's crew of dozens as you work together to battle aliens across the vast Rogue Space.
rows.description_html: In Slipstream: Rogue Space, Streamers captain a massive starship and viewers are the crew. Together they explore the galaxy, fight aliens, and operate the ship in real-time. Battle through challenging rogue-like maps as a team and work together to see how long you can survive. Captains and Crew Play as two unique roles: The captain , who makes key decisions, gives orders, and leads the ship. This can be a live streamer with their community or anyone bold enough to pilot a few friends into battle. The crew , who work together to operate the ship: shoot, repair, shield up, and more. Captains can play LIVE on stream with their audience, in real time . Dozens of players can join across desktop or mobile platforms to form an elite crew. Deep gameplay, persistent progress, and tons of interaction help build strong ties for your community. Many Ways to Play Launch a small ship with some friends, join a streamer of a few dozen crew, or take on major challenges with a streamer piloting 100+ players towards victory. rows.name: ELECTROBASIS
rows.short_description: ELECTROBASIS is a 3d dialogue-driven game, sprinkled with platforming and puzzle quests. Meet a cast of heavenly hosts that come with a MYRIAD of issues, and help to fix (most of) them! The casino yearns for a savior - she awaits a restoration.
rows.description_html: Hundreds, if not THOUSANDS of years ago, a Biblical rapture fell upon the Earth, leading for angels to walk beside man, in effort to make humankind more holy living by example. Which, nowadays, isn’t all that sacred of a concept - angels are everywhere! THEY’ve integrated human characteristics into their own culture, rather than vice versa.                                Made up of pure electricity, cherubs take up object heads to anthropomorphize their form. They own businesses, live in casinos, and are free to gamble their heart away. YOU , as a fallen angel, crashland SMACKdab in the center of a casino in Vegas - LITERALLY crashland. By playing this game you agree to clean-up duty*, fixing up the spark inside! Start with fixing up the casino herself by turning back on the power, and then expand into the happiness of the residents in the rooms upstairs.                                INCLUDES: A casino and hotel to explore! Five different residents that have something wrong with them! Exposition dump in text form for YOUR, yes your, eyeballs to scan over! 2010s dance party ending! At least one rat Music from famous musician VEN! You know Ven, don’t you? katabasis (n.) a mytheme or trope in which the hero embarks on a journey to the underworld any journey downwards or fall

rows.name: Marvel Rivals
rows.short_description: Marvel Rivals is a Super Hero Team-Based PVP Shooter! Assemble an all-star Marvel squad, devise countless strategies by combining powers to form unique Team-Up skills and fight in destructible, ever-changing battlefields across the continually evolving Marvel universe!
rows.description_html: Marvel Rivals Season 5.5: Update Overview About the Game Marvel Rivals is a Super Hero Team-Based PVP Shooter! Assemble an all-star Marvel squad, devise countless strategies by combining powers to form unique Team-Up skills and fight in destructible, ever-changing battlefields across the continually evolving Marvel universe! A Deep and Varied Marvel Roster Choose from a vast array of fan-favorite and cult-classic Marvel Super Heroes and Super Villains from across the Avengers, Guardians of the Galaxy, X-Men, and many more from across the Marvel Multiverse. Fast and Fun 6v6 Action with Ever-Changing Game Dynamics With intricate environments, fast-paced gameplay, and ever-changing battlefields, there's never a dull moment in Marvel Rivals! Battle as Super Heroes and Super Villains with incredible abilities and combine your powers to bring unexpected fun to the battlefield in a matter of seconds. Dynamic Hero Synergy Coordinate unique combinations between characters to ignite surprising Team-Up Skills! Unleash the synergy of combined superpowers and invent new tactics that can turn the tide of combat. Ride on Groot's back as Rocket Raccoon to take on your enemies as a dangerous duo, unleash Gamma energy as Hulk to charge Iron Man's armor for massive damage, and so much more! Creative Environment Destruction Tear your way through iconic Marvel worlds across destructible environments! From Asgard to the Tokyo of 2099, use superpowers to alter these environments, reshape the terrain, and craft a strategic advantage on the battlefield! Take cover to dodge attacks or use makeshift weapons to strike down enemies. Players will find countless ways to utilize the environment to claim victory! Continually Evolving Universe and Robust Post-Launch Updates The Marvel Multiverse brings infinite possibilities! Each seasonal drop will introduce new Super Heroes to the battlefield along with challenging and diverse maps! Unlock new content to implement across various gameplay strategies while experiencing thrilling action and endless possibilities in these adventurous team battles!

rows.name: Adorimon : Arena of Ancients
rows.short_description: Explore fantastic creatures called 'Adorimon' in a new 2D turn-based strategy game! Collect and train your Adorimons to discover the world, climb Challenge Tower, and duel other players in Arena.
rows.description_html: In Adorimon - Arena of Ancients, you would be able to adopt and train powerful-but-adorable creatures called 'Adorimon'. Leveling, feeding, teaching, evolving, there are tons of activities you can do to unlock the full potential of your Adorimons. Prepare a decent team to explore the story, climb Challenge Tower, and duel with other players. With 130+ species of Adorimons right now, and more will come in the future, guarantee you a pleasant experience of collecting and admiring their unique beauty. All Adorimon designs are original and can be found nowhere else. They are based on the inspiration of animals and plants in nature, and mythical creatures from various cultures. Each Adorimon has a full 3-stage evolution line, some even have multiple evolution branches, so that you don't get in the situation when your favorite Adorimon cannot evolve like others. All characters are animated thoroughly, making every battle more lively. Still the familiar turn-based combat mechanic where both sides make their decision, then the faster one goes first, but a lot of new vital things are added. Element interaction: There are up to 15 element types, and each Adorimon can have 2 elements. Knowing the effectiveness of each element against others is the key to victory. Status: effects that may turn the tide. There are a lot of statuses in 'Adorimon: Arena of Ancients', from common statuses like Poisoned, Burned, Healing,... to stat changing statuses. They take an important role in the result of a battle, and you can build your strategy focusing on a specific status. There is no limit of how many statuses one can bear at the same time. Moves: Currently there are 300+ moves in the game, and the number keeps rising. A fully-evolved Adorimon can prepare up to 6 moves to use in battle, along with 2 default actions 'Normal Attack' and 'Defense'. This gives you a lot of options to choose from, as well as harder to predict your opponent's action. Each move has its own mana cost and cooldown, so that there is no limit how many times a move can be used in a combat, and some moves cannot be used continuously. Special Abilities: Each Adorimon has a special ability. It can passively enhance a stat, or be triggered in a specific condition and make a surprise for your opponent. And that's not all. As the game keeps expanding, more interesting mechanics would be added! Beside the most common ways like leveling and evolving, there are many other activities you can do to make your Adorimons better: rarity enhancing, move tutoring, etc. You can even hunt for relics and resurrect almighty Ancient Adorimons, or breed two different Adorimons to get a completely new species. Leveling up is the most basic way to power up an Adorimon. When an Adorimon reaches level 15 or 30, you can evolve it. Once your Adorimon gets to the final evolution form, you can teach it various moves. This allows more strategies available. If you try hard enough, you can even resurrect Ancient Adorimons from relics. They are very powerful and surely worth your effort. This is not a pay-to-win game where there are limited contents blocked by purchase wall. In fact, a free player could obtain everything in the game. Gorgeous skins, extremely rare Ancient and Event Adorimons, ... all will be yours if you spend enough time and effort to get them. Doing daily quests regularly, joining in PvP Arena often, and you will have a top team in about 15 days. In PvP battles, it's experience and strategy brings you to victory.

rows.name: Up Hike
rows.short_description: Jump between platforms avoiding falls, use the walls for extra height and enjoy the serene landscapes, if you can. With minimal graphics and warm colors, it's a delightful Up Hike.
rows.description_html: Embark on an exhilarating ascent in Up Hike , the platformer game that challenges your skills and precision! In this thrilling 2D adventure, your goal is simple yet daunting: reach the summit. Brace yourself for a journey filled with heart-pounding jumps, strategic wall bounces, and the ever-present risk of a dizzying fall. Up Hike is a maze of precarious platforms, each jump demanding your utmost attention and timing. Your every move counts and as you go up the challenge will intensifie. Game Mechanics: Challenging Platformer: The only way to reach the end of your hike is to jump, but be carefull the higher you go the harder you fall . Strategic Wall Jumping : Use the walls to your advantage to bounce and reach higher in a sequence of consecutive jumps The longer you hold the jump, the further you will go: You will need a lot of practice to master it Dynamic Landscapes: Explore a variety of environments as you climb, each with its own set of challenges. From forests to icy peaks, adapt to new obstacles and keep climbing. Will you rise to the challenge and reach the summit in Up Hike ? The ascent begins now!

rows.name: Alien Horizon (Preview Alpha)
rows.short_description: A sci-fi survival city builder set on an inhospitable alien planet. Faced with imminent destruction of Earth, humanity pooled together their resources and sent sleeper ships to nearby potentially habitable planets. But this one turned out to be much less habitable than expected....
rows.description_html: Alien Horizon is a sci-fi survival city builder set on an inhospitable alien planet. Faced with imminent destruction of Earth, humanity pooled together their resources and sent sleeper ships to nearby potentially habitable planets. But this one turned out to be much less habitable than expected. Can you survive anyway? From one ship to a colony Build your colony around the sleeper ship, containing 1000 last survivors from Earth. Construct power sources, housing, infrastructure and factories to ensure comfort of your colonists and provide the colony with all the resources it needs. Manage bus lines, set laws and provide services, making sure your colonists are happy, healthy and productive. Each colonist is their own simulated individual. On your own Earth is dead, so it can't help you out here. If you didn't bring something with you, tough luck. Explore the landscape around you to find all the other ships from your fleet that carry supplies, and survey resource deposits to eventually produce your own. Complex resource management Manage complex production chains to produce 86 different resources, each with a realistic recipe. Build logistics hubs and set up storages to make sure all of them get to where they need. Preview alpha Even though this is a free preview, it's a full-fledged game of its own, with no time or content limitations. It is possible to achieve a self-sufficient colony. The proper game is still in development and will be released later. You can support its development by buying the Donation packs.

rows.name: Ball Bulét
rows.short_description: Ball Bulét is an isometric, Bullet Hell, twin-stick shooter in which a girl searches for revenge by fighting security guards with...a bouncing ball?! Progress through the building by performing ricochets with your spherical weapon against walls and enemies to reach the top.
rows.description_html: ◉ Ball Bulét started in the spring of 2022 as a Big One, an academic project by AIV - Accademia Italiana Videogiochi aimed at adding a production experience to the teaching carried out in the various courses, from the creation of the game concept to commercial publishing. The objective of the Big Ones is to give students the opportunity to collaborate with colleagues from other courses in the development of a video game project in which everyone can put the skills acquired during the lessons to the test and at the same time perfect their soft skills. ◉ Ball Bulét is an isometric, bullet hell, twin-stick shooter. In the game, you navigate various levels by defeating enemies using a sphere that can bounce off walls and opponents. Hitting more enemies at once will boost your gained score. SHE FIGHTS....WITH A BALL?! Your only weapon is 'the Sphere', a simple ball capable of bouncing against every surface without taking damage, fused with a special magnet that lets it float on air and come towards you when you switch the magnet on your arm. Why did you invent it? I'm not sure, and this is probably why the company fired you, taking all your old projects with it....except one they considered “useless” and that will determine their end. THEY KNEW YOU WERE COMING Crashing against the entrance with a hover car is not the stealthiest way to infiltrate, but sure it’s the coolest!! The security guards had the green light to shoot on sight, and all units were set to max alert from that coward of a CEO. Fight against unusual enemies that will not go easy on you. Evade rockets, jump over lasers, dodge sniper shots, duel against Cyber Samurais, and get revenge on your ex-employer for stealing all you worked on. IT'S NOT JUST A BALL... Get your Sphere(TM) some treats for its good work! Search for the power-ups scattered across the map and surprise your enemies with special attacks combining those powers with your aim. REACH THE TOP! Reach the last floor of this titanic skyscraper, explore the offices, and the laboratories, or take a break at the company’s sauna. BEHIND THE SCENE Ball Bulét started in the spring of 2022 as a school project from AIV (Italian Videogame Academy) students, an academy for those who want to specialize their ability in the Game Industry. Students of different courses (GameDesign, 3DArt, Animation, Programming) worked together to build a game that inspired many more to come and join. AIV is trying to give visibility to the talented and successful students who worked in Ball Bulét to help them start a career in the industry. In order of “Team join” here is the team and their major contributions over 2+ years: Roberto “RobZot” Zotta - Lead ProjectManaging / Lead GameDesign / UI / Coding Gianluca “Giax” De Simone - Lead 3DArt / Rigging Adriano Soldati - 3DArt Filippo Cassini - Lead LevelDesign / Lead ArtDirection Filippo Riccò - GameDesign / LevelDesign Michelangelo Ottaviani - LevelDesign Simone Barone - Lead Animation&Rigging Edoardo Altaluce - GameDesign / UIDesign Lorenzo Lezzi - GameDesign Lorenzo “Nain” Tomasetta - LevelDesign / UIDesign Davide Carotti - ArtDirection / VFXArt Riccardo Di Palma - SoundDesign / Composer Roberta Di Gioia - VFXArt Davide Biffi - Coding

rows.name: Capuchin
rows.short_description: This game has unique locomotion where you play as a capuchin and roam around alone or with friends. You can roam around, get eaten by Dave, explore the environment, learn new ways to move, What more would you need other then to be a capuchin?!
rows.description_html: Capuchin utilizes VR to it's fullest and allows the players to move around with nothing other than their hands while also making them feel like a fat idiot. The movement feels springy and is always ready for anyone new to play. Capuchin also mixes the idea of Horror into it with multiple levels for the players to explore all together. You can join a public lobby with random people or get your friends into a private lobby and have some fun with them. No matter who it is, Capuchin is always open to new users and all users now we bring you over to Charlie. What do you have to say about this game Charlie? 'cool game' - Charlie, 2024

rows.name: The Creature Zone VR: Welcome To Dystopia
rows.short_description: Set In The Fictional City 'Rapid Lakes, Michigan', You Play As David Skymanski, A Creature Zone Department Of Science Officer. When You Start To Realize How Damaging The Creature Zone Is, You And A Few Citizens Get Together To Finally End The Dictatorship.
rows.description_html: Not All Places End in Utopia... In This FPS Horror Physics VR Game Set In The Fictional City 'Rapid Lakes, Michigan', You Play As David Skymanski, A Creature Zone Department Of Science Officer. When You Start To Realize How Damaging The Creature Zone Is, You Decide To Finally End The Dictatorship Ran By James DiSonte. While You Try To Start An Uprising, It Turns Out That The Demonic Soul Which Inhabited The Terry's Pizzeria Terry Animatronic Back In Fayville Before It Was Nuked, Are Now In Captivity By The Creature Zone. What Will You Accomplish? What Chaos Will Ensue? And What Choices Will You Make? Play For Free To Find Out! Key Features Realistic Physics With Good Arms Physics-Based Climbing NPCs That Can Get Killed Physics-Based Guns And Much More! WARNING: This Game Has Flashing Lights, Scares, And Blood, So Be Careful. This Game Can Also Cause Motion Sickness, So Also Beware Of This.

rows.name: Hamburg: 'Neue Burg' VR
rows.short_description: Hamburg 1000 years ago: an immersive Virtual Reality Experience with a lot of interactive stations and a detailed reconstruction of a castle and the harbour in the year of 1024. Roam around freely or follow the guided tour in English language.
rows.description_html: Immerse yourself in over 1000 years of Hamburg's history and experience the beginnings of the city in 1024! The 'Neue Burg' - the nucleus of Hamburg's early 'New Town' - has been reconstructed in great detail in collaboration with archaeologists. This immersive Virtual Reality experience offers 22 interactive stations that invite you to discover and understand the history of Hamburg. Climb the castle walls and ship masts, jump back in time and compare then and now, collect parts of a painting to create a portrait of the Duke of the castle and explore models that visualize the 1000-year urban development of this place. You can follow the fully audio-guided tour or explore the entire area freely. 'Hamburg: Neue Burg VR' was developed as part of a PhD project and aims to use the potential of VR to convey history in a playful way. VR hardware necessary! Tested on HTC Vive Pro, Valve Index, Oculus Quest 2 & Pico 4

rows.name: Simulation: Catalyst
rows.short_description: In this game you can enjoy a semi-causal 2d platformer while fully immersing yourself in a 3d parallax environment.
rows.description_html: Simulation: Catalyst is a 2d side scroller in a 3d world. Make your way through each level by jumping, climbing, and avoiding the 'blocks of doom.' Each level gets progressively harder and the faster you complete a level, the higher your score. Challenge yourself or challenge your friends to this simple but addictive gameplay using the arrows keys and space to jump. This is an early version and more features will be supported based on the community input.

rows.name: Psychopomp
rows.short_description: Your entire life has been a lie. There are catacombs under every home and building, stretching down for miles. Something calls you deeper into the labyrinth. Delve into the depths, and discover the monstrosities below.
rows.description_html: Note: A New and Improved Version of Psychopomp has been released! Check out Psychopomp Gold! Welcome to the world of PSYCHOPOMP. There are catacombs hidden under every building in the world. Everyone knew about them, but lied to you about them your entire life. Descend into the depths, and see what awaits below. Psychopomp is a short Psychological Horror Dungeon Crawler. Something is wrong with the world, everything is not as you remember. You don't know why, but everything draws you to the Earth, to the tunnels below. Do the answers await you there, or is something far worse in store? Classic 3D Dungeon Crawler Gameplay! Unique Creatures and Enemies, all sorts of bizarre horrors await you below! Strange Secrets to Find! Bizarre characters to encounter, maybe some friends along the way? Explore a unique and atmospheric world, and uncover the lies that have covered it all up! Enter the catacombs, and immerse yourself in a world that only grows darker the deeper you get. Keep your wits about you, watch your back, and survive.

rows.name: Squirrels Gone Nuts
rows.short_description: Squirrels Gone Nuts is a fast-paced, multiplayer, arena shooter. Play as a speedy squirrel able to run on any surface and wield various guns. GO NUTS!
rows.description_html: You have three different player modes at your disposal: shoot, sprint, and slide. Shoot mode equips your current weapon for firing. Sprint increases your movement speed. Slide allows you to maintain your momentum. If you can see it, you can run on it. Every surface in the arena can be traversed allowing for a unique perspective on the 2D arena shooter. Shoot other players with your weapon, and don't worry you'll never run out of ammo. When you're hurt, grab a health nut to get back up to full health. The way you move around the arena is only limited by your imagination. Utilize the weapons and mechanics to maneuver around and outsmart your opponents.

rows.name: PANZERKAMPF®
rows.short_description: World war of tanks rages on. Join the battle in one of our real-world tanks! Upgrade your vehicles and destroy the enemy! Play with friends and dominate the war! Play for free, in intuitive and easy to grasp UI, with state-of-the-art graphics, particle effects and authentic sound!
rows.description_html: Panzerkampf is a PvP team tank game with tank battles from World War II. You will play with historically accurate tanks and also experimental tanks that existed as concept ideas. Modern era tanks will come into play later on as well. Key aspects of the game are the emphasis on a balanced game setup (no Pay2Win!), excellent gameplay and a clean and intuitive user interface. Panzerkampf is free to play. CHOOSE A TANK AND GET INTO THE BATTLE Select your tank, load up your ammo and equipment, give your crew members their daily orders and go directly into battle! BEGIN UPGRADING PARAMETERS AND POLISHING APPEARANCE OF YOUR TANKS Upgrade your guns, engines and other parameters as you fight. Send members of your crews to regular training exercises. Between battles, you will also be able to apply various camouflages, stickers, and badges to your tanks in the future. PLAY YOUR OWN PERSONAL TANK BATTLES OR FIGHT SIDE BY SIDE WITH FRIENDS Call to battle from your tank for yourself, or connect with friends in the game by simply counting down and entering the same battle. We are working on the option to form a platoon together and join a clan (tank brigade), which will allow you to cooperate in battles to achieve the highest number of victories, communicate with each other, or fight with other friends! IMPROVE YOUR COMBAT SKILLS Advance through battles, gain combat experience, improve your personal stats and fearlessly climb the in-game leaderboards. We will also be introducing new game modes later on, such as Death Match, Flag Conquest, and more! FIGHT IN AN ENVIRONMENT RENDERED WITH THE MOST MODERN TECHNOLOGY The game uses state-of-the-art High Definition Rendering Pipeline. Tank models and environments are highly detailed. Particle effects use advanced animation and rendering techniques. The tank sounds are those of real tank engines and weapons, including of course the legendary German 88!

rows.name: Brew Besties
rows.short_description: Brew Besties is a couch co-op top-down game where 2-4 players have to brew potions and deliver them to impatient customers. Every world comes with unique obstacles that will challenge your teamwork.
rows.description_html: Brew Besties is a couch co-op top-down game where 2-4 players have to brew potions and deliver them to impatient customers. Play through unique and interesting worlds, ranging from outer space, gardens and frozen snowlands! Every world comes with unique obstacles that will challenge your teamwork. Get enough points and gather all three starts per stage to make you and your friends become the true Brew Besties In this chaotic family game you need to work together to brew potions by helping each other prepare ingredients, managing the cauldron’s fire, gathering firewood and reaching remote areas. Use your throwing ability to throw other players, whether to be helpful, or not, is up to you! But remember, both strategy and communication are essential for success.

rows.name: Pavement Pummel
rows.short_description: Welcome to Pavement Pummel, an exhilarating multiplayer physics-based bike racing game. Engage in thrilling races against players worldwide across diverse landscapes. Master the art of strategy, skill, and speed. Navigate through city streets, mountain trails, or off-road terrain.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the world of **Pavement Pummel**, a thrilling multiplayer physics-based bike racing game. Designed with a unique low poly 3D aesthetic, Pavement Pummel offers an immersive gaming experience that is both visually stunning and challenging. In Pavement Pummel, you'll find yourself pitted against players from around the globe in adrenaline-pumping races through diverse landscapes. The game's physics-based mechanics ensure that no two races are the same, making every contest a unique battle of strategy, skill, and speed. Whether you're weaving through city streets, careening down mountain trails, or navigating treacherous off-road terrain, your bike handling skills will be put to the ultimate test. But it's not just about speed - strategic use of power-ups, mastering the art of drafting, and knocking your opponents off their game are all part of the ride. With its easy-to-learn, hard-to-master controls, Pavement Pummel is accessible to players of all skill levels. Whether you're a casual gamer looking for some fun, or a hardcore racer seeking the top of the leaderboard, there's a place for you here. So, are you ready to pummel the pavement and claim your victory? Strap on your helmet, rev up your engine, and join the race in Pavement Pummel!

rows.name: Looking For Cats In a Badly Drawn City
rows.short_description: Explore the amazing corners of a city full of jagged lines and curved outlines. Your goal is to find 100 cats hidden in the most unexpected places!
rows.description_html: Special Offer About the Game Welcome to the badly drawn town where the kittens hide! Explore the amazing corners of a city full of jagged lines and curved outlines. Your goal is to find 100 cats hidden in the most unexpected places! Make your way through the streets and alleyways, looking for cat silhouettes on the roofs and windows of skyscrapers. Listen for magical purrs and follow tails flickering through the clouds! Look for cats in parks with their mysterious trees, under bridges and in the most unexpected places, but be careful, some cats will turn their backs on you and you will only be able to spot them by their silhouette. Use your imagination and keen eye to spot all the cats in the most unusual situations.

rows.name: Supermarket Simulator: Prologue
rows.short_description: Start running your own supermarket with Prologue already. Stock shelves, handle cashier tasks, process online orders, design & expand. Set the prices based on the market. Be prepared to face the consequences if you fail to make the nightly repayment to the gangs.
rows.description_html: SEE FULL VERSION About the Game This Prologue is a limited version of the full game to stop waiting and jump into running your supermarket already. Don't forget to wishlist the full game to continue your most fun supermarket experience. Design your store, optimizing for efficiency and aesthetics. Determine where products are displayed, manage your aisles, and ensure a smooth shopping experience for your customers. Order stock using an in-game computer and anticipate the arrival of your next delivery. Unpack goods, organize them in your storage room and display them on shelves, fridges, and freezers. Read product barcodes, handle cash and credit card transactions, and ensure customers leave satisfied with their shopping and checkout experience. Navigate the complexities of a real-time market. Buy products when prices dip and determine the best-selling prices to balance customer satisfaction with profit margins. Wishlist the full game 'Supermarket Simulator' where every decision matters. Will you rise to the occasion, transforming a modest establishment into a retail powerhouse, all while balancing customer satisfaction, finances, and mafia expectations?

rows.name: Veiled Tales
rows.short_description: 'Veiled Tales' is an adventure game set in Georgia's high mountain village. The story revolves around an ancient tale, guiding the main character, Demetre, through crucial decisions. Immerse yourself in a wild world of deception, where uncovering secrets and mysteries becomes a fight for life.
rows.description_html: Ancient folk tale comes to life and unexpectedly, village trip to grandfather’s house turns into a deadly nightmare. Unleash the mystery of mountains with Demetre by travelling and meeting new people. Dive into a wild forest, hunt down animals, sell the meat and obtain money. “Veiled Tales” is an immersive adventure game set in a picturesque Georgian mountain village. In this 3rd person modern time game, you'll experience Georgia by fitting in Demetre's character. Players immerse themselves in the charm of Georgia’s architecture and language as spoken by the characters. Players' objective is to ultimately reveal secret of Demetre's brother's disappearance. Throughout the journey he faces diverse difficulties and obstacles, helps out villagers, gathers information and acquires ancient, inherited weapon. The first project by Georgian Game Development startup 'Surreal Genesis'. With this modest-size project we sincerely showcase our abilities as a starting point in this field. This is only the beginning of our long, indefatigable and hard journey. Stay tuned!
