rows.name: Aqua Fry
rows.short_description: Dive into chaotic underwater battles that play out like billiards in Aqua Fry. Knock rivals into environmental foes, outsmart the colossal Eye enemy, and hatch eggs to face an epic boss. Cute characters mixed with strategic gameplay – the ultimate 2D, top down, local multiplayer frenzy!
rows.description_html: Dive into the depths of underwater mayhem in this local multiplayer game, where up to 4 players engage in a chaotic free-for-all, akin to shooting pool but with a unique aquatic twist. Aqua Fry combines strategic gameplay, fast-paced action, and a splash of humor for an unforgettable gaming experience. Embark on an underwater adventure where you control quirky sea creatures in a top-down arena. The objective? Knock your opponents into the clutches of menacing sea creatures, trapping them in bubbles and putting them to sleep. But beware, the colossal Eye enemy is always in hot pursuit, adding an extra layer of intensity to every match. Key Features: Simple Controls: Joystick + one-button gameplay. Move with the joystick. Shoot, Charge, Defend with any face/shoulder button on your controller. Local Multiplayer Mayhem: Gather your friends or challenge AI opponents in intense 1-4 player local multiplayer matches. The more, the merrier – or in this case, the more chaotic! Free-for-All Gameplay: Experience the thrill of free-for-all gameplay, where every sea creature is out for themselves. Master the art of precision and timing to outmaneuver your rivals. Bubble Tactics: Utilize bubbles as both weapons and shields. Strategically use bubbles to defend against incoming attacks. Bounce the Eye enemy away from you with a well-aimed shot. Dynamic Arenas: Engage in battles across diverse underwater arenas, each with its own challenges and opportunities. Adapt to your surroundings to emerge victorious. Knock around parts of the arena and use the environment to your advantage! Egg-citing Progression: Win matches to hatch one of your five eggs. Successfully hatch all five eggs to face the ultimate challenge: a boss fish showdown. Defeat the boss to unlock new and exciting playable characters. NOTE: All characters have the same abilities. Dive in today. Are you ready to make a splash and become the ultimate sea champion?

rows.name: Eye see fun
rows.short_description: 'Eye See Fun' is a casual adventure and puzzle game with the main character being an eye. Players engage in the game by manipulating the eye and interacting with objects in the scenes to solve puzzles and unlock different environments. The goal is to help the eye find its companion.
rows.description_html: 'Eye See Fun' is an adventure and puzzle game that offers a rich combination of elements. In this game, players take control of an eye to interact with various objects in the scenes, unravel complex puzzles, and progressively unlock different environments. Adding to the excitement, players have the opportunity to assist non-playable characters (NPCs) in fulfilling their wishes within these diverse settings. It's not just a game; it's the tangible realization of the author's unique and imaginative ideas. The game's design philosophy emphasizes a relaxed and enjoyable gaming experience, completely devoid of any violent or explicit content. It is suitable for players of all ages to unwind and immerse themselves in the delightful atmosphere.

rows.name: Neon Digital
rows.short_description: Shoot portals and curve grenades through them in this fast-paced 1v1 or 3v3 arena shooter. Place portals strategically to outmaneuver opponents on the battlefield. Win by scoring in the net, controlling objective points, or eliminating the enemy team. Master portal tactics to dominate the arena.
rows.description_html: NEON DIGITAL BEND REALITY. MASTER PORTALS. DOMINATE THE ARENA. Enter the electrifying world of Neon Digital, where portal manipulation transforms traditional arena combat in adrenaline-fueled 3v3 or 1v1 matches on experimental server architecture. In this fast-paced tactical shooter, victory demands both lightning reflexes and strategic mastery of portal mechanics. REVOLUTIONARY PORTAL MECHANICS Deploy portals with pinpoint precision to create impossible angles, curve grenades through reality, and access areas your opponents thought were safe. Place portals at long range for tactical advantages or up close for devastating surprise attacks. Every surface is an opportunity to redefine the battlefield. ADVANCED PORTAL STRATEGIES Outthink and outmaneuver your opponents with creative portal placement. Set up complex chains of portals to send projectiles on unpredictable paths or create instant escape routes when under pressure. The most cunning portal strategists will always stay one step ahead. MULTIPLE PATHS TO VICTORY Adapt your strategy to secure victory through different objectives: Score in the opponent's net with skillful portal play Control strategic objective points on the arena floor Eliminate the entire enemy team with calculated precision DYNAMIC 3V3 TEAM GAMEPLAY Coordinate with teammates to execute complex strategies or improvise in the heat of battle. Different player roles ensure every match brings fresh tactical challenges and opportunities for creative portal use. MASTER THE CHAOS Neon Digital rewards creativity and quick thinking. The most successful players will combine strategic portal placement and team coordination to dominate the arena in style. Join the competition today and discover why players call Neon Digital the most innovative arena shooter of the year!

rows.name: Perished World Merchant EX
rows.short_description: An Open World sandbox merchant game. Explore a dangerous world, find supplies, trade with other survivors, upgrade your character, crawl through dungeons and fight against dangerous enemies. Become the savior or the nightmare of the wasteland, is all up to you!
rows.description_html: You play as Red 'the Merchant' Hunter, who has to explore a desolate world looking for supplies to survive and sell to travelers, so that they can follow their journeys and complete their quests. Every trade that you lose means that the chances of that buyer coming back is low. So is up to you to find what they want and to sell at whatever price you want. Open World for you to explore. Day & Night cycle that affect the behavior of your enemies. Watch your meters so you don't get Thirsty, Hungry or Tired. Characters will react differently based in your actions, such as talking with them while a gun is equipped. Any NPC can be killed. Multiple Endings

rows.name: Gravity Dash
rows.short_description: Embark on an adrenaline-fueled journey through the neon-lit streets of a cyberpunk city in Gravity Dash, a 2D infinite runner that will test your reflexes and strategic skills. Immerse yourself in the retro atmosphere, accompanied by a pulsating synthwave soundtrack that sets the tone.
rows.description_html: Embark on an adrenaline-fueled journey through the neon-lit streets of a cyberpunk city in Gravity Dash, a 2D infinite runner that will test your reflexes and focus skills. Immerse yourself in the retro atmosphere, accompanied by a pulsating synthwave soundtrack that sets the tone. Master the art of gravity manipulation as you jump, dash, and switch gravity to overcome obstacles. Navigate through the void and skillfully dodge explosive barrels to keep your run going. Play through three distinct levels, each lasting 180 seconds. With each level, experience a new layer of difficulty that will test your skills and keep the excitement levels high. The longer you run, the faster you become. For gamers seeking a real challenge, venture into the infinite level without any time constraints. See how far you can push your limits as the difficulty dynamically increases, providing an endless challenge for the most skilled players. Gravity Dash is a thrilling race against time and obstacles in a cyberpunk setting. Can you dash, jump, and defy gravity to become the ultimate infinite runner? It's time to find out. Strap in and prepare for a wild run!

rows.name: Instruction
rows.short_description: Generate voltage while uncovering the mysteries of a power plant in this story-based clicker game.
rows.description_html: Instruction is a story based clicker game where you, an employee of a power plant, are tasked with generating power for your city. The powerplant's built in intelligence mentor program, or I.M.P. for short, will help you generate the necessary amount of voltage to fulfill your quota. I.M.P may have developed a little too much of a personality for the powerplant's liking, but don't worry! It's still more than capable of keeping you on track. In this game you'll be tasked with using different systems to generate power. Each system works differently and can be upgraded to increase your efficiency. Discover each of the power plant's mechanisms, and uncover the story behind your less than friendly companion. Over 300 unique lines of dialogue 5 different systems to generate power Secrets and hidden interactions This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Tenno
rows.short_description: Create your ninja, master jutsu, and rise in the ultimate ninja saga RPG!
rows.description_html: Step into the world of Tenno, a 2D MMO Turn-Based RPG that lets you become the ultimate ninja! Inspired by classic ninja RPGs, Tenno delivers thrilling strategic combat, deep character customization, and an expansive ninja world reminiscent of your favorite anime adventures. Explore 5 Elemental Villages: Choose Fire, Water, Wind, Earth, or Thunder, each with its own academy and unique jutsu to master. Learn Legendary Techniques: Train in the ways of Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, and Genjutsu, unlocking powerful jutsu and secret techniques as you progress. Customize Your Ninja: Stand out on the battlefield with six types of custom items: outfits, weapons, back items, hairstyles, faces, and details like masks or tattoos. Master Tactical Battles: Engage in turn-based combat, using your elemental powers and jutsu to outsmart enemies and rival ninjas. Join Epic Events: Unlock rare items and exclusive jutsu through limited-time seasonal events, keeping your ninja equipped for any challenge. Join a world where your ninja destiny awaits—master the elements, customize your character, and engage in thrilling battles in Tenno!

rows.name: Don't Forget
rows.short_description: Don’t Forget is a 3D singleplayer story and exploration game inspired by dementia. Recollect your memories by looking for clues and playing brain-stimulating minigames whilst battling the effects of dementia. Explore three different key events of your life to figure out what has happened.
rows.description_html: Don’t Forget is a 3D singleplayer story and exploration game inspired by dementia. Recollect your memories by looking for clues and playing brain-stimulating minigames whilst battling the effects of your dementia. Piece together the story and don’t forget… Your head feels light and you wake up in a vaguely familiar place You wake up in a vaguely familiar place with only a journal at your side. You don’t know how you got here but maybe retracing your steps will help? Your journal is an anchor in guiding you through several spaces filled with fragments of your past. Recover your memories In order to understand what is happening to you and why, you need to explore three areas linked to your past and fill your journal with recovered memories by playing brain games. You feel like you lost a part of yourself Battle the effects of your illness and beware of its implications. As your journey continues, your perception of reality gets increasingly distorted. Dementia is not something you can control and this will be reflected the longer you linger in both the narrative and gameplay. Meet the team This game was made by a team of 6 students for the final group projects course in the bachelor Digital Arts and Entertainment at Hogeschool West-Vlaanderen in Belgium, during the course of 11 weeks. Special thanks Special thanks to the other people that helped to create this unique experience: our composer Frédérique Le Duc-Moreau, our poet Eve McIntosh, our two supervisors from DAE Tristan Clarysse and Dave Van Verdegem. A big thank you to Digital Arts and Entertainment for publishing our game.

rows.name: Infinite Blue
rows.short_description: Discover an immersive ocean Eco-Sim where you can be almost any animal under the sea! From a tiny seahorse to a massive blue whale, experience the endless circle of life in a massive world of reefs, shipwrecks, and hidden wonders.
rows.description_html: An Immersive Ocean Animal Exploration Game Dive into the world of Infinite Blue, an expansive underwater exploration game where you can become countless different ocean animals and swim through a beautifully realistic ocean environment. A Massive Roster of Aquatic Animals Discover 50 unique species for you to embody on your journey through the depths. Small tropical fish, eight-legged cephalopods, sea turtles, stingray, sharks, whales and much more! An Endless Circle of Life You are what you eat and you become what eats you. Experience both perma-death and never-death as you will always become another animal after dying. Procedurally Generated Reefs Using a hybrid combination of procedural generation and hand-crafted environments you can explore the massive environment that changes every play while retaining a variety of unique feeling areas. Physically Simulated Creatures Realtime physics bodies help create complex movements for the unique physiologies of the sea, bringing incredible life and realism to their interactions with the environment around them. A Massive World To Explore Discover all the wonders of the world from the glistening shallows of Red Reef to the deep trench bottoms of The Abyss. You'll want to see every inch of this world as certain species are unique to their particular environment. You never know what might be lurking in the depths... SeaTuber Mode A special feature I added for V-Tubers and content creators that will sync your animals mouth with your microphone output allowing them to become your avatar for more immersive RP. Truly innovation at it's finest and not a silly idea that made me laugh. Developer Disclaimer: Infinite Blue is my first game using Unreal Engine and was built in around 6 months as a learning project for me to test out the many tools and features UE5 has to offer. It lacks some of the more complex RPG elements my other simulators have and is more of a Sandbox / Exploration experience. I hope you enjoy it and get an idea of the possibilities we'll have going forward with the new engine.

rows.name: ZomBay
rows.short_description: ZomBay is a zombie shoot'em up game. Survive waves of endless zombies and gain exp to get the best guns!
rows.description_html: ZomBay is a zombie shoot'em up game. In ZomBay, players will face relentless waves of the undead while defending their base and their own survival in various heart-pounding game modes, each with unique challenges: Zombay has 3 modes: 1. BASE ATTTACK MODE: is based around the idea of WW2's battle of Normandy, while using modern elements from past popular shooting games. Hence the name, ZomBay. 2. SWAM MODE: Survive waves of endless zombies and gain exp to get the best guns! 3. CLEAR MODE: Clear each level of zombie as quickly as possible to get the best score! In ZomBay you'll find yourself defending your base, as well as your player. In Base Attack Mode zombies will charge the barricades and break through while you desperately try to hold them back! In Swam Mode zombies will swarm the player and increase in numbers over time! In Clear Mode zombies will patrol the map and the player will try to clear the level as quickly as possible! Features: 1. Tons of UNIQUE guns, with ADS (Aim down sights) or alternative firing modes! 2. ZOMBIE HORDES! 3. Online leaderboards with anti-cheat 4. 'Roguelike' gameplay loop (No winning, only getting better each time!) 5. Tons of GPU instancing and object pooling for optimal game performance! 6. Unlock guns for free up to level 60! 7. Skill tree with upgrades to improve player performance! 8. Updates with new content and bug fixes!

rows.name: SirKwitz
rows.short_description: Dive into SirKwitz: a beginner-friendly edutainment game that makes learning programming easy & fun! Explore 28 puzzles across four topics to master the very core concepts behind programming and develop your problem-solving skills. Ideal for those that think coding & programming are scary words!
rows.description_html: Embark on an enlightening journey into the world of coding with 'SirKwitz,' an introductory educational game designed to demystify the fundamentals of programming. This beginner-friendly game is a perfect entry point for young people and adults new to the field, offering a hands-on approach to learning basic programming, through a series of engaging puzzles. Over four main topics, each comprised of seven levels, players will explore key coding concepts: base logic, loops, orientation, sequences, and debugging. 'SirKwitz' combines learning with enjoyable gameplay, featuring a simple yet intuitive UI used to puppeteer our cute little robot which will help you translate programming concepts into instant action. The game focuses on developing core skills essential for budding programmers, such as problem analysis, spatial orientation, logic, and computational thinking, along with fostering attributes like focus and perseverance. Key Features: • Especially tailored for those who think 'programming' is a scary word; • Engaging, story-driven gameplay; • Simple yet complicated puzzles teaching core programming concepts; • Simple, clean & intuitive user interface, suitable for both young learners and adults alike.

rows.name: Skillwood
rows.short_description: Skillwood is a relaxing woodcutter simulator inspired by survival simulators and incremental games. Chop wood, mine stone, trade with NPCs, upgrade forests, unlock new trees or new areas and prestige to do even better next run.
rows.description_html: Coming soon! About the Game Game revolves around resource gathering by chopping or mining, while keeping enought stamina to do it. Upgrade your fireplace to increase maximum stamina and regenerate it neat the fireplace faster. To get new resources for your structures you can explore different areas. It may require building bridges and ladders. To get more trees and rocks upgrade unlocked areas, so more new trees and stones will spawn. Using skills will upgrade them and increase efficency of hits, however when you reach the tier limit you have to upgrade corrseponding workbench. It will increase efficency hugely but also increase stamina spent. There are also renewable food sources such as berry bushes that can provide some fast stamina.

rows.name: Let's Patiti!
rows.short_description: 'Let's Patiti!' is a multiplayer party game that supports 2-4 players and can be played online or locally. In the game, you take on the role of an adorable little cat, engaging in a game of chase and cunning competition with your 'Meow Meow' friends or AI in the 'Meow Meow Forest'.
rows.description_html: 关注我们 Dear players, Thank you for your continuous support and enthusiastic feedback for our game. If you would like to learn more about the latest information, please follow our social media accounts: Our official Xiaohongshu account: 独立游戏Let's Patiti! Our QQ group: 106727313 We will continuously improve the gaming experience. Thank you for your understanding and support, and we wish you a pleasant time in the game! The Patiti Team Thank you for your support Dear players, We are deeply sorry to see that Patiti has encountered some bugs during its initial release. We value your feedback greatly and are working tirelessly to address these issues to provide a better gaming experience. We have detailed the known bugs in the Steam update notes and will continue to provide regular updates on our progress. Furthermore, we have established feedback channels through social media, the official website, and within the game itself, encouraging everyone to actively report issues. We will promptly respond and consider valuable suggestions. We understand that these issues may have affected your gaming experience, and for this, we sincerely apologize. Please believe that our team is fully committed to resolving these issues and promises to provide solutions in future updates. Known bugs and temporary solutions are as follows: For the phenomenon of red screen and yellow screen, please lower the graphics quality on the game's main interface. Players are unable to change graphics quality back at the lobby after the game has ended. Change graphics quality at the game's startup instead. If the game freezes on the loading screen, it may be due to a player's high graphics setting. Close the game, reopen, and adjust the graphics quality to continue playing. Currently, in public rooms, it's possible to encounter full rooms that still appear in searches. Attempting to enter these rooms may lead to game freezes. Close the game and search for a new room to join the game. During this process, if you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to reach out to us. We appreciate your support and patience and look forward to presenting a more refined Patiti for you in the future. Thank you! About the Game 🎮 《Let's Patiti!》—— Friendship Annihilator's Meow Marathon 🐾 Winner of 'Best Friendship-Wrecker Game' Nomination (Not responsible for broken friendships!) 🔢 Core Formula (Online brawls + Local sabotage) × Sinisterly addictive cats = 2025's ultimate party poison 🐾 Feline Frenzy Party Up to 4-player online multiplayer mayhem! Play as mischievous kittens in chaotic forest battles. Double the fun with real friends, or enjoy AI training mode – even solo players can LOL like crazy cats! 🌀 Every Match = New Script Mysterious Meow Forest hides bizarre creatures: ▸ Bee cubs balancing cat food cans 🐻🍯 ▸ Fruit-selling raccoon 'Tong Dawei' 🦝🍎 ▸ Rats bigger than cats?! 🐭💥 Collect magical card combos to unlock wild strategies! 💥 Triple Threat Fun 1️⃣ Item Warfare - Wield weapons like [Salty Fish Remote], [Mad Rat Mobile] to troll friends! 2️⃣ Mini-Game Chaos - Sudden rhythm battles/brain teasers test reflexes 3️⃣ Final Dash Showdown - Transform into Lightning Cats, race for the Golden Fish Trophy! 💣 Meow Forest Survival Guide Environmental Hazards: ✓ Muscle Rats throwing random punches 💪🐀 ✓ Suspicious catnip piles and 💩 landmines Player-Induced Disasters: ✓ Cat Teaser Wand that forces opponents to perform 'Learn to Meow' dance 🎶 ✓ Exploding Garlic that makes friends kowtow to you 🧄💣 🏁 All schemes culminate in a fur-flying final sprint! Master terrain and items to become the champion cat on the podium! ⚠️ Friendly Reminder Here, friendships are fragile – your 'bestie' sharing cat food might portal you into a volcano next second! Gather your meow squad for this ultimate test of skills and morality! 💡 Pro Tip ✦Currently, Let's Patiti! officially supports UU Accelerator only . Using other acceleration tools may result. ✦ While cross-network play is supported, LAN parties deliver 200% better 'tail-on-fire' chasing action! ✨ Gather your frenemies for a meow-tastic battle royale NOW! ✨

rows.name: The Eminence in Shadow: Master of Garden
rows.short_description: Enter the world of The Eminence in Shadow: Master of Garden, a multiplayer, narrative driven, action-RPG where players form their own party from a deep roster of unique characters, voiced by the actors from the anime, and engage in new stories, to take down the world-threatening Cult of Diabolos.
rows.description_html: SUPPORT FOR THE ENGLISH VERSION ***Please note that game data cannot be linked between the English and Japanese versions. About the Game ・Based on the popular light novel, manga and anime franchise - The Eminence in Shadow: Master of Garden is finally available on Steam! ・Faithfully rendered characters from The Eminence in Shadow grace this beautiful high intensity party-based action battler. ・Strategically build your perfect squad to tackle the Cult of Diabolos and the many powerful enemies arrayed against Shadow and his elite warriors, the Shadow Garden. ・Progress through rich story and lore faithful to the original books plus exclusive game-only story content, 1-on-1 chats with each character, arena fights, guild battles, mini-games and more! ～World～ “The Eminence in Shadow.” Not the main character, and not the last boss. The one who lurks in the shadows of the storyline and holds all the power, hiding his true abilities by acting like a side character. The boy who longs to be a 'Shadowbroker' lives an unobtrusive life as a side character, training to gain magic power until he's killed in an accident and reincarnated into another world. Reborn as Cid Kagenou, the boy decides to enjoy himself in this other world with a made-up scenario about 'the Eminence in Shadow.' He starts fooling around with secret maneuvers against an evil cult that he born from his imagination... and it turns out that the cult really does exist! The girls he took on as his subordinates on a whim began worshiping Cid as Shadow, and before he knows it, Cid has become a true 'Eminence in Shadow.' Before long, Cid—along with his mysterious group the Shadow Garden—will destroy the darkness of his new world. The Strongest MC x Overwhelming Chuunibyou x A Serious Comedy Full of Misunderstandings!? ～What's Special?～ ◆ Experience The Eminence in Shadow's epic story modes! Continue the story with new chapters, beat exciting new challenges and get the latest characters after every new episode with anime-updates! Featuring cutting-edge 3D graphics and anime cutscenes, Master of Garden's story spotlights characters with memorable scenes from the anime and untold events from the light novels! Whether you're a fan of the light novels, or have yet to see The Eminence in Shadow, Master of Garden's story is sure to satisfy any anime fan! ◆ Every original 'Seven Shadows Chronicles' and event story is supervised by Daisuke Aizawa, author of the original light novels! Discover the fate of the Seven Shadows during their 'missing two years' away from Shadow only in 'Master of Garden'! ◆ Play 3D battles straight from the Anime! Destroy your enemies in exciting anime-style 3D graphics! ◆ Fight with the Seven Shadows! Team-up with Rose, Alexia & Beta and unleash their worst! Unleash Rose & Alexia's sister power! Build your dream party using any character from The Eminence in Shadow! Plus, specific matches will result in special battle animations you can't see anywhere else! Share your favorite secret moves on social media! ◆ Fill your Combo gauge to unleash Strike Combos! Master of Garden's unique battle system generates combos based on your party's action order! Strategize your best move from near-infinite character-order combinations! ◆ Get 1-on-1 time with your favorite heroine! Talk to your favorite girl on the Home Screen every day! You might be surprised - Deepen your bond to see an unexpected, new side of her! ◆ The incredible cast of 'The Eminence in Shadow' Cid / Shadow (Voice: Seiichiro Yamashita) Alexia Midgar (Voice: Kana Hanazawa) Alpha (Voice: Asami Seto) Beta (Voice: Inori Minase) Gamma (Voice: Suzuko Mimori) Delta (Voice: Fairouz Ai) Epsilon (Voice: Hisako Kanemoto) Zeta (Voice: Ayaka Asai) Eta (Voice: Reina Kondo) Rose Oriana (Voice: Haruka Shiraishi) Claire Kagenou (Voice: Rina Hidaka) Nu (Voice: Maaya Uchida) Aurora (Voice: Kaori Nazuka) Chi (Voice: Mayu Minami) Omega (Voice: Ryoko Maekawa) Lambda (Voice: Ikumi Hasegawa) Yukime (Voice: Shizuka Ito) Elisabeth (Voice: Saori Hayami) ◆ Opening Theme Song: 'grayscale dominator' Lyrics: hotaru Music: Tom-H@ck ◆ Music Basiscape Co.,Ltd. - Main Works: ELDEN RING, DISSIDIA FINAL FANTASY, others ◆ 'The Eminence in Shadow' anime creators (titles abbreviated) Original Story: Daisuke Aizawa Original Characters: Touzai Director: Kazuya Nakanishi Character Design: Makoto Iino Animation: Nexus Production: Shadow Garden ◆ Recommended if you... - Are a fan of 'The Eminence in Shadow' - Have dreamt of reincarnating in another world - Want to become the eminence in shadow yourself! - Have vowed to defeat an evil cult threatening the world - Love anime, manga and light novels! - Want 1-on-1 time with cute anime girls - Want to experience major misunderstandings - Can't resist a great RPG - Are looking for an amazing F2P game - Want to play the latest mobile anime RPG! ◆ Pricing: Free-to-Play (in-app items available for purchase). ©Daisuke Aizawa,KADOKAWA/Shadow Garden ©Master of Garden Project Published under license by Crunchyroll Games, LLC

rows.short_description: DON'T FACE UP is a first-person horror game. Never make eye contact with them. They may appear and disappear. They may be standing in the direction you suddenly turn your eyes. Even in such a situation, you must proceed with your search for the building. Therefore, 'DON'T FACE UP.'
rows.description_html: DON'T FACE UP is a first-person horror game. Story You wake up in a building you don't recognize. No, you can't remember who you are, let alone the building. You have lost your memory. The words 'DON'T FACE UP' are left at your feet. Unsure of what it means, you proceed to explore the building. You will have to find out what happened to you and what happened to this place. Rule They will appear at your side. Never make eye contact with them. They may appear and disappear. They may be standing in the direction you suddenly turn your eyes. Even in such a situation, you must proceed with your search for the building. Therefore, 'DON'T FACE UP.' Note: This game is NOT playable on SteamDeck!

rows.name: In The Shadows
rows.short_description: Embark on a short yet captivating journey in 'In The Shadows'. Player must manipulate abstract objects, harnessing the power of light and shadow, to cast silhouettes that form familiar shapes and objects.
rows.description_html: Embark on a short yet captivating journey in 'In The Shadows.' In this game, players are tasked with manipulating abstract objects, harnessing the power of light and shadow, to cast silhouettes that form familiar shapes and objects. The Game The game was crafted as part of a school project in a month and a half with no prior experience in Unreal Engine 5. Every element was created by me, utilizing free assets, and the voice lines were graciously provided by my sister (thanks, sis). Should you encounter any bugs or crashes, please don't hesitate to report them in the discussion section. If you enjoyed this brief adventure, you can support me by purchasing the short soundtrack as a DLC. Gameplay Navigate through the game's world using the WASD keys for movement. The mouse allows you to look around and examine your surroundings. When engaging with puzzles, the mouse movement is crucial for rotating them. For additional interaction, right-click and drag the mouse to move puzzles along the last axis of rotation. Interaction with puzzles is made simple by holding 'E'. A hint will be displayed to help you figure out what shape to look for. Press 'Esc' to access the in-game menu. Within this menu, you'll find options to rebind movement keys according to your preferences and adjust various graphic settings to enhance or optimize your visual experience. Source code In the spirit of learning and sharing, the source code for 'In The Shadows' is available on my GitHub, which can be found in the game's information section on the right.

rows.name: Gods Against Machines Prologue
rows.short_description: Your world is under attack by a ruthless race of machines, and you are its only hope. Cast epic spells, summon minions or buildings, and destroy the enemy before they conquer your home in this action roguelite shoot'em up game!
rows.description_html: Wishlist the full game About the Game Machines are taking over your world! Their buildings destroy forests, their factories pollute the earth and water. The air is filled with the hum of drones and ships. Your home is dying! Gods Against Machines is an action-packed roguelite shoot'em up (with RTS ideas mixed in) where every run is different thanks to a wide variety of spells and blessings, as well as procedurally generated maps. Here is what you will do in a typical mission of the campaign: Protect your world - Huge crystals rising from the ground are your source of mana. Protect them and (optionally, if your build includes such spells) build your base around them with spells that summon different types of buildings - mini volcanoes that bombard enemies from afar, or spirit dwellings that spawn powerful sprites to fight for you. Cast Epic Spells - Use your offensive spells to rain down destruction on your enemies - literally! Fire Rain, Thunderstorm, Meteor Storm - all powerful destructive abilities that unleash your wrath upon the machines. Control Corruption - Prevent machines from spreading corruption - either by destroying their terraformers or by cleaning the corruption yourself using various spells or minions. Reap as many rewards as you can - the less corruption your world has suffered, the more rewards you will receive! Acquire new spells, add new abilities to existing spells, and use powerful Blessings to improve your build and find game-changing synergies! But that is not all! Not only do you have several gods to choose from, each with their own special spells and mechanics, but there is also Gaia, the Mother of Nature. She will help you throughout the campaign and has her own special powers - and you will be able to activate some of them in each run! In addition, the game's roguelite progression is based on Gaia's powers: Meta Progression - Each run allows you to upgrade the abilities of Gaia, who will help you throughout the campaign. The more you play, the more powerful Gaia becomes, and the easier it will be for you to progress! Go beyond the normal campaign into the Void Realm - the game's endless mode. How far can you go? Synergize your powers with Gaia - Pick the right Gaia powers to activate and get crazy synergies that are otherwise impossible. Experiment, upgrade, and replay the campaign to get the overpowered build you need to conquer even the Void Realm! Try out over 3 dozen different spells, more than 50 blessings, and activate one of 3 available (9 total) Gaia powers. rows.name: Pet Shop Simulator: Prologue
rows.short_description: The Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game. Run your pet shop! Find new homes for pets, thus fulfilling the dreams of your customers. Take care of the needs of animals by selling the right items and get involved in matters related to the pets home life!
rows.description_html: The prologue is only part of the full game and is completely free. Every player will be able to play it and see what awaits them in the full version of the game. Main features is Prologue: - there are only rabbits and fish - some of the products in the store are blocked - some of the objects in the store are blocked - in Prologue it is possible to buy one store next door If something is available or unavailable in Prologue, it is marked in the game. Run a pet shop Your main task in Pet Shop Simulator: Prologue will be to run a pet shop. Your duties will include not only finding wonderful new homes for the animals, but also ensuring that they have a wonderful and prosperous life. Therefore, supplement your store with the right assortment so that when you give your pet back, provide it with the right accessories. Make your customers' dreams come true All sorts of customers will come to your pet shop. From the elderly to parents with children, or students. Each of them will have specific preferences regarding the pet they want to surround with their care and love. Your role will be to make their dreams come true and find them a perfect home. Make sure you have the right equipment for your pets Choosing the right pets for your clients is not all you need to spend time on. It is equally important to provide each pet with the appropriate food, equipment, and accessories that they will take with them. You have to make sure that you choose the right cage size for your pets, offer the best food, brushes for combing fur, and remember about toys and treats. Every detail will translate into the well-being of the pet and the knowledge of the new owner! Manage and take care of your pet shop As the owner of a pet shop, one of the challenges that await you in the game will be the proper management of the entire shop. Check the assortment of stores, make orders, import specialized equipment at the request of your customers. Proper management of your business will bring you many benefits, but also will allow you to find a perfect home for your pets. Develop your pet business Manage and develop your pet shop, expanding its space, possibilities and assortment. Take care of your customers and their opinion, buy new properties nearby and grow your business!

rows.name: Deconstruction Simulator: Prologue
rows.short_description: Deconstruction Simulator: Prologue is the ultimate demolition simulator, offering you complete freedom of action and a wide array of contracts to complete. Get ready for spectacular destruction.
rows.description_html: In the free Prologue you can expect: DESTRUCTION Save/load system Company personalization 3 exciting contracts to complete 5 tools of destruction 5 tools for dismantling Wrecking ball! Set of orders to fulfill Garage expansion DEMOLISH, RECOVER, SELL Find the contract of your dreams. Demolish and dismantle. Recover building materials and valuable items, then sell them for profit or recycle them. Every contract presents a new challenge and opportunities to earn money. BECOME THE KING OF DEMOLITION Take apart houses and furniture piece by piece, or destroy them with a hammer and wrecking ball. Advanced destruction physics allows you to precisely plan every demolition action or embrace chaos and watch as everything collapses beautifully - rundown shacks or luxurious villas. PLAY YOUR WAY Do you want to be a respected professional? Or perhaps a shady operator? You decide which contracts to take on and how to approach them. You can follow the precise instructions of your clients or demolish everything whatever you want. However, remember that every violation impacts not only your potential payout but also the valuable reputation of your company! UPGRADE YOUR EQUIPMENT AND BUY PROPERTIES Once you’ve earned a substantial amount of money, invest it in growing your business! Buy a bigger vehicle, expand your warehouse, and upgrade your tools. Decide where you want your deconstruction business to go. There are many exciting decisions to make. DOMINATE THE DEMOLITION BUSINESS Gain experience and build your reputation in the contract market. Achieve higher levels of demolition permits, unlocking access to increasingly complex and better-paying jobs. Dominate the demolition market!

rows.name: The Rubberhose Forest
rows.short_description: Welcome to a bone-chilling horror experience set a world inspired by the iconic Steamboat Willie cartoon and Slender: The eight pages. You are a daring cargo collector, navigating through an eerie forest, collecting valuable cargo while desperately avoiding the nightmarish duo, Mickey and Minnie.
rows.description_html: Welcome to a bone-chilling horror experience set a world inspired by the iconic Steamboat Willie cartoon and Slender: the eight pages. You are a daring cargo collector, navigating through an eerie forest, collecting valuable cargo while desperately avoiding the nightmarish duo, Mickey and Minnie. Once beloved characters, Mickey and Minnie have transformed into strange entities, their hollow eyes and eerie smiles haunting your every move. Your objective is simple: Collect valuable cargo scattered throughout the forest and return them to the dock inside a timeframe, while trying to not get caught. Be aware! The game uses you microphone, so keep quiet and everything should be alright. The base game was made as a small project for fun in about a week, with further updates added afterwards to improve on the gameplay.

rows.name: Goat Scourge
rows.short_description: Quiet village life is disturbed by the attack of the Ogre Sorcerer, who needs goat bones for his magical experiments. The beloved pet goat of a village boy is stolen - and he risks it all to save the goat's life. Help him retrieve his pet - and explore the village and its outskirts in our game.
rows.description_html: Quiet village life is disturbed by the attack of the Ogre Sorcerer, who needs goat bones for his magical experiments. The beloved pet goat of a village boy is stolen - and he risks it all to save the goat's life. Help him retrieve his pet - and explore the village and its outskirts in our game. The game contains several scenes in which the main character solves quests, explores the level with platformer mechanics, and confronts NPCs. The main goal of the character is to overcome all the obstacles, and save the goat. He will face the antagonist, whose aim is to collect the artefacts for his magic potion. You will have a chance to play for both of them. The entire game is quite short: you will jump on an adventure and will be done in less than an hour. But what an hour it will be! This game was made with MANU Video Game Maker - no-code game engine! Controls: Movement - WASD; Jump - Space; Interact - E; Interface buttons - 1-5; Menu Interaction - Enter; Attack/Chop - LAlt; Goat Minigame - 1-3; Quest Open/close - Q

rows.name: Guano
rows.short_description: Play as a delightfully dumb seagull, find food and complete quests to help free the Grand Masters and gain their powers. Harrass humans and free the Pohemeda Islands from the evil Food Inc. with your powerful poop and loud screams!
rows.description_html: Play as Guano, a dumb seagull that has a lot on his shoulders! While the protectors of the Pohemeda Islands, the Three Grand Masters, are neutralized, you’re the only hope to rescue your home. Food Inc., an evil and polluting megacorporation, seems to have set its mind on destroying every natural aspect of your archipelago. Get strong enough to stop Food Inc. before their garbage overtakes the islands! Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to wreak havoc in the Food Inc. installations, by pooping, screaming and stealing the food of tourists attracted by the corp and its leisure-filled resort. Use the stolen food to feed the Grand Masters, restore their strength and acquire their powers through a very sacred ritual: Regurgitation. Fly at incredible speeds in a stimulating open-world, populated by goofy characters! Friends or enemies? Race against them through breathtaking landmarks to discover new powers! Save the Pohemeda Islands from Food Inc, a megacorporation polluting the heavenly archipelago. Get help from three powerful Grand Masters to succeed in your quest. Finally get the chance to drop a dookie on those pesky tourists! Yell at Food Inc. employees until they go flying! Steal their food just like they stole your land!

rows.name: Zarathustra - Cybergeddon
rows.short_description: Take on the role of Agent Amy Tanner and solve a case in a cyberpunk future, where technology and religion have become one - A classic pixel art point&click adventure.
rows.description_html: In the aftermath of The Inflection, a momentous event that unveiled cosmic truths and alien technology, two religious factions emerge: the Church of Flesh, embracing chaos and free will, and the Church of Neon, upholding order and stability. Amy, an FBI agent affiliated with the Church of Neon, carries with her a unique asset: a cybernetic implant housing the consciousness of a past individual—you, the player. Together, you navigate the complexities of a case involving a book stolen from the Church of Flesh. This investigation is set against the backdrop of a world grappling with the implications of its newfound enlightenment and the delicate balance between these two divergent philosophies. Zarathustra is a classic point and click adventure with inventory and dialog puzzles. It's a rather casual experience with no dead-ends or overly difficult puzzles.

rows.short_description: Exploring a disarrayed food factory, play as Lyft and fight your way through this chaos using powerful abilities. Face off against relentless robots and bring them to pieces. There’s only one option left to stop them: destroy them, throw them, PUNCH 'EM!
rows.description_html: Food for Thought strives to deliver the best food products to the common people, but when its robot workers turn against Lyft, the last human in the factory, she has to step up and punch some steel. Uncover the truth behind this attack, find your boss for answers, and put an end to this with style and power. Unleash powerful blows to enemies, use them as a weapon and utilize the environment to your advantage. Delve deep inside Food for Thought 's factory and unravel the dark secrets that have been hidden for many years. Encounter a variety of enemies that can punch, shoot or block your attacks. Finish them off in style with a devastating blow.

rows.short_description: Degenerate loner jailbreaks a stolen android.
rows.description_html: Kinetic visual novel. (Only Main heroine is fully voice-acted.) The year is 2052. In a dystopian future where no one goes outside. rows.short_description: Fight back entities and run from those they persuade as you seal the portal before MR 333 is given access to the world of your home.
rows.description_html: After leaving the portal you are taken HOME. Home of origin will require you to seal off entities linked from escape portal. It will not take long for them to follow back, and thus opening the doorway for MR 333. Failure to complete the ritual you embarked on will open your home to the being and his entities wish to ensure this happens. The only way to seal off and continue the ritual is to birth a prison planet in their realm, a place where the vibrations can hold them and not give them reign in yours. Become pregnant, birth a planet and seal off the entities. MR 333 II: Planetbirth features a first person perspective with frantic gameplay requiring you to locate items, fight entities and run from enemies existing in your realm. Navigate the house after returning 'Home' and explore the surrounding areas. Rebuke entities and run from those corrupted. Become pregnant with the planetary fertile snake and fight the entities through each trimester. This is a small sequel to MR 333 that features an additional level to take place directly after the completion of the ritual from the previous game.

rows.name: DragonLoop: Prologue
rows.short_description: The heroine who lost her memory was trapped in a five-day loop. Connect with your partners to travel through a world with strange time changes, continue to become stronger, retrieve memories, and understand the truth. The game is a time loop Metroidvania.
rows.description_html: This is the prologue of DragonLoop. The prologue version is the first hour of the official edition. DragonLoop is a 5-day timeloop metroidvania, with the prologue being a specially customized 3-day timeloop of 1 hour content. Players will be able to play some of the areas in this episode over a 3-day timeloop. Please wishlist the DragonLoop if you like this game. The heroine who lost her memory was trapped in a five-day loop. Together with your partner, travel through a world with strange time changes, escape from reincarnation through exploration and combat, and learn the truth about the world! In the cycle, you will regain your memory and continue to become stronger. You can take advantage of new abilities, explore new areas, and defeat new enemies. You can also go back to the old area, defeat enemies that are different from what you remember, and try to change your known destiny. The game is a time loop Metroidvania. Change of time Dynamic world! Enemies, maps, NPCs... many contents will change over time. The game has a special timing method that allows you to explore as much as you want. Fight happily Easy-to-learn, fast-paced and smooth combat! Use the flexible [Link] to dash forward quickly, combine combos, and summon practical plants to assist in combat. Boss battle Use your powerful performance to engage in high-speed duels with dangerous bosses with different styles!

rows.name: That Way!
rows.short_description: Help your partner perform the heist of a lifetime! Send him instructions for how to get to each vault and make a getaway with your newly found fortune!
rows.description_html: That Way! is a platformer about planning your path to reach a series of guarded vaults. For each vault, create a list of commands that will help your partner reach it. When you are ready, send them to him one by one to get him there. You will navigate through 50 levels, each containing more hazards than the last. Plan carefully and watch your timing to ensure your victory! Controls Shift: Switch between 'Plan' and 'Run' modes Ctrl/Command + Arrows: Pan Camera Esc: Pause Plan Mode Controls WASD: Add new command Up/Down Arrows: Scroll through commands Run Mode Controls Enter: Send command

rows.name: SWORD OF JUSTICE
rows.short_description: “Sword of Justice” is sparking a rebellion against outdated RPG builds! This groundbreaking Open World MMO defies tradition with stunning visuals and an immersive, lifelike atmosphere that deeply influences the game world. Step into 'The Pulsing Martial World' and experience its breath-taking allure
rows.description_html: “Sword of Justice” is sparking a rebellion against outdated RPG builds! This groundbreaking Open World MMO defies tradition with stunning visuals and an immersive, lifelike atmosphere that deeply influences the game world. Step into 'The Pulsing Martial World' and experience its breath-taking allure. Premium Quality, Top-Tier Artistry “Sword of Justice” is adapted from the classic literary masterpiece “The Four Great Constables: Sword of Justice” by Wen Ruian, one of the 'Four Grandmasters of Chinese Martial Arts Literature.' Combining pure Oriental classical aesthetics with modern chip graphics technology, it creates a unique and refined art style.It offers a solid single-player Open World RPG experience, blending the joy of inclusivity with a rich and layered sparring system. No Grind, No P2W, Your Journey, Your Way Sword of Justice introduces the groundbreaking 'Paths Converge' system, where both competitive and casual players can earn full rewards through their preferred playstyles. The game abandons tedious grinding and shatters outdated MMO conventions, offering a stress-free experience. As the first season-based open-world MMO, the game offers hundreds of skills and pieces of equipment across its vast world for players to explore and acquire without paywalls. Open World, Endless Possibilities Players step into a vast open world, rich in Eastern aesthetics and the breathtaking scenery of the Song Dynasty. Roam the land, conquer peaks and caverns, and seek out lost weapons and martial techniques. Solve ancient puzzles and uncover wonders. Master martial arts to battle mythical beasts and outlaws across the wilderness, gathering rare treasures. Beyond combat, Sword of Justice brings the bustling streets of the Song Dynasty to life. Players can perform, test their skill in archery, preside over court trials, and engage in nearly a hundred professions in a world inspired by Along the River During the Qingming Festival. Unparalleled Competition, Challenge Accepted The game breaks free from traditional class restrictions with a revolutionary martial arts system. Tanks can heal while healers can unleash powerful attacks. Players can combine hundreds of martial skills freely to create unique fighting styles—your game, your rules. Epic Dungeons, Stunning Visuals Rally legendary heroes for epic dungeons, and feast your eyes on unique weapons, stunning skill effects, and cinematic combat animations. Solo Gamers' Haven, Relax and Play Breaking away from traditional online games that force players into mandatory team-ups, the 'NPC Companion System' enables solo players to tackle group dungeons, making gaming less stressful. “Sword of Justice” emphasizes the joy of diversity and values the experience of laid-back players. Its 'casual light gameplay' is exceptionally rich, offering equal core rewards. Farming, fishing, chess, sightseeing, travel, and archaeology—activities often considered 'offbeat' in traditional RPGs—take center stage in Sword of Justice. Sword of Justice invites players to step into its pulsing martial world. Together, we'll forge a new era of MMORPGs. Every encounter in the world is written by fate.

rows.name: The Lost Glitches
rows.short_description: The Lost Glitches is a Techno Optimist Trading Card Game with RPG progression. Head to head PvP battles require strategy, unique deck construction and clever wits to climb the ladder.
rows.description_html: Play Your Story The Lost Glitches is what happens when a bunch of card nerds, storytellers, and artists asked: “What if a deck was more than a win condition — what if it was your story?”  So we built a world where your cards don’t just play, they speak. This is a game where deckbuilding meets character progression, where your strategy evolves as your avatar does. With layered RPG mechanics, open-ended build paths, and faction mixing that encourages experimentation, The Lost Glitches invites you to play with intention, and identity.  There’s no single way to win here. No perfect list to copy. Just a city full of memory-hunters, code-benders, and digital ghosts waiting to see what kind of story you’ll tell through the cards you choose to bring to the fight. Features Play your army strategically, only 5 slots available. 300+ cards to collect Play ranked against players of your level Monthly season with booster pack rewards based on your rank Complete daily, weekly & monthly challenges Fair reward system of packs and items that promotes gameplay and strategy Play private unranked matches with friends Persistent progression with 3 skill trees, with 20+ skills each. Bring 3 skills to battle Growing inventory of cosmetics like avatars, sleeves and more to come Immerse Yourself in a Cyberpunk World Step into a world that feels like it’s been patched together from old code, forgotten dreams, and neon scraps. The Lost Glitches throws you into a cyberpunk universe buzzing with energy, where hackers are heroes, and memories are more valuable than currency. It’s part card game, part RPG, all style, made for those who get a kick out of cracking systems and crafting wild decks. No hand-holding, no fluff, just you, your cards, and a city that’s alive with static. Strategic Depth with Zero Hand-Holding Every match in The Lost Glitches is a mental dance — no gimmicks, no cheap wins. Just pure tactical thinking and raw decision-making. Build your collection card by card, shape your character over time, and grow stronger not because the game gave you a shortcut, but because you figured it out. Progression here isn’t dressed up in flashing lights. It’s slow-burn satisfaction. The kind that comes from unlocking synergy, pulling off a crazy combo you built from scratch, or turning a losing hand into a last-turn win. This is for players who want to think, not just click. Victory’s never handed to you — it’s earned! Skill-Based Mastery The Lost Glitches rewards true TCG enthusiasts who take pride in their strategic brilliance. Outthink and outmaneuver your opponents in matches that highlight your expertise. Experience the satisfaction of mastering a game that values your skill over chance. The Lost Glitches delivers for both Pilots and Builders alike! Unmatched Stunning Art Luck might hand you a win once, but The Lost Glitches is built for players who thrive on outthinking their opponents. Every match is a mental duel. You study the board, play the long game, and pull off wins not because the stars aligned, but because you earned it. If you enjoy learning the ins and outs of every card, crafting smart plays, and watching your strategies unfold exactly as planned, you’re in the right place. Grimy, Poetic, Indie Grit The art in The Lost Glitches isn’t just eye candy. It’s part of the code, part of the story. Cards don’t just sit there — they flicker, pulse, breathe. Every detail feels like it was ripped from a corrupted hard drive and stitched back together with neon thread. This world is messy, strange, and beautiful. Exactly how it should be. Creative Freedom Without Limits No rigid deck archetypes. No locked-in combinations. You build how you want. Smash together different syndicates. Stack up wild combos. Create something nobody saw coming. If you’ve got an idea that sounds crazy on paper but might just work — try it. Half the fun is in the experiment. The other half is when it actually works. A Collector’s Playground with Real Stakes There’s something special about pulling a card that wasn’t meant to be easy to find. That rush, that moment. We get it. The Lost Glitches is full of those moments. Rare drops. Limited editions. Cards that feel personal because they were earned, not handed to you. And soon, what you collect won’t just sit in your account, it’ll be yours to trade, show off, and take pride in. Style Is Part of the Strategy Decks don’t have to just function. They can speak. From avatars and card backs to emotes and effects, TLG gives you tools to make your style loud, subtle, or somewhere in-between. It’s not about showing off, it’s about making your presence known. When your deck hits the field, it should feel like you. Start Your Journey You don’t need to know everything to begin. You just need curiosity and a little fire. Whether you’re here for the strategy, the collection, the art, or just to see what happens when you throw a weird deck into the ring, there’s a place for you in The Lost Glitches. Let’s see what you can do.

rows.name: Zeitz Machz √Rhapsody
rows.short_description: A strange location, an awkward situation, and a mysterious girl: what will these lead to?
rows.description_html: No one knows what the future may hold. Just yesterday, Ais was going about her life, enjoying it to the fullest. But out of nowhere, she suddenly finds herself confined alongside a strange girl called 'Alice'. To make matters worse, neither of them remembered anything prior to this incident. Just who is behind this? And why are they doing this? A mystery yuri visual novel. Features: 30K words 3 Endings 3 CGs Credits: Logo Artist: Lazy Polar Bear Character/CG Artist: Miria Croissant and Sapphire Editors: Callista, Kristi Jimenez and Julia Martinez Music: Kamatamago Background: Minchiri Special thanks to our wonderful Kickstarter's backer!

Just who is behind this? And why are they doing this? A mystery yuri visual novel. Features: 30K words 3 Endings 3 CGs Credits: Logo Artist: Lazy Polar Bear Character/CG Artist: Miria Croissant and Sapphire Editors: Callista, Kristi Jimenez and Julia Martinez Music: Kamatamago Background: Minchiri Special thanks to our wonderful Kickstarter's backer!

rows.name: EDYN
rows.short_description: Join the battle for EDYN, the ultimate multiplayer strategy game. Build settlements, command armies, and unify the realms in epic PvP warfare to etch your legacy into history. Raid, loot, make alliances, and unite to conquer the planet itself, with no Pay-To-Win mechanics to upset the playing field.
rows.description_html: EDYN  plunges you into a dynamic multiplayer realm where you forge mighty settlements, command vast armies, and clash with rivals in epic PvP warfare with no Pay-to-Win or catchup mechanics . Embark on a grand quest to shape a living world with your strategic brilliance, forging alliances and conquering foes to etch your legacy into EDYN's history. In a land teetering on the brink of chaos, only the sharpest minds will unify the realms and bring order to EDYN. Build, Expand, and Conquer! Your journey begins with one of eight distinct factions, each offering their unique perspective of the world. Your faction can also determine your allies and rivals. Although considered teammates, the sandbox nature of EDYN means that these bonds are not set in stone. You have the freedom to forge or break alliances whenever you see fit. Should you wish, fallen members of your faction can be revived back into the world of EDYN in order to assist your cause. Though beware, reclaiming a fallen ally’s settlement is no small feat. In an ever-evolving world, your choices define your destiny. Will you unite under a common banner or carve your own path to supremacy? Begin your journey by constructing essential structures to gather vital resources like gold, wood and food for your troops. Transform your humble settlement into a sprawling empire. Delve into deep resource management, balancing production and expenditure to fuel your expansion. Invest wisely in building enhancements, army recruitment, and technological advancements to outpace your rivals. Your economic acumen will be the backbone of your dominance. Assemble an unstoppable force from a diverse selection of units, each with unique strengths and battlefield roles. Whether you prefer overwhelming foes with sheer numbers or deploying elite squads for precision strikes, tailor your military to reflect your unique strategy and ambitions. From your War Room, lead grand campaigns against NPC settlements and rival players. Launch daring raids to seize resources, deploy specialist units to crush enemy defenses, and halt their offensive. Conquer all of EDYN and assert your supremacy. Forge powerful alliances and engage in intricate diplomacy. Utilize in-game chat and direct messaging to conspire with allies, negotiate pacts, and influence the world's fate. Support your friends with resources or troops, and together, leave an indelible mark on EDYN. In EDYN, the true test lies not just in expanding your territory or advancing your settlement, but achieving legendary status. Through cunning diplomacy or decisive warfare, make your mark on a world where only the most exceptional rise to the top. Attain the ultimate accolade—exclusive, ultra-rare cosmetics reserved for the elite. These unique rewards persist across new servers, eternally showcasing your unmatched status for all to see. Do you have what it takes to seize the crown and become a legend, forever woven into the history of EDYN? There’s only one way to find out. Stand out on the battlefield with extensive customization options for your avatar. Unlock exclusive cosmetics through seasonal events, achievements, and progression milestones. Express your identity and let your legend be known throughout the realms. Note: Our in-game shop is purely for in-game cosmetics and will not impose an advantage or in-game mechanic advantage for participating.   Be among the first to shape EDYN's future. Dive into exclusive Early Access content and experience new features before anyone else. Connect with our community on Discord, share your insights, and influence the game's development with your feedback. A world on the brink awaits a leader. Gather your forces, strategize your conquest, and embark on an epic journey to become a legend in EDYN.

rows.name: Messorem
rows.short_description: An emotional journey about death, family and acceptance. Step into this thrilling narrative driven Action-RPG to experience an exciting combat system and a story tackling deep themes.
rows.description_html: A compelling narrative about death You play Messorem, a graveyard reaper. Your job is simple, guide the souls of the dead to eternal rest. After many years of the same job, Messorem starts to wonder if there is more to their life. Messorem stops doing their job and the souls no longer have someone to guide them to rest. One day a woman named Mallory arrives at the cemetary with her deceased son. In exchange for putting her son's soul to rest Messorem can finally get eternal rest themselves. To put the son to rest however, Messorem must gather his family for the funeral. The only problem is, the family is spread apart and the roads are filled with the frenzied spirits Messorem have neglected. To gather the family, Messorem must travel across the land and put all souls to rest. Magical combat arenas! Once combat is initiated, an arena is created from the element used to initiate the fight. Each arena has its own effects that can both affect the player and the enemy! Messorem's combat utilizes both melee combat and a ranged magic system. Each spell has their own effect and based on a rock, paper, scissors system connected to their own element. Wield nature's magic and choose the correct spell to put the frienzied souls to rest! Puzzles! To get an audience with some of the family members, you must complete a puzzle related to their personality. So get your dance shoes on and get ready to impress! Music by SHINE! The soon-to-be music phenomenon SHINE provides the music with the «Sounds From The Afterlife - Concept Album For Messorem». The norwegian 8-piece delivers an astounding 65+ minutes of live orchestrated music that paints the world of the game with a magical assortment of sounds, genre-variety and instrumentation. SHINE brings the action and drama to new levels with the two vocal-tracks «The Final Hour» and «Shimmer». From blistering speed-metal to folky J-pop undertones, the band delivers audible spectacle like no first-time Indie game has ever seen (or in this case heard) before.

rows.name: 100 KILLS CHALLENGE: ORIGINS
rows.short_description: Enter the fray in an intense, fast paced first person shooter experience. Kill using firearms, explosives, drones, and air support. Dominate maps in deathmatch, team, and PVE. Win with tactics - or sheer brutality. Remember: Hundred kills. One arena. Zero rules. May the best player win!
rows.description_html: ADD TO WISHLIST About the Game 100 Kills Challenge is a fast-paced first person shooter, combining the bloody reality of modern combat with a return to basics: Kill one hundred enemies before anyone else. How you do it is up to you: Be brutal, be clever, fight on your own or as part of a team, just be the first to reach one hundred kills. Remember the rules: There are none. All that matters is reaching one hundred kills: Fighting as a lone wolf in 12 player deathmatch, as part of Blue or Red teams in team deathmatch, or facing a computer-controlled onslaught in our brutal PVE modes. And remember: The amount of ways to kill will increase, as the game is being constantly expanded and developed! About 100 KILLS CHALLENGE ORIGINS: Only the death match mode and 2 maps are open, with a total of 19 weapons to choose from. The official version will have a team death match mode, 12 maps, and more than 40 weapons.

rows.name: Snow Cone Serenade
rows.short_description: Snow Cone Serenade is a short and sweet liminal adventure. Choose your mood and roll the dice to succeed or fail in spicy situations. Enter a cursed snow world to save your sick dog, Jedediah. Unravel a mind-bending mystery to face your innermost fears.
rows.description_html: A mysterious cold spell traps you in your cozy home. Your old dog Jedediah is sick and to top it all off, the heating suddenly breaks! Will you dare to enter a cursed world to fix it? A short and sweet Liminal Adventure Game , with dashes of CRPG. Talk to the people of Snow Cone, unravel a mind-bending mystery . Succeed or fail in spicy situations with a roll of the dice . Failing is half the fun! Choose your Mood to get a bonus on some rolls: Be Empathic - Sense your way around a conversation with compassion & charisma! Be Logical - Use reason and deduction to your advantage! Be Ruthless - Confront things with some good ol' brute force! An experimental, synth-heavy soundtrack with bleeps and bloops. Content Warning Pet loss

rows.name: Tangles - تشابك
rows.short_description: Awakening from a long coma following a training injury, Soldier Basel finds himself alone in an isolated camp on a deserted island surrounded by questions and mystery. He begins to search for answers to uncover the secrets, and whether they are painful truths or terrifying illusions.
rows.description_html: History, Truth, Dreams In the heart of an isolated island, a deserted camp sets the stage for a mysterious military mission. A team of 8 soldiers arrive for this mission. During the first days of training for the mission, Soldier Basel sustains a serious injury that leads him to a prolonged coma. Upon awakening, he discovers a startling reality – all those in the camp have vanished, leaving behind a trail of enigmatic secrets. Embark on the journey, piece together the mystery, uncover the secrets surrounding the mysterious disappearance of the other soldiers, and discover the secrets of the mysterious mission. Psychological Horror: Encounter psychological horror elements that go beyond jump scares. Be prepared for a storyline that twists and turns, leaving you questioning reality and adding a unique psychological depth to the gaming experience. Stunning Graphics: Tangles boasts high-quality graphics that bring the mysterious island and its secrets to life. Explore the detailed environment as you unravel the mysteries that shroud the camp. Hidden Secrets: The adventure doesn't end with the main storyline. Engage in optional side missions after completing the game to discover five hidden secret documents scattered throughout the camp. Each document provides unique insights into the island's history and geography. Engage with the intricate storyline, solve puzzles, and unravel the twisted events that await you on the mysterious island.

rows.name: Battle Clash
rows.short_description: Battle Clash is a fast-paced medieval PVP game where 10 unique classes battle for victory. Master each class's abilities, rack up kills, and unlock powerful ultimates to crush your enemies. Dominate the battlefield and lead your way to the win!
rows.description_html: Battle Clash is a medieval multiplayer PVP game with 10 unique classes, each with their own abilities. When the match starts, each player begins as the classic Knight class. From there, after every death, players either get to choose their next class, or have it assigned randomly (depends on match setting) There are 10 medieval classes in the game, and they each have their own unique set of skills: Knight: Primary: Sword Slash Secondary: Shield  ULTIMATE: Blitz Archer: Primary: Bow & Arrow Shot Secondary: Bow Shove ULTIMATE: Ruthless Heavy: Primary: Battleaxe Bludgeon Secondary: Dash ULTIMATE: Rage Wizard: Primary: Spell Cast Secondary: Staff Shove ULTIMATE: Fireball Assassin: Primary: Dagger Stab Secondary: Double Dagger Strike ULTIMATE: Cloak Swordmaster: Primary: Katana Slash Secondary: Katana Thrust ULTIMATE: Barrage Spearman: Primary: Spear Thrust Secondary: Spear Spin ULTIMATE: Impale Arbalist: Primary: Crossbow Bolt Shot Secondary: Crossbow Shove ULTIMATE: Surge Farmer: Primary: Pitchfork Stab Secondary: Charge ULTIMATE: Stampede Miner: Primary: Pickaxe Slash Secondary: Pickaxe Slam ULTIMATE: Avalanche Choose Your Battleground - 3 Maps! Weather Choices - Spice up the visuals! Toxic Emotes - Taunt with these classic medieval emotes, of course And yes, if you're reading this far... the characters are naked. You're seeing that right. For bug reports, visit our Steam Discussions, and fill out the annonymous google form! So what are you waiting for? Battle in the Clash right now!

rows.name: Wizzerd Quest
rows.short_description: Wizzerd Quest is a bite-sized open-world RPG with full split-screen co-op. Its aesthetic is straight out of the mid 1990's, and it's designed to be a fun little excursion without wasting your time. Play the entire game for free with zero microtransactions or DRM!
rows.description_html: Welcome to the mysterious land of Wayword! Wizzerd Quest is a bite-sized open-world RPG with full splitscreen co-op. Its aesthetic and gameplay sit somewhere between DOOM and Daggerfall, and it's designed to be a fun little excursion without wasting your time. The full game, which is totally free, includes: A main story quest that takes you all around the open world (Takes ~3 hrs to beat the game) 6 classes, assigned dynamically based on leveling 8 enemy types plus two bosses 12 hand-crafted dungeons 3 towns with facilities such as banks and traders Over 40 NPCs, all with unique, witty and funny (according to the devs) dialogue A full day-night cycle A voiced opening cutscene with cringe voice acting straight out of 1995 The ability to ATTEMPT BARTERING WITH FARM ANIMALS Absolutely ZERO microtransactions, network telemetry or invasive DRM Kondoorsoft offers this game to you totally free of charge. But make no mistake: this is no mere marketing demo. It's a full game, given freely to the community in the hopes that it will bring entertainment to those that play it. But if you like it and wish to support us, consider looking at the rest of our game catalog.

rows.name: Neon Runners: Craft & Dash
rows.short_description: 4 enter, 1 leaves! Dash, design, and dominate in high-speed neon races! Race against 3 others, choose runners with unique skills, and unleash powerful power-ups. Compete globally in daily time attacks or create your own custom courses to challenge the world!
rows.description_html: Neon Runners: Craft & Dash – The Ultimate Racing & Running Game! Get ready for an action-packed racing with simple controls! Compete in fast-paced running races, conquer stages, and defeat monsters in a thrilling sprint to victory. Unleash your creativity in the Level Maker, share your designs, and challenge the world to fun, neon infused races! This is the core mode that defines Neon Runners : Four enter, but only one emerges victorious. Race against three opponents, each equipped with powerful abilities, and be the first to reach the goal. The courses are filled with game-changing power-ups and gimmicks that add excitement—or chaos—to the competition. Daily Contest Take on the ever-changing Daily Contest map to receive amazing rewards. The greater your skills, the better the rewards that await you! Stage Mode Clear 100 unique stages and test your racing skills. Collect super coins to level up and grow your character! Endless Mode Keep the challenges going in Infinite Mode. Show off your skills without any limits and dominate the leaderboard! Build and Share Your Own Levels! ■ Create your own levels with a simple and intuitive level editor. Design race tracks that are nearly impossible to conquer or create the fastest route imaginable. You can even craft challenging puzzles that will push your friends to their limits! ■ Create with the community! Share your custom courses with the community and showcase your creativity. Build your own racing kingdom and become the star of your maps! Race with Style Discover your favorite among a cast of vibrant and distinctive characters that can change the game. Experiment with different Runners or master a single one to showcase your true skill. Receive rewards based on your mastery level and unlock exclusive character skins for each one. Neon Runners: Craft and Dash

rows.name: Bond Blues
rows.short_description: It's 2026, and you're a bail bondsman in Burlington. A fully voiced visual novel exploring the obligations of duty, and what justice really means.
rows.description_html: Christopher has started his new job as an assistant, others would say, an enforcer, for a bail bondsman in Burlington, Vermont. Does he take a gentler, or more forceful touch? When he begins to notice things beyond his pay grade, how does it play out? Learn what a bail bondsman is Small town intrigue Fully voiced Hand-drawn art 12 emails 29 music tracks A visual novel made for the CasualCord Game Jam 2022 - After a year in development, hopefully it's been worth the wait.

rows.description_html: IVRI immerses players in a gripping space adventure where they navigate an eerie, abandoned space station, meticulously piecing together the puzzle of the missing crew and uncovering the enigmatic secrets hidden within the ship's walls, delivering an enthralling narrative experience. A Space Narrative Horror Game: ● 20+ rooms to explore ● Windows 95 aesthetic ● Fun puzzles ● Time travel shenanigans ● Humorous dialogue ● Eerie and Cute Enter the chilling world of IVRI, a gripping horror game where you embody Ollie Rex on a mission to uncover clues about the vanished crewmates. But as you delve deeper, an ominous presence lurks aboard the ship, trailing your every move and unleashing chaos at every turn.

rows.name: Crystal Conquest
rows.short_description: Crystal Conquest is a free-to-play VR game where you control the elements and battle for victory. Harness the power of fire, water, earth, and air in epic 3v3 MOBA-inspired combat or intense dueling modes!
rows.description_html: Crystal Conquest is a Free-To-Play VR game where you control the elements and battle for victory. Imagine the elemental magic of Avatar in VR across fighting, MOBA, and level based campaign modes! Key Features: Play as elemental mages - 4 available by default, unlock more over time Choose which spells to take into battle, unlock more over time Customize your in-match shop - choose your potions, wands and other items, unlock more over time Different modes to suit your mood: Duel (1v1), Conquest MOBA (3v3) or Gauntlet (players vs waves of enemies) Single player or Multiplayer Private lobbies available, bring your friends Skills-based matchmaking to pair you with equal opponents Shape the game's future by communicating with the Studio on Discord Build your mage:  Choose the class that matches your playstyle and elements. Unlock class variants as you grow and customize your build. Harness the elements:  Battle with elemental magic where each element has unique properties. Use earth, fire, water, and wind to block, dodge, and deflect your enemy's attacks. Grow in Power:  Level up and unlock even more epic spells that change how you control the elements. Choose Your Battle Mode:  Battle in 3v3 matches to capture crystals and topple towers, face off in duels, or team up in co-op to take on waves of AI. All modes support AI for solo or practice play.
