rows.name: Purrfectly Hidden Cats - Kittenrock
rows.short_description: Welcome to the enchanting 'Purrfectly Hidden Cats - Kittenrock' resort! Uncover hidden cats in a captivating mountain setting, complete with nature, cabins, and campgrounds. Delve into charming mini-stories and find surprises in a world that's playfully inviting!
rows.description_html: UPCOMING GAMES MORE KITTENS About the Game Purrfectly Hidden Cats - Kittenrock' welcomes you to a richly interactive 2D world set in a picturesque mountain resort. The hand-drawn scene in Kittenrock is a labor of love, brimming with intricate details, natural beauty, and humorous Easter eggs, inviting thorough exploration and discovery. The gameplay blends classic hidden object mechanics with a unique twist—interactive people and cats around the map, enhancing the engagement and depth of the experience. Your primary goal is to spot the skillfully hidden cats that merge seamlessly into the scenic resort surroundings, often revealed through playful interactions with the environment and its inhabitants. Beyond the joy of discovering cats, the game unfolds engaging mini-stories that add layers of depth and charm. These stories are woven into the fabric of Kittenrock, creating a narrative that celebrates exploration and curiosity. In 'Purrfectly Hidden Cats - Kittenrock,' the game's zoom feature enhances your experience: zoom in to uncover intricate details and interact with characters, or zoom out to admire the whole scenic beauty of the resort. Whether you prefer a close-up exploration or a broader perspective, the game offers a uniquely engaging and visually stunning journey, encouraging you to discover hidden cats and enjoy the diverse landscape of Kittenrock. Engaging hidden object gameplay with an emphasis on observation and interaction. Interactive characters that add dynamic layers to the gameplay. Mini-stories linked to each discovered cat, enriching the game's narrative. A vast, interactive mountain resort environment filled with delightful Easter eggs. Distinctive line-art graphic style enhancing the game’s visual appeal. Soothing and immersive background music, perfectly matching the game's rhythm. A variety of achievements to encourage exploration and reward your discoveries.

rows.name: LowPoly Towerdefense
rows.short_description: You play in a SciFi environment with LowPoly graphics, engaging in Tower Defense. Manage resources! Each round introduces more enemies that you must defeat. Build resource ships in the factory and simultaneously construct towers on the platforms to fend off the adversaries.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Lowpoly Tower Defense! In this game, you have to manage resources and towers to prevent the enemies from reaching their goal. You'll be battling LowPoly SciFi enemies in a desert! But be aware: Resources are quickly depleted! You need to ensure a steady supply. Moreover, your opponents will increase with each round! Utilize the interim periods to construct towers, organize resources, and fortify chokepoints with towers. This game is designed as a supplementary activity for an instructional course and is developed without any commercial intentions. If you wish to recreate this game for your personal use, please contact the publisher! Now, enjoy building and best of luck! Best regards, Holger Instructions Welcome! After the game has started, simply click on Desert Fight in the Main Menu. Now you can move using WASD. First, you should build resource ships (click on the building directly in front of you). The ships will then fly to the silos and collect resources on their own. You can unlock additional silos - just click on them. Make sure you have enough resources to unlock a silo. Use the resources to build towers on the platforms, which will automatically attack the enemies. The towers have a limited range - try it out. Try to catch all enemies and pay attention to their paths. If you let too many enemies escape, you lose. The enemies appear at the top left in three different locations and then move down to the three caves on the bottom right. There are a maximum of 15 rounds! Good luck!

rows.name: The Bridge to Yesterday
rows.short_description: Step into a beautifully crafted world, where you'll embark on an emotional journey filled with intrigue and danger. Explore the touching relationship of two sisters, their struggle for survival, and their unwavering determination in a world where the past crumbles and the future is uncertain.
rows.description_html: Embark on an intimate journey through the remnants of a post-apocalyptic world in this heartfelt single-player adventure game. Take on the roles of two sisters, each blessed with unique abilities, as they collaborate to surmount obstacles and unearth the secrets shrouding their past. Upgrade your camp to increase your strength, stamina, and spirit for the treacherous journey ahead. Pick up resources along the way and meet a small cast of other explorers in this weird landscape. Solve puzzles to unlock new areas and be wary of the environment for clues on how to solve them. Unlock new abilities to help with the purpose of both combat but also dealing with the evil creatures along the roads of the forest. As players traverse the desolate landscapes, they'll gradually unveil fragments of the sisters' memories, immersing themselves in a narrative that explores themes of identity, resilience, and the unbreakable bonds of sisterhood. Crafted with dedication and passion by a close-knit team of six students from ITU Copenhagen, this cozy adventure invites players into a world brimming with charm and nuance. With its captivating visuals, poignant storytelling, and inventive gameplay mechanics, this indie gem promises an unforgettable experience.

rows.name: Rama's Quest
rows.short_description: Rama's Quest is an action survival game rooted in Hindu mythology. Invoke divine powers from the gods in your custom builds as you face waves of Rakshasa demons.
rows.description_html: Rama's Quest is an action survival game where you equip unique weapons and get divine powers from the gods to help you face endless demons in the forest. Become Rama, the legendary archer Wield your bow against challenging swarms of demons that haunt the Dandaka Forest. Invoke Divine Powers Meet Vishnu, Arjuna, Krishna, and more legendary gods from Hindu mythology. Perfect your builds by invoking their boons. Fight unique enemies The forest contains Rakshasa with various attack styles, like sword slashing, ground slamming, spear throwing, and more Face Powerful Bosses Fight through powerful Rakshasa bosses to win Join the community Join the Discord to keep up with updates and new releases from Roadtrip Games.

rows.name: Lights Off: Director's Cut
rows.short_description: Play through a common childhood fear about turning the lights off and going to bed. This time extended, remastered, and re-imagined.
rows.description_html: Lights Off: Director's Cut Welcome to 'Lights Off: Director's Cut', an immersive horror game that preys on the universal childhood fear of darkness. This fully re-imagined edition of the acclaimed indie game plunges you into a chilling atmosphere where the simple act of turning off the lights becomes your worst nightmare. Game Features: Seven Nights of Terror: Each night, the darkness grows more suffocating, and the horrors lurking in the shadows become more cunning. Three Distinct Endings: Can you find all three? Steam Achievements: Unlock Steam Achievements for finding the secret endings Fully Free: 'Lights Off: Director's Cut' is completely free to play. Experience the full terror without spending a dime. Dare to Turn Off the Lights?

rows.name: Battle Babes
rows.short_description: Battle Babes is a fast-paced, free-to-play single-player turn-based strategy card game. Collect, strategize, and battle your way to victory with 3+ hero powers! Experiment with 600+ unique cards, each with their own special abilities. Customize your decks and challenge AI decks to a fight!
rows.description_html: 🔥 Welcome to Battle Babes: The Ultimate Fantasy Turn-Based Strategy Card Game! 🔥 Embark on an exhilarating journey with Battle Babes , a brand spanking new, action-packed free-to-play card battle game. Master the art of strategy with 3+ dynamic hero decks and over 600 distinctive cards, each boasting unique magic, powers, and abilities. Immerse yourself in thrilling fast-paced battles where smarts, luck, and skill lead to victory. Personalize your decks and dominate in epic snap duels against challenging AI opponents! Are you ready to lead your Battle Babes to fame and glory? Base Game (Free to Play): Includes access to the following Hero Power Decks: Fire, Water, Nature DLC 1: Battle Babes: Blood, Sun & Moon Adds the Blood, Sun, and Moon Hero Power Decks. (Includes all content from the base game.) DLC 2: Lightning Adds the Lightning Hero Power Deck. (Includes all content from the base game and DLC 1.) DLC 3: Love & Death Adds the Love and Death Hero Power Decks. (Includes all content from the base game, DLC 1, and DLC 2.) DLC 4: Lust, Space & Shadow Adds the Lust, Space, and Shadow Hero Power Decks. (Includes all content from the base game and all prior DLCs.) DLC 5: Wind, Frost & Astra Adds the Wind, Frost, and Astra Hero Power Decks. (Includes all content from the base game and all prior DLCs.) DLC 6: Earth, Air & Ocean Adds the Earth, Air, and Ocean Hero Power Decks. (Includes all content from the base game and all prior DLCs.) Each DLC builds upon the previous ones, giving you access to all prior content and expanding your strategic options. Choose the decks that suit your playstyle, and dominate the battlefield in style! 🌟 Key Game Features: 🌟 3 Playable Hero Powers: Fire, Water & Nature! (Claim 1 Free Starter Deck Immediately) Battle 18 AI Hero Power Decks: Blood, Sun, Moon, Lightning, Love, Death, Lust, Space, Shadow, Wind, Frost, Astra, Earth, Air, Ocean, and more for epic AI challenges! Defeat Challenging AI Boss Decks: Dragon Clan & Succubus Queen. Earn Coins, Buy Card Packs. Collect 600+ Blessed Cards! Dynamic Turn-Based Combat: Engage in electrifying battles, blending deep strategy with an element of chance. Expansive Card Collection: Over 600+ unique cards featuring formidable babes, each with their special abilities and rich backstories. Deck Customization: Tailor your deck with a diverse mix of babes, spells, secrets, and artifacts to outmaneuver your opponents. Exquisite Artwork: Dive into a world of stunningly illustrated cards and breathtaking landscapes. Frequent Updates & Events: Stay engaged with regular additions of new babes, challenges, and rewards. Interactive Tutorials: New to card games? No problem! Our babes will guide you through the basics. Beginner-Friendly: Learn the ropes with interactive guides, making it easy for newcomers to join the fun. Play Solo: Practice against Advanced AI which shows no mercy. 🌌 Join the Battle Babes Universe: 🌌 Engaging Strategic Gameplay: Easy to learn, yet challenging to master – like mastering the art of walking in stilettos. Regular Content Updates: New cards, new babes, new ways to conquer. We keep it fresh so you'll never get bored. Continuously evolving gameplay with new hero powers and characters, keeping the experience fresh and thrilling. Expanding Fantasy World: Regularly introduced new cards and characters ensure an ever-evolving battleground. Battle Babes: A realm where sass meets class, elegance meets energy, artistry meets ambition. Sharpen your skills, customize your decks, and engage in fierce battles against worthy adversaries in the AI realm. Join the Battle Babes saga today and shape your path to glory! Say hello to Battle Babes, the epic single-player collectible card game that’s here to take over! Get ready to collect, strategize, and battle your way to victory with the sassiest, most powerful babes in the realm. Battle Babes, where fantasy, fun, and fierceness collide in a collectible card game like no other! You want a game that's easy to dive into but offers deep strategic play. What are you waiting for? Don't make these babes wait! 💋

rows.name: Genopanic: Prologue
rows.short_description: Enter 'Genopanic: Prologue,' the beginning of a dynamic story in a Metroidvania-style experience! Wield a plasma cutter, team up with your virtual dog LAIK, outsmart the cunning cat-girl AI VOLGA, uncover the secrets of Dark Matter, and delve into DNA experiments in a galactic adventure.
rows.description_html: ✨ WISHLIST FULL GAME ✨ About the Game Step into the World of Genopanic: Prologue Embark on an Intergalactic Adventure! Dive into the thrilling universe of Genopanic with this Prologue, offering a taste of the epic journey ahead. Perfect for newcomers and veterans alike, immerse yourself in a world where you can master the game's style and controls, all while getting a tantalizing preview of the adventures that await. A Compact, Rich Experience Designed to be completed in under an hour, the Prologue introduces you to the very beginning of our expansive story. Battle a formidable boss and get a glimpse of the challenges and triumphs that lie ahead in the full game. Discover the Gameplay Mechanics Experience a selection of the gameplay mechanics that make Genopanic unique. Although just a part of what the full game offers, the Prologue provides a solid foundation of what to expect in terms of gameplay and strategy. Stunning Visuals and Atmosphere The Prologue shares the same striking graphics and visual style as the main game. Every frame is a piece of art, setting the stage for the incredible journey that unfolds in Genopanic. A Sneak Peek into the Genopanic Universe Perfect for players new to the series or those eagerly awaiting the full release, the Prologue serves as an introductory chapter to the vast, mysterious world of Genopanic. Prologue Features Introductory Story - Experience the beginning of an epic tale that seamlessly leads into the main game's rich narrative. Sample of Combat - Engage in a thrilling boss battle that showcases the dynamic combat system. Familiarization - Get comfortable with the game's controls and mechanics, setting you up for success in the full game. Visual and Audio Treat - Enjoy the same high-quality graphics and atmospheric soundtrack as the main game. Prepare yourself for an unforgettable journey with Genopanic: Prologue - your gateway to a grander cosmic adventure!

rows.name: Let Them Breathe: Hello Mother
rows.short_description: Mrs. Chen is asked to pick up some documents; these documents reside at the University of Tokyo where she used to work. Upon her picking up these documents, she engages with audio recordings and diary entries that tells her what exactly took place in the experimentation room.
rows.description_html: 06/21/2024 We have another winner to Let Them Breathe: Hello Mother Speed Run Event: GandaCu. Feel free to watch the video below; we sent him a comment and hopefully we can work out his prize soon! 06/08/2024 We were hoping to set up a pre-record of the speed run of the winner but it seems it may be too advanced for our small team at the moment so instead, here is the speedrun. This winner was the sole participate of the event but hey, even so, they got a cash prize: Let Them Breathe: Selena's Awakening is our next project scheduled for September 2nd, 2024. We hope to have the game play trailer out on the 17th so you all can add it to your wish list. Buzz We have a WINNER for the Speed Run Event. The winner will be announced the same day we announced the title of the upcoming game currently in production. So expect later this month! 03/02/2024, 09:07 PM CDT This game does not have a tutorial. To play the game, one must think of the general mechanics of a PC game. For instance, if the mouse clicker is hidden on your screen when starting the game then click the 'windows' icon on your computer so as the mouse can appear. 03/8/2024, 11:44 AM CDT We're quite please to see the good reviews for Hello Mother. And yes, we also saw the discussion on the page; for a game to be submitted on , a player needs to request it. Now we could request it ourselves but that would mean we would also have to participate within the run's contest. 04/23/2024, 5:43pm CDT It has come to our attention one can not submit the game to Speed Run unless they are a well known user. As a result of this finding, if submitting to the speed run event: 1.) Upload to Youtube 2.) Email or comment the Youtube Link to us 03/17/2024, 12:52 PM CDT So glad so many are enjoying the game! Also there will be no more updates for this game. We are in the mist of working on our next game. Still, good luck to all those who enter into the contest! About the Game Mrs. Chen, the mother of Jesse Chen, is asked to pick up some documents; these documents reside at the University of Tokyo where she used to work. Upon her picking up these documents, she engages with audio recordings and diary entries that tells her what exactly took place in the experimentation room. Follow Mrs. Chen and discover more about the world of Let Them Breathe. In this walking simulation and collectable game, you will explore a small abandoned laboratory. Within the different compartments of the library, you will find items in which you will be able to engage with such as recordings, and documents in which you have to collect so as to win the game. In this casual short game with a spice of thriller, the atmosphere allows for the player to walk the environment to discover what took place within various locations of the game. The player will find out more about the location, and the two individuals who once occupied the space prior to the player's arrival. Let Them Breathe: Hello Mother is a video game that takes place within the Let Them Breathe franchise. It tells the story of Mrs. Chen who is the mother of one of the characters in the indie web series and even the indie movie, Let Them Breathe: City on the Ocean.

Follow Mrs. Chen and discover more about the world of Let Them Breathe. In this walking simulation and collectable game, you will explore a small abandoned laboratory. Within the different compartments of the library, you will find items in which you will be able to engage with such as recordings, and documents in which you have to collect so as to win the game. The player will find out more about the location, and the two individuals who once occupied the space prior to the player's arrival. It tells the story of Mrs. Chen who is the mother of one of the characters in the indie web series and even the indie movie, Let Them Breathe: City on the Ocean.

rows.name: Loop Theory
rows.short_description: Loop Theory is a horror game in which every minute spent in the game changes your idea of the story. Take on the role of a character with a mysterious past and find out about what happened.
rows.description_html: Immerse yourself in the game created on the Unreal Engine 5. Solve puzzles, make your way through various rooms, use objects and find out more about the fate of the main character. Average time to complete the game: 45 minutes This is a story-oriented horror game. Take part in the mysterious investigation of the crimes of the most ordinary family. The narrative in the game does not provide direct answers related to the paranormal story of the main character, so you will have to collect the missing pieces of the puzzle yourself. Will you be able to get answers to questions about your character's past and present? During the passage of the plot, you will come across notes and inscriptions, study them! Waiting for you: - A mysteriously changing house - Riddles - An ambiguous plot ATTENTION: The game contains images of violent scenes that can have a negative impact on the psyche.

rows.name: Passing Into Fantasy
rows.short_description: Otaku culture inspired top-down danmaku shooter.
rows.description_html: Jordan Jones, mild mannered engineer, was showcasing a nuclear reactor at an anime convention, when the worst of disasters struck. A magical substance known as contrivium was spilled onto his reactor model, causing the convention center to undergo a magical girl zombie apocalypse. Both merchandise and attendee alike have undergone startling transformations into malevolent magical girls. In the ensuing chaos, Jordan was bitten by a radioactive cosplayer and became the superheroine known as Lunar Heart Skydancer. Along with her friends, she now must defeat the evil sorcerer-of-culture, Victor Haqdev, who is using his foul chaos magics to force every animal, mineral, and vegetable into his harem of magical girls. Will Jordan and the other survivors escape this anime-convention-gone-wrong, or will she experience humiliating objectification? PIF is a top-down shooter with a shmup soul. Dodge hundreds of bullets in 360 degree danmaku. You'll not only need reflexes, but clever wits to analyze the challenging spell card patterns. In retro fashion, the game has few features save one: save you the player as much time as possible and keep you engaged in the action, with perhaps a few minutes of indulgence into a very comedic plot.

rows.name: ChatBBT
rows.short_description: Explore the fictional, baby themed chatbot, ChatBBT, in this short, story driven adventure to the heart of the psyche, led by none other than software's leading assistant, Binderclippy. Go ahead... Ask 'BBT something! Anything!!
rows.description_html: ((Warning: This game contains quick flashing light)) Artificial intelligence is all the rage nowadays! You can't walk down the block without someone saying 'AI this!' or 'AI that!'. What does it all mean? The future seems so uncertain!? If only there was some way to get away from it all, return to a simpler time, a time where we could live without fear of AI generate images' or LLVM induced singularity's cold, silicon breadth pouring down the back of our neck, and retreat to some good old homegrown software. Software that takes us back to a carefree time... an AI free time... ChatBBT proposes to simulate just this innocence we've all been pining for, and ChatBBT is powered by THE most cutting edge AI to bring you the experience of conversing with the epitome of innocence itself: A baby. Features: Ask ChatBBT all the questions you've been dying to ask a baby since your foregone infancy Acquaint yourself with Binderclipply: ChatBBT's built in assistant Customize your profile Become hyperfixated on the graveyard that is progress Take a look at the Q&A section (maybe there's some helpful stuff there) Confront your own mortality Maybe think about upgrading to a premium membership? Wrestle with your lack of free will Rate ChatBBT responses, providing feedback so we can improve this top of the line baby technology Plunge headfirst into the mystic visions you always knew God would provide you with

rows.name: A 20-year-old RPG Maker game remade with the latest RPG MAKER UNITE and available for free?! ~The Heroes of the RPG Maker series vs. the Demon Lord~
rows.short_description: The game that was created 20 years ago with RPG MAKER 2000 has been remade in the latest RPG MAKER UNITE!(←the story setting, but it's true that RPG MAKER UNITE was made!) Let's enjoy this new RPG Maker experience, which fuses nostalgia and chaos!
rows.description_html: ◆A Game Created 20 Years Ago, Now Remade with the Demon Lord as the Star! The legendary game born 20 years ago with RPG MAKER 2000 is making an unexpected comeback with the latest RPG MAKER UNITE! (This is the storyline setting, and the RPG MAKER UNITE version is real!) But it’s not just a simple remake—this time, the main character is the Demon Lord! The legendary heroes who have colored the history of RPG Maker, transcending time and the boundaries of works, are gathering and beginning their fierce assault on the Demon Lord’s castle! As the player, you will defend against them as the Demon Lord. Can you withstand the heroes’ fierce attacks and maintain the dignity of the Demon Lord’s army? ◆A Surprising Combination of Tower Defense × Shooting!? This game, made with RPG MAKER UNITE , is a tower defense shooting game utilizing Unity’s features!! Repel the heroes who attack one after another with magic, traps, and the monsters of the Demon Lord’s army! Recruit monsters to build the ultimate formation! Use the shooting elements to attack and scatter the heroes! The heroes will attack with a variety of skills and equipment. Depending on your monster formation, create your own strategy to defeat the heroes who will attack one after another! ◆ Don’t Miss the Treasure Chests on the Map! When it comes to adventure, treasure chests are a must! But these treasure chests in the game aren’t just item supply points... Surprisingly, the treasure chests also contain comments from RPG MAKER series developer Mr. Ojima Yoji ! There are some never-before-released behind-the-scenes stories, so fans of the series definitely should check them out!

rows.short_description: Mini Settlers: Prologue is a free version of Mini Settlers. In this minimalist city builder, settle islands, construct cities, and design efficient logistic networks to fulfill your buildings' needs and fuel population growth to adventure into new worlds.
rows.description_html: Mini Settlers: Prologue is a free version of Mini Settlers. In this minimalist city builder, settle islands, construct cities, and design efficient logistic networks to fulfill your buildings' needs and fuel population growth to adventure into new worlds. Build your buildings and factories to harvest resources and create new ones to expand your cities and industries. Build a well-connected network of roads, trains & ports between your Factories and Cities to transport and fulfill any need they may have, but be careful not to overload your supply chain. Settle abandoned islands by building your settlement and growing your population by fulfilling all their needs. Features: 🧠 Establish an intricate and wide logistical network 🗻 Settle abandoned islands 🔨 Build large cities, and increase your population ⚖️ Balance your supply chains ⚔️ Compete with other players globally

Enjoy the free content from Paris City, and play through two game modes and three quantity pieces. Get extra content from DLCs. London, New York, Rome, Berlin, and more await you! rows.name: My Shadow
rows.short_description: Explore the enigmatic world of My Shadow, a 2.5D Horror Puzzle Platformer where reality blurs. As night descends, illusions materialize, luring you into the intricate depths of your own mind. Unravel the mysteries where the boundaries of reality haze and imagination takes control.
rows.description_html: The Mind can sometimes be too imaginative. While you tuck yourself into your bed and turn the lights off, the creatures of the night begin to appear. As you hide under your bedsheet, they surround you. As you begin to drift away, they take you, down, deep into the depths, of your mind... Welcome to the hauntingly surreal realm of My Shadow, a mesmerizing 2.5D Horror Puzzle Platformer that thrusts players into the enigmatic depths where reality and imagination intertwine. As the night descends, a mysterious world materializes, inviting you to embark on an otherworldly journey through the intricate labyrinth of your own mind. Traverse the intricacies of the distorted dollhouse, solving puzzles that gradually unveil the truth about your innermost demons.

rows.name: Don't Puke!
rows.short_description: Only a few will make it to the top! Ride, jump, and fly either solo or with friends, in this virtual reality game! Mastering your cart control skills is essential to reach the island's highest peaks.
rows.description_html: Only a few will make it to the top! Join other players for a crazy ride in a new online, physics-based VR game with unique control mechanics. Explore the world around you and have fun! Discover the vast, open sky island playground that will push your skills to the limit. The island is divided into different areas, each offering unique PvP or Co-Op mechanics. Climb and fly to the highest peaks of the island. Solve mini-puzzles alone or with friends. Mastering your cart control skills is essential to reach the summit. The sky is the limit! CURRENT FEATURES: Players navigate the world using a special cart that moves according to physics principles. Additionally, it can boost, jump, and glide. Players steer the cart by grabbing and turning the wheels. Boost to move faster or ascend steep inclines. Jump to reach higher floors or vault between platforms. Or, spread your wings and soar through the air. The game can be enjoyed in single-player mode or on one of the public servers for even more fun with other players. The game takes place on a sky island, divided into several parts. Each part features a specific mechanic for PvP gameplay. The vertical section of the island presents a challenging obstacle course, ideal for single-player and even better in multiplayer co-operation. Utilize your cart control skills to ascend to the island's summit. Players collect stars scattered around the island. Some are located in hard-to-reach places. Collecting all the stars signifies mastering the game. Each star collected grants a checkpoint, which can be used at any location. Use these checkpoints to teleport between interesting locations or to save your progress. The game features online multiplayer, voice chat, and quick visual emoji reactions.

rows.name: Death Fighter
rows.short_description: This is a simple side-scroller made by one person. It's my first game and I would really appreciate any reviews from you !
rows.description_html: The world is in peril, as thousands of demons are devastating the world and your village was the first victim. In search of revenge you swear that you're ready to fight, even against the death itself. Begin your journey as a Death Fighter and show the Death itself who's the boss ! This game is a 2D platformer and side scroller where you play a Death Fighter who wants to avenge his friends. Death Fighter is made of three levels with different mechanics and ennemies to defeat by jumping on their head. At the end of each level, you will fight and defeat a boss by jumping multiple times on their head and jump into a portal to go to the next level. Game Features Challenging and complex gameplay Customizable difficulty from beginner to expert ! Unlockable skins and rewards ! Made by an indie game developer, with love !

rows.name: Sirocco
rows.short_description: Sirocco is an infinitely replayable 5v5 arena. Rally your team as you swap abilities mid-match, craft unique builds and load up auto-firing weapons as you craft strategies on the fly. No rules — just fun.
rows.description_html: Ditch the roles, hard counters and last hits in Sirocco. Rally your team as you swap abilities mid-match, load up auto-firing weapons , and craft strategies on the fly. No rules — just fun. Creativity As Meta Without fixed roles and hard counters, learn as you go and discover your own strategies instead of being punished for not following the strategies of others. Auto-firing Arena, Not Farming Arena Sirocco utilizes an auto-fire mechanic and economic system that promotes team fighting and positioning over last hitting NPCs. High Risk, High Reward Every Ability In Sirocco Is A Skill Shot. Deep Strategy, Not Memorization Combine specialized weapons, ship abilities, and ability augmentations to develop your own way to play. Conquer The Five Seas with your Friends by Making New Ones In Sirocco, teams win, not individuals, so whether you are 10-0 or 0-10, our economic system ensures all your friends are critical to achieving victory.

rows.name: Neon Nova
rows.short_description: Dive into the adrenaline-fueled world of Neon Nova, a cutting-edge Neon Arena Ship Shooter! Experience intense arena battles, unlock customizable ships with vibrant neon skins, and dominate diverse game modes. Are you ready to be the master of the neon universe? Jump in now!
rows.description_html: Immerse yourself in a futuristic world brimming with vibrant energy and intense arena battles with our groundbreaking Arena Ship Shooter. Neon Nova seamlessly blends fast-paced action, stunning neon aesthetics, and thrilling game modes for an unforgettable gaming experience. Neon-Styled Atmosphere Experience the thrill of a neon-drenched universe where vibrant colors and dynamic lighting effects bring the gameplay to life. Diverse Game Modes Engage in different game modes, whether it's classic Deathmatch, Checkpoint-Race or challenging Survival modes. Each mode offers a unique gameplay experience, upgrade your ship with Power Up's and ensuring hours of gaming excitement. Customizable Spaceships Tailor your ship to your personal style. Unlock new skins and colors to stand out in the arena and dominate your opponents in intergalactic combat. Intuitive Controls Enjoy seamless and intuitive controls, allowing you to navigate effortlessly through the neon arena and execute precise maneuvers in the heat of battle. Challenging Enemies Face a variety of challenging enemies, from skilled AI opponents to challenging arena fights. Each battle is unique, requiring tactical skill and quick reflexes. Prepare to dive into the future of the Arena Ship Shooter with Neon Nova. Unlock skins, become the master of the arena, and dominate the neon universe! Steam Deck Setup If the game doesn't start on the Steam Deck, you need to go to the Steam library, select the game, go to 'Settings > Properties > Compatibility,' enable the Compatibility tool, and choose 'Steam Linux Runtime.' Steam Deck Controller Setup If you experience issues with the right stick while playing, go to the controller settings for the game on the Steam Deck (press the Steam button) and adjust the Death zone (slightly increase the left slider).

rows.name: ProtectHeart
rows.short_description: ProtectHeart is a strategic defense game, defend the heart at all costs! Are you up for the challenge?
rows.description_html: ProtectHeart is a strategy and defense game. Your objective is to protect the heart from various enemies, from turtles to fighter jets. You'll get experience points for defeating each enemy, once you have enough points you'll be given an upgrade opportunity that will last for the rest of the game! You need to pick carefully, it could be the difference between surviving and failing.

rows.name: Seraphim Slum
rows.short_description: An eerie liminal game that explores just how far an angel can fall. Play as sapphic Lucifer and corrupt angels into falling... in love with you.
rows.description_html: 'The slums are rotting. You are spilling out.' Ezekiel has moved into the slums. She finds herself enamored with its inhabitants: three girls, in particular. Befriend an angel, fall in love, and break them by awakening them. Whisper their tragedies, tell them lies and tell them truths, sing your sweet corrupting song like lovers do. Push them over the edge.  It's not a matter of if they fall... but how they fall. Seraphim Slum  is a sapphic liminal visual novel revolving around fallen angels, the horror of intimate relationships, self-perceived sins, predestination, and love conquering self.  You play as Ezekiel as you explore the slum… Helping Macy, Salxire, and Oriel unravel their self-suppressions and succumb to their desires.  Your love's a perfect sort of obsessive. Some could say it's devouring. Delving into the liminal slum as it is eaten alive by your nature .  Finding out what it truly means to have free will and autonomy… at the price of corruption. Esoteric and poetic musings on philosophy and autonomy... Choice-based branching with 4 unique endings ... and a bonus Free Roam route where you explore the slum's depths... Many scene illustrations and a gore toggle for a darker take on an angel's love... Fully voice-acted dialogue. Custom-made OST ... and a hidden bonus track exclusive to the ideal ending. Endings list, CG gallery , and Steam achievements! A playtime of 5-6 hours for a full run. CONTENT WARNINGS This game isn't suitable for those who are easily disturbed. rows.reviews_html: “A bunch of fallen, lesbian archangels and a prophet who lies as easily as she breathes… This game had me so in tune with my sapphic side...” Fuwanovel “I was honest to god blown away by this game, from the moment I saw the cover, and then the art and then downloading and playing it... it's clear as day that so much amazing talent came together to make this, with a lot of very cool visions culminating in something that scratched the itch that games like [We Know The Devil] and pretty much everything by kittyhorrorshow left behind.” Inyssa “Not as much a story as it is art, poetry, music and snippets of philosophy pieced together into a fascinating and sometimes confusing mind trip.” LittleMissLeeStories

rows.name: Morph!
rows.short_description: Morph is a casual game in which you can transform into a bunch of objects in the world of the game, chasing each other, or hiding quietly, and so on.
rows.description_html: Morph is a casual indie game that allows you to play in a variety of styles, such as 'possessing' over 100 different objects in a given world to find and chase other players, or quietly hiding. Possess yourself with another object! Possess with a variety of objects to blend in perfectly with your surroundings to hide your presence and strategically gain a tactical advantage. Find other players! Find, chase, and slay other players. Hide naturally! Hide your possessed object inconspicuously by blending it seamlessly into its environment. Use your skills! Create your own play style by combining various skills and enjoy the game. Play with variety maps! Enjoy the game using numerous objects on maps of various concepts.

rows.name: Ranocta
rows.short_description: Ranocta is a note-drop 2D rhythm game in a space that crosses straight and circular shapes. In an emotional and beautiful world full of colors and sounds, experience your own performance to recover lost light.
rows.description_html: This game is the second creation of 'Lanota - Music game with story'. An old, broken tuner, and a dark world that has yet to recover. Nevertheless, when they can't give up on purification, a makeshift tuner is created by combining a skeletal judgment line and a music-energy stone called a 'purification stone.' Taking care of this unstable invention and starting over again, there is a whole new style of performance that is more confusing, complex, bumpy, unpredictable, but sometimes colorful, dynamic, brilliant. Characteristics of the game 1. There is a judgment line that freely crosses straight lines and circles, and it is a unique system that remotely hits notes by controlling two 'purification stones' placed on it with eight key inputs. The nine types of notes, each in a different way to destroy, are designed to reflect the characteristics of the game, and the oddly woven patterns, combining all these elements, give you a shock you've never felt before. Enjoy 27 kinds of song pattern, which range from boringly easy to very challenging and difficult. 2. With the permission of Noxy Games Inc. and composers, some great pieces from Lanota were brought. 3. Pictures that exclude characters and place more importance on color than shape fill the screen. Object design and illustration applied for each piece of music are somewhat clumsy and clunky, but on the other hand, they form a sensuous and profound atmosphere. 2023.03 ~ 2024.02 Devoting my senior year in high school, joversound

rows.name: Brighter Shores
rows.short_description: Brighter Shores is an all new adventure from award winning MMORPG designer Andrew Gower. It is an enchanting point-and-click style RPG with hundreds of hours of gameplay, set in a land of magic and mysteries, with a huge number of professions to try, and something new to find around every corner.
rows.description_html: Brighter Shores is an all new adventure from award winning MMORPG designer Andrew Gower. Explore a land of magic and mysteries, with a huge number of professions to try, and something new to find around every corner. Brighter Shores features an ongoing story and hundreds of hours of gameplay. As the newest recruit in the Hopeport town guard, you are looking to make a name for yourself. This soon turns out to be a more challenging role than you had anticipated, with a strange storm raging over the harbor and unrest from the local goblins. You will discover powerful magic sources and become one of the legendary classes of old: Cryoknight, Guardian or Hammermage. Which is fortunate, because something is corrupting the deepest reaches of the nearby Hopeforest, and only through the strength of your new-found powers will you be able to deal with it. Learn a diverse range of professions, such as Fisher, Forager, Chef. Woodcutter, Miner, Alchemist Stonemason, Merchant, Blacksmith, and many more! Encounter a huge variety of fantastical foes over the course of your adventures. The game will be constantly expanding, with new content being released in an episodic format. Each episode features its own unique side quests, professions and lands, as well as advancing the central story. There are hours and hours of content you can play for free. However, if you want more stories, professions and places to explore, you can buy a Premium Pass. A Premium Pass gives you many benefits, including access to all released episodes:

rows.name: Astro Felix
rows.short_description: Skate, jump, and claw your way through endless chaos! Astro Felix is a fast-paced, endless, retro-style platformer starring a fearless space cat on skating wheels.
rows.description_html: Astro Felix is a fast paced endless skate adventure where you play as Felix, the universe’s coolest cat on four wheels! Dash through the vibrant cyber city, dodge deadly obstacles, outsmart enemies, and collect coins and power-ups to boost your run. This platformer will test your reflexes and charm your heart.  From Home Cat to Pixel Hero Astro Felix started as an experimental passion project based on a real cat, our beloved real life companion! His quirky behavior, skate-like slides across the floor, and curious nature inspired us to turn him into a pixel legend.  Features  Fast-paced 2D gameplay  Cute and quirky space cat protagonist (Yes actually based on our real life cat.)  Avoid enemies  Collect coins and powerful pickups  Gamepad and keyboard support  Pure arcade fun with a unique twist

rows.name: Moss Piglets
rows.short_description: This real-time strategy game requires you to direct your horde of moss piglets through dynamic terrains and great dangers.
rows.description_html: Attention commander of the great moss piglet horde! Your moss piglets need your help to get through these terrible dangerous terrains and worlds. No one is sure of the reason for the moss piglet horde being here in this strange land. Now it falls upon you to rally your troops, maintain your resources, and SURVIVE. As your journey unfolds, you will face many obstacles and strange paths. Do not despair! You can be victorious! This hilarious, simple, top-down RTS game, the player will control their horde of moss piglets through a variety of levels requiring you to solve puzzles, evade deadly obstacles, and to stay alive. This will prove difficult, as moss piglets do not have much of a survival instinct. The underlying lore of this world is sure to fascinate the player with the unexpected and the unknown. Moss piglets have many awesome abilities such as healing, burning, freezing, and more that the player will learn to control. Each level holds surprising new adventures for the player! Good luck! Our Team: Parker Bennion Dane Ericksen Nathan Howard Miriam Jardine Marshall Krueger William Lemmons DJ Swiggett Ethan Ware Tanner Mahovsky Ryan Short

rows.name: METAL BEANS
rows.short_description: METAL BEANS is a 3D Action-Arcade game where you control two desktop buddies in a computer space. Protect the PC from digital threats by charging up your way through virus creatures and upgrading Catbot and Robitz in the system!
rows.description_html: METAL BEANS METAL BEANS is a 3D Action-Arcade game where you control two desktop buddies in a computer space. Protect the PC from digital threats by charging up your way through virus creatures and upgrading Catbot and Robitz in the system! CATBOT and ROBITZ are your desktop robot buddies that will help you defend the computer! Swap between the two characters as you combine their attack styles and discover their combined battery combo patterns. Upgrade your characters with disks to customize their skills and stats. -- DESKTOP ARENA The DESKTOP ARENA is your hub to access different stores to upgrade your characters, and replenish their systems back to 100%! Starting off, Blippy will help you recycle your Bad Bits from viruses into player upgrades. -- WINDOW EVENTS Enter different windows to face internal computing issues head on in various arcade-action game modes! How will you upgrade your desktop buddies to prepare them for the ongoing hordes? -- THE CYCLE REBOOTS... As the viruses get tougher to delete, so can you! Use your Databucks earned by your session's scores to unlock more features and upgrades! -- See you inside the PC!

rows.name: FELLCHASER
rows.short_description: You've stolen Death’s scythe in an attempt to cheat your fate. Now you must escape Purgatory by brewing combo-building potions and reaping hordes of creatures in this hack and slash Roguelike!
rows.description_html: In a hasty misstep and with a careless attempt at a new potion, you, Henric the town alchemist, led your own love toward an unconscious state. Alas upon brewing a cure, you falter and see Death before you– but your time is far from up. You've stolen Death’s scythe in an attempt to cheat your fate. Now you must escape Purgatory by brewing combo-building potions and reaping hordes of creatures in this hack and slash Roguelike! Explore the Depths of Purgatory Purgatory is made up of a series of islands all connected by time-bending portals. Home to more than just Death herself, Purgatory bears residence to a wide array of bizarre and oh-so-hungry creatures ready for their next meal. Collect Strange Brewables and Create Combo-Building Elixirs Purgatory is likewise home to a variety of herbs, critter remains, and unsettling items. Collect these mysterious ingredients, mix in uniquely shaped bottles, and reap the Souls of the Damned to assist in your expedition through Purgatory. Interact with the Curiously Cozy Beyond the feasting, beasting monsters Purgatory is home to, a curiously cozy crow named John seems to have made the best of a rather dark and dreary situation. Whether you trade ingredients at John’s Wicked Wares or simply stop for a wee rest, John would absolutely adore your company… and business! It’s All Led Up to This! After you’ve slayed hordes of creatures and brewed your final concoctions, a new island of Purgatory will present itself. Will you be strong enough to escape through the Gates of Purgatory and revive your love once and for all?

rows.name: All City King
rows.short_description: All City King is a stealth game where you take the role of an up-and-coming street artist. Your target is the subway trains and your goal is to make your art travel all over the city.
rows.description_html: All City King is a stealth game where the player takes the role of an up-and-coming street artist. Your target is the subway trains and your goal is to make your art travel all over the city. Some games allow you to heist a bank where you take out the guards and escape with a giant pay-check. But in All City King, your “bank” is the trains, and your “pay-check” is your art or whatever message you feel fit to share. Enter the subway quietly, make your mark on the trains, and get out. As you start your career as a street artist and after you have learned the ropes, your goal is to spray paint subway cars in increasingly difficult missions. Sneak past patrolling security guards, leave your mark on subway trains, and watch as your masterpiece leaves the station! Music by: Lars Bjerkholt Skotnes

rows.name: Atuel
rows.short_description: Atuel is an award-winning surrealist documentary game in which you explore beautiful, dreamlike landscapes inspired by the topography and wildlife of the Atuel River Valley in Argentina.
rows.description_html: Atuel is an award-winning surrealist documentary game in which you explore beautiful, dreamlike landscapes inspired by the topography and wildlife of the Atuel River Valley in Argentina. Perspective is fluid and interconnected as you shapeshift to become different animals and elements that form part of Atuel’s ecosystem. Real-life interviews about the past, present, and future of the Atuel weave together to form a historic narrative about people’s intimate relationship to the land they live on and the effects of the global climate crisis. A beautiful audiovisual experience focused on contemplative exploration. Shapeshift to become different animals and elements of Atuel’s ecoystem. Stunning surrealist landscapes based on the real-world topography of the Atuel River Valley. Real-life interviews with historians, biologists, geologists, and more. A historic narrative woven together from many different, interconnected perspectives. An atmospheric, ambient soundtrack produced by musicians Makunouchi Bento. An impactful half-hour game available in many different languages.

rows.reviews_html: “A climate crisis documentary in the form of a third person walking sim where you play as a river. A high concept with a high execution.” Robert Yang “...not one person's voice, but a collection of voices describing the Rio Atuel in Argentina. You steer a drop of water, or a rush of it, or a bird or fish, as scientists and inhabitants describe their perspectives of the river. A small project but a really lovely, evocative presentation.” Andrew Plotkin “Combines geography, documentary, science, history, and beautiful visuals into a singular and sublime experience.” James Coltrain

rows.name: The WereCleaner
rows.short_description: Kyle is a Janitor. He's also a Werewolf. And now he's got the night shift. Try not to kill anyone while working to get your paycheck - in a stealth-comedy game with surprises around every corner.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Howlin' Hugs The WereCleaner is a stealth-comedy game about cleaning messes and fighting your own instincts. Explore an ever-expanding office space and master an arsenal of gadgets to clean the office of messes, accidents... and the carnage of your own ongoing rampage. Features One unique and interconnected game world, filled with secret routes and handcrafted details A dynamic NPC system, with dozens of characters to avoid, trick or kill if needed 7 levels of wacky scenarios, shifting layouts, and hilarious surprises 3 multipurpose tools to dispose of every kind of mess - intentional or not

rows.name: Bulls and Cows - Wild West
rows.short_description: On the farm, amidst green pastures and picturesque meadows, our little heroes will meet Vanessa – a clever and friendly cow-guide. She will enthusiastically explain the rules of the game and help children develop their logical abilities.

Here, children will embark on a unique adventure, meeting a kind and lovely cow-girl. On the farm, amidst green pastures and picturesque meadows, our little heroes will meet Vanessa – a clever and friendly cow-guide. She will enthusiastically explain the rules of the game and help children develop their logical abilities. 'Bulls and Cows: Wild West' will offer children an endless number of levels that will capture their imagination and ignite the desire to conquer all the puzzles. Thanks to Vanessa, our little heroes will strive for new heights in solving the riddles. Immerse yourself in the unique world of the Wild West, accompanied by lively country music. Children will enjoy every level, playing with Vanessa and her friends, and enhancing their logical skills on this captivating farm! Get ready for an exciting adventure on the farm, uncover number mysteries, and become true sheriffs of puzzles in 'Bulls and Cows: Wild West' alongside Vanessa!

rows.name: Looking For Cats In a Badly Drawn Forest
rows.short_description: Look around the house, mountain peaks and forest to find 300 cats hidden in the most unexpected places!
rows.description_html: Welcome to the badly drawn forest full of cute cats! 🐈‍ This game has 3 different levels, in a forest theme. 😺 Try to find 100 kitties in each level! Click on them to color them! 🐱 Look for kitties in the woods. 😹 Look for kitties in the cabin. 😺 Look for them in the snow. 😹 Look for kitties at the lake. 🙀 Look for kitties in the mountains. 🐱‍ Look inside, around mountain tops and in the woods, but be careful, some kitties hide too well! Key features: 😹 300 different kitties to find! 🙀 There are hints if there are difficulties! 🐱‍ There is a zoom function to help you see the kitties! 👓 Use your imagination and a sharp eye to spot all the cats in the most unusual situations!

rows.name: Illusion Carnival
rows.short_description: A lost soul wanders through a whimsical, eerie pop-up book like amusement park. Dive into fun-filled stages, encounter unique characters, fend off spirit erosion, and uncover the park's hidden secrets. The enchanting yet dark Illusion Carnival begins now.
rows.description_html: To Contact Us Join our Discord Server We welcome your inquiries at illusioncarnival@hotmail.com Should you encounter a bug impeding your progression, try returning to the main menu and re-entering the game. For further updates on development, follow the developer's social media accounts: Twitter/X @KiZ_qi About the Game This game marks the inception of the 'Illusion Carnival' series. 'Illusion Carnival' is a stylized 2.5D role-playing adventure game that captivates with its unique visuals and character-driven narrative. Immerse yourself in levels reminiscent of carnival games, where puzzles and light action/bullet hell elements await. Characters with distinct personalities and dark fairy-tale-like narratives craft an immersive atmosphere reminiscent of a bizarre amusement park adventure with hints of psychological horror. Trapped within the whimsical and eerie confines of an amusement park, a lost soul transforms into a tiny paper boat embarking on an unique journey, striving to break free. Confettia, once a dazzling amusement park, now stands corrupted and riddled with anomalies intent on consuming your spirit. What befell the park's previous visitors, and what draws you here? In a realm with no death and no escape, what fate awaits should your spirit succumb to utter madness? Navigate enchanting 2.5D pop-up book-style landscapes that transport you into a realm of fantasy and fairy tales. Admire the cute yet slightly ominous art style, where vibrant hues give way to unsettling anomalies, evoking a theater-like ambiance with thematic visuals throughout. Embark on a journey through diverse sections of the amusement park, each with various carnival aesthetics, from roller coasters to whimsical minigames. Engaging in dialogues between characters, adding charm to your park adventure. Interact with adorable yet enigmatic anomalous dolls, unravel puzzles concealed within toy boxes, and gradually unveil the park's mysteries. Partake in thrilling yet manageable combat encounters as you dodge the anomalies' assaults, endeavoring to restore the park to its former glory. Experience a narrative that seamlessly intertwines light-hearted comedy with dark fairy tales. Meet a cast of distinctive residents and fellow park visitors, relishing in their endearing performances and immersive storylines, all while engaging in jovial conversations with them.

rows.name: Introspection
rows.short_description: IntroSpection is a top-down bullethell-like action game about a man forced to confront his past. Delve into memories and blast through waves of inner demons as you explore one man's mental purgatory.
rows.description_html: Introspection puts the player into the shoes of Daniel, a guy in his early twenties struggling to find his way in the world. Fight your way through waves of enemies, challenge bosses, and attempt to escape as you explore Daniel’s mental purgatory. - Explore three different layers of Daniel’s personal purgatory, each with their own distinct themes. - Piece together Daniel’s past as you (may or may not) struggle to escape. - Gun your way through rooms of enemies that stand in your way

rows.name: Zero's Fantastic Anecdote
rows.short_description: A Danmaku Shooting Game.
rows.description_html: 'Zero's Fantastic Anecdote' is a shooting game where you will control Zero, a high school student with flying ability who is drawn into a forest world different from the real world. Here, you will face countless fairies and bosses, who will fire danmaku of various shapes and colors at you. You need to flexibly dodge and counterattack in order to survive. Game features: You can freely move in the air and use your superpowers to control the speed of the barrage, creating amazing effects.Engage in intense battles with various fairies and bosses, enjoying the beauty and excitement of barrage.The interesting plot and characters allow you to understand Zero's Fantastic Anecdote's background and destiny, discover his relationship with the forest world, and uncover the truth hidden in the fog. Featuring traditional shooting game modes and handling techniques, it brings a unique gaming experience. If you enjoy shooting games, then ''Zero's Fantastic Anecdote' will definitely bring you a different adventure. Come and experience what Zero has experienced with her! If you love the music in the game/are a fan of Zero’s amazing work, please check out OST~ 🎵🎶 You’ll make her super happy! 😊 The currently publicly released version is only the trial version of the first two stages, and Zero will release the complete version as soon as possible! I want to make easy and normal difficulty as a way to kill time, while hard and lunatic are aimed at professionals. (although there are many imperfections in current version, including the fact that the final boss has not yet been put into the game)

rows.name: Treasure Defence
rows.short_description: Treasure Defence is an award winning VR game that innovates on the classic tower defence genre. Play arcades, win towers and fight The Royal British Navy. Plunder gold from destroyed ships and fortify your pirate cove.
rows.description_html: This is a VR-Only game, using OpenXR Argh Pirates!! The brits are attacking your pirate cove! Get ready to fight them, using towers you acquire from various mini games. Place them on the board and slam the bell to start the wave. The towers will automatically target the British boats when they pass by. Types of towers: Rifleman Tower - Fast Projectiles with low damage Bomber Tower - Slow but high damage Monkey Catapult - Attaches itself to a enemy boat and deals damage over time Harpoon Tower - Slows down the enemies The towers can be acquired by interacting with the arcade machines. Claw Machine Whack-a-moneky: Essentially Whack-a-mole, but with a monkey's hand instead. Hit that monkey a certain amount of time to be rewarded a tower Shoot a bottle: Inside the cabinet is a shooting range, where you have to use a pistol and shoot a certain amount of bottles to be rewarded a tower. Controls: Adjust height: Hold either the right laser point or right controller and aim at the box icon with text “Height up” or “Height down”. This will adjust the player's height in the VR build. Turn off laser in game: X Button / Primary button on the Left VR motion controller. Teleportation: Hold the right VR motion controller primary button / A to show the teleportation circle “gizmo”. While holding A on the right motion controller press X / Primary button on the left motion controller to confirm and teleport to the location that the player is aiming at. Blue circle gizmo - Can teleport White circle gizmo - Cannot teleport Rotate view: Right VR controller joystick Regular movement: Left VR controller joystick Interaction/grab: Grip button on each Vr controller. Allows two items to be picked up, one on each hand. Reset player position: Left Joystick click

rows.name: Icy Incline
rows.short_description: 'Icy Incline' is a experience where you control a penguin sliding through 24 icy trails. Race against time, avoid obstacles, and find the best route for the fastest time and reach the end of each trail. See your performance with stats like best score, worst score, and crashes.
rows.description_html: 'Icy Incline' is a experience where you control a penguin sliding through 24 icy trails. Race against time, avoid obstacles, and find the best route for the fastest time and reach the end of each trail. See your performance with stats like best score, worst score, and crashes. As the penguin, your goal is simple yet thrilling: reach the end of each trail in the shortest time possible. The icy trails are filled with obstacles that demand quick reflexes and strategy. Feel the rush of the chilly wind as you gracefully navigate the 24 trails, avoiding crashes and collecting powerups. The obstacles consist of candy canes, cones, rocks, and ice patches. Candy canes, cones, and rocks will end your run, while ice patches will slow you down. Controls: A, D - turn left, turn right Credits AJ - Developer, Design Jérémie - Trail design Kross Kancel - Sound

rows.name: Grid Dungeons
rows.short_description: A turn-based strategy game. Command a team with swordsmen, archers, and mages, strategically navigating grid maps. Unleash unique actions to defeating enemies. Master tactics, minimize damage, and conquer in this immersive strategy adventure.
rows.description_html: Immerse yourself in the strategic depths of our turn-based dungeon game! Take command of a party of diverse characters, navigating through grid-based maps to outwit and conquer enemies. Your mission: strategically eliminate foes while minimizing damage to your own team. Explore the treacherous depths of dungeons, where every move counts in this thrilling adventure of tactics and skill. Can you emerge victorious against the lurking dangers? Embark on a strategic journey through a myriad of maps in our turn-based dungeon strategic game! Command a diverse party of characters, each wielding unique weapons - from swordsmen engaging in close combat to archers picking off enemies from a distance, and mages unleashing powerful spells. Unlock a plethora of actions, allowing you to tailor your approach to each challenge. Navigate the grid-based landscapes wisely, combining the strengths of your team to defeat foes and uncover the secrets hidden within the dungeons. Master the art of strategy in a world where every move and action shapes your destiny!

rows.name: Wittle Mistakes - Prologue
rows.short_description: Play the first game of many! Wittle Mistakes is a mechanics-based third-person 3D adventure where players navigate the trials of infancy within the Mother Corporation. Unveil the dark secrets that Mother has been hiding. The playpen awaits! Built by an insane two-man team.
rows.description_html: SUMMARY Welcome, dearest players, to 'Wittle Mistakes,' an adventure curated with the utmost care by yours truly, Mother. Here, you'll navigate the trials of the Mother Corporation as an adventurous infant. Each challenge is a lesson, with surprises and secrets tucked in every corner. From the dangers of our playpen to the mysteries within our toy-laden landscapes, your journey will be filled with discovery and confusion. But tread carefully, for not everything is as playful as it appears. What truths lie behind our cheerful facade? Only the brightest and bravest will uncover the secrets and learn what it means to make a 'Wittle Mistake.' 'Wittle Mistakes' is more than a game; it's an adventure where every challenge is a tender embrace, every obstacle a chance to grow. Are you ready to join our family and discover the love and learning that await in Mother’s world? Let's begin, and may your mistakes be wittle but your discoveries grand. GAMEPLAY 'Wittle Mistakes' is a third-person 3D platformer, adventure game, that thrusts you into the wobbly legs of an infant baby destined for greatness (or failure).We invite players into a richly imagined world where the charm of childhood curiosity meets the challenge of intricate puzzles and survival against odd, even whimsical, adversaries. As an infant protagonist, players will navigate through a series of escalating trials orchestrated by the enigmatic M.O.T.H.E.R. corporation, blending elements of platforming, puzzle-solving, and stealth in a 3D environment rendered with a mix of surreal beauty and eerie undertones. KEY FEATURES Movement Mechanics: Players start with basic movements (crawling, standing, walking) and progressively unlock more complex abilities. Mastery of these movements is crucial for overcoming physical obstacles and advancing through levels. Narrative-Driven Single-Player Story: Immerse yourself in a gripping tale that blends humor, absurdity, and unexpected twists. Discover the secrets behind the M.O.T.H.E.R. corporation's bizarre trials and the true nature of the world you're crawling through. Puzzle-Solving: Each level is structured around unique puzzles that integrate physical navigation with environmental manipulation. Players must solve these puzzles to unlock new areas, evade dangers, or manipulate the environment to their advantage. Skill Progression: The game is designed to teach and then test. Early levels focus on learning and mastering new skills in a relatively safe environment. Later levels challenge players to apply these skills in more complex and dangerous contexts. Level Progression Highlights: Initial Discovery : Master basic movements and interact with a vibrant world filled with toys, teaching the joy of exploration. On Your Feet: Overcome the first real test of agility by winning a race, a testament to your growing abilities. Aerial Acrobatics : Navigate through an obstacle course of bounce pads, perfecting control in mid-air for thrilling platforming action. Mind Over Matter: Tackle puzzles that require cunning over brute force, challenging your intellect. Precision and Patience: Test your coordination with fast-moving obstacles, a trial of timing and reflexes. 'Wittle Mistakes' is not just a game; it's an odyssey of growth, challenge, and the pursuit of triumph over seemingly insurmountable odds. It's a colorful, surreal journey set against the backdrop of a child's innocence and the dark whimsy of the world that awaits. Join us in this unique adventure where every mistake is a lesson, and every challenge is an opportunity for discovery. ABOUT US At Rockfire Games, we believe that gaming should be a rollercoaster of emotions, with humor leading the charge.

rows.name: Falos
rows.short_description: Falos: Learn to read 100+ words in 100+ languages while playing a game. A game where you match words to emojis across four different play styles.
rows.description_html: Play Falos, learn to read the first 100+ words for over 100+ languages. Four Different Gameplay Modes Gorilla Jumper: Navigate through levels by jumping onto the correct emojis that match the displayed words. Precision and quick thinking are key as you leap from one emoji to the next. Dragon Snake: Embrace the classic snake game with a twist. Guide your character towards the right emojis while avoiding your growing tail, ensuring each move aligns with your language learning goals. Bird Adventure: Take to the skies in a side-scrolling escapade. Flap the wings of your bird to soar among the clouds, diving through the correct emojis that match the words below. Endless Gorilla Runner: Test your reflexes in an endless runner format, where you must jump across multiple levels to snag the right emojis. Avoid the wrong ones to keep your streak alive and score high. Educational Video Game Diverse Vocabulary: From animals and colors to essential travel items, expand your linguistic repertoire in a fun and memorable way. Multiple Languages: With over 100 languages featured, Falos offers an unparalleled opportunity to explore new languages or strengthen existing skills. Engaging Challenges: Each game mode presents unique challenges that cater to different playstyles, ensuring a fresh and exciting learning experience every time. Progress Advance through levels by matching the correct emojis with their corresponding words. Beware of the incorrect choices, as they cost you a life. Success hinges on accuracy and speed, with each level upping the ante and enriching your vocabulary. Design Philosophy Falos is designed to make language learning accessible and entertaining. By integrating learning into familiar gaming formats, players of all ages can enjoy the thrill of gaming while absorbing new words in another language. Whether you're a seasoned polyglot or a curious beginner, Falos offers a unique blend of education and entertainment. Join the Adventure Prepare yourself to have fun in the colorful and captivating world of Falos, where every jump, flap, and dash brings you one step closer to linguistic mastery. With its innovative approach to language learning, Falos is not just a game—it's a gateway to global communication and understanding.

rows.name: Anamnesia - part 1: am i my body?
rows.short_description: Sci-Fi Mystery Visual Novel. Nine people are trapped in an underground research facility, forced to play a game of life and death. Check your log to find the truth that connects those apparent strangers - if you even want to, that is.
rows.description_html: Can you find the truth? Nine people wake up trapped in an abandoned research facility. Split into three teams, separated into different halls, the members of the two Answer Teams need to compete in a game of life and death. The goal: to figure out the 'truth' behind the secret member of the Question Team: Emilia. Do you really want to? Each part of Anamnesia will cover the same timeframe from the perspective of a different protagonist. Part 1 centers around Adrian, a member of Answer Team A. rows.name: Keep It Steady!
rows.short_description: Take control of a paddles left and right sides and move them up or down to guide a ball! Guide the ball through several game modes by either dodging on-coming holes trying to make your ball collide with them or by aiming for glowing holes that give you points for entering them.
rows.description_html: Main Idea of the game In this game you will rely on physics as you take control of a paddle or platforms left and right sides. With this ability you will be able to lift up or down either side of the paddle allowing you to be able to control the mass of a ball sitting on top of the paddle. Your goal is to be able to manipulate the paddles left and right sides correctly to make the ball sitting on top of the paddle roll into a randomly selected glowing hole to get points while also trying to avoid the other unlit holes around it. Game Modes There are so far 5 game modes currently in the game they are Classic, Endless, Climb, Phantom, and Speedball. Currently Climb and Phantom are the only ones with sub game modes. Each sub game mode having a twist on the main game mode they are from. Classic In the Classic game mode you are to move the sides of the paddle up and down to roll the ball in the glowing hole to score points. But be careful if you are to roll the ball accidently into a black unlit hole it will cost you a life. if you lose too many lives the game will be over. Climb In the Climb Game mode you will be trying to guide the ball away from every hole as long as you can. If you touch any hole it will make you lose a life and if you lose too many lives it will be game over. However every hole is moving in either a up, down, left, or right direction making it a challenging experience to dodge every hole thrown your way. The holes also speed up over time making it harder to dodge them as you try to continue to get the best time. Your only goal in this mode is to survive as long as you can and get the best time. Climb Point Climb Point is a sub game mode in climb that has slightly different objectives. It is basically the same as all the other climb sub game modes except for there is a glowing hole you need to get. the hole is randomly chosen and will be moving downward with the other holes. the holes in this mode will only come from the top and be going downward. If you miss a glowing hole it will chose another hole. All you have to do in this mode is stay alive as long as possible while also getting the glowing holes to increase your score. Phantom In the Phantom Game mode you will do exactly the same as in the classic mode but there is a twist. Depending on the sub game mode selected you will have one item in the game (ball, paddle, holes) flicker and disappear for a short time. The objects that disappear will be gone for a short amount of time but will then reappear again shortly. Speedball In the Speedball game mode it will also be exactly like the classic mode however, to get points you will need to make the ball go as fast as it can into the correct hole to get more points. The faster the ball moves into the correct hole the more points you will get for that hole. If you use barely any speed you get no points. the points you can get from this game mode are 0, 1, 2, 3, and 5. To get 5 you need to make the ball go incredibly fast into the correct hole. Endless In the Endless game mode it will also be just like the classic mode except you get to play infinitely! You will be able to get your scores higher than what can be done in Classic or Speedball. There will also be a timer to show you how long you have played the endless mode as well. The more points you have and the shorter amount of time you got them in can show the world how good you are at the Endless mode. High Score Board This game features a online or local high score board for all game modes. On the online board try your hand at being the best in the world at one of the game modes or even all of them! On the local board you can play against others who use your device and you can have a friendly competition with people around you you know.

rows.name: Armless Samurai
rows.short_description: Your arms may be taken from you, but not your honour. Your legs have become your sword and shield. Run on walls, dive kick & dash into your enemies, parry bullets with your shins. Become a warrior of legend, Armless Samurai!
rows.description_html: Go leg to leg with the fast-paced gauntlet of Armless Samurai. Armless Samurai is a fast paced first-person parkour game where you play as a samurai whose limbs have been lost in battle, and robbed from their arsenal. Worry not, however, they haven’t taken your legs yet! And this will be your enemy's greatest mistake… In an effort to seek vengeance for your limbs, take on a mountain of monstrous machines and obstacles to ascend the mighty fortress. As a now armless samurai, you must dash, kick & fight your way through six unique levels on your mission of revenge! Become a warrior of legend, Armless Samurai! Key Features: Fast paced parkour movement! Do anything to rush through. Slide through the castle, charge and dash through your enemies, even run on walls! Use your legs for everything! Parry projectiles, fight enemies, destroy obstacles and move around using just your legs. Battle against mechanical enemies and dangerous obstacles! Fight against a wide range of unique enemies as you move through each level. Avoid and defeat the castle’s dangerous obstacles using your samurai parkour skills. Score grading system! Race against the clock for the fastest times while competing for the highest scores. Combo your attacks to increase your score, aiming to get the highest possible and the legendary SSS rank, or just dash your way through the levels as fast as possible. Compete against others! Move around the castle as fast as possible whilst fighting enemies to gain the highest scores possible. Compete against your friends and other players on the Steam leaderboard.

rows.name: KICK ME!
rows.short_description: Kick opponents off rooftops in KICK ME! Multiplayer PvP madness awaits as you strategize, deploy unique abilities, and grab boosts to secure victory. Navigate dynamic arenas, and be the best kicker! Are you up for the challenge?
rows.description_html: Welcome to KICK ME! - the ultimate multiplayer PvP game where the rooftops are your battlefield! Get ready for an adrenaline-pumping experience as you strive to kick your opponents off the edge while avoiding the same fate. Craft your strategy, master unique abilities and powerful boosts to dominate the competition. Features: Intense PvP Action: Engage in thrilling player-versus-player battles on dynamic rooftops. Strategize and outmaneuver your opponents to secure victory. Strategic Gameplay: It's not just about kicking; it's about survival. Plan your moves wisely, anticipate your rivals' actions, and stay one step ahead. Unique Abilities: Unleash a variety of special abilities to gain the upper hand. Whether it's a speed boost, a powerful knockback, or a surprise maneuver, choose the right ability at the right time to turn the tide in your favor. Boosts Galore: Keep an eye out for power-boosts scattered across the rooftops. Grab them to enhance your abilities, increase your strength, or gain a temporary advantage over your opponents. Dynamic Environments: Explore a variety of rooftop arenas, each with its own challenges and quirks. Adapt to your surroundings and use them to your advantage in the quest for supremacy. Multiplayer Mayhem: Team up with friends or go solo in intense multiplayer matches. Prove that you have the skills and strategy to be the last kicker standing. Get ready to experience the thrill of rooftop combat like never before in KICK ME! Are you up for the challenge? Kick, strategize, and dominate!

rows.name: HYPER DEMON PVP
rows.short_description: HYPER DEMON PVP is a free online 1v1 FPS. Master simple but deep mechanics and defeat opponents in intense duels to climb the global leaderboard.
rows.description_html: HYPER DEMON PVP is a free online 1v1 FPS. Master your movement, aim, timing and resources to defeat your opponents in intense duels. With precise lasers and powerful charge shots, damage your opponent to grow their weak point. Hit the weak point to defeat them instantly. Defeat them 3 times to win the match. Use your recharging shield to avoid damage and reflect projectiles. Compete on the global leaderboard. Create private lobbies to challenge your friends. Watch replays and spectate other players to improve. Study the tutorials and practice with a CPU opponent while waiting for the next match to start. 1v1-only allows for a unique server architecture. Each match will use the server with the best ping for both players. Originally a secret easter egg in HYPER DEMON, PVP is now expanded and available free for everyone. Enjoy responsibly.
