rows.name: Vollema
rows.short_description: Vollema is a hand-drawn, color-changing RPG featuring a unique pattern memorization-based combat system where you and your classmates uncover a sinister plot involving your school, local politics, and a cult-like paramilitary organization.
rows.description_html: In Vollema , you assume the role of a college student on your university's volleyball team. While en route to The Big Game, you and one of your teammates accidentally stumble upon a major conspiracy surrounding the school, local politics, and a cult-like paramilitary organization. Looks like the tournament is going to have to wait. As you unravel the story, you will... Recruit new party members capable of countering different attacks during combat, indicated by color and sound cues. Explore various unique and colorful locations, each one giving you and your party a slightly different look. Wrestle a goat. Encounter manmade horrors beyond your comprehension. Meet some... unique individuals and creatures inhabiting the surrounding area. And maybe even make it to The Big Game after all! Look out for yourself and your team, because someone, somewhere, is absolutely out to get you!

rows.name: Grim
rows.short_description: Grim is a horror game inspired from Taiwanese folklore “Aunt Tiger”. The player will play in a room-oriented 3rd-person perspective as a “ghost” and will observe the world from fixed camera perspectives to solve puzzles and survive the monster’s pursuit.
rows.description_html: We present to you GRIM, a spooky narrative game where the player is dead and through the possession of various objects as a ghost, players can make world-shaping decisions that decide the fate of their twin trapped inside the same house with a vicious monster! You and Jia must fight off the monsters of the night, figure out what happened to your parents, and reveal the dark passages, hidden away from innocent eyes. Inspired by the different retellings of the original Taiwanese folklore “Aunt Tiger”, Grim provides players with a unique experience exploring an immersive 3D environment and a dynamic narrative where players will uncover different storylines based on their decisions. As a ghost, players can possess objects and toggle different physics-based movements with unique controls depending on various items.

rows.name: Sporti's Universe
rows.short_description: Sporti's Universe is an innovative exergame designed to address the challenge of getting school-aged children to engage in physical activity in today's digital age. It leverages technology to encourage physical movement while providing an engaging and enjoyable gaming experience.
rows.description_html: What is Sporti's Universe? Sporti's Universe is not just a game; it's a revolutionary approach to promoting physical activity among school-aged children. In an era where screens and video games often keep kids indoors and sedentary, Sporti's Universe empowers them to use their movements to control in-game actions and characters, all while having fun. Key Features: Encouraging Physical Activity: Sporti's Universe makes physical activity enjoyable by allowing children to control the game through their movements, promoting active gameplay. Diverse Sports Activities: The game offers a wide variety of sports activities, including climbing, snowboarding, kayaking, and more, providing a range of active experiences. Immersive Experience: Sporti's Universe creates an immersive virtual sports world with lifelike motions and camera-based AI animations, enhancing the overall gaming experience. Body-Controlled Gameplay: Players' movements serve as the controller, making it a genuinely physical and active gaming experience that keeps kids moving. Accessibility: The game is designed with low technical requirements, ensuring that a broad audience can access and enjoy it. It is compatible with inexpensive web cameras, making it accessible to many users.

rows.name: Whispering Death
rows.short_description: Whispering Death: Prologue draws you into a twisted world built from the remnants of your past. Solve puzzles, search for answers, and stay alert - She’s always watching, and one wrong decision can end everything.
rows.description_html: Step into the chilling world of Whispering Death , a survival horror game with intricate puzzle elements that will keep you on the edge of your seat. In this game, you play as a man who wakes up in a nightmarish realm, stripped of his memories and haunted by the unknown. Your goal is to remember who you are and find a way out of this terrifying place. Navigate through a frightful environment teeming with monstrous creatures and sinister entities that thirst for your demise. The game masterfully blends storytelling, and puzzle-solving, ensuring a gripping experience that challenges both your wits and nerves. Whispering Death stands out with its procedurally generated items, offering players a unique experience each time they play. This feature ensures that no two playthroughs are the same, demanding new strategies and approaches every time you dive into the horror. Prepare yourself for a survival horror experience like no other, where every corner hides a new threat and every step could be your last.

rows.name: Forest Ranger Simulator - Apprenticeship
rows.short_description: This is a free prologue of Forest Ranger Simulator. You have 45 minutes to explore, and have a glimpse of the story and game mechanics. Take care of forgotten nature's treasure. Build, craft, feed, clean, and manage your forest.
rows.description_html: Forest Ranger Simulator - Apprenticeship is a free prologue to Forest Ranger Simulator. You have 45 minutes to explore the game, have a glimpse of the story and the game mechanics. If you like it. Here you can get the full game. Take care of forgotten nature's treasure. Build, craft, feed, clean, and manage your forest in Forest Ranger Simulator. Ensure its long-lasting beauty and become a flawless Forest Ranger! WHAT CAN YOU DO IN FOREST RANGER SIMULATOR ⚒️ Build & Repair - seatings, benches, feeders, bridges and more 🧰 Craft - create something useful out of not useful items 📚 Learn - read and learn about real life nature in your notebook 🐦 Feed - hungry animals such as ducks or birds need to be fed ⭐ Unlock Items & Badges - advance through game to unlock new items and get rewards 🏃‍♂️ Explore - walk, run, drive and watch beautiful nature by day and night 🗑️ Sort & Clean - help forest and clean it from garbage, lots of different trash need sorting 💰 Buy and Sell l - use online store to earn some $ 🪓 Gather - mushrooms, brushwood, timber, honey and more 🌲 Take Care of the Forest - estinguish fires, get rid of traps and more DO WHAT YOU LIKE - it's sandbox, play how you like it! QUESTS Forest Ranger always has his hands full. The number and variety of quests will not let anyone get bored. Some tasks you can complete without hurry, in others you will have to do a little jogging. Some will require the use of a car. We do not want to reveal too much. See for yourself. CRAFTING What is crafting in Forest Ranger Simulator? It's creating useful things from literally whatever you can find. Sometimes you'll definitely feel like MacGyver. GATHERING In order to create something you first have to tear it down. Specifically, we need to acquire materials for building and crafting. To build a table we will need wood. In addition, in the forest we can find many other valuable things like mushrooms. LEARNING Forest Ranger Simulator is a game, however, we wanted to include as much valuable information from real life as possible in the game. Thanks to the notebook you will learn a lot about the work of a Forest Ranger, you will also find many interesting facts about forests, such as information about mushrooms. Learn by playing. The name simulator obliges. WORKSHOP Workbench. There's nothing like having everything at hand. Saw, pliers, hammer, paintbrush.... and many more tools ready to go. Why not build a bird feeder? DAY & NIGHT The profession of Forest Ranger is not a job from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. Here you have to be on guard day and night. Remember that the night is dark, and the only light is the glow of the moon and your flashlight. Watching the sunset or the beauty of the moon.... priceless. CLEANING Forests, it's not just trees, leaves and animals, it's a ton of trash left by people. You will find more than 150 different trash here. Sometimes you will be surprised what you can find in the forest. Remember that everything has to be sorted. You have special trash garbage cans for this. Some skills as well as large garbage bags will be helpful in cleaning up. EMERGENCIES A Forest Ranger has to be alert at all times. You need to observe what's going on in your forest and quickly intervene with a threat. Maybe it's a smoldering fire, or maybe poachers have set up snares again.
rows.about_html: Forest Ranger Simulator - Apprenticeship is a free prologue to Forest Ranger Simulator. You have 45 minutes to explore the game, have a glimpse of the story and the game mechanics. If you like it. Here you can get the full game. Take care of forgotten nature's treasure. Build, craft, feed, clean, and manage your forest in Forest Ranger Simulator. Ensure its long-lasting beauty and become a flawless Forest Ranger! WHAT CAN YOU DO IN FOREST RANGER SIMULATOR ⚒️ Build & Repair - seatings, benches, feeders, bridges and more 🧰 Craft - create something useful out of not useful items 📚 Learn - read and learn about real life nature in your notebook 🐦 Feed - hungry animals such as ducks or birds need to be fed ⭐ Unlock Items & Badges - advance through game to unlock new items and get rewards 🏃‍♂️ Explore - walk, run, drive and watch beautiful nature by day and night 🗑️ Sort & Clean - help forest and clean it from garbage, lots of different trash need sorting 💰 Buy and Sell l - use online store to earn some $ 🪓 Gather - mushrooms, brushwood, timber, honey and more 🌲 Take Care of the Forest - estinguish fires, get rid of traps and more DO WHAT YOU LIKE - it's sandbox, play how you like it! QUESTS Forest Ranger always has his hands full. The number and variety of quests will not let anyone get bored. Some tasks you can complete without hurry, in others you will have to do a little jogging. Some will require the use of a car. We do not want to reveal too much. See for yourself. CRAFTING What is crafting in Forest Ranger Simulator? It's creating useful things from literally whatever you can find. Sometimes you'll definitely feel like MacGyver. GATHERING In order to create something you first have to tear it down. Specifically, we need to acquire materials for building and crafting. To build a table we will need wood. In addition, in the forest we can find many other valuable things like mushrooms. LEARNING Forest Ranger Simulator is a game, however, we wanted to include as much valuable information from real life as possible in the game. Thanks to the notebook you will learn a lot about the work of a Forest Ranger, you will also find many interesting facts about forests, such as information about mushrooms. Learn by playing. The name simulator obliges. WORKSHOP Workbench. There's nothing like having everything at hand. Saw, pliers, hammer, paintbrush.... and many more tools ready to go. Why not build a bird feeder? DAY & NIGHT The profession of Forest Ranger is not a job from 8:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. Here you have to be on guard day and night. Remember that the night is dark, and the only light is the glow of the moon and your flashlight. Watching the sunset or the beauty of the moon.... priceless. rows.description_html: Farmer's Father: The Origins is a free prologue of Farmer's Father. You have 60 minutes to explore, have a glimpse of the story and game mechanics. Fight with hunger, wounds, cold, disease, and enemy cruelty. Defend your family and survive the war! 'The first casualty of war is innocence' War breeds heroes you've never heard of. You are the ordinary person holding a huge burden of protecting what's most precious and innocent. Fight with hunger, wounds, cold, disease, and enemy cruelty. Defend your family and survive the war! Imagine waking up in the middle of the snowy night to the sounds of a falling sky. Explosions, fire, chaos, the frightened whimper of your child. It’s your turn: now or never, slip away from your enemies before it's too late… FEW OF MAIN FEATURES IN THE GAME 🕊️ Building - animal homestead, baby cradle, trough, and more 🕊️ Crafting - create something useful out of junk 🕊️ Cooking - prepare all kinds of food out of what you can find 🕊️ Sneaking - move quietly then you'll survive 🕊️ Hunting - use guns and provide needed food 🕊️ Exploring - strange sounds, enemies, unknown territories 🕊️ Taking care of family - making family safe, fed, and warm PROTECT YOUR FAMILY As a father, since the first breath of your child, you’ve always known the responsibility relies on your shoulders… but the stakes were never that high. Do what you must to keep your wife and son alive. FARM, HUNT, IMPROVISE Nothing can be taken for granted now. You will have to earn every meal and bargain for each piece of comfort for you and your family using extreme measures. Hunt for wild animals, make forest recipes, and, as a farmer, use your skills to create a new home during the occupation… SURVIVE Sneak, wait for your moment, and ATTACK! Every. Second. Counts. Your enemies are cunning and trained. Can you handle that while being 'just' a farmer? Your everyday abilities may come in handy so don’t underestimate yourself and keep trying! After all, you’ve got nothing to lose and everything to gain.

rows.name: Shadow Touched
rows.short_description: Shadow Touched is a 2D platformer where the player has to use their platforming skills and travel between dimensions to complete levels.
rows.description_html: EARLY ACCESS This game is currently in its early access phase, indicating that certain elements may undergo changes or removal. The game will get updates, although not on a regular schedule. Description Embark on a platforming journey with Shadow Touched, a 2D platformer created from my long programming apprenticeship journey. This project, developed in almost two months, has evolved beyond its academic roots into a passion project that I am committed to expanding over time. Key Features: Unique Dimensional Gameplay: Take control of Twilight, the main character, and master the art of dimension-hopping. In the normal form, Twilight has a single jump, a dash, and a basic attack pattern. Switch to the shadow dimension for increased movement speed, higher jump height, an additional jump, and three powerful attack patterns with enhanced damage. Choose your form wisely to navigate the intricate levels and overcome challenges. Strategic Platforming: Traverse diverse and meticulously designed levels that will test your platforming skills. Formidable Foes: Encounter the formidable Knight, your primary adversary in the shadowy realms. Stay on your guard as these enemies will strike if you get too close. Use your dimensional powers to defeat them quickly! Checkpoint System: Shadow Touched features a checkpoint system. If Twilight meets her end, she respawns at the last checkpoint touched and you can continue your adventure without losing progress. Do not let your lives reach zero though! Power-ups: Shadow Touched features power-ups that enhance the player's gameplay. Double jump : Allows Twilight to jump an additional time. Light Shard : Grants a 1-up. Darkness Dispersal : Removes a percentage of darkness. The higher the current darkness, the more it removes. Jump Impulse : Shoots Twilight vertically. Speed Boost : Grants increased movement speed for a short duration. Dashify : Allows Twilight to dash an additional time (has no effect in shadow form). Note: Shadow Touched is an ongoing project, and I am committed to expanding and enhancing the game based on player feedback and evolving ideas. Join me on this journey as we shape the destiny of Twilight and explore the boundless possibilities of the shadow dimension. Controls Move with WASD or Arrow keys. Jump with Space. Interrupt jumps with S or down arrow key. Holding the button will make the character drop down faster. Attack with C or Left mouse button. Shift between dimensions with F.

rows.short_description: 1959 - Olimpia, South Italy. Play as Giove Scadenza and save your fiancée from the Inferna mafia with your newfound powers. Can you survive the Folgore ?
rows.description_html: what Is Folgore Folgore is a top view fighting game, inspired by comics, taking place in south Italy at the end of the 60’s. To save his fiancée and his honor, the hero must cross the city of Olimpia, inspired by Naples, and eliminate all types of enemies on his way to the final boss. To do that, he makes a pact with the Folgore, a divine artifact endowed with electrical powers from Jupiter, but renowned to be dangerous for its owner . With the Folgore, the player can attack by combining melee attacks and electrical powers. He can also interact with his environment to stun his enemies and continue the level. During some scenarized moments, an ultimate power called the overload activates to remind the instability of the Folgore and make the player experience even more pleasurable. The goal in Folgore is to let off steam while playing an original game full of dark humor. The player needs to feel the strength of his powers, but also the shift of the “hero” to the dark side. To treat this subject correctly, we took a lot of inspiration from dark comics like Batman, we decided to combine 2D and 3D to accentuate this. To understand the genesis of Folgore, look at a comic book. But instead of reading it, you are going to play it. In Folgore, we wanted a strong identity : the temporality of the game is unique, blending the Italian 50’s and Roman mythology, which allowed us a lot of liberty, especially for the creation of enemies. The dark comics aesthetic and humor of the game remind the player of the anti-hero personality of the playable character, but also the grim after-war period in Italy. For the gameplay, we came back to the basics : not a lot of inputs and a gameplay easy to learn that needs to be mastered to be effective. The originality resides in the electrical powers that Giove got from the Folgore : It allows him to interact with his environment and perform faster and more powerful attacks and movements, while getting the player to manage his power gauge to survive the enemies' waves. Finally, even if it's better to play the game with a controller, we chose to adapt the game for arcades to remember the feeling of an old school beat them all. rows.name: Space Hat
rows.short_description: Space Hat is an adrenaline-fueled, fast-paced FPS game that combines intense combat with well thought out platforming sequences. In this futuristic sci-fi world, the player assumes the role of a cyber bounty hunter equipped with a special hat that grants the power of teleportation.
rows.description_html: Space Hat is a Fast FPS Platformer, set in a futuristic Sci-Fi world where you play as Vega, a space bounty hunter hired by an organization to execute a contract. She's one of the most experienced and deadliest mercenary in the galaxy. Better known by the name ''Space Hat'', her mission is to dismantle a space cartel that has become too powerful. Vega has a range of different moves and attacks including jumps, dash, slides, two fire modes and a powerful punch. The core of the game is about mixing differents combat or parkour moves with her teleporting Hat. The game has parkour phases, asking for dexterity and combat arena phases in which the player have to eliminate all the enemies. The player's goal is to master the various mechanics to finish the levels as quickly as possible. Embark on 2 adrenaline-packed levels that offer a unique solo experience : Fast and bloody combats and precise platform phases. Execute the target and remember the clock is ticking. Kill ennemies with style Teleport everywhere Move at lightspeed Set the best time

rows.name: Animal Tracker
rows.short_description: Explore a fantastical island where fantastical new creatures await! Run, jump, and glide your way to discover new animals to photograph and become the next great Emergent Organism Researcher in this single-player island exploration game! What surprises await you on the island?
rows.description_html: Explore the newly discovered island of Anakalys where new species of creatures, called Emergent Organisms, now roam freely! The island awaits! An open-world island Welcome to Anakalys , an island seemingly born from the mists! You play as the Rookie Resarcher, a newbie looking to make their name as a researcher in the modern age of exploration. Dr. Cooper, a legend-turned-hermit researcher, discovered this mysterious island, and he wants YOU to research its inhabitants! In this single-player open-world exploration game, you'll journey the island yourself! Anakalys is home to a vibrant jungle environment, the perfect home for an exceptionally cute selection of animals to roam about. Additionally, Anakalysis is home to a unique phenomena of floating chunks of land, which may lead you to new places... Meet the residents On the island, you'll be tasked with photographing the EO's with your trusty camera! Take photos of the organisms doing their day-to-day routines such as eating, bathing, and socializing! Completing specific objectives will reward you with some money, which can be used to purchase player equipment! Additionally, the EO's will leave a number of valuable pick-up items around the island to help speed up your equipment funding. With equipment, you'll find that exploring the island will be a breeze! Get equipped There are multiple upgrades available to help you maneuver around the island. With enough objectives completed, no place will be unreachable for the stalwart Rookie Researcher! For example, double-jump boots will definitely get you over some of those pesky floating platforms! Remember: it's not science if you don't write it down Additionally, completing objectives will help fill out your research database, powered by the Advanced Data Terminal (aka the A.D.T)! Each step gets you closer to fully uncovering the mysterious life on the island, with three unique EO's to become acquainted with. What are ya waitin' for? Get to explorin'!

rows.name: The Circle Tales: Elvenwoods
rows.short_description: The Circle Tales: Elvenwoods is a free-to-play action-adventure game where you embark on a journey to slay a god. The very first game by Studio Castor, set in a medieval high fantasy open world.
rows.description_html: Elvenwoods is a story-driven action-adventure game, and the first instalment of the Dark Aeon saga. It is an experimental project made to learn game development, and is now available for everyone on Steam. It will therefore remain completely free. In the beginning, there was a Source. This Source was the origin of every universe, and the only thing that prevented time and space to collapse. In the year 5000 of the Creation Era, the high priest of the Dead God Tarisdum destroyed the Source, starting a ten-thousand-year prophecy. Its first events take place in Vàlochlin, a young world built by the Warlord Dusnol to hide the skull of the Dead God. You are Imriel of Darkwood, Green Spirit of the Circle, an elf who dreams of exploring the world. After arriving in the Elvenwoods, you begin a quest to slay a resurrected Tarisdum, and to uncover the mystery of the Three Enemies. The beginning of a saga A 10-hour long, fully voiced story. Elvenwoods is a story-driven game, based on a main questline and seven factions. Epic battles A dynamic sword, bow, and magic combat system. 18 unique boss battles await the players, as well as a trials mode for those who seek a true challenge. A vast open world The world of Elvenwoods expands on three different maps and more than a hundred locations to explore. Players can travel by foot, on a mount, on a boat, or even by flying.

rows.name: Autotag
rows.short_description: Battle your friends in this cozy cartoon multiplayer car shooter! Get unique physics based weapons to destroy your friends and customise your car to suit your style! Get tagging and bagging them kills today!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Autotag the online gaming experience that combines the thrill of classic tag with an arsenal of powerful weapons for an intense and action-packed competition! In this adrenaline-fueled destructible arena, players will engage in heart-pounding matches where the goal is not only to avoid being tagged but to defend yourself using a variety of unique weapons. Physics Based Weapons All weapons in Autotag are physics based to make gameplay a little bit more fun and less predictable. That also means players can be thrown into a roll after being hit with a cannon ball, or thrown into a tree by an tank turret round. If projectiles aren't your thing then the flamethrower might be a good weapon to pickup. Boosts to Tag & Escape Boosting into another player is an instant kill and the best way to earn XP! So make sure you master the art of traveling fast without flying off into the sea. Remember cars can't swim! Moveable Objects & Breakables All objects are loose and physics based to act as an obstacle to get in players way when on the move to tag you. Helping you to escape with a chair might just win you the game. Key Features Online Multiplayer Battles Physics Based Weapons Multiple Game Modes (Battle, Autotag)...more to come Quick Match Restarts Server Hosting Features Planned Battle Royal Mode Weapon Racing Multiple Maps Weapon Ranks More Weapons More Car Models Much Much More... Thank you for taking the time to read the games description, feel free to head back up and hit that Wishlist or join the discord for more information.

rows.name: Project Entropy
rows.short_description: Welcome, commander, to Project Entropy- an ultimate Sci-Fi and role-playing game with battles in space. In this immersive MMO experience, you will command alien civilizations, conquer uncharted planets, and build Hero fleets.
rows.description_html: Welcome, commander, to Project Entropy - the ultimate Sci-Fi and role-playing game with space battles. Immerse yourself in this MMO experience where you'll command alien civilizations, conquer uncharted planets, and build Hero fleets. Command Alien Civilizations: Take control of alien civilizations and lead them to victory. Each civilization comes with its unique abilities, technologies, and units, providing diverse gameplay experiences. Conquer Uncharted Planets: Embark on an adventure across the cosmos and conquer uncharted planets. Explore unknown territories, engage in epic battles, and expand your empire to dominate the galaxy. Build Hero Fleets: Assemble powerful fleets of hero ships, each with its special abilities and attributes. Customize your fleets to suit your playstyle and lead them to victory against formidable foes. Customize Mechs and Weapons: Modify and upgrade your mechs and high-tech weapons to enhance their capabilities on the battlefield. Experiment with different combinations to create the ultimate war machines. Engage in Intense PvP and PvE Battles: Challenge other players in intense PvP battles or team up with friends to take on challenging PvE encounters. Test your skills, strategy, and teamwork to emerge victorious in battle. Explore Vast Maps: Discover vast and diverse maps filled with unique challenges, resources, and secrets. Uncover the mysteries of the universe as you journey through space and conquer new territories. Join a Global Community: Connect with players from around the world, form alliances, and compete in epic interstellar conflicts. Forge friendships, share strategies, and rise to become a legend in the galaxy. Season-Based Gameplay: Experience dynamic gameplay with seasonal updates that introduce new planets, challenges, and rewards. Stay engaged with fresh content and compete for dominance in the ever-changing universe. Epic Storyline: Immerse yourself in an epic storyline filled with intrigue, betrayal, and discovery. Unravel the mysteries of the universe and shape the fate of civilizations as you embark on a thrilling adventure. Stunning Visuals and Sound: Enjoy stunning graphics and immersive sound effects that bring the universe of Project Entropy to life. Immerse yourself in the beauty and chaos of space battles like never before. Embark on an epic journey across the stars and become the ultimate commander in Project Entropy. Download now and join the battle for galactic supremacy!

rows.short_description: An exploration-type action game in which 'Fluffy Girl Doge' is the main character. Get the skills of 'Doge' and explore the unknown ancient ruins.
rows.description_html: An exploration-type action game in which 'Fluffy Girl Doge' is the main character. Get the skills of 'Doge' and explore the unknown ancient ruins. Game Features Simple 2D action that can be played easily! Explore the intricate ruins to obtain new skills! Collect 70 different treasure items! Collect crystals to enhance your status! There are more than 70 areas to explore and more than 7 types of boss enemies! High difficulty challenge mode that opens up after clearing the game! Interesting friends to support Doge's adventure! rows.name: Welcome to Ukraine
rows.short_description: I've come to the realization that there's so much about my own country that I don't know. In light of this, I've developed a game to share my journey of discovering Ukraine. Through this interactive experience, I hope to offer insights into the rich culture, history, and beauty of our country.
rows.description_html: I've come to the realization that there's so much about my own country that I don't know. In light of this, I've developed a game to share my journey of discovering Ukraine. It's Jigsaws with lot of useful features. Through this interactive experience, I hope to offer insights into the rich culture, history, and beauty of our country. I hope it will be interesting not only for jigsaw puzzle lovers;) I want to keep this game free and I will update it from time to time with new pictures and features Multiple puzzle pieces selection 3 different Cutouts shapes Rotation and Sorting features Useful Zoom and Magnifier tool Customizable background color Wide cutout range I used CC0, self generated content or pictures I have permission from the author. I will try to deal with local photographers to provide more quality pictures and facts of my country. Also, you can check my other puzzle game (which uses the same engine) Master of Pieces - Jigsaw Puzzles! Enjoy game and share your thoughts! Peace!

rows.name: Bodyrain
rows.short_description: Slaughter hordes of zombies and challenging bosses in Bodyrain: a zombie FPS game! Accumulate money to acquire new weapons and gain experience to strengthen your character and clean up Dawn City!
rows.description_html: - Fast paced and precise shooting mechanics - A wide variety of weapons and grenades to use against the hordes - Many different types of zombies, each with different attacks and strategies - 5 unique bosses to fight and beat the game - The ability to level up your character and improve its attributes - An infinite game mode on a special map - Stunning stylized graphics and effects - A dynamic soundtrack to slaughter zombies Dawn City, once a bustling urban center, found itself suddenly plunged into darkness on a stormy September night. A disastrous scientific experiment resulted in the leakage of an experimental substance, turning the inhabitants into insatiable zombies. To contain the threat, authorities imposed an impenetrable quarantine, isolating a portion the city from the rest of the world. Years passed, and Dawn City became a field of ruins. Gangs of survivors fought over scarce resources, while zombies ruled the dark, empty streets. Amidst this chaos, an unlikely hero emerged: a zombie hunter known as 'Raven.' Clad only in makeshift armor and armed to the teeth, established an outpost on the outskirts of the city called Refuge of Hope. There, the fearless could accept missions to eradicate the undead in exchange for rewards. Players, assuming the role of bounty hunters, ventured into the Urban Ruins in search of challenges. The locations were eerily familiar but now dominated by abandonment and despair. Once bustling streets were now dangerous, and once imposing buildings had become infested fortresses. The goal is to completely eradicate all zombies from the quarantine and rebuild the city, with 5 of them being very difficult bosses to defeat, requiring the player to save money to improve their weapons and attributes to stand a chance against them.

rows.name: Karga
rows.short_description: In the game 'Karga,' players become hero defenders aided by a dragon to battle the witch Hag and her dark army. Armed with elemental revolvers and special skills, they combat various foes. The hero's abilities and weapons strengthen with each battle.
rows.description_html: In the virtual game 'Karga,' the player assume the role of a hero defender who joins forces with a mighty dragon to confront the sinister witch Hag and her army of darkness. Armed with a pair of revolvers loaded with bullets imbued with the elements of fire and ice, the hero gallantly enters the battlefield. These potent revolvers are not the only weapons in the hero's arsenal; he also possesses special skills that assist him in combating countless hordes of skeletons, giant spiders, and ghostly creatures sent by the Witch to impede her. With each battle, the hero's skills improve, and his weapons and abilities grow in strength. The game features a brief storyline that unravels the motives behind the Witch's desire to seize the dragon's gold. Additionally, a survival mode offers players the opportunity to fend off endless waves of adversaries, determining the ultimate defender.

rows.name: Cardboard Chronicles
rows.short_description: Welcome to Doodleburg! You play Doodle, a child who has been transported into a cardboard world of their own creation. Not all is well in the Burg of Doodle. An ancient, extradimensional evil has awoken and it's up to you to save this idyllic town from its ravenous rampage.
rows.description_html: A puzzle adventure game all about thinking inside the box. In a world made entirely of cardboard and doodles, you are the one who created it all. A child with nothing else to play with but some boxes and crayons gets spirited away into their imaginary world and becomes a doodle themselves! Smash and fling your way through puzzles as you help the strange characters you meet on the way to freeing yourself in Cardboard Chronicles! Take control of Doodle to interact with eccentric NPCs, solves simple, yet engaging puzzles, use your slam abilities to smack enemies and objects, and defend Doodleburg from an encroaching evil that threatens to destroy your cardboard world.

rows.name: Caden's Climb
rows.short_description: A fast-paced 2D platformer inspired by a whole buncha stuff!
rows.description_html: Caden's Climb is a fast-paced platformer inspired by Pizza Tower & the WarioLand series (emphasis on 'inspired by Pizza Tower') where you play as Caden Climb, the indie developer on a quest to stop the CEO of Super Silly Softwares, Christopher Manman, from absolutely destroying your game company while making sure to rescue all 5 smalls from each level (and collecting the Dodecahedron!) In Caden's Climb, you can expect a variety of ways to play such as, Classic: Maneuver your way through a level, slam the button and run to your nearest exit! Try go as fast as you can and get the best rank possible! If the stability of the realm falls apart however. Blacko WILL stop you. Race: Race against your friend, and pastaria owner, Caden Smalls! Deathrun: Battle against time, in an ultimate race to the exit. Collect clocks to increase your timer, but beware. If the timer runs out, it won't look so hot on your ranking. Boss: Fight one of Christopher Manman's best minions! Kill them! (that last part is really up to you.) Wyatt's Levels: Dive through a giant conglomerate of the current world's levels but be warned. The pirate always prevails, and you certainly don't understand what you're dealing with.

rows.name: League of Masters: Auto Chess
rows.short_description: League of Masters is a new take on the Auto Chess genre. Our game is a dynamic PvP experience with a deep progression system. Challenge friends and foes in an epic battle of wits that will determine who the true strategist is.
rows.description_html: League of Masters is the next generation of PvP! We've combined elements of Auto Chess and RPG to create a strategic game with a deep progression system. Every player has a chance to win, but the higher your tactical preparation, the greater your chances of success! Showcase your intellect and claim victory! Unlike traditional Auto Chess games, success also depends on the power of your commanders, but they won't succeed without your smart and tactical approach. Join the League of Masters community now and help your commanders secure victory! Prove your worth in PVP battles In PvP battles, you'll fight against players from around the world. Everything will come into play: cunning, tactics, strategic maneuvers, and even psychological attacks. And most importantly, you can conduct a battle and defeat the enemy in just 15 minutes. Specially designed graphics for the genre will finally help distinguish units from each other. We've put in the effort! Level up your commanders and dominate In League of Masters, there are a whopping 12 unique commanders! Each has its own abilities that increase damage and enhance tactics. Even if your opponents lack experience and skills, their commanders can be much stronger than yours, so you always need to be on guard and adjust your strategy as the battle unfolds. Choose fighters wisely Demon or genie? Mage or archer? The game features over 50 units of different classes and synergies for both PvP and PvE battles. Just look at how powerful they are! Assemble an unbeatable team and test different strategies to find the perfect one. Crafted by strategists for strategists Our team consists almost entirely of players with 20 years of experience, who prioritize skill and knowledge over grind and unfair play. League of Masters is pure strategy, endless possibilities, and fair competition.

rows.name: The Crack (壳中之物）
rows.short_description: Crack is a text adventure game that combines a profound emotional experience with elements of mystery and puzzle-solving. In this game, players embark on a journey to revisit the past, explore themselves, and uncover hidden secrets.
rows.description_html: Are you still contacting your friends from school? Do you still remember the love from the youth? And even more, do you still have the dream that keeps your heart beating? You’ve been trained to have a heart covered by unbreakable shell. In this game, you are going through a journey to crack it, leading to the long forgotten. Who is murmuring in the dark? Who is screaming for help through the crack? Happiness and torture, past and current, drop by drop, are all there to be collected, by you. When it is finally at your fingertip, will you become a warrior, a deserter, or, a murderer? Humbly offered by SMS Studio, a journey of Crack. Key Features Rigorous Original Plot: A tightly woven narrative intertwining reasoning with flashbacks and dialogues, progressively deepening and leading players to understand the stories of each character from various perspectives while solving puzzles. Rich Story Choices: Diverse story directions and endings, where each choice can lead to unexpected consequences. Mystery Puzzle Elements: Combining traditional text-based gameplay with modern mystery elements, offering players an experience that is both familiar and novel. Exquisite Visual Style: Beautifully designed scenes and character art, immersing players as if they were in the midst of the story, having face-to-face conversations with the characters. Beautiful Original Music: A rich collection of original background music, enhancing the immersive experience of solving mysteries. Settings: Use settings to switch to Chinese and English

rows.name: Screamboat Willie
rows.short_description: Do you LOVE Steamboat Willie? Great! He's in this game! Do you HATE Steamboat Willie? great! He's gross and scary and you are trying to dodge him and ultimately get away from him! So basically no matter what this game is for you!
rows.description_html: After awaking upon the steam boat of the famous, Steamboat Willie, The player is tasked with escaping by any means necessary. A task easier said than done as Willie, who was locked up for nearly 100 years, roams about the boat relentlessly hunting the player. But don't worry, you're not completely alone. There is a stranger communicating from the other side of a radio, with his help, you should have everything you need to avoid Willie, solve puzzles, and ultimately escape. Key features: Willie will hunt you. Maybe Willie got good grades in highschool, or just listened closely to his “Hunting people 101” class, either way he’ll be constantly on your heels. Ensuring that you never feel quite safe while navigating the steamboat. Willie is also a great listener! Which is great when you need someone to talk to, but not so great when Willie is hunting you with what are probably nefarious motives. Be careful what items you interact with, you’ll never know if Willie is listening or from how far. Puzzles that will “tickle” your brain. Throughout Willie’s steamboat, there will be various problems which will need fixing if you’re to escape. Different “technically unique” puzzle designs will have you wondering how to go about one as opposed to the others. But don’t fret too much. We will have hints, but those are for babies… You wouldn’t happen to be a baby, would you? Puzzles will affect the map, sometimes helping you, and other times hindering you. Multiple endings. You just might escape and everything might turn out peachy… Or you might not and Willie might have a better life. Who knows? Well, I guess I technically know because I made it… But you can know if you play it, and that’s pretty cool. Some endings are because you were smart. Others because you didn’t quite fit that definition. Appreciation levels if you play our game: 11/10 Your rating and various rating related websites: GOAT/10

Key Features: - Talk to a rock. - Multiple Choices - No goals other than the pursuit of good conversation. - Funny. He thought that since this game did well on YouTube one time that he may as well experiment with putting it up on Steam. 🤪 His other game, Moving Jigsaw Puzzles is available on Steam and is also very fun.

Luckily, a magical pixie comes to Tabbie's aid and grants her the power WHACK THE SH⭐️T out of anyone in her way!   While her tiny handler expects her to use her new powers for good, this magical girl has other plans in mind: ⭐️ REVENGE!!! ⭐️  ********************************************************************************* This Magical Girl is a B⭐️tch is a comedic visual novel inspired by magical girl staples such as Shugo Chara and Card Captor Sakura.         ⭐️ UNCONVENTIONAL MAGICAL GIRL: Tabbie Bones' magical misadventures thus far, detailed in 24k words, 15 CGs, and 2 animated transformation sequences (~3 hours of playtime) ⭐️ FULLY VOICED CAST: Every student and faculty member of Middling Middle School has a voice (and they're going to use it!) ⭐️ BRANCHING CHOICES, STICKER ACHIEVEMENTS, SECRET ENDINGS: Actions have consequences...especially when you're a magical girl! ⭐️ EXPRESSIVE CHARACTER SPRITES: 200+ hand-drawn expressions and poses meticulously coded to dance across the screen at your command. ⭐️ ORIGINAL EARWORMS: Catchy original soundtrack to accompany Tabbie's saddest, maddest, and baddest moments. *Full game statistics will be available at launch                      ⭐ VOICE TALENT ⭐️ Abby Pasion as Tabbie Noah Belachew as Eden Victor Melin as Calem and Tonathan Jacob 'Zombie_J' Mira as Mr. Teacher and Mr. Monster Taylor Fernandez as Strength and Clown Robin van der Niet as Love Ali Gohar as Magician Nyima Green as Stu Eden Solomon as Den Corey LeVier as PA Guy and Sad PA Guy Joyce Liu as Corpse Shelley Hunter as Doll and ???

rows.name: Ocean World: Eden Crafters Prologue
rows.short_description: Embark on a journey of survival, crafting, and automation in this free prologue introducing one of the planets you can transform in Eden Crafters – an upcoming open-world game that challenges you, alone or with friends, to turn a hostile planet into a habitable haven for humanity.
rows.description_html: Ocean World is a free Prologue introducing one of the planets that you can transform in the full game 'Eden Crafters', now available ! You located a planet where your scanners detected a lot of water, it should be easy to turn it into a habitable haven for humanity. Gather materials, craft essential tools, and lay the foundation for a thriving civilization. Except... maybe there is too much water on this planet? Ocean World presents a unique challenge: giant waves caused by a nearby moon. Automate resource gathering and transformation with conveyors and machines, from elaborate factories to environmental transformation systems. Temper the climate, create a breathable atmosphere... and survive the giant wave incoming. This free episode offers a glimpse into the vast potential of Eden Crafters, providing a taste of the adventures that await in the full co-op, open-world survival and crafting experience. Take the first steps toward transforming a hostile planet into a flourishing Eden, where crafting and automation are the keys to success. FEATURES Open World Co-Op Crafting Factory Building Terraformation Vehicles

rows.name: Sovereign Elect
rows.short_description: Grow and lead a party of followers to support your quest for the throne. Explore this fantasy land with voiced dialogue and real time choices that can effect other players. This game takes heavy inspiration from Bee Swarm Simulator with an emphasis on combat.
rows.description_html: Sovereign Elect is a game centered around accumulating influence. Your ultimate goal is to become the sovereign of the land. To do this, you must gain influence, which is primarily done through mercenaries you hire. Mercenaries come in different rarities. They each have different stats and abilities which effect your methods of obtaining merit. Once merit is obtained, it can be converted into influence by your mercenaries. You will obtain contracts that you can use to hire new mercenaries. Your group will start off small, but given time, you can reach up to a total of 40 mercenaries. You cannot become king if you do not have a band of loyal followers. Activities are represented by small icons the player can interact with. If they are related to merit, your mercenaries will interact with them automatically. This also includes enemies, which will target you if no mercenaries are present to defend you. Activities that give merit come in 4 varieties: Strength, Dexterity, Charisma, and Wisdom. These correlate with attributes your mercenaries have, which are represented by the color on their glove. Certain abilities your mercenaries have may also behave differently depending on the attribute/color they associate with. With this in mind, the type of mercenaries you decide to have matters.

rows.name: Region: Gear D
rows.short_description: Embark on an immersive VR FPS adventure! Customize your guns and outsmart AI foes in exhilarating PVE combat. Get ready for a unique strategic shooting experience, coming soon to Steam. Your ultimate VR battleground awaits – don't miss out!
rows.description_html: Step into the immersive world of 'Region：Gear D', a groundbreaking virtual reality PVE FPS that revolutionizes the way you engage with virtual combat.'Region：Gear D' offers an unparalleled level of customization and weapon interactivity, promising to deliver a thrilling and realistic experience to FPS enthusiasts and VR adventurers alike. In 'Region：Gear D', creativity is your deadliest weapon. The game's innovative gun assembly mechanic allows you to build and modify your firearms from a vast array of components—making each weapon a unique creation tailored to your playstyle. Whether you prefer the pinpoint precision of a custom sniper rifle or the rapid-fire chaos of a personalized submachine gun, the power to craft your ideal arsenal is at your fingertips. Beyond the workbench, 'Region：Gear D' features a variety of challenging environments where your creations will be put to the test. rows.name: Hunter Beat
rows.short_description: Description: Hunter Beat is an exhilarating virtual reality game designed specifically for people who want to escape from everyday worries, shift to positive emotions, and enhance their concentration.
rows.description_html: Description: Hunter Beat is an exhilarating virtual reality game designed specifically for people who want to escape from everyday worries, shift to positive emotions, and enhance their concentration. Participants immerse themselves in the game, where they shoot at dynamic 'targets' and score points. The success of the gameplay depends on several factors: accuracy, agility, reaction speed, sense of rhythm, and the ability to see more broadly, not just in front of oneself. Hunter Beat features a variety of engaging levels with different levels of difficulty. The game offers a wide selection of music tracks, which also influence the pace of gameplay. Hitting the target in rhythm/beat allows the player to earn additional points. Key features of the game include: Dynamic tasks that require quick reaction and precise movements. It enhances attention concentration. Shooting with both hands contributes to reloading. Levels of varying difficulty that present challenges for new achievements and stimulate the player's attentiveness. Universality - suitable for adults and children alike. Hunter Beat is the perfect way to escape from the gray routine, engage in something exciting, and at the same time, develop attentiveness and improve emotional state in a gaming format. In Hunter Beat, players encounter arcade-style action elements, the main one being shooting cartoon ducks. On a successful hit, the ducks explode, displaying exaggerated animation effects, including the appearance of exaggerated bones and cartoon-style blood. These scenes are intended for comic effect and are designed to be non-realistic. They are not intended to suppress or glorify military force or brutality. However, we understand that this stylistic approach may be taken in different ways, and we caution that some of the participants in the response scenes may be conspicuous or unexpected.

rows.short_description: 'Enthralled' is a short game about a man possessed by a demon. It takes place in a desolate world where you balance between looking for a way out, stopping the demon from killing innocent people, and not being completely devoured yourself. Explore the world and find a way to deal with your curse.
rows.description_html: Possessed by a demon a long time ago, you have limited control over your actions and your faith. Enthralled is a short game best described as a walking simulator with some combat and puzzle elements, focused on the atmosphere and world exploration.

rows.name: Spiderbro 2
rows.short_description: Help Shadowbro overcome a computer worm come to life and save the multiverse from colliding! Collect items, talk to employees, solve puzzles and explore the secrets of a company that caused everything to happen!
rows.description_html: Spiderbro 2 is a retro inspired adventure puzzle game for Windows and Linux. You play as Shadowbro, a spider that has to save the multiverse from the antics of a real life computer worm! EXPLORE, COLLECT ITEMS, SOLVE PUZZLES! Make your way deeper into the company building by exploring the environment and collecting items for your pockets! Use your pocket items on world objects, give them to NPCs or merge them with one another to solve puzzles! THE IN-GAME PCs ARE BACK WITH AN UPGRADE! Use the in-game PCs and check for further clues! Text logs with clues and backstory can be found on PCs found throughout the game! Take a trip to PC-SPACE, a company exclusive VR service that takes using a PC to new depths! A WORM IS LOOSE! THE MULTIVERSE IS COLLIDING! A computer worm gone wild has broken into the real world! More cracks and holes to new universes have appeared! In Spiderbro 2 you should expect the unexpected as you overcome the worm whilst travelling between different universes! DISCOVER COMPANY SECRETS! Go deeper into the company building and find out what triggered the events of Spiderbro! Each new department will unravel more secrets! NO NEED TO PLAY THE PREQUEL! Players need not play the first Spiderbro! Spiderbro 2 expands upon the first game in a way that does not require the player to complete it! Spiderbro 2 also contains a copy of the first game, within the game! YOU WILL DIE! Be warned that this world is not safe! Make frequent use of savepoints to prevent losing progress! EVEN MORE! Cloud saves 34 Achievements New game plus mode Two possible conclusions Built in Cheat Sheet with all puzzle solutions CONTROLS Arrow Keys / WASD - Movement SPACE / ENTER - Interact P / E - Open Pockets ESC - Back / Pause

rows.description_html: Experience the action-packed story of Circuit Thunder®. Circuit Thunder® is a 2D-platformer, action-adventure RPG where you follow the legendary Electrex Bolt® and master electrifying abilities of light, ultimately harnessing lightning as your weapon. Traverse through novel lands, battle mysterious enemies, and strategically learn new defensive and offensive abilities.  Begin your journey with the first book, Circuit Thunder®: Hypcampex®   BOOK I : HYPCAMPEX® Set within Planet Photonus, you will embark on a journey as the legendary Electrex Bolt® to acquire the artifact of the Hypcampex® and stop the Avengers of Light, the Lavengers, from destroying the planet. With vibrant environments, pestering enemies, and innovative maps, you will be able to put your skills to the test and brave the war against the Lavengers. Will Electrex Bolt® succeed?  SAVE PLANET PHOTONUS FROM ANARCHY Destroy the drone waves deployed by the Lavengers and best their tactics. The trials and puzzles that lie ahead will not be easy feats. It will take the most omnipotent of prowess. FIGHT THROUGH SPACE Battle through space on the BOLT Voyager V3 and show the Lavengers that Electrex Bolt® is the best pilot within the galaxy. MASTER THE LIGHT Does Electrex Bolt® have what it takes to master the light and revive those whom he has lost?

rows.name: In a Detective's Mind
rows.short_description: In a Detective's Mind is an investigation game that seeks to put you in the role of a detective, who needs to solve cases and deal with obscure problems from his past.
rows.description_html: In a Detective's Mind is a short game made by two people, where you will play as Andrew, a detective who is learning to deal with the problems of his past. You will have to solve two cases, where you will receive very few details about what happened. The objective is for you to be able to put together in your head what happened in the place, with as little detail as possible, so it will be important that you explore and make deductions, so that you can solve the cases and puzzles in the game. Build your destiny Being a detective is not an easy task. With each new case you decide to investigate, new people have their fates sealed in your hands. One word, one wrong accusation can mean the end of an innocent life. In a Detective's Mind proposes an experience where your decisions matter, changing not only the destiny of the people around you, but yours as well. Having 3 different endings , In a Detective's Mind takes you on a journey of no return.

rows.name: Evostrike
rows.short_description: A Roguelike tactics game where you fight hordes of aliens. Your Units evolve and learn new skills as the fight goes on. Manage your squad of 5 specialised mercenaries, and fight a never ending war against the infestation.
rows.description_html: Story Drifting along the edge of humanity's galaxy, your ship comes across an unknown threat. An entire sector infested with hostile creatures. It is your objective to engage these beings, eradicate as many of them as possible, and gather data for your home sector. Evolve Your ship contains a small group of mercenaries which can evolve and improve their equipment and skills. Choose from 4 different evolution paths each with unique strengths and skills. Evolve your squad of 5 Evo-Mercs, choosing from the 12 different evolutions available. Mastery While your Evo-Mercs are fighting in their current evolution, they will gain mastery over their role. Each evolution has 3 mastery steps, granting them increasing buffs. These buffs persist even after changing evolutions, and their effects stack. Combine the 39 Masteries together with the 12 evolutions to create powerful combos. Stack the mastery of damage to allow the Sniper-Evo to punch through armor. Stack magazine efficiency to the point where the single shot Mortar-Evo becomes a twin barreled beast. Many more combos are there to find. Events Along your journey through the infested sector your ship and crew will come across different events. Be it a desire for more unstable mutations, or just simply broken parts in the med-bay. Choose how you react and live with the consequences. Choose your Route You'll be able to choose your own missions as you approach the heart of the infestation. Multiple paths will open up; some are harder but grant better rewards. The further you push on, the more advanced the alien threat will become. Engage the enemy Fight in missions against big alien armies. Analyze the map, make your plan and execute on it. Defend! Build defensive structure around your ship to protect it from the aliens. Survive the night! Nighttime is brutal, this is where the aliens hunts, they are faster stronger and more active. Survive the night and prepare for the daybreak. Use the advantage of the burning daylight to push ahead. Use airstrikes and aggressive maneuvers to take out the alien nests one by one. Attrition. Some fights are too hard to be won at first. but the aliens aren't endless... The longer we persist the less of them there are. Even if it looks hopeless at first, hold fast and endure. The aliens will tire, and our ship's supply generator will increase in power as it warms up. Elites As we reach the heart we will encounter the elites of the infestation. Bigger stronger and with the only goal to take out our ship. Destroy their vital parts one by one and stop them from reaching our ship. Meta-Tech Sooner or later we will fail. We are the Drifting-Edge, we're meant to be the scouts and first responders, we're not here to do this on our own. Once we die, our date gets sent back home, and with the data we collect we'll be able to research new constructs for our fellow Drifting-Edges. They'll charge in after we have perished, stronger and with more info.

rows.name: Vigor
rows.short_description: Outlive the apocalypse! Dive into intense Encounters and extract the most valuable spoils the Outlands have to offer! Loot, shoot, and build to become the absolute Outlander and explore the landscape of a post-war Norway in Vigor, a free-to-play looter shooter.
rows.description_html: Join the game that has been played by over 20 million players and explore the harsh and unforgiving Outlands, the shattered remains of what was once Norway. Utilize any means necessary to survive. Set in a post-apocalyptic atmosphere in the early 90s, the landscape of the Outlands is as deadly as it is beautiful, so be careful out there. Experience the thrills that Encounters have to offer, a high-stakes mode where survival is key. Extract the most valuable resources in order to build and upgrade your Shelter, or lose everything if you die! Choose over 60 different weapons and consumables to customize your loadout based on the play style of your choice - sneaky looter or deadly shooter. Change the pace of the Encounter and gain an advantage over your enemies by controlling tactical points on the map. Compete for Loot Events, special places that hold more valuable loot, and try to retrieve the Airdrop, the most precious haul in the Outlands. We dare you! Escape from specific exits at any time and avoid the deadly radiation cloud that sweeps over the map, killing everyone trapped inside it. Play alone in Shootout, a fast-paced deathmatch, or join a squad with your friends in Elimination, a 5v5 tactical, round-based teamfight. In Encounter, you can team up with a friend as a Duo, or compete as a Lone Wolf where the risk vs. reward factor is greater as you square off against other squads on your own! Identify as one of many groups of Outlanders that inhabit this broken world through various cosmetic sets. Choose between military, non-military and everything in between to instill fear in the hearts of your opponents. Your Shelter is your safe haven in the apocalypse and your central hub for information. By collecting resources from Encounters, you can build and upgrade your Shelter, which will, in turn, provide you with more options (craft better weapons and consumables, generate Crowns and other materials) that will be essential to your survival. Practice your marksmanship in the Shooting Range, craft your necessary equipment in the Armory, and customize your character from the wardrobe while you keep building your Shelter to maximize its potential.

rows.name: The Secret Weapon
rows.short_description: Get ready for endless laughs with The Secret Weapon - a wacky online card game that guarantees non-stop hilarity! Challenge friends, create insane combinations, and become the champion of absurdity!
rows.description_html: Feature List Unleash Your Inner Madness Dive into a world where creativity knows no bounds and embrace the insanity of The Secret Weapon . Laugh-Out-Loud Fun Prepare for endless laughter with friends as you compete to create the most ludicrous combinations in this hilarious card game. Randomized Mayhem Every game is a new adventure with randomly chosen phrases and unpredictable reactions, ensuring non-stop entertainment. Easy to Learn, Impossible to Master Simple gameplay mechanics make it accessible to all, but the limitless possibilities guarantee a fresh challenge every time. Over 70 Cards, 90+ Phrases Enjoy endless laughs with a wide variety of cards and phrases, ensuring each game of The Secret Weapon is a unique and hilarious experience. About the Game Dive into the madcap chaos of The Secret Weapon , a wild multiplayer online card game where insanity reigns supreme! Get ready to burst into fits of laughter as you challenge your friends in battles of absurd creativity! Start the game with 4 cards and plunge into unrestrained fun! Each turn, a master is randomly chosen and faces a daunting decision: selecting a phrase from a list of equally bizarre options! Other players must then tap into their twisted imaginations to choose the craziest card from their hand and react to the phrase chosen by the master . A point is awarded to the player who presents the most insane reaction! With a myriad of absurd cards and off-the-wall phrases, every game is a journey into pure absurdity! Prepare to lose your mind as you strive to accumulate points and become the ultimate king of madness in The Secret Weapon ! NOTE: The game must be played by at least 3 players in order to start a game.

rows.name: Cracking the Stone
rows.short_description: Enter the life of a boy experiencing tragedy for the first time, the burden of his parents’ hopes & dreams, and the struggle to let his emotions in. Deflect the negative emotions coming from outside forces while trying to juggle the ins and outs of childhood, puberty, and relationships.
rows.description_html: Cracking the Stone is an interactive comic about following the life of a boy who is learning what it's like to struggle with grief. As tragedy overwhelms the boy, take control of his early life and help him learn what it's like to follow his own path, all the while blocking out the negative emotions that fly toward him as a consequence of his journey through life. What is it like to juggle the complexities of childhood & adolescence with the struggle to keep one's emotions at bay and stave off existential dread and depression? Cracking the Stone aims to answer that question via an emotional journey through an interactive medium! Note: This free demo is an incomplete version of the story ends on a cliffhanger! It contains only portions of the first 2 of 5 planned chapters in the story.

rows.name: Kindred
rows.short_description: A physics-based 2D puzzle-platformer.
rows.description_html: In this touching story exploring the fragile bonds of brotherhood, you control a mysterious ghostly force. Use your powers of possession to manipulate objects and guide a curious young boy toward a discovery that will forever change his life. The choices you make will affect this boy's grieving mind, driving him to despair or providing closure. What sort of spirit will you be?

rows.name: Viking Rise
rows.short_description: Race against other players to explore Valhalla and conquer Midgard!
rows.description_html: Are you a fan of strategy games? As the Viking leader, how will you lead your Tribe to explore, plunder, and conquer the world of Midgard? Will you participate in the war games? Famous Heroes from Norse mythology and Viking history are ready to win wars with you. Strategize and use your wits to utilize the strengths of your Heroes! What enemies will you encounter in these war games? What friends will you make? Try your hand at [Viking Rise]! Valhalla is calling! [Viking Rise] is one of the best online multiplayer real-time war strategy games with epic world-building. You play as the leader of the Vikings, guiding your Tribe throughout Valhalla in the uncharted world of Midgard. Explore, plunder, develop, hunt, and fight your way across the land of Valhalla, filled with hidden dangers and opportunities. Lead your Viking Tribe to the top as you accrue massive wealth, fame, and power. Form an alliance with other players, protect one another from invasions, and defeat all enemies to conquer Midgard! Features ☆Audiovisual Masterpiece☆ Explore magnificent oceans and towering mountains, and experience realistic changes in the seasons. Delve deep into your Heroes' stories, set against the beauty of the vast Nordic landscape. Immerse yourself in the world of Midgard with a stunning original soundtrack composed by the renowned Mikolaj Stroinski. ☆Global Multi-Player Battles☆ Challenge players from around the world or fight alongside allies and prove you have what it takes to be a Viking leader. Choose strategy, diplomacy, or warfare as you stake your claim on Midgard and build your empire in Valhalla. ☆Design Your Territory☆ Expand your territory to support your growing Tribe. Conquer the lands of Valhalla, grow your population, and recruit talent to develop your land. Whether you decide to develop a commercial trading center, a land of rich resources, or a powerful military fortress, it's all within your control! Personalize your territory with a wide variety of Viking-style structures! ☆Naval Combat☆ Lead the Vikings across unknown waters to conquer new lands in Valhalla. Strategy is key! Use the sea to your advantage to carry out surprise attacks on the enemy and plunder their resources! Set sail for strategic territories, or use your ship to retreat from unfavorable situations and ambush your enemies from the sea. Come up with unique strategies by combining your navigational and naval combat skills in war! ☆Real-Time Combat☆ Fight your enemies in real-time on a massive world map. Find strength in numbers as you form alliances to crush the vast enemy forces. Whether on land or sea, survey your battlefields and give commands in real-time. Adjust your strategy to devastate your foes and become the strongest in Midgard. ☆Fight Alongside Viking Heroes☆ Summon legendary Viking Heroes to join you in war! Recruit Ragnar, Bjorn, Ival the Boneless, Snake-Eyed Sigurd, Harald Bluetooth, Rollo, Valkyrie, and other famous figures from Norse mythology. Build Valhalla, summon Heroes to fight for you, and become a true Viking ruler. ☆Tame the Ancient Dragon☆ Send your Heroes to hunt down mythical beasts, craft legendary equipment, explore mysterious ruins and caves, and discover hidden treasure. Tame the mighty dragon and obtain a powerful boost on the battlefield. Make a name for yourself and become one of Midgard's greatest legends!

rows.name: Deathless Death
rows.short_description: In the quiet of conscience and shadows of sin, four souls find themselves entwined in crimes involving a woman. In this narrative puzzle game, you don the sacred robe of a priest, hear the confessions of sinners, uncover secrets, seek the truth behind their crimes and deliver the final judgment.
rows.description_html: JOIN OUR DISCORD Feel free to join our official Discord to share your comments and ideas with us <3 About the Game Deathless Death is a narrative puzzle game featuring Psychological Thriller elements. In this story, you take on the role of a priest, entering a world filled with thoughts and illusions. Listen to the confessions of four sinners, uncover the secrets of their past, and unravel their fates intertwined by one woman. Story As the chimes strike the hour, you light the candles on the altar one by one. Upon lighting the fifth candle, drops of wax fall onto the pristine white altar. The flames flicker softly, awaiting the sinners to confess. The confessional door opens, then closes. Through the cross-shaped screen, you cannot see their faces clearly. Their words are laced with lies, self-embellishment, fear, and bravado, but you must peel away each layer. Only when the fog of words is cleared will the truth behind the reflections emerge. Soothe the restless souls, listen to the turmoil in their hearts, and extinguish the flames of their desires. This is your mission, and you are destined to reach the end. Gameplay 【Point&Click Puzzle】 By listening to confessions and capturing the imagery within their words, you can glimpse into the mental landscape of the confessors. 【Immersive Performance】 Emotions cling to objects, memories lie buried in the past, all waiting for your gaze. Immerse yourself in their chaotic thoughts—their lives and secrets are hidden within. Discern and uncover the mementos buried in their minds, and only then will they confess their sins. 【Moral Dilemma】 Will you redeem or condemn? Use your heart as the scale to weigh their sins and judge their fates. Their past cannot be rewritten, but they have entrusted you with their future. The confessors' fates may seem insignificant to you, but each decision you make shapes a new version of yourself. Game Features Unique art style and immersive interactive performances Innovative pop-up narrative with light puzzle-solving Morally challenging choices and a panoramic exploration of the human psyche About the Publisher GCORES PUBLISHING is an independent game publishing venture formed by GCORES, committed to bringing you more outstanding indie games from the BOOOM CHALLENGE. Feel free to follow our publisher webpage for future updates. About BOOOM BOOOM is an independent game brand by GCORES, The 'BOOOM CHALLENGE' is held twice a year, featuring three weeks of development time and a specific theme. After the development phase, an online trial play game festival is held for all players, and these games are showcased at GCORES' large offline video game festival.

rows.name: Preface: Undiscovered World
rows.short_description: Preface is an immersive tech demo showcasing Melba, PLAYERUNKNOWN Productions' groundbreaking technology generating an Earth-scale world. In this project still in development, experience our machine learning agents creating a planet in real-time, directly on your GPU.
rows.description_html: ROADMAP About the Game Preface: Undiscovered World - A Tech Demo from PLAYERUNKNOWN Productions Explore a World in the Making Preface is an immersive tech demo showcasing Melba, PLAYERUNKNOWN Productions' groundbreaking technology generating an Earth-scale world. In this project still in development, experience our Machine Learning agents creating a dynamic planet in real-time, all processed directly on your GPU - with no reliance on cloud services.   A Development Journey Join us on a journey into the future of world-building. Preface gives you the opportunity to explore a vast Earth-scale world spanning 510 million km² (200 million square miles) and be among the first to witness this new technology, as it takes shape. As we continue to build and refine Melba , your experiences and feedback will play a crucial role.   Your Feedback, Our Path Forward We believe in community-driven development. That's why we invite you to join us on Discord , where you can engage directly with our dev team, share ideas, provide feedback, and stay informed on the latest updates.   Preface is a tech demo - not a finished product. We’re in an ongoing development phase, so check back regularly to see new features and enhancements as we continue to push the boundaries of ML-driven world generation.

rows.name: IRREVERSIBLE
rows.short_description: Immerse yourself in a world where darkness comes to life, and monsters inhabit every corner. Your journey is a fight for survival in a forgotten village shrouded in a paranormal nightmare.
rows.description_html: Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of a unique psychological horror with shooter elements, unfolding in the expanse of an enthralling open world. A sinister village awaits you, shrouded in mysteries, populated by monsters, and filled with paranormal phenomena. In this grim place, you will meet its inhabitants, delve into their stories, and take part in saving them from the frightening fates that have befallen them. Features The game has a completely seamless open world, which is available immediately after a short introduction. To move around the world, you will have 3 types of transport at your disposal. Immersive gameplay. There is no order in the game. You yourself have the right to choose where to go and what to do. Quest system and storyline. By completing quests, solving puzzles and assigned tasks, you will get an interesting ending. Well-developed dialogues. The game has 40 pages of AI-generated text dialogue. All this is also voiced by AI in English. Good arsenal. To fight your enemies equally, you have 6 types of unique weapons at your disposal. However, you don’t have to use it; you can complete the game without firing a single shot. Interesting locations. Abandoned villas, mental hospitals, churches, cemeteries and settlements await you. Horror atmosphere. The game has an atmospheric soundtrack and also contains the main elements of the horror genre. You are not alone. Characters with quests, interesting dialogues and most importantly - support are scattered throughout the open world.

rows.name: Hare Trigger
rows.short_description: Play as a bunny with a gun in this fast-paced side-scrolling shooter. Your job? To destroy as many helicopters as you can.
rows.description_html: In a city shrouded in  darkness and consumed by helicopters , bunnies must band together to eliminate the critters swarming the skies... Rack up points, climb the leaderboard, and prove who’s the ultimate bunny hero in this fast-paced battle for survival and bragging rights! Hare Trigger is a side-scrolling action arcade shooter inspired by early 2000s Flash game classics like Heli Attack 2. Each time you hop in, you will play as one of the bunnies taking part in the fight against the helicopter swarm. Use precise movement, patience, and powerful weapons to eliminate as many helicopters as you can before the helicopters eliminate you .

rows.name: BioDive
rows.short_description: Led to a remote exoplanet by a distress signal, B3-4K discovers a laboratory under the surface of the planet. Push blocks, flip levers, and turn mirrors to solve puzzles and explore the mysteries of the laboratory.
rows.description_html: After picking up a strange distress signal on their ship’s comms, B3-4K, a pilot for an intergalactic shipping company, lands on the remote exoplanet of Suna. While investigating the planet’s surface, B3-4K discovers a laboratory under the surface of the planet itself. Using your puzzle-solving skills, you’ll play as B3-4K to navigate the winding hallways and many rooms of the laboratory and locate the source of the distress signal, learning about the laboratory’s history as you do. Who –or what– has been calling out into the cold vastness of space? And what could they want? Features: • Explore the underground laboratory of the remote exoplanet Suna • Push blocks, flip levers, and turn mirrors to solve puzzles in a top-down 2-D pixel art environment • Experience the story and look for clues • Investigate the hidden mysteries to uncover the truth • Enjoy the original art and music If you wish to play this on Mac please check out our website

rows.short_description: A game about pogoing up skyscrapers.
rows.description_html: A game about pogoing up skyscrapers. An important message is waiting for you at the top of the tallest building, but there may be even more climbing to do after that. There are 100 purple crystals scattered around the town and some are hiding in the most unsuspecting places. Available to play on both controller or keyboard/mouse.
