rows.name: SYNC
rows.short_description: Launch the SYNC protocol, where you are the ultimate weapon. Your job is to commandeer different robotic synth’s abilities in a high-octane, first-person frenzy. Master the art of SYNCing, and control the pace of battle.
rows.description_html: Launch the SYNC protocol, where you are the ultimate weapon! Leap from foe to foe, commandeering different robotic synth’s abilities in a high-octane, first-person frenzy. Each enemy, a new synth for you to possess; every ability, your arsenal. Master the art of possession, and flip the pace of battle in a blink. As a Divergent AI, you are the embodiment of the SYNC protocol, designed to infiltrate, outmaneuver, and outsmart within the confines of a mysterious lab. Your mission: to uncover the truth behind your creation and the purpose of the SYNC protocol itself. First Person Shooter Gameplay with SYNC: You have the power to SYNC! Charge this ability bar by eliminating enemies with your weapons and abilities of the host you currently have control over. If you begin to run low on ammo or abilities, use your charged SYNC bar by locking onto an enemy and SYNCing to them, granting you power over their weapons and abilities as well as restoring health! Master Different Loadouts: Every robot you see in the facility is something you can take over and use to your advantage. There are currently three different enemy types for you to take as your own. The STALKER has the ability to fly as well as a railgun and missiles. The GUNNER has a boost and an automatic weapon as well as a chain knife to shred through multiple enemies at once. Then the RUSHDOWN who is a brute with a shotgun, grappling hook, and a damaging shield. Know which ability is best for the situation you are in to clear the room of enemies. Uncover the truth behind SYNTELL: The narrative unfolds as you delve deeper into the labyrinthine facility, each level peeling back layers of the story. rows.name: Chocolate Factory Simulator: Prologue
rows.short_description: The Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game. Enter the world of steam and sugar and become a master chocolatier in Chocolate Factory Simulator: Prologue. Craft gourmet chocolate for your customers in your steampunk workshop with the help of Nougat.
rows.description_html: Chocolate Factory Simulator: Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game. Even automatons love chocolate in the world of Chocolate Factory Simulator: Prologue! Welcome to Chocolate Factory Simulator: Prologue, where cogwheels and steam work overtime to create the most delicious chocolate! Use your clockwork workshop full of gourmet machinery to create every kind of chocolate your customers could dream up! The world’s steampunk technology is perfect for sweet-making, and all available to you in your manufacture. Satisfy even the most particular customers. The world of Chocolate Factory Simulator: Prologue is full of different customers from different lands and altitudes, all gathering at your factory for one thing: their favorite chocolate. Take their orders and learn their preferences to win over loyal customers. Discover the colorful world outside of your workshop through their personalities. The art of chocolate. Create elaborate pralines using all the steam-and-cog-powered technology at your disposal in your workshop. Discover a variety of recipes and get creative with their presentation - change your chocolate’s shape, color, and even add some accessories to make it really stand out! Wrap it up in colorful packaging and voilà! You have created a box of beautiful chocolates! Recruit the your very own automaton! Juggling every order and whim of your customers would be a tough task on your own. That’s why you have Nougat! Nougat is your very own personal chocolate-making automaton. Give him tasks, modify him upgrade his capabilities and you will have the best chocolatier’s assistant that you could ever ask for!

rows.name: Squigley
rows.short_description: Traverse and experience a massive, cohesive 2D world as Squigley. Use your wits, resources and unique movement mechanics in order to explore this dark digital world.
rows.description_html: Traverse a massive 2D world and overcome nail-biting platforming challenges using unique movement mechanics and objects in this difficult indie experience. GET MOVING Traverse the world with a fluid and fun movement system unlike any you've ever seen before. In Squigley, you hold percise control over your movement, allowing for clutch saves and close calls. SPEND WISELY Be resourceful, as you must carefully use your coins to maintain your progress through checkpoints in the massive overworld. If you have some to spare, there are plenty of customization and upgrade options! CMD YOUR DESTINY Not a fan of the difficulty? The command terminal allows for easy skips, fun cheats, and other tools to enhance accessibility, so everyone can enjoy Squigley ! BUDDY UP Grab two controllers and pair up with a buddy to enjoy mutiplayer mode! Two players can control their character and can gravitate to each other while airborne to assist each other past a challenge.

rows.name: Spring Dogs : Ultimate Multiplayer Battle Royale
rows.short_description: Step into the frenetic universe of Spring Dogs and strive to emerge victorious in this locally focused multiplayer battle royale. Customize your character and challenge up to 17 AI-controlled competitors, 8 human players in split-screen, or 16 in team mode.
rows.description_html: Compatible with the Steamdeck Step into the frenzied universe of ' Spring Dogs ' and strive to emerge victorious in this locally focused multiplayer experience. Traps like pitfalls, spikes, rams, balls, barbed wires, and many more await you. Whether on land or in water, master avoiding these obstacles to be the quickest to cross the finish line. Personalize your character by choosing from a variety of skins and hats available. Play solo and challenge up to 17 AI-controlled opponents . Invite your friends for unforgettable matches with up to 8 players in split-screen mode ... ...or engage in team battles with up to 16 players where cooperation with your teammates is key to victory! Don't have enough controllers? No problem! With the ability to share controllers and keyboard inputs , invite as many friends as possible to join the race and find out who will be the last one standing in this intense competition. Dive into Time Attack mode to attempt beating your own and your friends' records, aiming to establish yourself as the fastest racer. Hone your skills, perfect your trajectories, and aim for the best possible time. Are you ready to take on the challenge and become the track champion? Don't wait any longer; let the race begin!

rows.name: WHERE SAFETY ENDS *R*
rows.short_description: What does it take to be SAFE? Maybe it's all about a person who will come to your rescue no matter what. Or maybe it has to do with a place that you know inside and out. OR, perhaps, (just maybe) a room full of strangers with no entrance might just do the trick.
rows.description_html: *INTRO* I would like to introduce you to SAFETY, a place for the unfortunate! You must be quite the special guest since our doors only open to those who truly commit to the cause. I can only hope you know what I mean... You are most welcome (even encouraged) to talk with the rest of our precious participants, but be mindful, they DO not like whining. Enjoy your stay ~~~ *DESCRIPTION* This is a short game that explores the concept of SAFETY. You will awaken in a room with three strangers and no knowledge of what has happened to you. In isolation, you are to communicate with them to find out what this place is and why you are here. This story has five different endings, the outcome of which will be determined by the choices you make. Do you think you are brave enough to leave? And, what awaits past the door? Perhaps, you and I are not so different, it may be that we have met in SAFETY before. And for those of you still there, I hope this short story will aid you on your journey. Please consult the Readme file in the games folder for the controller button layout.

rows.name: Joe 'n Jo
rows.short_description: Joe ‘n Jo is a challenging physics-based platformer about two giraffes who are strapped together for eternity. Play solo or with a friend and make your way through unique environments that will test your coordination and patience!
rows.description_html: Joe ‘n Jo is a whimsically challenging physics-based platformer about two giraffes, Joe and Jo, who are tethered together for eternity! Whether you embark on this journey solo or team up with a friend, you'll navigate through diverse and challenging environments that will test your coordination, patience, and problem-solving skills. Experience the silliness of controlling two giraffes whose bodies are tied together and move entirely by physics. Control each giraffe by moving their head to climb up obstacles and tumble across fields. Each step and jump requires coordination and thought in order to make progress! Play through the entire game with a friend! Simple to learn but challenging to master, the controls encourage players to work in harmony. Effective communication and synchronized actions are key to overcoming the game's many obstacles and puzzles. Practice makes perfect! As you progress, levels increase in complexity. Master the intricacies of giraffe locomotion, adapt to changing environments, and triumph over ever-more demanding obstacles. Can you reach the end?

rows.name: last seen online
rows.short_description: Look through someone else’s computer. Inspired by early “escape room” flash games.
rows.description_html: You were always a snoop, weren’t you? That’s why you bought an old computer you saw lying among piles of junk at a garage sale. You didn’t even bother to format the computer before you turned it on. You were curious. After all, a personal computer is an extension of another person’s soul, all their secrets, projects, interactions. “last seen online” is a psychological horror escape room, based on early flash games. Look through someone's computer files. Solve puzzles and discover the secrets that lie within the computer.

rows.name: Hues
rows.short_description: Move sprites slices and destroy color blocks.
rows.description_html: Sprites like color blocks so move them there. The faster the better. Color blocks can be destroyed with the mouse. Use this combination to solve the very fun very interesting levels. Features 3 characters with unique limitations you control using the arrow keys to move based on physics. The ball rolls freely. The hex rolls but not so easily. The box cannot roll. The mouse allows you to destroy the blocks that must be removed to solve the puzzles. The color blocks disintegrate into a nice satisfying dust by either clicking on them or a nice smooth slice motion. The color blocks and even the characters can be attached by joints that can rotate by motors. Levels can have springs and buoyancy from the water. There is a bonus count down to allow speed runners to compete. Levels are highly replayable.

When similar numbers collide, they merge, setting off a chain reaction of shockwaves and creating exciting combo effects that boost your score. FEATURES: ENDLESS MODE: Compete against friends and players worldwide on the leaderboard in an endless mode. PUZZLES: Challenge yourself with 50 puzzles that progressively get harder. CHALLENGES: Put your skills to the test with 16 open-ended challenges that encourage creative thinking and strategic gameplay. LEADERBOARDS: Showcase your skills on integrated leaderboards.

rows.name: The Exile Princes
rows.short_description: A story focused, old school, procedural RPG: raise your banner and bring your house to victory in the unique medieval fantasy setting of the Exile Realms. Start out in questing service, gain companions, followers, power and influence, and ultimately through strength or guile learn to rule the lands.
rows.description_html: The Exile Princes is a story focused, procedural RPG designed for short playthroughs in which you as a knight gather companions and fighters to bring your house to victory throughout the unique fantasy setting of the Exile Realms. Starting out in service to the current lords of the land, you can gain power and influence and ultimately through strength or guile ensure your faction's place at the helm of every city in the realms. The game's design is old-school, with a text readout core to the interface and simple tile-based maps, decision screens, and battle stat interfaces available. The interface graphics are lovingly produced based on actual medieval artwork, and show a lively medieval world for you to discover. Features Explore: procedurally generated worlds and cities offer a varied experience with every playthrough. Forest altars, dungeons, fortified manors, ruined chapels, bandit camps, stone circles and more may be encountered on your travels. Wonder: at a fantasy imaginarium from across the medieval world with a world of blemmyes, grotesques, cockatrices and wood sprites as well as creatures specifically named and adapted from medieval artwork for this game. Lead: a simple turn-based combat system with an exhaustion mechanic gives quick but tactically interesting combat choices. Rule: become leader of a city through election or conquest and hold court to deliver justice and develop your lands. A living world: as the player travels, the city-states of the realms will squabble, hold events, make raids and declare wars, changing the world around you in a dynamic way. Choose your house: four different factions allow you to vary your playstyle between the heroic Phoenixes, the exploration driven Scholars, the militaristic Generals, and the wealthy Wyrms. Each faction comes with unique military units and bonuses. Choose your difficulty: five difficulty settings let you vary your play between the relaxed exploratory style of the easy 'John Mandeville' mode, through the classic 'Moriaen' RPG experience, to the ultra-tough 'Silence' mode for those who want a tougher roguelike-style experience. Events: join tournaments and feasts to boost your prestige and gain skills. Companionship: with a range of generated characters: six companion classes and varied character traits give a wide range of potential characters with stories, quests, interests, and opinions on the world. Nameable pets provide further possibilities for building a found family of companions and allies. Romance: party members may enter romances with you and with one another, unlocking unique interactions to further the romance throughout the game. Soundtrack: a unique set of 12 tavern songs gives a folkloric depth to the Exile Realms setting.

rows.name: Brass Necessity - Demo
rows.short_description: In this top-down, sci-fi shoot 'em up, you'll have to solve combat-based puzzles in order to escape the cursed undead. You've only got your laser as a weapon and crystals to change its element. You'll need to figure out matchups that work best against enemies to escape. Good luck, you'll need it!
rows.description_html: Note: This game is no longer under active development. This version of the game now acts as a standalone demo.   On a planet far from here, and in a completely different time... You're part of a crew of explorers, and you've stumbled upon the ancient ruins of a human civilization. How it got there doesn't really matter. Because, really, it wasn't your choice to be here. And even worse, it's magical, cursed, and pure evil. Hoards of undead swarm you, and they aim to make you one of their own. The only thing between you and death is your laser. And even that doesn't seem to work as well as you'd like. But even if you're from a different planet or a different time, you still don't want to die, so you best get to figuring it out. If you time it right and use the right ammo, you might just make it out alive. Mechanics In Brass Necessity, the control layout is simple. There are only seven inputs, and four of those are WASD for moving. You've also got the ability to sprint, which is handy for dodging the greedy hands of the dead. But the star of the show is your somewhat trusty and temperamental laser. It has two whole inputs dedicated to it. So it's not hard to work. One key reloads the ammo. The other fires it. Simple! The crystals you use as ammo change the properties of your laser. The only snag is that these crystals seem to be growing from the undead. Use the wrong crystal, and they'll be much harder to kill. Meaning you're more likely to die. Use the right one however, and you're less likely to die. Got the wrong ammo? Tough! You'll have to reload or search for the right one. All your crystals suck? Just reload them all to reset your laser. See, simple! Intuitive! Just don't fire your laser too long... the manufacturers never quite got continuous firing right. About the Studio Popped Corn Bytes is an independent game studio. The studio hosts the Game Creators' Club, where members of the group contribute to development projects, like Brass Necessity. Members get the opportunity to gain experience and make their own creative mark on published games.

rows.description_html: Over The net is a simple, casual sport game which require good reflex. Move your player and try to win match with opponents in two game modes - 1vs1 or 2vs2. rows.name: Stars Survivor
rows.short_description: Compete in a stunning galaxy where skill reigns supreme! Destroy planets, upgrade your ship, and dominate intense top-down battles. Climb the trophy leaderboard in this ever-evolving space shooter with constant updates. Will you claim your place among the stars?
rows.description_html: Get ready for an epic gaming experience with Stars Survivor, the ultimate multiplayer space combat game ! 🎮 Dive into a thrilling intergalactic universe where you must compete for survival and glory. Engage in intense and breathtaking space battles against players from around the world, and prove your dominance in a variety of exciting game modes.  Be the last survivor to claim victory!  Take on other pilots in a fierce competition where strategy and skill are crucial to triumph. GLOBAL RANKING SYSTEM In Battle Royale mode, put your skills to the test in competitive ranked matches. Climb the divisions and leagues to rank among the best pilots in the universe! Your rank will be proudly displayed in the global leaderboard.  CUSTOMIZATION Earn XP by winning battles and unlock a variety of unique items in the Space Pass, our exclusive battle pass. Customize your spaceships with lasers, thrusters, and much more! 🔧🚀 IN-GAME CURRENCY Earn Planetary by playing and completing challenges. Use them to purchase cosmetic items, upgrades, and special equipment from the daily store.  STRATEGY Explore different planets on the map and destroy them to collect bonuses like missiles, speed boosts, static mines, repair packs, and more. Use them wisely to gain an edge over your opponents in space combat.  PLAY WITH YOUR FRIENDS Invite your friends to join you in this space adventure. Team up or engage in friendly duels to determine who's the top space pilot!  Download Stars Survivor for free now and embark on an unparalleled intergalactic gaming journey! Let the battle for survival and glory begin!  Note: In-app purchases are available for players looking to acquire Planetary more quickly and access exclusive items.

rows.name: Christmas Countdown
rows.short_description: Join Santa's elves in a festive race against time to wrap presents and fill Santa's sleigh before Christmas Eve in this fun and cheerful game for the whole family.
rows.description_html: Christmas Countdown is an enchanting game that sets you in the heart of the North Pole, where the magic of Christmas is in the air. With just five days until Christmas Eve, Santa needs all hands on deck to ensure every present is wrapped and ready for delivery. You play as one of Santa's most diligent elves, tasked with wrapping toys that come zipping down a conveyor belt, aiming to pack them into Santa's sleigh before they crash off the end. Navigate through five intense levels, each representing the final countdown to Christmas Eve, growing more challenging and frenetic as you progress. Your skills, speed, and Christmas spirit will be put to the test as you try to keep up with the ever-increasing pace of gift-wrapping mayhem. Once you've mastered the story, dive into Endless Mode, where the true challenge begins. Compete against elves from around the globe for a spot on our leaderboards by wrapping more presents than anyone else and proving your worth as Santa's top elf. Key Features Festive Gameplay: Immerse yourself in the holiday spirit with vibrant graphics and cheerful Christmas music that brings the North Pole to life. Progressive Difficulty: Each level brings a new challenge, pushing you to refine your strategy and improve your speed to keep up with the game's pace. Endless Mode: Test your limits and strive for the top of the leaderboards in a never-ending gift-wrapping extravaganza. Leaderboards: Showcase your high scores and see how you stack up against players from around the world. Family-Friendly Fun: Designed for players of all ages, Christmas Countdown offers an engaging way to get into the holiday spirit. Whether you're in for a bit of holiday fun or looking for a joyful game to play with the family, Christmas Countdown promises hours of excitement and holiday cheer. Join us at the North Pole and help make this Christmas the most magical one yet!

rows.name: Nekokami: Internship - The Prologue Adventure
rows.short_description: Architect beautiful, peaceful worlds in a far-future where Cats rule the universe. Befriend sometimes-naughty spirits of nature. Manage Humans. Join us in this unique planet-building adventure and get a taste of the full journey!
rows.description_html: UPDATE: Nekokami - The Human Restoration Project is now in Early Access! 🎉 We have made significant improvement to gameplay and graphics - check it at out our developer page or scroll down to 'More from Rocket-in-Bottle'! 🚀 (Screenshot from Early Access version.) ✨ Nekokami: Internship is a FREE prologue to the full game Nekokami. This prologue contains 20+ Expeditions and roughly 4 hours of story-rich gameplay. In this sneak peek of the full game, you will: 🌏 Create beautiful worlds of natural habitats and human settlements with strategic, or spontaneous, placement of tiles in a unique hand-drawn-like art style. 🌌 Follow the beginning of a whimsical yet heart-warming story of Human-Cat friendship, set millennia later in the future. 💼 Earn your place in Nekokami Co., your employer, by creating worlds that beat expectations. Or just relax. Your bosses are Cats after all. 🔮 Befriend a selection of Kami, spirits of the nature and the universe, and see them bring miracles to your work. They are Cats too. What could go wrong? 🌟 Nekokami Co. is commissioned to manage planets all over the universe. That's a LOT of planets! Environment, biomes and rules differ from Star System to Star System. You will get to visit at least SIX Star Systems during your internship. 🐈 I did mention the Kami*, right? Technically the spirits are the real fellows creating the worlds. As a Planetary Architect, you are basically borrowing their Creative Energy for your own use. You will need to seek their acceptance and approval. Through their friendship, you will potentially learn the secrets of nature and the arcane laws of universe. *Kami is actually a Japanese word that roughly translates to 'spirits and gods'. About the Developer This game was made by a tiny tiny independent game studio in Fukuoka. We hope you enjoy it!

rows.name: Pearl Fishery: Quest for the Mega Pearl
rows.short_description: Shoot pearls, fire harpoons, and collect treasure under the mysterious 'Pearl Island' in this new single-player, ocean-themed coin pusher game!
rows.description_html: Q. What kind of game is this? A. In this game, you can shoot pearls to gather treasure under the mysterious Pearl Island and fire harpoons to fight off dangerous sea creatures. Pearls can score bonuses, or they can trigger Party Time for even more rewards. You can earn new badges and titles! Shoot Pearls Under an island where pearls are plentiful and sea creatures roam, you control a pearl shooter that will lead you to riches...and danger. Bonus Blocks Pearls can activate bonus blocks—providing you with extra pearls and gold. You can even get big pearls! Party Time Want to party under the sea? Trigger five of the same bonus block. You will be rewarded with a pearl waterfall and a light show. Big Pearl Bonus Some pearls are very big. They can be collected and exchanged for a lot of gold. How much gold? Luck will decide. Earn Gold Push pearls off the platform to get gold. It's time to make a fortune. Get Treasure Need a place to store your gold? Put them in treasure chests and collect as many as you can. Badges & Titles With enough treasure chests, you can level up. You will get a shiny new badge. And a cool new title to go with it. Sunken Pirates Even as ghosts, pirates want to loot your treasure. They will take what you have, but you can send them back to the depths! Giant Crab Sea monsters live in treacherous waters. Fight back and defeat the Giant Crab! It'll lead you straight to The Mega Pearl. The Mega Pearl The biggest pearl of them all was rumored to be deep under Pearl Island. No adventurer, pirate, or merchant has found it...yet.

rows.name: The Beautiful Island
rows.short_description: A short visual novel about war, peace and hope. Explore a city after a devastating war. Talk to people, try to understand, try to help. The heroes of war are dead, but you can be a hero of peace!
rows.description_html: 'The Beautiful Island' is set in a parallel history in a not-so-far future. It is set on an island, resembling the Taiwan of our own world, after a war. You can chose to either play the game after the island lost the war and got annexed by its neighbor or after it successfully defended itself. Jan, an engineer, visits the island not long after the war ended. He tries to reconnect with people that he knew from his previous visit. He learns about their fates and how the war has changed their views on the political situation. Will you stay neutral or will you get involved and help? Can you change fate? Will you form your own opinion? – Then share it with other players at the end of the game! Game play This visual novel includes several endings – some better, some worse. Make decisions, talk to people, find a path that leads to an ending of your choice, but please understand: war has no good endings! The World of 'Beautiful Island' This is not the real world. It's the world of our fictional story. The real world is more complex than any story – but maybe stories can help us to understand the world a bit better?

rows.short_description: Resist the urge to press the button and do not uncover the secrets that may lie within its crimson facade. The choice is yours: to press or not to press.
rows.description_html: - Man vs The Red Button You are in front of a red button you must no press. Will you dare to defy the unknown, or will you walk away, forever wondering what could have been? Only the strongest will be rewarded and enter the Empty Place. This game includes: - A button - A choice - A secret place - 10 ranks to climb. - 80.6mb of data - You don't need a mouse, a keyboard or even a screen to play it. - Voice acting by Shakyra Dunn.

rows.name: VGA Planets Nu
rows.short_description: A graphical multi-player play by turn war game that simulates combat in space between galactic empires.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the Echo Cluster, a dense cluster of star systems, rich in resources and native life. Over three hundred years ago the 11 races arrived marking the start of a complex and brutal history which is still unfolding today. They brought with them a dangerous and powerful technology, which has allowed elite members of society to skip through time by accelerating close to the speed of light, slowing relative time and then decelerating to alter the course of history again and again. These people are commonly referred to as Echos. As an ambitious leader, you seek access to this technology to make your mark on history. To get it you’ll need to learn the lessons of the past and climb the ladder of society. Unlocking the secrets of history and forging glory in the present. Be aware though, the road is more perilous than ever, as a new ruthless species has arrived, and is disrupting life in the Echo Cluster. They are known as the Horwasp Plague. Claim your home sector now to start your journey! VGA Planets Nu is a graphical multi-player play by turn war game that simulates combat in space between galactic empires. The game emphasizes mining, colonization and the construction of starships. Players compete against each other economically and militarily on a galactic scale. The game system allows players to construct starships by selecting various components and placing them on a given hull type. There are usually 11 players in a game, each playing a different race with special ships and abilities, but there are other formats as well. At the start of a game, each player is given a planet, a starbase, and a ship. The players have to manage their planet's population and resources wisely. They can create more ships and expand their domain through colonization or conquest of neighboring planets. Of course, all players are attempting to do the same thing, so the fleets will, inevitably, engage in combat from time to time. VGA Planets Nu can be compared to a multi-player chess game in which all players move all their pieces simultaneously, one turn at a time.

rows.name: YOUR EARTH
rows.short_description: This game is an earth creation simulation game that allows you to create and view the earth in various shapes.
rows.description_html: Rather than confining Earth to a singular form, let's unleash its diversity by shaping it in various forms. In this interactive experience, you can pause Earth's constant flux and craft your rendition. The paused Earth becomes 'YOUR EARTH,' which you can explore from multiple viewpoints. Moreover, accompanied by ambient music, you can contemplate while witnessing Earth morph into various shapes. This game promises to alter your perception of our planet. Distribution Guidelines: Include the name of the game in the title of the video or live stream. Also, include the URL of the store page in the summary or description section of the video or live stream.

rows.name: Deck Dash
rows.short_description: Deck Dash is a PvP auto-card battler. Craft your deck, build your engine, discover countless combos, and defeat all your enemies. Sort your items and create your engines to win epic tactical fights. Explore and upgrade items and become the ultimate survivor of The Island.
rows.description_html: Deck Dash is an asynchronous PvP auto-battler card game. Craft your deck with different types of items, enter fights against other survivors on the island, build your engine on the board, discover countless combos, and defeat your enemies. Epic tactical duels await you on the island. Steam version of Deck Dash is a PC port of the original mobile game. It is free from the mobile F2P monetization scheme. In this version, you can buy gems only for customization elements, not to progress faster. Note: All your IAP purchases will go to the development of our upcoming titles. Thanks in advance! Main Duels – Engage in tactical asynchronous PvP battles with your custom deck. Character Customization – Personalize your in-game character. Ranking League – Climb the competitive ladder and prove your skills. Missions & Events – Take on challenges and earn exclusive rewards. Game Modes - Experience different ways to play. With the right combination of items and strategic alignment, anything can happen in Deck Dash. Some engines can create amazing damage and devastate your opponents! Go through many playstyles and find what works best for you. Build devastating synergies that multiply your power. Watch the numbers explode as your engine kicks into overdrive. Adapt and counter your opponent’s strategies in real-time. Deck Dash is designed to have a deep engine-building mechanic that suits an auto-battler card game. With over 150+ unique items, you can mix and match to create the ultimate build. There are no faction restrictions—only pure creativity and strategy. Discover countless synergies and optimize your engine. Adapt your deck to counter enemy strategies. Experiment with wild mechanics and find your playstyle. Deck Dash offers a variety of modes designed for infinite replayability, catering to both competitive and casual players. Whether you enjoy testing your skills against others, refining your strategies in PvE, or experimenting with unique deck builds, there’s always a new challenge waiting for you. These game modes also serve as testing grounds for shaping the future of Deck Dash. Let us know which modes pique your interest so we can refine the core game with your feedback in mind. Featured Decks – Try out curated decks with unique synergies. All-in Brawl – High-risk, high-reward battles with everything on the line. Harsh Survival – Endurance-based matches that test your adaptability. Proving Grounds – A true test of skill for seasoned strategists.

rows.name: Celtic Heroes
rows.short_description: Are you looking for that classic MMORPG vibe? Whether you're a minmaxer strategizing every detail for maximum efficiency, a savvy fashion collector in search of the most stunning outfits, or even someone who enjoys the journey of casual leveling, Celtic Heroes opens its gates to you!
rows.description_html: Step into the legendary world of Dal Riata, where heroes rise, clans wage war, and mythical creatures roam the lands. Celtic Heroes is a free-to-play 3D MMORPG inspired by Celtic mythology, offering deep quest-driven gameplay, dynamic boss battles, and a thriving player-driven economy. Choose your class, forge your destiny, and relive the nostalgia of a decade-old adventure-filled world. Key Features A Free-to-Play MMORPG Without Restrictions Earn gear, potions, and currency through gameplay. No paywalls, no locked content —just a fair and rewarding experience. Epic Boss Battles & High-Stakes Combat Face off against Celtic warlords, dragons, and mythical beasts . Take on world bosses, and PvP battles , either solo or with your clan. Victory brings valuable rewards and legendary loot. Seasonal Events & Exclusive Rewards Participate in limited-time events to earn unique armor, rare charms, and powerful weapons . Engage in community challenges and leave your mark on the world of Dal Riata . Clan System – Build Your Legacy Join a clan and gain access to a shared clan bank, where boss loot can be stored and distributed.  A True Open Economy – Trade Without Limits All gear and items are tradeable —nothing is bound to your character. Buy, sell, and exchange items via the Auction House and direct trading , shaping the in-game economy as you see fit. Pets & Mounts with Unique Abilities Summon combat pets to assist you in battle or ride powerful mounts to traverse the world faster. Professions – Fishing, Cooking & Crafting Take a break from combat and master the arts of fishing, cooking, and crafting . Catch rare fish, prepare meals with powerful buffs, and sell your goods for profit. A Living, Expansive World Explore forests and ancient ruins , complete story-driven quests , and customize your hero with a variety of armor sets, weapons, and abilities .   A CLASSIC MMORPG EXPERIENCE – EXPLORE, TRADE, BATTLE, AND BUILD YOUR LEGACY Join thousands of players and forge your path in this evolving fantasy world. Add to your wishlist and start your adventure today.

rows.name: Ruiga Pirates: First Survivors
rows.short_description: Defeat legions of pirates and marine beasts to emerge victorious! Ruiga Pirates: First Survivors is an adventure with survival elements. Customize your ship, brace yourself for a bullets from myriad foes! Navigate the perilous waters of a ghost-infested realm and Play for Free now!
rows.description_html: WISHLIST FULL GAME About the Game Ruiga Pirates: First Survivors is a survivors-like game. Hellish seas, pirates everywhere and you can't escape sea creatures. All you can do is fight to the death and take what you can and leave nothing behind. Collect gold on every run to buy upgrades, new ships and find skilled captains. Get ready for seven seas challenges! In the prologue of our game, players are thrust into a world of high seas piracy, where the haunting specter of ghosts looms large. Amidst constant battles for survival, they must navigate treacherous waters, facing both natural and supernatural threats. With adrenaline-pumping action and thrilling encounters, the prologue sets the stage for an epic adventure filled with excitement and peril. Choose your ship and captain. Customize your enhancements. Your choices will make you live more and make you shoot more. Prevent enemy ships from approaching you. Avoid fires and watch out for traps. Complete challenges and explore hidden treasures. With the missions you will take, you will sometimes bomb an island and sometimes go after the most wanted pirates. Get ready for legends of krakens, mermaids and more!

rows.name: Galaxy Rush
rows.short_description: Feel the thrill of galactic racing! The most exhilarating grand prix of the spacefaring age is upon us, and the audience is waiting for you. Gear up and start your engines, for the Galaxy Rush is about to blast off!
rows.description_html: Galaxy Rush is a sci-fi racing game that delivers the thrill of high-speed racing. Hop into a world where the most exhilarating Grand-Prix of the space age has begun, and the audience is waiting for a show. Gear up and start your engines, for the Galaxy Rush is about to blast off! Spacecraft: Step into the cockpits of 9 different spacecraft as you zip through different planets to claim victory for your own. Each craft reflects the driving preference of the racer, making no two spacecraft the same. Enjoy discovering different playstyles and mastering your favorites! Environments: Explore the galaxy as you boost your way through locations such as the sweeping corners of Neptune, the arid deserts of Mars, the neon metropolis of Earth, and the frozen peaks of Pluto! Fun for All: Gather a group of two to four friends to duke it out, or race solo against AI competition. Different gameplay modes allow you to create your ideal set of races. Immersive Gameplay: Featuring intricate and aesthetically rich visuals coupled with a diverse gaming experience, Galaxy Rush invites all kinds of players to have an experience that is out of this world. Updates: Our team is consistently working on adding new content to the game in the form of new gameplay areas, so stay tuned for more!

rows.name: Fastival
rows.short_description: Race through an enchanting carnival and be on the lookout for wacky obstacles and cool shortcuts as you compete against up to three other friends in this cute and cartoony arcade racing game!
rows.description_html: Fastival is an arcade racing game where players speed through different attractions within a vibrant and cartoony carnival throughout each race. Knock down targets as you race to trigger unique effects on the track that you can use to your advantage. Collect wacky items that can be used to mess with other racers to enhance your driving capabilities. Race Through Three Unique Tracks Each track is a different section of the Fastival with its own fun theme. Enter the Fastival in “Whirling Welcome,” navigating tight turns and spiraling around a merry go round. Navigate a field of giant wack-a-moles popping up and down and zoom across a roller coaster. Fly through a ring of fire and get launched by a cannon up into the big top circus tent. Master Each Bumper Car Fastival features four different types of bumper cars that players can choose from each with unique driving strengths and weaknesses. The Shark car boasts a higher top speed but is more challenging to control while the Vintage car is slower to accelerate but heavier, allowing you to utilize drifting to your advantage more often. Knock Down Targets to Affect the Race In Fastival , you can gain an advantage as you race through unique interactions with the environment. Knock down targets in each race by driving through them to trigger a temporary effect on the race track. Some targets will reveal a shorter path while others activate hazards that other racers have to steer clear of. Use Items to Take Out the Competition As you race, collect carnival tickets that turn into one of five fun items. Activate a firecracker to launch yourself forward and gain temporary invincibility, or throw a volley of water balloons at other racers to spin out their vehicles. Customize Your Racer Mix and match between four cute costumes and color palettes. Developer Notes Fastival was created by the students of Cohort 33 at SMU Guildhall, a graduate video game design program in Dallas, Texas. In their second Team Game Project course ('TGP2'), the entire cohort of 47 students from all disciplines—Art Creation, Programming, Design, and Production—with help from three game music students in SMU's Meadows School of the Arts came together each day to make this game. For many students, this is their first experience working on a large team, and the course is designed to teach the students how to communicate at scale and iterate on the game design to find the fun. To accomplish this in roughly 12 weeks of production and produce such a vibrant, fun game is a challenge, and we are really proud to share their hard work with you. Thank you for playing. We hope you enjoy Fastival . If you do, please consider leaving a kind note in the community hub and share the game with your friends.

rows.name: FreeInfantry
rows.short_description: Isometric. Massively Multiplayer. Capture The Flag. Skirmish. Bug Hunt. And more. Welcome to FreeInfantry - the world's first massive multiplayer online isometric shooter.
rows.description_html: Step into the ultimate squad warfare experience in this real-time, fast paced tactical top-down shooter. Use momentum to your advantage and to your enemies detriment as your bullets and explosive shrapnel ricochet using FreeInfantry's Newtonian physics model. Plan your attack from the shadows and ambush your enemy thanks to Infantry's real-time Fog of War visibility model. FreeInfantry features several zone types, providing players with exciting and varying experiences in this sci-fi military universe that starts with the war between the Titan Militia and Collective Military. Fight alongside your team or as a solo trooper in Io's Landing against a neverending tide of enemy bots in escalating challenge modes. Join a squad and test your skills and strategy in the competitive deathmatch league that's 50 plus seasons running. Survive against the swarm of aliens in Bug Hunt. FreeInfantry is most active daily between 9 PM and 2 AM EST , but may be enjoyed at other times as well through the featured bots zones.   FreeInfantry is 100% free with zero paid unlockables. Prepare for battle and experience it today.

rows.short_description: A short 10 minute visual novel about being a fragment in the universe and trying to find a way out of the ****.
rows.description_html: You are a fragment in the universe. You wake up with no body, no sense of touch, nothing. But... you can walk? You have no legs! You walk the endless plain, then is stopped by a mysterious girl. Who is this girl? Is she... god? What am I doing here? The mysterious girl shall guide you. - You - You are you. Where are you? With the help of this mysterious girl, maybe she has the answers for you. - Mysterious Girl named Aesysis - Who is she? Is she god? Am I dead? The answer relies in her words of wisdom. 3000~ words 1 beautiful CG 10 minutes of story 1 Choice, 1 Ending Gore Filter Breathtaking OST This game is only suitable for mature audiences. rows.name: Rabbit Hole
rows.short_description: Rabbit Hole is a fast paced, tough-as-nails 2D RogueLike-Shooter, made with love for the genre. You are Disc, someone who was suddenly brought to the Rabbit Hole. Collect guns, fight foes and meet strange new characters on your descent to the bottom, all in an attempt to find your heart again.
rows.description_html: “Remember you will live.” Rabbit Hole is a fast paced, tough-as-nails 2D Platformer-RogueLike-Shooter inspired by popular roguelikes, made with a love for the genre. You are Disc, someone who was suddenly brought to the Rabbit Hole. Collect guns, fight foes and meet strange new characters on your descent to the bottom, all in an attempt to find your heart again. “This place is like its own ecosystem. A big living breathing mess.” Every run is different. Enjoy hours of replayable content through randomly generated floor layouts and 50+ weapons to collect and use. “Hey, hey, hey! How's my favorite anxiety-fueled nutjob!” Unlock new characters with diverse playstyles. Each of the 6 unlockable characters keep gameplay fresh and give a unique perspective on the gameplay loop. “There was a blank line, almost as if I had erased it” Discover the truth that lies beneath the surface. Collect books and fill out your library to understand its unseen history. In the end, you may even come to understand yourself?

rows.short_description: Flash may be dead but Millie's back in this action-packed revival! The Mole King is gearing up for war and made the mistake of annoying Millie. Go berserk and massacre your way through mountains of monsters to shut him up for good.
rows.description_html: Millie's back and she's still mad! In this latest installment of the long-running Millie Megavolte series, you play as Millie Megavolte, Lance LeTourre, Kilzek Green, Anne Abelle and a ton of new characters too as they fight for what's right ('right' being a relative term here). Story Mode The classic! Instead of one big adventure, the story is told through lots of short ones. Every story involves different characters and gives a piece of the bigger picture of what's going on. At first, Millie and Lance set out to stop the Mole King but things get a little more complicated from there. Journey Mode Done with Story Mode? Great! Play Journey Mode FOREVER! Journey Mode is a rogue-lite-lite where the areas are randomized and the levels themselves are shuffled. Pick your team of four characters or go in solo and rampage across the world! Cool Bullet Points The humor is back! Those who don't like shock or blue humor may want to cover their eyes. There are girls in skimpy outfits running around too 14+ unique playable characters. Millie and her friends are back with a whole cast of even more friends Play dress-up with multiple outfits and weapon choices for every character Four difficulty levels from Noob to Master (plus two secret ones). Don't get pwned! Also, the baseline difficulty is way easier than the head-crushing-hard previous MTC games were No more tiny Flash-o-Vision! Millie 8 uses a custom engine (built with SFML) and runs in full 1080 and doesn't chug to reach 60 FPS Play with a controller, seriously. I even implemented the Steam Input API so you can use whatever wacky controller you want

rows.name: CastingPlz
rows.short_description: CastingPlz is a 2-player cooperative roguelike game where players take on the roles of two characters with distinct responsibilities: one for attacking and the other for movement.
rows.description_html: CastingPlz is a 2-player cooperative roguelike game where players take on the roles of two characters with distinct responsibilities: one for attacking and the other for movement. [Background] In the past, a Grand Wizard sealed away the monsters that roamed the world and restored peace by imprisoning them in a massive labyrinth. During this time of peace, a rumor began to circulate worldwide: 'In the deepest part of the labyrinth, the Grand Wizard grants any wish.' The source of this rumor is uncertain, but people from all walks of life are heading to the Grand Wizard's labyrinth, each with their own dreams. [Labyrinth] The labyrinth is inhabited by sealed monsters that have formed their own ecosystems over a long period, establishing rules to live by. As you conquer the ever-changing labyrinth one step at a time, delve deeper, uncover its secrets, and progress to lower, more profound levels. [Monsters] The monsters trapped by the Grand Wizard are determined to eliminate newcomers who intrude into their ecosystems. Defeat the advancing monsters to conquer the labyrinth, but don't get too comfortable. As you venture deeper into the labyrinth, more powerful monsters await you. [Soldier & Wizard] You must choose to play as either a Soldier or a wizard, with the game roles divided to the extreme. You will need to cooperate with each other to embark on your adventure. Soldier: High mobility Low combat power Wizard: Powerful magic Limited mobility To achieve your dreams, you must save your partner and approach your own aspirations. [Magic and Items] As you progress through the labyrinth, defeat monsters using various spells and acquire diverse items to grow and potentially expedite the conquest of the labyrinth. ... Maybe?

rows.description_html: From the dull life of a simple worker, you find yourself living a spicy isekai adventure in an epic ancient realm. This new universe comes with a mecha twist, sexy girls, sultry Aeons and the ultimate mission of saving Zeus. Life used to be so boring… yet normal. Every day was the same. Nothing too exciting, just the old routine - but then, out of the blue, everything took a wild turn when you entered a mysterious portal.

rows.name: Pizzakai
rows.short_description: Play as a deceased man by the name of Peppy who has been recently reincarnated as a freshly baked Pizza mobster. Offered a deal by a 'Pizza God,' Peppy must enter the crime den of the House of Unified Triple-Cheeses and engage in combat if he wants any chance of returning to his own world.
rows.description_html: You died, and have been Isekai'd into a world where you are Pizza. You cannot doubt that this is awesome. Use Various Weapons to Put Holes in Your Favorite Foods! - Use a Caesar's Downfall to decimate all visible enemies! - Use a Howie's Little Friend to smack your adversaries into the next dimension! - Use a The Domino Effect to burn your way through obstacles! Explore a Large Level and Encounter Various Enemies - An agile breadstick that breaks into two and will try to slice you up! - A cowardly chicken wing that runs away, and throws molotovs to overcook you! - A hefty deep dish pizza that can tank much more than your own thin crust! rows.name: Rocksmith+
rows.short_description: Learn guitar and piano with an expanding library of thousands of songs!
rows.description_html: Learn guitar and piano with an expanding library of thousands of songs! Rocksmith+, an award-winning music learning service, is the evolution from Rocksmith 2014 Edition, which had to be retired for music licensing requirements. In Rocksmith+, the catalog of licensed songs is different and expanded. As for the key features that made prior iterations help millions of players learn how to play guitar, they are the same. But Rocksmith+ now also includes piano – for the same price. Our key features include Riff Repeater and Adaptative Difficulty to hone your skills. Rocksmith is the only music learning service that adjusts difficulty as you play. So, join the 5+ million of players to learn at YOUR pace with real-time feedback and song exercises. Rock on! Note: If you purchased Rocksmith 2014 Edition, you can continue to use it.

rows.name: Sharpshooter
rows.short_description: Gunfight your way through procedurally generated Wild West towns. Customize the gameplay mechanics to suit your playstyle. Straightforward, non-stop action.
rows.description_html: Fully playable with the Revolver. Buy the 'Supporter Pack DLC' to support my work and get more weapons to play with: Machine Gun, Bow, Carbine, Coach Gun, Repeater and Dual Pistols. ::: STORY ::: The outlaws aren't too happy about you jailing their leader, Sheriff. They're all over town. Grab your six-shooter and clear them out. ::: STRAIGHTFORWARD NON-STOP ACTION ::: Gunfight your way through procedurally generated Wild West towns. Get rid of all outlaws or die trying. ::: CUSTOMIZE GAMEPLAY MECHANICS ::: There is a bunch of options that modify different aspects of how the game mechanics work. This allows you to shape the difficulty to suit your playstyle and skill level. Do you want the gunfights to require hardcore skill or just be casual? Here are some examples: What reaction time should outlaws have, and how well do they aim? Do you want projectiles to be affected by gravity? Should damage account for velocity? Choose the amount of health you have and if it regenerates after a specified time. Should reloading be realistic, fast, or not even needed? ...

rows.short_description: A 2D puzzle game with a spin! Make your way through obstacle courses of pipes, water streams and bats as fast as you can whilst spinning out of control.
rows.description_html: Pipe Escape is a tight controlled 2D puzzle game where the only objective is to escape a labyrinth of pipes whilst in a constant state of spin. Find your way to an exit through the depths of this pipe hell!

rows.name: 50 Floors: The Paranormal Investigators Prologue
rows.short_description: Find a way out.
rows.description_html: JOIN OUR DISCORD Roadmap About the Game ADD TO YOUR WISHLIST NOW After a conversation with President of Underwood Corporation, you must urgently go to the studio for the shooting of a new episode of the Paranormal Investigators TV show. Unfortunately, the elevator is broken and you need to go through 50 floors on the stairs, but there are 3 simple rules: 1. If there is no anomaly, go down to the floor below. 2. If there is an anomaly, return to the floor above. 3. The corridor is safe, but if it changes, the rules will change. 50 Floors: The Paranormal Investigators Prologue is inspired by games like The Stanley Parable, PT, The Exit 8, and narrates what happened a couple of hours before the events in the Paranormal Investigators. Key Features: 200 options for anomalies 4 endings Jump scares VHS Filter

rows.name: Soul Eater
rows.short_description: The player embarks on a journey through a sword containing the soul of a being desperate for revenge against their past betrayers. As the player travels the world, they seek out those who betrayed them in the past, and with each encounter, they have the opportunity to seize their souls.
rows.description_html: About this Game 'Soul Eater' is an exhilarating 2D platformer roguelike game that offers players a dynamic and constantly evolving gaming experience. With every playthrough, the game dynamically adjusts the positions of enemies and map layouts, guaranteeing that players face fresh challenges and surprises each time they engage with the game. Moreover, players have the option to randomly upgrade their skills, introducing an element of unpredictability and strategic decision-making to their gameplay. Game Story The player embarks on a journey through a sword containing the soul of a being desperate for revenge against their past betrayers. The soul within the sword shares the player's past wounds and anger, fueling a desire for vengeance against their enemies. As the player travels the world, they seek out those who betrayed them in the past, and with each encounter, they have the opportunity to seize their souls. These acquired souls are absorbed into the player, further empowering the player, and allowing player to control the enemy. Controls Move the character 'W','A','S','D' Throw the sword 'R' Interact with NPC 'V' Skill 'Q' Attack 'Left Mouse Click' Parrying ' Drag while holding down the right mouse button ' Requirement 'Soul Eater' only work Window system

rows.name: On Track
rows.short_description: On Track is a cozy productivity tracker to help you rejuvenate, relax, and focus on tasks you want to accomplish. Watch a lush landscape roll by as you watch from your cozy train seat. Set a timer to focus, manage a todo list with all your goals, and relax as you stay on track.
rows.description_html: Welcome to On Track! Enjoy a relaxing environment to help you tackle any tasks big or small you’ve been procrastinating on. On Track was built track by track to help you get focused. When you board, name any goal you want to accomplish, set a timer, and get to work! Listen to laidback music and adjust ambient audio if ASMR is more your speed. Manage your Tasks Set a timer and make your to-do list of tasks. Feel accomplished as you cross off each item you’ve completed and re-assured you can edit and delete any tasks as you go. You can start, stop, restart or edit your timer sessions to help you stay on top of your tasks. Watch the World Go By As the landscape rolls by, it will evolve over time as you complete more task sessions. Keep an eye out and you may even see some surprises. You can slow down or stop the train at any time. Relaxing Lo-fi Soundtrack On Track features a playlist of relaxing lo-fi inspired tunes to help you get into your flow state and become one with the train. rows.name: Math Path Builder
rows.short_description: Create a path to solve all goals. Sounds simple? ... It isn't!
rows.description_html: Math Path Builder Challenge yourself at generated levels that get harder and harder. The goal is simple: Connect the path from the origin to all goals, but the numbers need to add up! Every level has exactly one start position. You have one or many goal positions which exact value you need to reach. You can guide a path from the start to each goal. The path can split. Use numbers or modifiers to reach the goals value. Mathematic operations are always done in sequence. The game includes a rudimentary online rank which simply tells you which global rank you have based on your highest completed level. It is best played in a small window. No accounts needed, no advertisements or in-game purchases. The game is completely free. Enjoy!

rows.short_description: Welcome to TRAUMA Pro Wrestling, a promotion that doesn't kiss ass, nor draw money! Your road to stardom begins today, take a look at what we got in store for you!

TRAUMA Pro Wrestling, AVAILABLE NOW!

rows.name: 江梦潮音 J.M.Rhythm
rows.short_description: J.M.Rhythm is a black-and-white style rhythm game set in the southern regions of Yangtze River of China. It is the first work produced by J.M.Arcady. In this game, you can use our “rhythm generator” to upload your own music and it will generate a corresponding beatmap automatically.
rows.description_html: J.M.Rhythm is a black-and-white style rhythm game set in the southern regions of Yangtze River of China. It combines the elegance of Chinese ink painting with the beauty of music. We wish you could feel the depth of traditional Chinese art and enjoy the picturesque scenes of 'Jiangnan' while playing this game. It is the first work produced by J.M.Arcady, an indie game team formed by undergraduates. We are dedicated to spreading the essence of Chinese culture through games. One of the game's special features is that you can use our “rhythm generator” to upload your own music and it will generate a corresponding beatmap automatically. The beatmap is written in the form of JSON and allows manual modifications.

rows.name: Escape From Zombietown
rows.short_description: Escape From Zombietown is an Action Shooter FPS where you collect guns, grenades and consumables to help you fight off the zombies while you make your way out of town. With 20 levels filled to the brim with zombies, this game has all the zombie annihilating action you need.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Zombietown! Each zombie has a unique ability. Some zombies are fast, some are slow, and others even explode! Your job is to escape town while taking out the zombies. Watch out for the zombies that shoot lasers, and stay on your feet for the zombies that throw eggs. You never know who could be around the next corner! But Don't Worry, You Have The Right Tools For The Job You can find different equipment around the map. Guns eliminate zombies quickly, but you can run out of ammo if you're not careful. Pills give you temporary powerups, so make them count. Health packs heal you when you get hit by the zombies, and grenades blow up zombies in different ways. The impact blows them up instantly, the incendiary lights the zombies on fire, and the decoy distracts them - the perfect getaway!

rows.name: Counterpick Labs
rows.short_description: Counterpick Labs is a free platform fighter where you mix and match gear to build your perfect loadout. Featuring a single player story mode, a roguelike PvP mode where you earn powerful upgrades as you fight, and a classic no-frills PvP mode.
rows.description_html: Join Our Discord About the Game Key Features Mix and match quirky weapons and gadgets to build your perfect fighter. Single player story missions. Classic and roguelike pvp modes. Rollback netcode. Frequent updates with new weapons, missions, upgrades, and more! Smooth platform fighter action Combo your opponents and knock them offstage to secure the win. Play locally or online with rollback netcode. Free to play with no way to buy power. Build your perfect fighter Over 200 (and growing!) loadout combinations, plus countless cosmetic options. For a tanky, ranged build, pair Oleg's might with the Warp Mine's teleport, and hurl Chakrams to deal damage from afar. Or dominate the skies by combining Space Suit's triple jump with Jet Boots' maneuverability and the momentum-altering recoil of the Flame Cannon. Classic & roguelike combat Enjoy intense, skill-based combat in Classic mode. Or try your luck in the roguelike Arena mode, where you'll earn powerful upgrades as you fight, from elemental weapon auras to ricocheting projectiles to dramatic stat boosts.

rows.name: Unreal Physics
rows.short_description: Unreal Physics is a exploration of in-game physics like never before, this dynamic 3D sandbox features a mesmerizing collection of demos, showcasing stunning visuals and realistic simulations. It's a playground of endless possibilities where creativity meets the cutting edge of physics technology
rows.description_html: Dive into the dynamic world of physics with Unreal Physics an immersive 3D physics sandbox and demo collection that pushes the boundaries of Unreal Engine. This unique experience combines the cutting-edge FluidNinja and Chaos physics systems to deliver a mesmerizing showcase of fluid dynamics, destruction, and realistic simulations. Fluid Dynamics Unleashed: Witness the incredible power of FluidNinja as it brings fluid simulations to life in ways you've never imagined. Whether it's the graceful flow of water, the mesmerizing realism of smoke, or the viscous flowing of molten lava, the fluid dynamics in this sandbox will leave you in awe. Chaos Physics on Display: Brace yourself for a revolution in destructible environments and realistic physics simulations with Unreal Engine's Chaos Physics. Experience the sheer thrill as structures crumble, debris scatters realistically, and chaos ensues in response to your every action. The level of destructibility will redefine your expectations of in-game physics. Endless Possibilities in the Sandbox: Engage with a variety of physics-driven demos and sandbox environments that showcase the versatility of FluidNinja and Chaos Physics. From tinkering with fluid dynamics to unleashing controlled chaos, each demo invites you to explore, experiment, and marvel at the beauty of physics in action. Visual Spectacle: Immerse yourself in stunning visuals that showcase the capabilities of Unreal Engine. From the realistic rendering of fluid surfaces to the intricate details of destructible objects, every frame is a testament to the technological prowess that FluidNinja and Chaos Physics bring to the gaming landscape. Embark on a adventure into the realms of physics with Unreal Physics a playground for FluidNinja and Unreal Engine physics showcasing the possibilities of current physics systems. This sandbox experience isn't just a game – it's a showcase of innovation, creativity, and the awe-inspiring power of physics simulations

rows.name: Milky Way TD SURVIVORS AUTOBATTLER RTS: Earth
rows.short_description: Milky Way is a unique mix of Tower Defense, RTS, Auto-Battler and Survivors. Build your base, choose random upgrades and use powerful skills to survive against hordes of enemies.
rows.description_html: Full Game About the Game Milky Way is a mix of Tower Defense, RTS, Auto-Battler and Survivors genres. Visit planets in the Milky Way Galaxy and protect them against hordes of enemies. Milky Way: Earth is a demo version of the game, where 1 of 4 maps, 9 of 11 towers and 3 of 5 skills are available. BUILD YOUR BASE Develop your economy: gather stone with mines and gold with furnaces. Strengthen your defenses: use collected resources to build towers to fight off the enemies. Towers are divided into two types: some of them summon units, while others attack enemies. Some of the summoned units are perfect in order to distract enemies against themselves and protect other towers. Remember that the good placement of the towers is the key to victory. USE SKILLS Gather mana with pylons and spend it on powerfull skills. You can summon a giant meteor, shoot with orbital gun or unleash a starfall on your enemies. Use everything to win! SURVIVE! There're over 40 types of enemies in the game, some of them have dangerous abilities. Can you survive against all of them? FEATURES Dynamic and engaging gameplay A variety of gameplay styles 11 towers with their own abilities 4 maps with unique atmosphere Multitude of upgrades to choose from

rows.name: Block Tower TD 2: Prologue
rows.short_description: Block Tower TD 2 is a strategic game in the roguelike style with original innovations. Build worlds from blocks, choose random upgrades, each game will be unique.
rows.description_html: Full Version About the Game Block Tower TD 2: Prologue is just a part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version of the game. In the prologue, 2 maps, part of the towers and upgrades are available. Block Tower TD 2 is a strategic game in the roguelike style with original innovations. Build worlds from blocks, choose random upgrades, each game will be unique. Build the World! Unleash your potential in creating defensive strategies, playing in a world where every block is important for your defense. Create unique tactics by placing blocks in the right places. Build the Towers Tower placement is a key aspect in Tower Defense games. Especially in Block Tower: build them on elevations, leave space for resources, cleverly combine blocks. Each tower has an experience bar: the earlier it is built, the stronger it becomes at the end of the game. Skilful tower placement will make your defense stronger and more efficient. Choose Upgrades The sequence of upgrades plays a crucial role in progressing through each stage. Optimize your strategy based on resources, magical towers, or fortified defense. The random block generation, combined with tactical decisions, gives the game almost endless replayability. Harvest Resources Develop your economic strategy wisely. Early investment in economic buildings can be risky but will provide a significant advantage in the end. The random distribution of resources in each game creates new strategic challenges, requiring your creative approach and decision-making skill.

rows.name: Asterball
rows.short_description: Enter the galactic gridiron field as a Sportsman to beat your opponents in the fast-paced sport of Asterball. Play in a PVP setting where two teams battle it out in the field to see who can win with the most touchdowns.
rows.description_html: Asterball is an online third-person sports game where you play as a Sportsman on one of two teams in a game of gridiron, with a unique twist. Levels Asterball contains multiple different levels, each with their own unique gameplay elements. Battle it out in the classic Starfield, which takes you back to the basics. Or compete in the Warpgate, which challenges the players with limited platforms and portals. Items Each Sportsman can gain points during gameplay from various tasks, such as scoring touchdowns or tackling other players. These points ca be used to gain advantageous items to help. Items only last for the round, but can help gain an edge on the opponent in different ways. The Sportsman can purchase the electrifying Lightning Rod to gain a huge increase in speed, or can play on the offensive with the Pulse Bomb, causing targets to be knocked back.

rows.name: Crowd Diver
rows.short_description: Crowd Diver is an asymmetrical stealth multiplayer game where you can immerse yourself in the role of the Seeker, tasked with protecting the city from impending evil. Alternatively, you can become the Monster, seeking to wreak destruction and eliminate targets disguised.
rows.description_html: Dive into Crowd Diver, an asymmetrical social detective stealth multiplayer game where you can immerse yourself in the role of the Seeker, tasked with protecting the city from impending evil. Alternatively, you can become the Monster, seeking to wreak destruction and eliminate targets disguised. FEATURES Seeker Bind-Rod The Bind Rod is a powerful weapon in Crowd Diver's armory. The Seeker use this weapon to capture monsters. Security Consoles There are four consoles placed across the city. Activate them to reduce the targets visibility to the monster. Be cautious, as they can counter-hack the consoles! Monster Kill Mechanic Three targets are added for each monster that enters the game. They were highlighted through the map. Kill them when you are in distance! Quick Change Change your appearance as quickly as possible when you think you've lost the Seeker with the Quick Change mechanic. Environment Interactive World Use doors and teleporter to move quickly to other parts of the map. Futuristic Map The map presents itself as a unique environment in the futuristic style of Solarpunk. With its innovative design and captivating atmosphere, it offers players a visually impressive setting for their adventures. ABOUT US This game was created as part of a student project during our third semester at the School for Games in Hamburg, developed over a period of 10 weeks!

rows.name: Viking Frontiers: Prologue
rows.short_description: Survival of your people - that's the only thing that matters. Become the leader of a newly founded Viking settlement and lead it to safety and glory. Gather, build, craft, hunt, raid and follow your Gods to endure hardships of nature and save your clan from violent destruction.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the North A series of unfortunate events has brought you to an unknown shore, and it is your task to transform it into your new home and fortress. Can you unite the remnants of your clan? Can you withstand the challenges of nature? And most importantly, will you prove worthy of the honorable title of Jarl? The fate of your people rests on your shoulders… Viking Frontiers Features A deep, extensive survival system Immersive simulation features, including crafting, building, hunting, expeditions and many, many more Management of clansmen’s needs, laws, activities and living conditions Beautiful, realistic graphics that allow you to experience everything from a first-person perspective Numerous quests, random events, day and night system Addictive gameplay steeped in an authentic Viking vibe and awesome sound effects Your people need you Know that your newly formed settlement will face many challenges and difficulties. You, as its leader, must learn to recognize the most favorable opportunities and the greatest threats. It's entirely up to you, whether you choose to follow the path of the hunter, farmer, priest, builder, or any mixture of them all. Discover your own ways of survival and master a host of useful skills to tame this wild, dangerous land. Feel the thrill of survival Viking Frontiers combines the best elements of RPG, Survival, Simulation, and Strategy genres to provide you with an absolutely unique gaming experience. If you choose so, you can delve into the main story, explore the in-game world, or focus on side quests or your other favorite activities. Jump right into the misty tale straight from the Viking sagas and enjoy varied, highly replayable gameplay. Stay up to date Be sure to join our community to show off your settlement and exchange the tales about your deeds with other Viking Frontiers players. Become a member of the clan and join our Discord server, where we regularly host interesting events and engaging competitions. To always stay up to date, follow our Social Media channels. See you there, Jarl!

rows.name: Battle Room Beta
rows.short_description: Join the action-packed world of BATTLE ROOM BETA! Jump into the game right away, no preparation required! Explore different maps, team up with your friends and dominate the competition by making best use of the unique features of your chosen character!
rows.description_html: BATTLE ROOM BETA offers an immersive online multiplayer TPS shooter experience, completely free as a beta version. No daily maintenance, installation or complex configuration required: Just start the game! As simple as opening a door, incredibly easy to get into the action! Non-stop adrenaline-filled excitement awaits you in different battle rooms where 2 teams will face each other! Players will be able to enjoy high-quality graphics even on very low-end devices! KEY FEATURES Limited edition characters with unique abilities for the beta version, but with fairly balanced gameplay. 2 different levels that present familiar objects and interesting environments for exploration. Continuous weapon discoveries and utilization for strategic advantage. Cross-platform playability between PC and mobile devices, supporting multiple languages. FUTURE UPDATES In the near future, BATTLE ROOM will introduce: 2 additional game modes. Over 10 new levels and 20 additional characters for expanded gameplay. Character customization options for personalization. Features like ranking systems, achievements, and new items for enrichment. A diverse array of unique weapons to unlock and master. New abilities like climbing and dodging bullets.

rows.name: The Monarch: First Light
rows.short_description: Will you be the savior to purify this land? The Monarch is a lane-defense game where you control a monarch, expand your kingdom, and defend against evil by strategically managing gold resources, recruiting diverse units, and exploring a world filled with mythical threats.
rows.description_html: Full Release About the Game The Monarch is a Kingdom-like strategy game that has minimalistic control & smooth gameplay with power-up aspects. The gates of hell open each night, terrorizing the land. As the player, you must find a way to destroy the gates and defend your lands in the process! Gather coins, recruit peasants, train units, build powerful structures, gain power-ups, and adapt! Can you bring peace to the land? New Player Tips If you take a hit, you lose a coin. Hold a few extra coins in your pouch just to be safe! Build and upgrade your walls as soon as possible! Try to recruit at least 1 peasant every day! The forest is dangerous at night; watch out!
