rows.name: Real Life
rows.short_description: Survive the dungeon and return to the tavern with your loot to venture further — or die alone and lose it all.
rows.description_html: 🧩 Welcome to the world of Real Life You wake up in a dark dungeon-labyrinth. Your goal is to find the key, defeat the boss, and move on to the next level — or return to the tavern with your loot and grow stronger. The deeper you go, the more dangerous your enemies become… but the greater the rewards. If you die, you lose everything. You'll respawn at the nearest tavern, penniless. Your journey is to uncover the truth about this place... and whether it even has a bottom. ⚠️ Remember: the most dangerous enemy in the dungeon is another **player**. 🎮 The game is being developed in two main stages: **Roguelike** and **MMORPG**. 1️⃣ **Roguelike** is based on procedurally generated dungeons. I'll be adding all core mechanics and dungeon modes. Once everything is in place and class/build balance (including PvP) is tuned, I’ll move on to MMORPG development. 2️⃣ **MMORPG** will be built on top of the Roguelike base, but progress will not carry over. Essentially, it will be two games in one client — the second featuring an open world, sieges, node systems, and city management. 🎭 Atmosphere & Inspiration Inspired by anime like **Sword Art Online** and other survival-in-dungeon stories. Also by LitRPG novels like **'Moonlight Sculptor'**, **'Dragon's Heart'**, and more. Game inspirations include **Ragnarok**, **Lineage 2**, **Aion**, **Diablo**, **The Witcher**, **The Elder Scrolls**, and **Elden Ring**. 🔮 The Vision I'm making this game **for myself** — my dream game. I’m disappointed with the modern game industry chasing trends and casualization. I want to create a true **hardcore old-school experience** — where you don't just play the game, you live in it. In this world, you’ll find friends, enemies, maybe even love. Join guilds, meet teammates in real life. You can go solo, or team up with a friend… but beware — **your friend might shoot you in the back and steal your loot**. You might run into another group deep in the dungeon. You could kill them and take everything. Or negotiate, pay a fee, or team up to defeat the boss… but what happens after is up to you. What matters is knowing **when to stop** — kill the boss, get back to the tavern, trade your loot, and grow stronger. Now you and your friends, fully geared, are ready to go even deeper. Here, death means **losing everything** — and maybe even your friends. 🩺 I’m a healer In every game, I’ve always played support. (Yes, I’m a good healer 😉) I also love crafting. These elements will get special attention. Healers are team players. I’ll be aiming for a balance where **a disorganized team of strong players will lose to an average team with good synergy**. There will be a place for solo players too — but it will require **serious skill**. Teamplay will be a core focus — but choose your teammates wisely: **friendly fire is enabled**. Difficulty-wise, the game will feel like a **Souls-like**. 💰 Will there be Pay2Win? Everyone defines Pay2Win differently. Personally? **I hate it**. Since I’m making this for myself, here’s the current monetization plan (subject to change): - 🎮 The game will be **free-to-play**, if I can successfully combat cheating and botting. - 💳 There will be a **subscription**, purchasable for real money or in-game currency ('Core'). Subscription may include: - x2 “Core” drop — local monster loot currency (1 per kill) - +10–20% carry weight - Extra storage or personal tavern room - Cosmetic items - Increased item drop chance 🎁 Most importantly: the subscription will be **tradable for in-game currency (Core)**. So a player can buy it for $5 and sell it to another player for Core — **players will set the price**. ❌ What **won’t** be in the shop: - Items generated out of thin air (no stat gear, no Core currency, no consumables). 📊 Development Budget - 💸 Budget as of 13.02.2024: **~$3,300** - Target cost for Roguelike version: **$5,000**, max **$10,000** - Server cost: stable 5k–10k online = at least **$35,000** - More players = more server cost 📆 Development started: **June 2023** 🎯 Planned release of Roguelike version: **June 2025** 🧑‍💻 I'm a full-time **sysadmin**, working on the game in my free time. If community support reaches **$1,000/month**, I’ll quit and go full-time on the game. 💬 Join the Discord server! Report bugs, give feedback, and help shape the game ❤️

rows.name: Unlock the Three
rows.short_description: Unlock the Three is about a Police,Medic,Security Worker and a Father trying to escape from a Monster in locked hospital. Each survivor has its own unique skills to perform and survivors must be collaborate with each other to be able to escape.
rows.description_html: Unlock the Three: A Horror Escape Game This game can be played in single-player mode or with 2 to 5 players online. Story: Unlock the Three tells the story of four characters trapped in a hospital overrun by a mysterious monster. These characters are: The Police Officer: Strong and brave, they can lead the way in difficult situations. The Medic: With medical knowledge and skills, she can treat the wounded. The Security Guard: He knows the hospital's passages and security systems. The Father: A devout man of faith, he can use his faith to protect the others and ward off the monster. Gameplay: The game is played with a team of four players, each controlling one character. One additional player takes control of the monster. Monster: The monster must use its cunning to hunt its prey and hinder the survivors. Survivors: The survivors must progress through the hospital by finding keys and escaping the monster. Each character has their own unique set of skills that they must use together to survive. Character Abilities: The Police: They can use their pistol flashlight to see around and protect themselves and others from monsters. The Medic: She can heal the wounded and revive the fallen. The Priest: He can use his faith to protect the other survivors from the monster. He can hold up a cross to repel the monster and give the others a chance to escape. He can also bless the other survivors to clear their minds. The Security Guard: He can watch the building from cameras and guide the others. Features: A tense and atmospheric experience Five unique playable characters (including the Monster) Team-based gameplay Unlock the Three is an exciting game that combines horror, mystery, and teamwork. Can you work together with your friends to escape the monster and survive the hospital? About the Developer: Unlock the Three is created by a solo indie developer, dedicated to crafting unique and immersive gaming experiences. As a solo developer, I have put a lot of effort into this game, but there might be some issues or bugs. I apologize for any inconvenience and appreciate your understanding and support.

rows.name: Enter The Lost Chamber
rows.short_description: Explore dungeons, battle hordes of monsters, and defy fate in “Enter The Lost Chamber,” an action-packed pixel art roguelike. Discover new challenges, collect powerful weapons, and prepare to face the final boss at any time. Dive into the darkness!
rows.description_html: Delve into the unforgiving darkness of ' Enter The Lost Chamber ', a pixel art roguelike that challenges you to explore deadly dungeons infested with supernatural monsters. Armed with an arsenal of varied weapons, face hordes of zombies, bats, and other abominations in a never-ending fight for survival. Each descent into the depths offers new surprises and unique challenges, while the possibility of facing the final boss at any time adds constant tension. Delve into the darkness, collect mysterious artifacts, and become the master of shadows in “ Enter The Lost Chamber ”. Throw yourself into a cycle consisting of a series of three dungeons . Each cycle completed presents a unique challenge and formidable enemies to face. Each cycle completed is more difficult than the previous one thanks to new enemies, new behaviors, and increased difficulty. At the end of each dungeon, an epic boss awaits, ready to test your skills and strategy. Defeat is not an option, as failing erases the player's progress. Find, mix and upgrade over 25 items . Change weapons radically changing your experience by discovering hidden rooms. Explore the dungeons and discover them all! Reroll the wheel of luck in exchange for a few crystals to hope to find the item you need! Face more than 10 different monsters some of which have visual and behavioral changes as you progress through the cycles. 3 memorable and unique bosses challenging your skills, your reflexes and your strategy you can't wait to face and stop your progress. Deathkeeper , the powerful final boss of Enter The Lost Chamber , is accessible from the start of the game. Go without equipment if you dare or perform cycles to gain power before this epic encounter.

rows.name: Dungeon Full Dive: Player Edition
rows.short_description: Embark on your TTRPG adventures for free with DFD: Player Edition, where your fantasies come to life. Create up to three heroes, design your own maps, and dive into a world of adventure. The Player Edition is your gateway to an ever-expanding universe of TTRPGs.
rows.description_html: Game Master? Upgrade to Game Master Edition! Unlock session hosting, advanced GM tools, and exclusive content. JOIN OUR DISCORD Join our Discord community to keep updated with the latest Dungeon Full Dive news and meet other adventurers! About the Game Start Your Epic Tabletop Adventure 'DFD: Player Edition' is the most immersive way to play any tabletop RPG FOR FREE. Features of the 'Dungeon Full Dive: Player Edition': Play TTRPG Online: Dive into TTRPG sessions as a player. Play together with your friends or with new people you meet online. Character Editor: Bring your hero to life with our character editor. Create up to 3 unique characters to embark on your adventures. Map Builder: Unleash your creativity with our map editor. Design up to 2 unique TTRPG maps to explore. Plus, gain access to all DFD maps. Explore the GM Tools: Get a taste of ALL of DFD's GM tools, including soundboards and dynamic weather systems, designed to enhance storytelling. Available in offline mode. Jump into an adventure with your friends or build an entirely new party with random travelers, whether it’s using a mouse and keyboard or in VR. And, of course, cross-play is supported between PC Players and VR Players! Play any tabletop RPG that you want. Create and modify your character sheets and notes in-game. Furthermore, DFD includes game mechanics and stat integration for 5e. That means that things like initiative tracking can easily be done with just a click of a button! Place your characters or even monsters, then switch into their view to experience the adventures from their eyes. For the first time ever, interact with the tabletop adventures of your dreams: Drink in the tavern, play some instruments in the city market, or explore the dark forests. You can adapt, choose, or even create your own battle maps. DFD offers a variety of lovingly handcrafted 3D maps for you to use for your adventures or to modify with our map editor, where you can also create your maps from scratch! Choose your battles, whether it’s in the icy depths of the mountains or in an underground cave. Build an army of miniatures using DFD’s powerful character editor! Create your heroes and use our powerful customization system to make all of them unique: Be whoever -or whatever- you want to be. Join our Discord community to keep updated with the latest Dungeon Full Dive news and meet other adventurers!

rows.name: TESD: Into the Vortex
rows.short_description: After performing a mock-ritual during the 2017 Halloween podcast, Baron Von Flanagan unknowingly unleashed a power long since sealed and thrust all of TESD Town into another dimension. Take control of Bry, Walt, and Q as they venture into the vortex in an attempt to save all of TESD Town!
rows.description_html: TESD: Into The Vortex is an old school 2D pixel art style RPG game where players control a party consisting of Bryan Johnson, Walt Flanagan, and Brian Quinn. Players will fight enemies, complete quests, upgrade gear, and solve riddles. This game was developed as a solo project and total playtime should run a couple hours max.

rows.name: Winnie-The-Pooh Taste Test
rows.short_description: Platform through a Winnie-The-Pooh picture book. Use your reaction skills and abilities to fight creatures, explore new areas, and collect honey!
rows.description_html: Explore! Run, jump, and fight through a world inspired by the classic Winnie-The-Pooh picture books. Meet new characters and creatures as you overcome platforming and combat challenges. Collect all the honey you can find to unlock new areas and mini games. Game Features Classic platforming. Combat with four directional attacks. Dashing and wall jumping. Combat areas. Eeyore. This game is a short experience showing off the mechanics and feel of a Winnie-The-Pooh platformer.

rows.name: Victim Complex: Part 1
rows.short_description: Use your wits and iconic ghost hunting equipment to uncover the mystery of what happened to the residents of an abandoned apartment complex in this narrative-driven horror experience.
rows.description_html: Victim Complex: Part 1 is an early Demo for the upcoming full game release, scheduled for Q4 2025. Search Steam for Victim Complex to add the Full Game to your wishlist, see more demos, and get updates on progress! Victim Complex is a first person, narrative-driven horror experience. Play as hack medium Jack Lognare, who has stumbled on his first legitimate haunting. Will you try to help the spirits trapped in the haunted apartment complex, or will you rush to save yourself before whatever killed them gets you too? Use Iconic Equipment Use iconic ghost-hunting equipment to find and communicate with the lingering spirits in an abandoned apartment complex. Uncover the Mystery Follow the spirits' clues to discover what happened to the deceased tenants. Stay Alive Whatever killed the tenants is still here... can you avoid it and escape with your life? The Story Hack medium Jack Lognare has a specialty: 'cleansing' haunted locations so that they can be fixed up and sold without the stigma they once had in their communities. When he is hired to exorcise the spirits in an apartment complex in rural Wisconsin, he expects to find the same thing he usually does: nothing. But when he arrives, he discovers that this time, the rumors may actually be true, and he has found his first legitimate haunting. Initially thrilled to use his phony 'ghost hunting equipment' for real, he soon learns that the malicious Entity that supposedly killed all the residents may be real as well... and it doesn't plan on letting him leave so easily. Each chapter will have multiple endings; will Jack help the trapped spirits along the way and get the true answers, or focus on getting out as quickly as possible before he shares their fate? You decide how Jack will fare, in Victim Complex.

rows.name: Destiny Online
rows.short_description: Destiny Online is a 2D Fantasy MMORPG and offers free-to-play access. Pet System: Capture monsters, make them pets, and have them aid you in combat. Character Dressing up System: Freely DIY your favorite style with hairstyles, headwear, clothes, back accessories, and tails.
rows.description_html: Destiny Online is a 2D Fantasy MMORPG developed by Destiny10.com and offers free-to-play access. The game's most interesting feature is its in depth pet system. Players can capture practically any enemy in the game and customize their growth as they level up. The experience rate in game is fast paced, so players should be able to complete all of the newbie quests and have themselves nicely equipped within an hour or so after creating their character. FEATURES 1. Pet System: Capture monsters, make them pets, and have them aid you in combat. 2. Character Dressing up System: Freely DIY your favorite style with hairstyles, headwear, clothes, back accessories, and tails. 3. Marriage System: Experience romance and adventure with your loved ones. 4. Master / Apprentice System: Ally your character with a Master while leveling for added benefits. 5. Weapon Crafting: Craft supreme weapons with your name on them, and add gems to refine them with added bonuses. The game's five playable classes are: Warrior – Their key attributes are Strength and Vitality. They are the primary melee oriented character in Destiny Online and are capable of dealing large amounts of physical damage. They enjoy the highest HP in the game and high physical attack power. Swordman – Their key attributes are Strength and Stamina. They are capable of dealing of dealing long-range physical attacks. They use long swords and other weapons which have a long reach. They are very similar to Warriors. Mage – Their key attribute is Intelligence. They are the primary offensive spell casting class in Destiny Online. They have low HP but can devastating amounts of damage with their spells. Taoist – Their key attributes are Intelligence and Spirit. They play a lot like mages, except their spells curse their opponents rather than lots of damage. They rely more on their pets than other classes. Priest – Their key attribute is spirit. They are a supportive class capabable of both buffing their team mates as well as healing them.

They have low HP but can devastating amounts of damage with their spells. Taoist – Their key attributes are Intelligence and Spirit. They play a lot like mages, except their spells curse their opponents rather than lots of damage. They rely more on their pets than other classes. Priest – Their key attribute is spirit. They are a supportive class capabable of both buffing their team mates as well as healing them.

rows.name: The Bright Star Of Seraph-Katis-
rows.short_description: 《The Bright Star Of Seraph-Katis-》is a short text adventure game. This game combines a visual novel and an 'adventure mode'.
rows.description_html: Sorry! this game does not have English subtitles yet. Story: ——This is a story about a boy and a girl. Ten years ago, the boy lost his memory and also lost his memory about her. ——A very important memory for him. With the help of a doctor in biological brain science, the boy embarked on a journey to regain memory fragments. Where is this place? What happen in this world? He woke up in a mysterious laboratory. He met a girl with horns on her head. …… The vague memories gradually came to mind. But…… Features: ◆ A simple short story（ ◆ With traditional 4:3 resolution（ ◆ 'Adventure Mode' for exploration ◆ A normal ending and a hidden ending Staff: ◆ Script：Auiy ◆ Illustration：Auiy ◆ Background music：Auiy ◆ Theme song：优莉酱 To players: This game is the first game I made and I realized my dream. I am the only game developer, and the theme song is composed by a friend. All the materials used in the game are original materials (without AI or materials borrowed from others), so I spent a long time learning and producing these materials. rows.name: Foobar Zero
rows.short_description: Foobar Zero is a fast-paced multiplayer shooter game, with anime characters. Customize your characters with various outfits, create your own loadout with futuristic guns and swords, and dominate your enemies with superior movement!
rows.description_html: Fast paced action, with dynamic movement such as walljumps and dodges 6v6 team based PvP, or 12 player free for all Customizable loadout, with 3 weapons 3 skill slots Multiple gamemodes Anime aesthetic Customizable outfits for your character Futuristic virtual world Foobar Zero is set in a world where the virtual reality has reached such a level, where it is possible to fully immerse and control your game avatar. In this game, you are controlling such an avatar, and combatting other players in a simulation. The area of the combat is replicated from old records, currently available locations, and even fictional locations, like an alien ship! Check out the in-game shop where you can purchase various outfits for your character! You can mix them together however you want, and choose the color you like, to express your own style. These are pure cosmetics and doesn't affect the gameplay to keep it balanced. You won't last long if you stand still. Use the covers, dodge the attacks, and walljump your way to victory! Practice your skills on the different maps, to learn all the jumps and tricks you can do. Nobody will be able to stop you! With the various melee weapons in game, you can find your favourite. Do you prefer faster attacks? Power Katana is the perfect one for you! Are you more tactical, you want to wait around the corner, or predict your enemy's movement? Rocket Fists will deliver powerful attacks but each one has to be charged up. Try them all out, and you will find what is best for you! Each loadout have 3 skills. One passive, one active, and one ultimate. Ultimates need to be charged up, but when it's usable, they have high impact. Use Bubble Shield to protect your party from any damage, or Tornado, to demolish anyone close to the impact! Return to the roots of multiplayer gaming! Create your own room, select game mode, map, and other settings, and start your own game! Play multiple rounds with the same people if you want, or choose a different, the choice is in your hands!

rows.name: Molementum
rows.short_description: Molementum is a 3D party action game where you assume the role of a mole criminal to rob mines of their precious gems. Grab up to 3 friends and scramble your way through mines while engaging in various acts of competitive mischief as you try to become the most notorious mole criminal.
rows.description_html: Get ready for a Heist Party! Molementum is a 3D party action game where you assume the role of a mole criminal to rob mines of their precious gems. Grab up to 3 friends and scramble your way through industrial mines engaging in various acts of competitive mischief as you try to become the most notorious mole criminal. Upgrade yourself between rounds with different abilities that will extend your nefarious arsenal to complete constantly changing objectives. Battle your friends! Compete with up to three other players online in the ultimate heist party. Outsmart and outmaneuver your friends in order to collect the most gems! Gain molementum! Move around by swapping between digging and rolling - dig for fast reactive movement that can allow you to burrow up underneath your fellow moles to attack, or use the momentum of a roll to gain even more speed and become an unstoppable fireball that grows in reach with your speed. Upgrade your mole! Unlock a bevy of unique and wacky upgrades between rounds of play. Take to the skies, stun other players, and summon otherworldly buddies to your command. Changing challenges! Players will face different objectives round to round that tie into an evolving story. Collect the most soda, fight to stay on camera, and fight each other!

rows.name: Mid-Death Crisis
rows.short_description: Mid Death Crisis is a strategic, turn-based couch co-op game designed for three players. Harness, empower, and strategically redirect spells to your comrades, enhancing your collective strength!
rows.description_html: Mid Death Crisis: A strategic, turn-based couch co-op game for three players. Command skeletal minions aiding Zeborius Zelgon, a lich battling the amphibious Rana Empire. Redirect Zeb's waning magic to empower allies, conquer foes, and reignite his evil fervor amidst a cryptic adventure. Strategic Collaboration Mid Death Crisis is a strategic, turn-based couch co-op game designed for three players. Play with two friends to strategically redirect, and empower the lackluster spells sent out by Zeb. Each of the three players commands a skeleton with a unique set of skills, adept at their own tasks. Just one can’t take on an army, but with many your might can grow to even surpass that of the Lich himself! Unique Roles Each of the three skeletons, the Zealot, Thief, and Warrior, have learned abilities from Zeb. The zealot is a master of damage, amplifying spells to the fullest of their potential with deranged genius. The thief is all about positioning, a magic-juggling aficionado who never misses their target. The warrior is a master crowd controller. Choose your favorite and work directly with your teammates and discover which loadouts mesh well with others to perfectly defeat the waves of enemies that come your way! A Lich Who Lost His Way Embarking on this adventure, players take command of skeletal minions serving Zeborius Zelgon, a once-powerful lich now plagued by sorrow. Zeb's crypt has fallen under the invasion of The Rana Empire, a formidable species of frogs intent on claiming his domain. As Zeb's sorrow saps his magical abilities, players, serving as his most loyal minions, must harness, empower, and strategically redirect his spells to their comrades, enhancing their collective strength. By overcoming hordes of frog enemies, escorting Zeb through his crypt, and rekindling his malevolent passion for evil, players confront the trials of the Mid Death Crisis.

rows.name: 1000 Cuts: Jomaku
rows.short_description: A challenging 2D action platformer with brutal one-hit-kill combat, consequential choices, and a lore-rich story set in the dark fantasy world of Kurogawa, Japan. Inspired by Sekiro and Blasphemous, Jomaku is a free preview of One-Thousand Cuts, 'raising the curtain' for the full game coming soon!
rows.description_html: ⛩️ WISHLIST AND FOLLOW THE FULL GAME ⛩️ 🏯 FOLLOW ON KICKSTARTER 🏯 About the Game Jomaku (除幕) 'Curtain-raiser' a short act or monologue to introduce a longer kabuki play. A preview. 1000 Cuts: Jomaku is a 60-90 minute proof of concept experience of One-Thousand Cuts, with a short tutorial, plenty of exploration (over a dozen hidden pettable cats, an optional boss, bonus lore drops, three alternative video modes), unlockable upgrades, a three-phase final boss , and multiple endings based on which moral route you choose. Combine instant-death combat with unique special abilities and environmental hazards to devastate your enemies, or die trying. Strategize efficient solutions or overwhelm with brute force as your slice your way through the Army of One-Thousand , one cut at a time. Discover and fight a deadly collection of challenging bosses on your journey. Master each of their martial art styles to unleash powerful combat techniques on your enemies. If you can defeat them, that is. Find hidden lore throughout a rich, dark fantasy Edo Japan. connect the shattered pieces of this expansive world, inspired by real Japanese history and folklore. The time of the samurai is coming to an uncertain end. Exiled as a child by his father Hidetsugu , young Hiroyuki has grown up training at his Uncle Jiro's secluded dojo, hoping one day to prove himself worthy enough to return home. Now caught at the center of a hostile takeover within his clan, Hiro is torn between loyalty and honor. Hiro has to choose: side with his father and kill his friends and Uncle Jiro - the only real family he's ever had - or side with Uncle Jiro and attempt to face down the fearsome army under his father's control. It only takes one cut to kill, but what is one man against the Army of One-Thousand?

rows.name: ARC TCG
rows.short_description: ARC TCG is a strategic 3D card game set in a fantasy universe with over 350 cards and 15 heroes. Build your deck and engage in battles with an automatic combat system, where every choice and every move determines victory. Get ready to forge your legend
rows.description_html: ARC TCG is a strategic 3D card game set in a fantasy universe full of magic and challenges. Choose your hero, build unique decks with over 350 cards, and engage in intense battles with an automatic combat system that challenges your strategy and planning, in single-player and multiplayer modes. With more than 15 heroes to choose from, every game is different. Every decision makes a difference, every move can change the course of the battle. The semi-automatic component means that the player can focus exclusively on when and how they can play one or more cards. Creatures on the battlefield will attack automatically, however, the many abilities the game offers can turn the fate of combat around. The order of attack always starts from left to right. Creatures that fight take damage equal to their attack value, and fighting happens most of the time when two creatures are facing each other (except for dedicated abilities that alter this behavior). Combat is therefore very simple, immediate, but at the same time it offers a very high strategic depth, as the position of the cards on the battlefield determines the order of attack, which can be altered, however, thanks to the presence of some card abilities. Each creature has a default set of abilities up to a maximum of 4 per creature. Each ability is unique and always offers new strategies, and combining certain abilities also makes it possible to create powerful combos. The game offers more than 50 abilities. Some of them are present only in specific factions because they are strongly contextualized, while others are shared in most creatures because they are more generic. Each ability activates according to certain conditions: summoning, destruction, end/ start of turn, etc., thus increasing the strategic depth of the game Each Hero has a specific ability, activated only 1 time per turn and under certain conditions. Take advantage of their characteristics with the available cards to increase your chances of victory. There are more than 15 heroes in the game, offering more than 15 different and unique play styles! Trigger conditions make their abilities play out in a reasoned manner further increasing the strategic depth of the game Play with 3 different factions: Humans Nature Dimensional Each faction brings with it a unique abilities set, heroes, and cards, offering new game strategies Singleplayer: Relaxed : play without worrying about scores or leaderboards. Test to your decks and try pre-built ones. Standard : play with your decks by challenging different levels of AI, gain experience and rewards Draft : play by choosing a random pair of cards from the two proposed until you build your deck Ranked : play against AI, win games, climb the rankings and earn rewards at the end of the season Infinity Tower : play against the AI in a series of matches where your hero's health persists between matches. Can you conquer all the floors of the Tower? Dark Maze : Play against the AI with one of the three decks available and choose the right paths through the maze. Pass through the rooms, defeat the bosses of the various realms, and reach the end of the maze. Can you become the Lord of the Dark Maze? Multiplayer: Private : play vs another player in a private match, test your decks or play with pre-built ones Standard : play vs another player in public match, win rewards based on opponent 'strenght' League : play against another player and climb the leaderboard, advance in rank and get new rewards In addition, the game in its current state offers: 3 playable Factions +350 unique cards +50 unique abilities +15 Heroes 9 pre-built decks Deck Editor : Create/Edit your decks and share them with the community! Progression System Online Services Ranked matches Singleplayer Seasons Sound Effects High Quality graphics Multiplayer

rows.name: Meteor Havok
rows.short_description: Meteor Havok is a take on the classic Asteroids arcade shooter. Enter the asteroid fields to blast a path to safety with your agile ship and powerful lasers.
rows.description_html: Jump into the asteroid fields to make space safe from random collisions. Overview: Fly your ship through fields of asteroids, and others objects, as you fire your laser blaster, change directions, even fly in reverse to avoid incoming objects. There are currently 6 random levels to play thru with random cycling between levels. Levels get progressively more difficult as you complete each level. As you play you can earn extra lives. Controls: Control your ship through simple keyboard controls or Gamepad in game. Autofire option added in version 1.4.1.

rows.name: [Test Subject Name]
rows.short_description: [Test Subject Name] is an FPS Platformer that sees you descend through layers of test chambers, fighting multitudes of robots along the way, using weapons taken from enemies, and coming in contact with intelligent machines that want you dead.
rows.description_html: [Test Subject Name] is an FPS Platformer that sees you descend through layers of test chambers, fighting multitudes of robots along the way, and coming in contact with intelligent machines that want you dead. Use your robotic implants and marksmanship to combat the hordes of hostile machines, and try to figure out if the voices you keep hearing through the speakers are friends or foes, or both. Keep swapping and dropping guns as they start to overheat, and decide whether to use a laser-powered sniper rifle or a radon-fueled minigun, or simply return to your trusty revolver.

rows.name: ReCoil
rows.short_description: ReCoil is a 2D Top-Down Shooter with a unique twist to it's genre. The recoil of your weapons launches you back.
rows.description_html: ReCoil is a 2D Top-Down Shooter with a unique twist to it's genre. Your armour is too heavy for you to manage, but you need it to survive. You will have to use the recoil of your weaponry to navigate each level. Gameplay: Recoil: The recoil acts as a double edge sword. It allows the player to have complete control in movement. However, when using your arsenal, it may become challenging to balance the need of ammunition for facing enemies, and escaping dangerous situations. When firing your weapon, your player character will be thrown directly behind him with a great amount of speed and acceleration. But this will use your depleting supply of ammunition, which will be needed to survive. There are also 3 different weapons in ReCoil, each with there own gimmicks and variations of knockback. This allows for even more freedom whilst playing. Levels: There will be 12 uniquely designed levels in ReCoil to play. Each level has a timer at the bottom of the screen counting down until the clock reaches 0, allowing progression to the next level. Some levels are not only harder to beat, but also require a larger period of time that the player needs to survive in before accessing the next level. ReCoil is a short, free game created by Sisyphus.

rows.name: Arcane Archer
rows.short_description: Arcane Archer is a 3D platforming FPS speedrun game where you must use explosive arrows to blast yourself across gaps and up walls to reach the goal! Use the power of your explosive arrows to parkour your way through an assortment of stages, and shoot for the top of the leaderboard!
rows.description_html: Arcane Archer's gameplay revolves around shooting and detonating explosive arrows to make your way through the game's 12 stages as fast as you can! Take on increasingly difficult levels, and then test your skill against the online leaderboard! Experiment with different strategies and routes to give yourself an edge! The game also features a build-in speedrun timer and level select to help you practice certain levels and become the best archer you can be!

rows.name: Chrono Recorder
rows.short_description: 'ChronoRecorder' is a 3D puzzle game. Players can manipulate time and gravity. And you have to use that ability to solve problems. You might think this game is difficult if you don't use your brain.
rows.description_html: The player is trapped in an unknown space. In the player's hands is a clock that controls time and a camera that controls the state of objects. Clocks can stop or slow down time. The camera can turn back time or change the gravity of an object. The player must use these two objects to clear the stage. This game was created by 4 developers. There are not many stages in the game, so please enjoy it lightly. (Maps may be added in the future. Good responses encourage developers.)

rows.name: The Dust of the Violet Crystals
rows.short_description: A flesh-eating dust leaves you to survive alone against hordes of Listless.
rows.description_html: The Story: After a flesh-eating dust blows through your small town you are left trying to survive alone against hordes of Listless humans. Starved for social interaction you find yourself questioning your sanity when a voice speaks directly into your mind begging for your help. Game Features: Navigate an apocalyptic world full of Listless humans while managing your health and toxin levels. Collect items and choose travel locations that you feel will most aid in your survival. Can you choose correctly and survive until you solve the mystery of the anonymous voice? Or will you fail and drag others down with you when you die? Multiple endings, and almost every choice will have some impact, sometimes immediately. Good luck! Excerpt: NARRATOR Huddling in the corner of our modest shop I can see them. I can see them through the glass, weaving to and fro as if only held upright by the merest of threads invisibly dangling from the hazy sky. The light that had previously consumed their retinas has faded to a dull glow. For hours I have hovered inside my shop. Waiting. Watching. My wife and I had chosen the reflective lettering on the glass of our shop in an attempt to catch the eyes of passerby to peruse our wares. I do not understand why, but it seems to confuse them. Almost immediately on turning to the glass the light in their eyes will fade, and they will either stand idly, waiting, or join the ranks of the others. A sudden scream shatters my thoughts and I slowly stand and walk toward the glass pane. A lone woman runs screaming through the street. YOU (horrified) No…No! NARRATOR As soon as I speak one of the Listless turns toward the window and I press myself against the wall in terror. It weaves to and fro in indecisive consternation, its ears aware of sound but the mirrored letters confusing its vision. After a few moments it turns back towards the woman. By the time I work up enough nerve to return to the glass and try to help, it is too late. But the Listless aren’t even the worst part. The dust. The dust is always worse.

rows.name: Mausoleum of Memories
rows.short_description: Mausoleum of Memories is a first-person 3D puzzle adventure game based on Egyptian Mythology. You play as the ghost of a man named Aaru who has been denied entrance to the afterlife and now must reflect on his human existence and any lessons he may have learned so he can finally rest in peace.
rows.description_html: Travel through an ancient puzzle-filled pyramid as the ghost of Aaru, a man who has been denied entry into the Egyptian afterlife for being neither good nor bad. The gods of the afterlife, Anubis and Osiris, have charged you with the task of reflecting on the life you led when you were alive to balance your soul on the Scales of Justice and gain entrance into the Field of Reeds, a place of eternal rest. You must investigate your tomb while thinking about your human life and the choices you made when you were alive in the hope that this act of reflection will lead to eternal peace. As a ghost, you cannot physically touch objects and thus must possess specific items, such as boxes and statues, to move them around and solve the puzzles. The fate of your soul hangs in the balance. Will you be able to earn your way into the afterlife? Explore an Egyptian pyramid filled with ancient statues and walls decorated with hieroglyphs. Solve puzzles based on various stages of your life and discover artifacts that may have meant something to you when you were alive. Play as a ghost and possess things like rotating statues and boxes and manipulate them to solve puzzles in an immersive environment. Enjoy a touching and reflective story with fully-voiced dialogue and multiple characters. Investigate your human life and ponder how the choices you made may have impacted the lives of others. Balance your soul on the Scales of Justice and earn entrance into the Field of Reeds where eternal peace and a restful afterlife await you.

rows.name: Operation Marakudja
rows.short_description: Mmm... It's Marakudjaaaa! Operation Marakudja is a dynamic multiplayer first-person shooter. What can you do for the divine fruits of Marakudja? Choose your hero and fight against many players around the world to collect the precious fruits and win!
rows.description_html: Follow me ! About the Game Operation Marakudja is a fast-paced FPS where you can play both in single player mode and with other players online. Choose your character and go on a heated battle for the incredibly delicious fruits of Marakudja! Each of the characters is armed with their own unique weapons. Hone your play style, find useful items and collect as many fruits as possible. Explore a variety of environments, from deserts to lush jungles and futuristic landscapes. Raid of Marakudja: Collect and steal Marakuji fruits from other players in this competitive mode where every loot counts. Destroy your opponents in exciting battles and try not to lose your loot to gain the upper hand over the other players. Marakudja Giant: Stand up to protect the Giant Marakudja and earn Marakudja every 5 seconds for as long as you hold it. Be vigilant, though, as your opponents will try to shoot you down to take control of the precious Giant Marakudja above your head. Balloons and Marakudja: This mode is all about survival. Protect your three balloons, which represent your lives, while collecting and stealing Marakudja from other players. If you lose your three balloons, you won't be able to reappear, so play smart to stay in the game. Unlock a multitude of costumes as you progress with your character, gaining levels and unlocking new appearances for ultimate customization.

rows.name: Bed and BEAKfast
rows.short_description: A DEMO of 'Sincerely, Robin' -- our upcoming management, cooking, and narrative game currently in development! Play as Robin and return to your hometown to regrow your late grandfather's bed and breakfast. Cook meals, connect with the community, and forge lasting relationships!
rows.description_html: Bed and BEAKfast is a DEMO of Sincerely, Robin , our upcoming management, cooking, and narrative game set in a world of birds! Play as Robin and return to your hometown to regrow the bed and breakfast left to you by your late grandfather. Cook meals for your guests, engage with the community, and forge lasting relationships with the birds that come to stay! The full game is currently in development! By downloading this DEMO, you can expect a proof of concept of the upcoming game. While traversing the tree, you will be able to interact with a variety of characters, create dishes to serve your guests, expand your B&B, and support your community. Follow our social media to keep up with our development journey!

rows.name: Jumping Steve
rows.short_description: Jumping Steve is a 2d arcade style indy casual roguelike game. Stay on the crows. Collect the thingys to increase your score so you can unlock stuff. MOD machine randomness. With over 2 Achievements. Power ups. 2 player. Lots of items. Visit Camp Aign. Not compatible with the gameboy camera.
rows.description_html: Jumping Steve is a 2d arcade style indy game with lots to discover. No tutorials, no cut scenes, very little reading, extremely fast loading times and lots of action. Features: 1. Fast arcade action. 2. Global leader boards. (No one has beaten the Dev yet and hes acting REAL smug about it) 3. Mini Games (And more planned). 4. Retro style with modern unique design. 5. Many achievements with hints throughout the game. 6. Several challenges for the hardcore gamer. 7. Simple gameplay with lots of stuff to do. 8. A longer description, WOW! Control Steve and jump to stay on the crows, collect the thingys and stay alive for as long as you can to increase your score. Complete random tasks and less random tasks like staying alive for 2 minutes to tick the boxes in your achievement list to increase the power of your log book. Unlock power ups in classic mode or use the M.O.D machine for some randomised madness. Its arcade style of play is perfect for taking in turns with friends. A score board so you know whos better. Player 2 can drop in or drop out at almost any time for some 2 player madness or go to the 2 player only VS mode. A 'unique' indie style of its own. Visit Camp Aign on the search for The Main Thingy and collect more Thingys. Find items like the Upgraded shirt to improve your jumping and score or other items to do other stuff. Over 25 minutes of original music to discover. Compatible with touch screen devices. The first game ever made by Steves Games. Created using Construct (The demo version is not up to date and has many bugs)

rows.name: My Little Cemetery
rows.short_description: Become the groundskeeper of a neglected graveyard. Find friends amongst the deceased, learn their stories, and give them a peaceful afterlife. Experience the juxtaposition of death in a cute and cozy atmosphere.
rows.description_html: My Little Cemetery seeks to juxtapose themes of death with a cute and cozy atmosphere. Become the new groundskeeper of the long-neglected Midwich Valley Cemetery and restore it to a state of beauty and tranquility. You'll find that some ghosts still linger there, and you can befriend them by tending to their graves, speaking with them, and fulfilling their requests. Complete daily maintenance tasks to earn money to spend on tools, seedlings, and decorations to beautify your cemetery. Grow plants to attract a variety of animals, allowing you to create a sanctuary for both ghosts and critters alike. By the end of your time here you can hope to learn the stories of the deceased and give them a peaceful afterlife, perhaps even gaining the attention of the Grim Reaper himself. EXPLORE THE GHOSTS STORIES AND BUILD CONNECTIONS. CUSTOMIZE THE GRAVEYARD TO YOUR LIKING. UNLOCK MORE CUSTOMIZATION OPTIONS.

rows.name: Altered Bloodlines
rows.short_description: A troubling missing persons case soon snowballs into an investigation of a shadowy criminal enterprise and vast conspiracies that even affect your own family. Will you be able to solve the mystery while protecting those dear to you? Will your fledgling romance survive full knowledge of your past?
rows.description_html: In Altered Bloodlines, you will play as a 37 year old FBI Agent based in Boston. You just rescued six kidnapped young women, with the help of your partner, Sarah, and a pair of BPD Detectives, Luke and Hannah, but the case is far from over. You will be drawn deep down the rabbit hole as you uncover vast conspiracies and a shadowy criminal enterprise previously believed to be nothing more than myth and legend and will have to rely on your friends, both old and new, to uncover the truth and protect those closest to you. Will your fledgling relationship with the lovely Luci survive all that you will experience and learn? Will you be able to protect all those close to you from harm? Only you can determine your ultimate fate as you search for the truth behind Altered Bloodlines. Experience a gripping story full of mystery, romance, and passion as you strive to close the largest and most labyrinthine case of your career.  FEATURES A gripping story in the visual novel format. Make choices to determine the path of the story and your relationships with several beautiful love interests. As you progress through the story, unlock sexy images of many of the gorgeous women of Altered Bloodlines and view them in the gallery. Experience steamy scenes with the captivating ladies of the game, unlocking them in the replay gallery. Earn Steam achievements as you make your way through the story. Additional chapters will be made available to purchase as affordable DLC as they are ready, expanding the story until it reaches its conclusion. MEET THE CHARACTERS THE MC, JAMES ACKERMAN James is the main character of our story. He’s a 37 year old FBI agent working out of the Boston office with his partner Sarah. The story begins with James waking up in the hospital after suffering an injury while rescuing several kidnapped young women, what turns out to only be the beginning of an epic case involving a vast criminal empire. You will take on the role of James and can rename him if you so choose. You will develop your relationship with the captivating young Luci as you begin the case, but will your budding romance survive everything you learn? LUCI COOPER Luci is an 18 year old Freshman at the Massachusetts College of Art and Design. She was the sixth kidnapping victim and you felt an undeniable connection to her the instant you saw her photo in the case file. SARAH LOCKWOOD Sarah is a 35 year old FBI agent and has been your partner for eight years. The two of you are extremely close and have had a friends with benefits situation going on for most of your time as partners. HAYLEIGH GRAHAM Hayleigh is one of Luci’s closest friends and a freshman and Boston University. HANNAH POWERS Hannah is a 33 year old former Army Ranger and current detective with the Boston Police Department. Since partnering with your close friend Luke Robinson, she has also become a good friend of yours. LUKE ROBINSON Luke is a 37 year old detective with the Boston Police Department. You met on a case shortly after you were assigned to the Boston office and have been close friends ever since.

rows.name: Final Dash
rows.short_description: Introducing Final Dash, the thrilling platformer where you'll embark on an adrenaline-fueled journey through stunning worlds! Jump into fast-paced challenges, create your own levels, and compete with friends. Are you ready to dash to victory?
rows.description_html: Welcome to Final Dash, the electrifying platformer that takes you on an unforgettable journey through extraordinary worlds! Dive into a fast-paced experience filled with unique obstacles and breathtaking landscapes. In Final Dash, not only will you face meticulously designed challenges, but you'll also have the chance to create your own levels using our intuitive editor. Unleash your creativity and build amazing worlds that will challenge your friends and the community at large! Explore captivating environments, from futuristic landscapes to vibrant fantasy realms. Each level is meticulously crafted to provide visually stunning experiences and engaging gameplay that will test your reflexes and skills. Moreover, in Final Dash, the community is at the heart of the experience. Share your creations with other players, play community-made levels, and compete for top scores on global leaderboards. The fun and excitement never end in Final Dash! Are you ready for the ultimate challenge? Get ready to run, jump, and soar to greatness in Final Dash!

rows.name: Path of the Tank
rows.short_description: Can you challenge oblivion itself?
rows.description_html: Path of the Tank is an action-RPG where you can only play as a tank. But why? Why a tank and nothing else? Find out in this linear, glorified flash game that is easy to pick up. It might remind you of a bygone era... Key mechanics of the game: -2 gamemodes to choose from: Campaign and Survival Mode! -Real time combat -Simple yet deep skill tree, with 5 powerful late-game options to freely choose -Hunger mechanic; scavenge for food to survive! -Fairly wide variety of enemies from different factions -Upgradeable armor, potions and weapons -Tons of secret areas that may contain more than simple loot -Basic experience earning system. Defeat enemies to earn xp! -Conversations with differents characters, some with a philosophical questioning. -Travel through different scenarios like dark crystalline caves, villages, ruins, dungeons, and, mostly, lushful forests! -Long boss fights (you're a tank, you will not do much damage!) -Multiple endings and cinematics -Terminals with lore and forgotten memories to relive Gameplay: Tanking the angered forces of nature is no easy task. While your resilience is impeccable, you're still a mortal being, and you will need all the tools you can get. Armor, potions, defensive spells, and even unique special objects or other sources to make yourself tankier are all very needed. Hordes of enemies will try to surround you, and will slowly but surely will try to tear you apart. The gameplay may be in real time, but is not fast paced. You will need to manage you health, hunger, mana and cooldowns of your abilities at a moderate pace. The best way to survive is to manage these resources accordingly. Survival Mode: A secondary, arcade gamemode where you fight enemy waves that become increasingly difficult! Your only breaks are right after 6 waves, that's when you can spend all your money to upgrade your gear! How far can you get? Story: Something went terribly wrong. Nature is completely altered; earth itself is coming to life, animals are scared and the spirits are restless. The balance of existence itself, which is key for the stability of life has been altered beyond recognition. It's not the first time that this has happened, and it won't be the last. The price that the rational and the non-rational beings are paying in this world is heavy. Will you be able to stop this disaster? Of course you can. Otherwise no story would be told. But you're here to discover a lot more than that. Remove the nightmares of the innocent beings in this land, tank. Travel the path. Eat the path. In every story, the path must be travelled. Heroes must do their part, otherwise, oblivion will take it all, leaving nothing in its path. Not even a single memory in the mind of thousands, alive and those who are not here yet. Fortunately for us, our mere natural existence makes all the difference in the world to shape it however we want. That's why we have to fight. One day, when you finally understand the implications of all of this, you will become a illuminated soul. The natural deterioration of the universe must be fought by the illuminated. Entropy is always present everywhere, so we have to be the ones who chose order. There's a lot of places to discover while traveling the path. Perhaps you could dig out some information out of your past too...? The hidden secrets in these lands are key to understand this world. You will have to hunt them down to discover what really happened! But most importantly... Can you challenge oblivion itself?

rows.name: Essence Bloom
rows.short_description: Essence Bloom is a linear, story-focused indie visual novel that allows the player to experience a world with beautiful cherry blossoms and fun times with friends....
rows.description_html: 'I will show you a path to happiness.' Essence Bloom is a linear story-focused Visual Novel that is centered around the MC (the player) living in a peaceful world where he spends time with friends: Hikari - Aka, 'The Sunshine Girl,' is always smiling and happy. In fact, she seems obsessed with it and wants everyone else to be as happy as she is. Yuna - She runs the coffee shop, is number one in her class, and still finds time to take care of her younger sister, Saeko. She's bossy and blunt, but she has a gentle heart deep down. Saeko - She is the opposite of her older sister, Yuna, in almost every way. She's clumsy, timid, and very reliant. She also seems confused most of the time and worries everyone, but she is well loved.  Kagome - She's a well-disciplined martial arts champion who will defend anyone she cares about, no matter the sacrifice. She can also, surprisingly, be a bit bashful. The friends spend their time in school studying, working at their local coffee shop, and doing fun activities. Everything is peaceful until things start to happen that threaten the serenity of this world... Features: A story-rich experience with aesthetic visuals, energetic characters, and ~4 hours of dialogue.  This game is meant for 18+ audiences. Some viewers may find the content disturbing or offensive.

rows.name: CloudStudy
rows.short_description: An online study room shared by players around the world. Those who work hard for their dreams are welcome to join.
rows.description_html: Find a Study Buddy CloudStudy is an innovative multiplayer game that blurs the lines between traditional learning and entertainment, creating a unique virtual learning and living community for global players. In this limitless virtual campus, you'll encounter like-minded individuals from around the world, exploring the vast ocean of knowledge and sharing the joy of learning together. Virtual Campus Upon entering CloudStudy, you'll step into a carefully designed virtual campus. Here, spacious classrooms await, where you can listen to lectures and interact with classmates from all over the globe. Cosy dormitories provide a place to rest and unwind, while vibrant gyms and game halls offer outlets for stress relief and physical exercise during breaks. Grow Together In CloudStudy, you'll never feel alone. Connect and interact with players from around the world, encouraging and supervising each other to maintain healthy schedules, work, and learning progress. We understand that staying motivated can be challenging when doing it alone, but in CloudStudy, you'll find companions who will walk alongside you on your journey. Learning Environment CloudStudy offers various smart assistance mechanisms to help you better plan your study and life. Feeling stiff after long hours of study? The reminder system will prompt you to take a break and move around, maintaining your optimal learning state. Want to organize your daily schedule? Our time management system allows you to easily set and track your plans. Enter the Focus Mode, where the screen dims, displaying a clock, while curated music accompanies you through each concentrated moment. Custom Decorations CloudStudy encourages creativity, allowing you to customize your space through the DIY mode. Whether it's your classroom seat or dormitory layout, you can decorate it according to your preferences. Maintaining a regular schedule and active participation will quickly earn you points, which can be redeemed for various ornaments and decorations, making your space uniquely and warmly yours. CloudStudy is not just a game; it's a vibrant learning and living community with endless possibilities. Here, you'll grow and progress alongside global players, experiencing the joy and sense of achievement that come from learning. Join us now! Embark on your new learning journey in CloudStudy!

rows.name: Earthling of Gaia
rows.short_description: Save your goddess Gaia from all incoming enemies by manipulating the earth around you!
rows.description_html: *******important note******* Learning the earthbending system used in this game is not easy. It is advised to focus while playing the tutorial. Also you should watch bending tutorial videos on my youtube channel. If you don't want to commit to this intense learning, then I do not recommend you to play this game. If you ignore this note, then you will complain, that the hitboxes don't work, while you don't even throw an attack on the enemy. This is my first finished and published game so far. Although I did my best, you should not expect AAA quality. *******important note******* Earthling of Gaia is played in the first person perspective in VR. It does count as action game, because the core game mode is to defeat waves of enemies. It's a simple wave defense game. It is important to know, that this game is just a small game. Your main weapon against the incoming enemies will be your earthbending skills. You can manipulate the earth around you by using the motion of your hands. Once an enemy is hit by a stone, he will be stopped. There is even waterbending. The goal of the game is to defend your precious goddess Gaia. You will win, if you stop all incoming waves. The game comes with different difficulty settings. If you are just here for role playing, you can play on easy mode. If you are here for a challenge, you can play on the impossible mode. There are many different ways how to use your earthbending skills! Watch the trailer for additional information about the earthbending system used in this game. About Me: I am a young solo developer. I developed this game in my free time, while working a full time job. I did not study game development. All my knowledge comes from online tutorials. Although I give my best to to deliver you the most impressive gaming experience, I cannot promise that I am able to fix all bugs or keep a high quality standard compared to other games. Technical Infos: This game can only be played with a virtual reality headset and associated controllers for each hand. The VR-device should have a joystick for moving. For Rotation the game supports snap turning.  There is only a single player mode.

rows.name: Ribbit Rampage
rows.short_description: An arcade-style top-down shooter where your only weapon is your froggy tongue. Eat hoardes of enemy insects in frantic, high-precision fights that demand clever decision-making. Don't get surrounded - it's one hit and you're croaked.
rows.description_html: Ribbit Rampage is a fast-paced top-down shooter about a frog eating bugs. The frog can only do one thing: extend its tongue. But this one action is simultaneously how you move, damage enemies, eat enemies, and deflect projectiles. You will soon be frantically clicking all over your screen to hold back the endless waves of fearsome bugs, all of which require you to defeat them in different ways. And you'll constantly need to manage which enemy to prioritize - because it's one hit and you're croaked. Each new difficulty level is gated behind a score threshold. So get those good runs in to advance to the more hectic parts of the game. Take down the coveted Super Heavy enemies to prove yourself. Chase after the elusive Earthworm for bonus points. And find the perfect opportunity to deflect a Bee's stinger into a crowd of enemies for a massive multiplier.

So get those good runs in to advance to the more hectic parts of the game. Take down the coveted Super Heavy enemies to prove yourself. Chase after the elusive Earthworm for bonus points. And find the perfect opportunity to deflect a Bee's stinger into a crowd of enemies for a massive multiplier.

rows.name: Smash and Bash Monsters: Prologue
rows.short_description: Prologue for Smash and Bash Monsters. An addicting Clicker-Looter game where you defeat Thousands of monsters to loot equipment and get stronger, that can be as Relaxing or Frenetic as you like!
rows.description_html: Prologue for Smash and Bash Monsters Experience the first bosses of Smash and Bash Monsters. Beat waves and waves of monsters to get stronger, in this clicker-like adventure! Before entering each new wave you have to beat the boss from the previous one! Buy new weapons, on the shop, smash stronger monsters with your new weapons to get stronger loot! Buy upgrades from the shop to go even further into the waves Equip your new loot and gadgets to get the edge you need to Smash and Bash the Monsters!

rows.name: 驱煞
rows.short_description: QUSHA is a Chinese-style roguelike survivor game where you take on the role of a novice Daoist disciple in a world overrun by demons. As you progress through the game, you'll master a variety of talismans and Daoist techniques, unlocking powerful spells to combat evil forces and defend the peace.
rows.description_html: QUSHA is a teaching program in the -UE5 Full Process Course for Indie Game Creators by VaMP He and MOTZIFY. It’s a course project, not a full-fledged commercial release. We welcome you to play and provide feedback! Through continuous cultivation and upgrades, players enhance their spell abilities, enabling to remain fearless even when surrounded by demons. By combining various spells, increase strength and slay monsters on journey. Vast Arsenal of Spells for Unleashing Demonic Annihilation QUSHA boasts an extensive spell system, immersing players in a journey of magical mastery. As you progress, you'll refine your spellcasting prowess, becoming adept in wielding a diverse array of talismans and spells to effectively combat the forces of evil. Through continuous upgrades and demon slaying, you'll ascend to the pinnacle of power, becoming the ultimate vanquisher of all things demonic. Experience the thrill of slaying all kinds of demons Powered by the UE5 engine, QUSHA can host a large number of demons. With every swing of your blade and every spell cast, you'll revel in the visceral thrill of decimating hordes of malevolent creatures. Are you interested in game development? Join us and learn to make games together! QUSHA is a teaching program in the -UE5 Full Process Course for Indie Game Creators by VaMP He and MOTZIFY. Due to its nature as a course project, the game is smaller in scope. We encourage you to try it out and share your thoughts! In this course, we will teach you to make QUSHA step by step: starting from software download, we will take you to unlock the development and release of indie games. There is also a large developer support fund,which can make your game stand out! Are you interested in game development? Come and scan the code to to learn more!

rows.name: River Town Factory: Prologue
rows.short_description: If possible, would you like to go back to ancient times to start a factory, refine oil, or even build a large computer? With the accidental fall of a meteorite, you traveled back to River Town a thousand years ago and became a workshop owner. And the story will begin from here……
rows.description_html: Attention Workshop Masters, the official version is available here! About the Game River Town Factory: Prologue vs. Official Version Differences *Special Note: Prologue save data can all be transferred to the official version. In the Prologue version, players can increase the favorability of all romanceable NPCs up to 4 hearts. In the Prologue version, players can increase the favorability of all regular NPCs up to 4 hearts. In the Prologue version, players can access up to T1 node in the Oracle Temple. In the Prologue version, 15% of buildings and technologies are available. In the Prologue version, players can explore the Central Region, including martial arts and relic caves within the region. In the Prologue version, players can reach a maximum of Level 2 on the SwordWay Sect and River Town Bounty Board (Somewhat Famous). In the Prologue version, players can participate in the Spring Festival, including the Flower Festival and Qingming Festival. Create automated production assembly lines, from wooden planks to circuit boards, design every step of your production line. Unlock future technologies gradually, from silicon purification to photovoltaic power generation, and build your futuristic workshop. Use inter-district teleportation stations to receive products at various levels, expanding your factory's territory to the entire continent. From brewing and oil pressing to manufacturing ovens, even producing watches and antibiotics, astound ancient people with your futuristic goods! Reinforced concrete, rubber, and large-scale computers, these will be the mass-produced materials you use in the ancient times, a thousand years ago!!! There are 12 characters that can be pursued in the game - the royal, the martial arts world, the merchant, etc. Unlock the secrets of each character and pursue the friendships and romances you desire. Choose your partner and discuss marriage, and together move into the workshop where they will provide powerful assistance. Make connections with nearly 30 historical figures, each with their own changing schedules throughout the four seasons. Participate in their lives and use modern knowledge to solve their problems. In the River Town, everything happens naturally, and you have the final say on when to work, explore, and engage in romantic pursuits. A fast-paced combat system that is easy to pick up, combining evasion and offense to defeat your enemies through strategic maneuvers. Whether through formal training or adventures in the martial arts world, master more than 40 martial arts techniques including external skills, internal skills, light skills, and hard skills, allowing you to dominate the martial arts world. Explore the four major villages on the map, complete village quests, and uncover their secrets. Explore the mystical realms left behind by ancient predecessors, delve deep into them, and defeat bizarre creatures. Explore the entire continent, discover treasures, explore bat caves, and punish bandits for the people. Sign contracts with mine owners throughout the entire map, allowing ancient people to work for you. Be a skilled craftsman or a social butterfly? Become the top martial artist or a versatile expert in everyday life? It's all up to you to decide. Craft spiritual medicines, weapons, and clothing, becoming a master of ancient craftsmanship. Create over 20 different dishes with various enhancements, such as Five Treasures Stew and Snowy Sunset Soup... Make them in your kitchen! Fill the Heavenly Workshop with the products you create, allowing ancient people to visit and witness modern technology. Utilize the power of future technology to repair the time machine and fulfill a mission that only you can accomplish.

rows.description_html: Trapped in an endless tower. You have to go through 10 levels, some hard and some easy. Make sure to always read the level hints + inspect every corner for helpful objects you might need!

rows.name: A Living Room
rows.short_description: You are a man in a room. Something feels off. Or maybe it's on. A short existential comedy point-and-click non-adventure about the limitations and imitations of human existence – or, really, whatever you want it to be about.
rows.description_html: You are a man in a room. A puppet in purgatory. Simulated flesh in a digital prison. There is no escape. You won't scream, because you're not programmed to. Your choices matter as much as anything matters, so the bar is fairly low. 'A Living Room' is a short point-and-click non-adventure that you should be able to finish in less than an hour. Hurry up, please. It will all be over soon. The nothing never felt so much like something.

rows.name: My succubus Kukula
rows.short_description: Click the cute pixel Succubus Kukula, as she barges into your house—she'll kill you, if you don't sign her pact! ^o^ Save yourself!! Life and death are in your hands, so take care not to anger Kukula.
rows.description_html: [b]My Succubus Kukula[/b] is a cute pixel clicking game. Kukula, the succubus, suddenly barges into your house, and if you don't sign a pact with her, she'll kill you! ^o^ Save yourself!! You need to figure out which different parts of her body to click to gain her favor, and in the process, you'll trigger some very cute little animations. Game Features [list][*]Each ending corresponds to a CG, and the game has nearly 100 different CG variations! [*]Each round of mini-games leads to one of 9 endings, with one final additional ending! [*]Cute pixel CG and lots of pixel character animations! [*]Dozens of reactive cute voice lines! [*]More than 20 unique triggered animations, one cuter than the other! [*]A relaxing and fun and slightly thrilling click-based game. [*]You can fall in love with a succubus!!!!!![/list] Notes! Life and death are in your hands, so take care not to anger Kukula. QQ群: 664329462

rows.name: Cleanbot 9000
rows.short_description: 3D Platformer, MetroidVania style Collect-a-thon, this game will have you hop and bop, whack and vac with your outlet plug tail flail. Defeat bosses to clear boundaries. Unlock extra abilities and play as multiple characters!
rows.description_html: It's time to CLEAN UP your act! In this 3D Platformer, Cleanbot will hop and bop... whack and Vac the dirt and garbage littering a one bedroom apartment. These Hot Bots are ready to spray away the Dust Bunnies and Moldy Silverware lurking in your home. The player can choose which of the bosses to face in whichever order. Make your way over dangerous end-tables and filthy floor tiles. GET DIRTY with the bosses. Each one defeated removes certain barriers that may prevent progress. Clean up collectables to unlock higher stats or a Maze Runner Mini Game: (Rat Race). Heal your character and restore power to your battery by playing as Bobby Pin. He is a character created from a bobby-pin who can fit in the harder to reach places where open outlets may hide. Finally, defeating the Filth Lich allows you to replay the game as your friend who helps you get plugged in: Bobby Pin!

rows.name: Conflux: Prologue
rows.short_description: Date! Fight! Collect! Conflux: Prologue is a collectible visual novel card game featuring a medieval fantasy setting with unique card battle mechanics and character hangout events. This is a prologue to the full version of the game – Conflux.
rows.description_html: Conflux: Prologue is a collectible visual novel card game Prologue campaign featuring 6 battle encounters with unlockable character cards and hangout events Intuitive introduction process to get you going quickly 30 unique characters with animated abilities giving you plenty of opportunity to create compositions capable of defeating any threat Fully voice acted hangouts with characters you meet during your adventures Some of the progress will carry over to full game For full experience visit - In a stable world there is always a force that tries to kick it off-balance. The master of dark magic Eloise was able to acquire a source of a massive power and is aiming to get even more. In the assault of your home village she destroys the very last forces that were able to oppose her, leaving only a handful of knights alive capable of fighting. Without a strong leadership the lands are destined to fall into tyranny, but you are given a chance to show that even when outnumbered and devastated you can still come back as a winner. Uncover the dangers of Conflux and bring freedom back to your homeland in this unique collectible card game experience.

rows.short_description: A 2D Qix-like retro arcade game. Draw lines to capture the canvas and defeat enemies!

Complete all 25 levels to win! Controls: WASD/arrow keys or click/touch to navigate & move, ESC to pause, M to mute.

rows.name: Reborn: An Idle Roguelike RPG
rows.short_description: A tactical idle roguelike RPG where you progress through auto-battles, gather resources, craft gear, and brew stat-boosting potions. Build your character, shape a village of evolving NPCs, and uncover hidden truths in a story-driven world that rewards curiosity and time.
rows.description_html: Overview Reborn: An Idle Roguelike RPG blends the long-term satisfaction of idle games with the challenge of roguelike progression and the charm of classic RPG storytelling. You play as Katie , a Reborn—an immortal warrior sent to protect a quaint, slowly unraveling village nestled on the edge of a dangerous cave. While you're off battling waves of increasingly powerful Creatures, the village moves forward: relationships evolve, secrets bubble to the surface, and a darker truth about your origins begins to emerge. 💤 Idle, But With Purpose Set your character to auto-fight through an ever-deepening cave and check in when you're ready. Level up your stats, craft and enchant your gear, brew potions, and plan your next run. ⚔️ Die. Rebuild. Go Deeper. Each run ends in death, but to a Reborn, death is growth. Keep your experience, and customize stronger builds with every rebirth. Tweak your stats, push one floor further, and uncover a little more each time. 🏡 A Village Worth Protecting Meet 19 unique villagers with evolving relationships and personal storylines. Help them grow, uncover the truth about your shared pasts, and change their futures. 📜 Systems With Depth Six core stats to build and balance. Crafting & gear upgrades with randomized bonuses and enchantable crystals. Potions brewed with a mix of ingredients for temporary, stackable boosts. Questlines that unlock more of the world and the people within it. 🌱 Built For The Long Haul This is a game designed to be played in short bursts across weeks or even months. No daily login requirements. No monetization. Just a chill, thoughtful loop you can come back to whenever you want. 🎮 Join Our Community Reborn was shaped by player feedback, and it continues to be. Join the Discord to share ideas, report bugs, and help shape what's next. Whether you're in it for the lore, the strategy, or just a cozy background grind—thank you for playing. To everyone who’s left a review (yes, even the negative ones), reported a bug, offered feedback, or just chatted with me during development, thank you. Your support, humor, and ideas have kept me going through the highs and lows of building this game over the last 18 months of development. I never expected such a warm and thoughtful community to form around Reborn, and I’m incredibly grateful for it. You’ve made this more than a solo project, you’ve made it something we've created together..

rows.name: Skill Up!
rows.short_description: Skill Up is a colorful 3D jump and run game where you progress through a large variety of unique stages. Just reach the goal; and don't fall down!
rows.description_html: Skill Up is a satisfying 3D Jump & Run experience with a stage based progression system. In each stage, you must reach the goal without falling down! Each stage comes with a unique concept and hurdles that have to be mastered. Features : A large variety of colorful, unique stages. Stages contain classic platformer elements and other unique mechanics. Perfectly synchronized systems that behave identically on every run. Speed running has never been fairer or easier! Additional mastery: After completing a stage, it can be played again to master it. This time, you shall not stop moving until reaching the goal!
