rows.name: Soulbind: Prologue
rows.short_description: Soulbind: Prologue is an action platformer in the Roguelike genre. The hero is a common skeleton and an outsider. But there is one special feature - you can replace your body parts with parts of your opponents' bodies. Learn the backstory and start your journey in the world of Allaar.
rows.description_html: Start the journey .The prologue is set before the story of the main game Soulbind: Tales Of The Underworld. You will learn where your hero's journey began, how he met his indispensable companion and other characters. Assemble yourself piece by piece .Yes, you are an ordinary skeleton, an outsider, but you have a specialty - you can replace your body parts with body parts of defeated enemies. A couple of successful battles and you are already half an invincible monster, a third a zombie and a third a witch on your grandmother's side. Found and knocked out body parts have different rarity, which depends on the main characteristics and unique passive effects. To put it simply, if you like to change the strategy of the game, to be a tank or a mage - there is something to play with. Get special skills .How about breathing fire, turning to stone, or summoning a swarm of disgusting flies to your aid? Easy, all you have to do is defeat an enemy and get his head or torso on you. Although a little luck is needed here too. Mutate .By defeating enemies, you accumulate internal power and voila, you can choose a special mutation of your character. For example, strengthen the skills you use, improve basic attacks, add a stun chance, and more. Get to know the mysterious world The action of the prologue takes place in the library. It's a confusing location with its own traps and secrets, and of course dust, magic and books not handed in on time. Perhaps the library is the perfect place to learn more about the world of Allaar. And say that again .Death is commonplace in the world of Allaar. Yes, you'll lose everything you've gained, but you won't lose your experience as a player. The second attempt will be better than the first, and on the fifth time you can even get one eyeful of the boss. The main thing is that the attempts can be different from each other and if you like it, it is worth paying attention to Soulbind: Tales Of The Underworld, there you will find new enemies and new mechanics.

rows.short_description: Survive, Dominate and Create the most Chad pigeon in Chadgeon: Enjoyers Edition+
rows.description_html: Chadgeon: Enjoyers Edition+ is a 2D roguelite brawling game where you play as a pigeon competing for scraps of a dwindling ice-cream cone. Level up your pigeon by eating delectable ice-cream cone treats and challenging other pigeons. As your pigeon becomes more powerful, you will gain access to new powerful upgrades that will enhance your pigeon's dominating advantage. However, eventually the ice-cream will run out and only the strongest pigeons will survive. Key Features: - PVE, COOP, and PVP game modes. - Defend against huge waves of Pigeons in Ice-cream operations. - Play solo or with friends in online multiplayer - Bulk up your pigeon with powerful upgrades as you level up. - Looksmax your pigeon with various customizable skins - Find out where the minions were from 1933-1945 - Goofy Ah ah AI. - Ryan Gosling (Literally Me) - I love pigeons 💗

rows.name: Riptide
rows.short_description: In Riptide, gear up your ship, customize your loadout, and fight for the fleet! Riptide is a spaceship combat game with an emphasis on powerful customizations and utility. Accomplish your mission by loading up and taking out the enemy.
rows.description_html: Outfit your Ship Prepare with the perfect blend of weaponry! Choose between heavy weapons to ravage turrets or lighter weapons to spray down scouting enemy parties. Change stats with ship components! Tank up to take on the whole army or become so offensive that they won’t be even able to see you coming. Experiment and make your perfect ship! Naval Fleet Combat Dive into the universe of naval space combat. The enemy is well established in your sector with scouting parties, defense turrets, and heavy ships that vastly outperform your own. That being said, you’re now the captain of your own unique battlecruiser and a tried and tested crew. With your skill and their experience combined, victory is almost guaranteed! Narrative As a recently promoted captain, you’ve been relocated to be at the forefront of the revolution. Lead a special operation – one that has the power to turn the entire conflict on its head. It is up to you to prove that there is still hope for an end to this war. Learn the details through your military briefings and slowly put together the full context of the Catolia civil war and its rich history. Learn and untangle the stories of your crew and your enemies to get to the heart of the rift tearing this system apart. Your mission? Fight for freedom or die trying.

rows.name: Kriegsfront Tactics - Prologue
rows.short_description: Kriegsfront Tactics - Prologue is the proof of concept for the upcoming procedural turn-based mecha tactics RPG set in alternate 1970s Southeast Asia. In this prologue chapter, you'll get to experience combat, exploration, and the opening story of the game.
rows.description_html: Kriegsfront Tactics - Prologue is the proof of concept for Kriegsfront Tactics, an upcoming procedural turn-based mecha squad tactics game for military sim fans where we combine elements from classic tactical strategy RPG games, roguelikes, and lowpoly retro-style visuals. In this prologue chapter, you'll get to experience the game's opening story and roughly the 1st hour of gameplay. Set in alternate 1970s during an era of conflict in Southeast Asia, you'll play as a commander of a mecha squad sent behind enemy lines. Manage your squad, resources, and mechs. Complete your mission and survive the front while facing hard decisions that will test your morality. Metal Crunching Cinematic Combat Watch the mayhem and destruction unfold, metal against metal. Customize Your Mech Customize your mech’s livery, salvage or swap parts, and equip weapons. Survive 1970s Southeast Asian Jungle Explore the jungles of Southeast Asia during an era of conflict, encounter events, and uncover secrets in this alternate 1970s world. Execute Tactical Mecha Operations Plan ahead, strategize, and use your tactical prowess to outsmart your enemies.

rows.name: Your Turn to Disembark
rows.short_description: Your Turn to Disembark is an episodic narrative game about a weird train and the passengers that are trapped inside of it. Will you make it out of the train or will you be trapped onto it's route for the rest of days?
rows.description_html: Notice : Base game only includes Chapter 1 of the game, more chapters will be added in later updates. You've awakened inside of a train with no memory of ever boarding... Something appears to be weird about this train. Maybe it's the surprisingly clean environment, maybe it's the windows that are just a bit too hard to see out of. Or maybe it's the fact that the train appears to be never ending, constantly looping back on itself enough to drive any passenger mad! Something is weirding me out about this place.. But I can't put my finger on what? Welcome to Your Turn to Disembark , a episodic narrative adventure game about finding your way out of this strange and unnerving train with the help of 8 other bizarre passengers. In this mystery adventure game you will be talking to the various passengers who are also stuck upon this train and trying to escape together. Learn about their pasts and futures, their struggles and their strengths. Some will become your friends, some may snap... Walk around the train to try and discover it's secrets! And maybe, finally figure out what really is going on in this locomotive...

rows.name: Fatal Falls
rows.short_description: In Fatal Falls you explore the dark secrets of 'The Grand Elysium', a posh luxury hotel in the middle of nowhere. Interact with its guests, drink a cocktail at the bar, peruse the noble premises – the choice is yours! Just make sure you don't get entangled in the hotel's dark deeds...
rows.description_html: Fatal Falls is an indie horror adventure that plunges players into a sinister, twisted world within the walls of a seemingly ordinary hotel named The Grand Elysium . Uncovering the mysteries of this place involves a journey through multiple chapters, each one peeling back a layer of deceit, horror, and the darkness hidden in plain sight. You must find clues and unlock puzzles to delve deeper, eventually confronting the hotel’s true nature — a place designed to ensnare those struggling with mental health. Every interaction shapes your path and can lead to multiple possible outcomes. While most roads end in despair, only one path offers a chance to bring justice, if players uncover the right clues and avoid the clutches of a patrolling receptionist. Suspense builds as the protagonist faces unsettling therapy sessions with a strange psychologist, whose probing questions on mortality and depression blur the lines between sanity and madness... Players must solve puzzles to access hidden rooms and unveil shocking truths about the hotel and its corrupt management. Tension heightens as you evade the ever-watchful receptionist. Will you expose the criminal organization pulling the strings, or will you find yourself ensnared by their dark secrets? With an immersive atmosphere, complex choices, and intense psychological themes, Fatal Falls explores the horrors of the mind and the terrifying consequences of falling too far into despair.

rows.description_html: Wyvern Studios Solitaire: 30th Anniversary Edition is a tribute to the original game released in the 1990's by Wyvern Studios. It features both Klondike Solitaire and Pyramid Solitaire . It includes 9 different deck styles to choose from and features joystick support for the full experience. The base game is offered for free and can be played as is without any cost forever. We plan to offer rulesets DLC with additional solitaire versions and content DLC with more fun deck styles that you can choose to purchase, or not. We will also be offering a Solitaire Construction Set DLC that will allow you to create and share hundreds of unique solitaire creations. The 9 deck styles in the base game include three(3) traditional playing card decks and six(6) photo decks guaranteed to be 'Family Friendly!' TRADITIONAL DECKS Traditional Face Cards Easy Read Alphanumeric Cards Wyvern Memories Face Cards FAMILY FRIENDLY PHOTO DECKS Fireworks Fungi Insects Minerals & Gems Natural Textures Space Exploration

rows.name: Scrambler
rows.short_description: Scrambler is a fast-paced rogue-like wave survival game where you control adorable cartoon characters fighting off endless waves of quirky enemies. Level up, collect power-ups, and survive as the challenge intensifies in procedurally generated levels.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Scrambler , where adorable characters and menacing enemies collide in a whirlwind of action! In this rogue-like wave survival game, you’ll control a group of lovable yet fierce cartoon heroes, each with unique abilities and powers. Your mission? Survive endless waves of quirky, unpredictable enemies—ranging from mischievous little critters to giant, menacing bosses—all while unlocking new upgrades and weapons. Each run is a fresh adventure, with procedurally generated levels ensuring no two experiences are the same. Collect power-ups, discover hidden treasures, and fight to stay alive as the chaos intensifies! With every wave, the challenge grows, but so do your characters, leveling up in delightful and unexpected ways. Scrambler combines charming visuals with frantic gameplay. Will you be able to outlast the adorable onslaught and become the ultimate wave survivor? Get ready to fight, dodge, and level up in this action-packed rogue-like survival adventure that’s as cute as it is chaotic!

With every wave, the challenge grows, but so do your characters, leveling up in delightful and unexpected ways. Scrambler combines charming visuals with frantic gameplay. Will you be able to outlast the adorable onslaught and become the ultimate wave survivor? Get ready to fight, dodge, and level up in this action-packed rogue-like survival adventure that’s as cute as it is chaotic!

rows.name: Cyan's Snow House
rows.short_description: 'Your place is here.' - 'Cyan's Snow House' is a dialogue-free, short indie game set in a snowy village, offering a universal, heartwarming experience in just 10 minutes. Enjoy tranquil moments with Cyan and her animal friends, leaving a lasting impression.
rows.description_html: 'Cyan's Snow House' is a heartwarming short indie game that transcends language to provide a universally enjoyable experience. Without a single line of dialogue and requiring only simple mouse clicks to play, players step into the shoes of Cyan, a lone girl in a snow-covered village, who daily feeds and spends time with animals shivering from the cold. Despite its brief playtime of around 10 minutes, it leaves a lasting, wonderful impression on anyone, anywhere in the world. The gentle moments shared between Cyan and the animals convey a warm message: 'Your place is here.' Recommended for anyone seeking a moment of solace on a cold winter's day, this game promises to melt your heart with its soothing embrace.

rows.name: Obilia
rows.short_description: Embark on a journey in Obilia, an archipelago of tomorrow dedicated to humanity's legacy and imagination. Explore this evolving world, get to know its legendary figures, and find your own place in this expansive open-world RPG.
rows.description_html: JOIN OUR COMMUNITY! About the Game Obilia is a casual episodic open-world RPG, an open-ended odyssey in a vibrant archipelago tailored for you. Following widespread societal collapse, Vigor Pike, visionary founder of Legacy, envisions a fresh start. With his friend Kai Hudson, they unveil Obilia – a beacon of hope and rediscovery. As a latest generation Legacy envoy, you'll step onto a world of possibilities, adventures and secrets, and find where you belong in the Obilia's rich, evolving tapestry. Your journey will lead you far and wide – from the presence of a philosopher in a city of wisdom to the vengeful rage of a demonic god, or discovering the extraordinary fauna, unearthing ancient songs lost to history, and navigating through environments rich in forgotten lore. From lush forests to misty mountains, serene waters to dreamy caves, each island will offer its unique adventures and challenges. Obilia warmly invites you to weave your own story where you will never run out of things to do. Welcome Home, Future Obilian In your travels across this new habitat without end, you'll uncover both new and familiar landscapes, you'll assist and befriend companions, solve puzzles, confront foes, and engage in cooking, crafting, fishing, and more. As you gain the trust of the inhabitants, you'll uncover what it means to be an Obilian. You Lead the Journey Choose how you want to explore and experience Obilia – fish in ever-changing waters, cook unique dishes, cultivate crops from your travels. Craft yourself tools and weapons, build a home filled with artifacts from your adventures, and explore the richly-varied regions of Obilia, where puzzles and quest unlock secrets and rare treasures. An Ever-Unfolding Odyssey Rediscover humanity's legacy in Obilia, built away from the remains of a world in disorder, a place to remember humanity, reenact history, and reshape a future. Interact with colorful and enigmatic inhabitants, each with their own rich histories and secrets. Find companions to progress your story and expand your world. Master your skills in fishing, crafting and puzzle-solving, earn the trust of the community, and uncover the depths of Obilia. Craft Your Personal Paradise Turn your personal island in Obilia into a reflection of your journey! With limitless customization options, you can cultivate your own land, build and decorate the home of your dreams. Whether it's a Victorian cottage, a Viking longhouse, or a simple thatched hut, your island will be the canvas for your imagination. Expand it, blend styles, and create a space that represents the unique Obilian you are.

rows.name: Helbreath Nemesis
rows.short_description: Helbreath is a dark medieval MMORPG featuring intense PvP, strategic alliances, and a trade-centric economy. Choose between two warring factions and immerse yourself in epic battles and quests in a vast fantasy world.
rows.description_html: Version 7 Helbreath is an MMORPG (Massively Multiplayer Online Role-Playing Game) that combines elements of action, strategy, and fantasy. Set in a dark medieval world, players choose between two warring factions: Aresden or Elvine. You can explore a vast world, battle monsters and other players, complete quests, and participate in epic battles. The game is known for its intense PvP (Player versus Player) gameplay, trade-based economy, and strategic alliance-building to dominate territories. Get ready to immerse yourself in an exciting and challenging adventure in Helbreath!

rows.name: God of Fortune
rows.short_description: Every time we tap in the virtual world, a string of numbers full of hope and wealth will follow. Every click in the virtual world is a challenge and breakthrough in real life. Every click is a knock on the soul; every God of Wealth Coin is hope for the future.
rows.description_html: God of Fortune Click on the wooden fish god of wealth coin, Sincere heart will lead to cyber wealth. The virtual world is real and illusory, One click to make money and be happy. In future updates, you will receive CAISHIENB. Stay tuned. Achievements: There are 100 achievements in the game that can be easily completed with just a click of the mouse~ Cloud Archive: The game adopts cloud save format, and previous clicks will not disappear, but will gradually gather into a tower as time progresses. rows.name: Count to Ten: Infinity
rows.short_description: In this arcade-style game, chasing higher scores becomes an addictively fast-paced quest for precision. Count to Ten challenges you to tap numbered shapes in sequence, ramping up the challenge with every success. Pure, quickfire fun!
rows.description_html: Key Features: Simple and Easy to Learn: Just tap the target number. Progressive Difficulty: Each successful tap increases the game's challenge procedurally. High Score Focus: Aim for a new personal best with every playthrough. Intuitive Design: Easy to pick up, no tutorials needed. Skill Mastery: Perfect for players who enjoy mastering their reflexes and reaction times. Be the Best: With leaderboard integration and plenty of achievements, you'll be able to see just how well you play compared to others. Engage in a simple yet increasingly difficult challenge: tap shapes in numerical order as quickly as possible. The game is a straightforward test of focus and reflexes. As you hit each target, several difficulty factors will increase, pushing you to keep pace and making each level more and more challenging. There's no complex backstory or convoluted things to learn; it's just you and the numbers in a race to see how long you can keep the sequence going.

rows.name: Acorn Cop
rows.short_description: Based on a true story, Acorn Cop is a meme game where you shoot all the acorns, but do NOT shoot any human or other living things. Enjoy and collect easter egg items. Can you do just that for 20 minutes?
rows.description_html: Special Offer About the Game In Acorn Cop, you're taking a shooting test as a cop. The rules are so simple: - You must shoot and destroy all the acorns - You must NOT shoot any of the humans and other living things (use your best judgment) - Everything else you can shoot at will, some of them will be very useful when destroyed, and some are just collectibles - Do not miss more than 2 acorns for 20 minutes and you win the game (a.k.a passing the test) Controller guide: - Flick LS to change aim assist target - While you're slowing down by holding the LB button, ammo won't refill Features: Permadeath Special items with unique effects like slowing time, clearing all the acorns on the screen, refilling ammos... Collectible items Classical music (makes violence classy) Boss fight Funny easter eggs Achievements

rows.name: Soul Shifters: MMORPG
rows.short_description: Take control, dive into battle, and become a Daemon Lord in Soul Shifters: Online! Download now to unleash epic powers and save humanity. The adventure awaits!
rows.description_html: WELCOME TO THE EPIC WORLD OF SOUL SHIFTERS: ONLINE! An exploration and grind focused MMORPG. Explore a vibrant universe where humans and Daemons collide in an epic battle for supremacy. Uncover the power of assimilation, transforming into powerful Daemons to face unimaginable challenges. Immerse yourself in this electrifying journey, where your courage will shape the destiny of the world. --- INCREDIBLE FEATURES - ASSIMILATION: Become a hybrid warrior by absorbing Daemons, using them in combat, each with unique and deadly abilities. - TACTICAL DAEMON SWAPPING: Switch between Daemons to face diverse challenges. Swap during battle, choosing the best Daemon for each combat moment. - UNIQUE ABILITIES: Evolve your synergy with your Daemon to master up to 1 standard skill, 3 elite skills, and 1 supreme skill for each Daemon. Unleash elemental powers to crush your adversaries. --- IMMERSIVE WORLD - EPIC CONFLICTS: Battle other hybrid warriors in epic duels and defeat powerful Daemons while exploring dangerous areas to become the mightiest Daemon Lord. - INTRIGUING NARRATIVE: Explore diverse micro-narratives with NPCs, featuring light and humorous storytelling. --- CHALLENGES AND ACHIEVEMENTS - INTENSE BATTLES: Challenge yourself in intense battles as you grow stronger. Reach the final showdown with Legendary Daemons in epic battles that will determine the world's fate, with the possibility of absorbing them to become even more powerful. - MAP EXPLORATION: Freely explore the map, discover hidden chests, unravel mysteries, and uncover new areas. --- TECHNICAL FEATURES - PLAY WITH FRIENDS: Soul Shifters is an online game, so invite your friends for epic adventures. Form strategic alliances to face even greater challenges. - MULTIPLATFORM: Enjoy the flexibility of playing on various platforms. Sync your progress and dive into the action wherever you are. --- DOWNLOAD NOW AND EMBRACE YOUR DESTINY IN SOUL SHIFTERS: ONLINE Get ready for a unique experience where strategy, courage, and power converge. Download now and embark on this thrilling journey. Humanity relies on you to become the true Daemon Lord and save the world!

rows.name: Fancy Rinshi Sensetion
rows.short_description: Become the heroine's imaginary friend and guide her. Her fate is up to you.
rows.description_html: Be the heroine's imaginary friend and guide her through the game. [Overview] Fancy Rinshi (It's mean a near-death by Japanese language) Sensation is a cute and slightly horrifying multi-ended adventure game. You are the imaginary friend of the main character girl, Kusuha, and lead her through a fancy and cute world. Kusuha is in a near-death state due to a car accident and is about to step into the afterlife. How you lead her is up to you. You can encourage her or lie to her. Depending on you, she will certainly be saved or she will certainly die. Please enjoy the 'Sensation' of her 'Rinshi (Near Death)' in the 'Fancy' world. [Game Points] About 30 minutes for the first play. Number of endings: 7 (plus one hidden end).

rows.name: The Storyteller
rows.short_description: The Storyteller is an online game where you can build your own turn-based RPG game without any programming and graphic knowledge. Play your world with your friends online, challenge them in turn-based battles, and let them loot and level up after a fiercefull battle while they go through your story.
rows.description_html: In the game you can create your own world in a worldbuilder mode and tell your story as a Storyteller. After you finished the worldbuilding, you can host it and play with your friends in a Turn-based combat RPG. Here are the features you can access: Play as a Storyteller: Create Worlds: Easily paint terrains and add buildings, trees, and decorations. NPCs and Shops: Add characters that players can interact with, including shopkeepers. Interactive Storytelling: Tell your story and engage players with interactive elements. Epic Battles: Challenge players with turn-based combat and powerful enemies. Triggers: Change chapters or music on the fly. Rewards: Place chests with loot for players to find after battles. Set the Mood: Use music and sounds to enhance the atmosphere. Dice Rolls: Add a TTRPG feel with dice roll challenges. Custom Rules: Adjust the game’s difficulty and other settings to your liking. Host and lead your friends through your creation online, or let everyone explore the world that you created. Play as a Hero: Create Your Character: Pick an avatar and distribute stats. Battle: Fight in strategic turn-based battles. Level Up: Grow stronger and choose your path as a warrior, mage, or rogue. Learn Spells: Master different classes and spells. Loot and Gear Up: Find treasures, buy gear, and get ready for bigger challenges. Adventure: Dive into the story and interact with the world. TTRPG Checks: Use dice rolls for key moments like persuasion. Be the Hero: Complete the campaign and become a legend.

rows.name: Egregore
rows.short_description: Embark on a first-person adventure to a mysterious café in Cairo. Adopt a new perspective and shape reality to your will as you unravel an occult conspiracy hidden in plain sight.
rows.description_html: They wish to summon an Egregore, to shape reality as they see fit. Egregore is a first-person adventure where you uncover an occult conspiracy in modern Cairo. Using a unique graphing mechanic, you’re empowered to connect the dots and discover a web of intrigue and possibility. Egregore questions what constitutes “truth” , immersing you in a deep and uncertain world. What would you do to uncover the truth? Reshape reality by drawing connections with a mystic astrolabe. Summon people, objects, and rooms as you explore the world around you. Create your own truth with the knowledge at your disposal, forming new realities, spaces, and associations. Question dynamic characters to uncover the truth. Follow your own path through the story using the information you've uncovered. The residents of Café Ramses are more than they seem, with histories and motives all their own. Connect them to concepts, people, and objects around Ramses to discover their connections, personalities, and anxieties. Traverse a vibrant cafe in modern-day Cairo. Explore an authentic, radiant portrayal of modern Egypt. Make your way to Café Ramses, a respected traditional coffee house that prides itself on its culture. Egregore is an AGP/MFA thesis project developed in collaboration between USC Games , Berklee College of Music , and Otis College of Art and Design . Inspirations include NORCO , Riven , and The Case of the Golden Idol .

rows.name: The Veiled Ones
rows.short_description: The Veiled Ones is a horror stealth game about a Muslim exorcist trying to save his son from a jinn possession. In this game players will reveal the story behind their son's possession, while avoiding the jinn that haunts them.
rows.description_html: Warning: This game may potentially trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy. Viewer discretion is advised. The Veiled Ones is a stealth horror game about a Muslim exorcist trying to save his son from a jinn possession. Inspired by the invisible entities from Islam, the players must rely on a magic artifact and their hearing to survive the jinn haunting their son, and unravel the mystery behind their son's disappearance. LOOK INTO THE JINN WORLD Use the black magic artifact called the Looking Glass to peer into a haunting realm, and navigate the invisible enemies that are haunting you HIDE FROM INVISIBLE ENEMIES Look for clues about your son's possession while hiding from invisible jinn. Listen to their footsteps, use the Looking Glass, and avoid the crying whispers UNRAVEL THE POSSESSION Piece together the clues and exorcise your son. Who is possessing him? And why? The Veiled Ones was created as part of the University of Southern California’s Advanced Game Project (AGP) in collaboration with students from Otis College of Art and Design, Berklee College of Music, and Laguna College of Art and Design. For more information, please visit our publishing page. To learn more about the USC Games program, the #1 game program in the world, please visit the website listed on the right side of the store page.

rows.name: Bugnauts!
rows.short_description: Embark on a thrilling 3D projectile action adventure in Bugnauts! Swing your net to battle giant bugs and save your island home from an evil resort tycoon. Fight, collect, and explore in this action-packed game for all ages.
rows.description_html: In Bugnauts, players take on the role of Chloe, a young entomologist determined to save her island home from the giant Phantom bugs wreaking havoc across its shores. Armed with her trusty net, swing, jump, and battle your way through hordes of magically corrupted insects in this fast-paced 3D projectile action game! Explore rich environments, collect fascinating insects, and delve into the vibrant world of Bugnauts! Gameplay Features Engage in fast-paced combat Use Chloe’s net to catch projectiles hurled by her overgrown enemies and swing them back with force! As Chloe you will face hordes of Phantomized bugs, all transformed into mindless fighting machines. Face an array of enemies with unique attacks waiting to be turned against them. Traverse the world and collect hidden items From the lush island forests to the unfinished resort, Chloe's journey is filled with opportunities to explore. Using her jump and dash abilities, Chloe is able to reach new parts of the island. Use the net to catch hidden collectible bugs just waiting to be found. Collect them all to complete the field guide! Save the environment and save the island See your impact! In Bugnauts, every action counts towards saving your home. Take down Phantomized enemies to return their natural forms and witness the surrounding environment heal in real time. Restore the island one bug at a time. About Development Bugnauts was developed as one of the University of Southern California's Advanced Game Projects (AGP). For more information about the USC Games Program, check out their website.

Take down Phantomized enemies to return their natural forms and witness the surrounding environment heal in real time. Restore the island one bug at a time. About Development Bugnauts was developed as one of the University of Southern California's Advanced Game Projects (AGP). For more information about the USC Games Program, check out their website.

rows.name: Brinkmanship
rows.short_description: Brinkmanship is a first person sci-fi mystery about greed, manipulation, and trust. As a spaceborne colonist 20 years into your voyage you’ve just discovered that your ship has secretly altered its heading. Your parents give you a gun. The ship goes into lockdown. What do you do? Who will you trust?
rows.description_html: Brinkmanship is a first-person sci-fi mystery about a colony ship that has secretly changed course. The ship has 30,000 people on it and has been traveling for 20 years, your entire life. Now the future you’ve been promised is slipping away. The player must investigate the ship to find out what’s going on and confront the ship’s captain to get it back on track. Brinkmanship emphasizes conversation over violence, but leaves the gun on the table. Investigate a Thrilling Sci-Fi Conspiracy Immerse yourself in a gripping narrative as you uncover hidden truths, and decipher the cryptic motives steering the vessel off-course. With each revelation, the stakes heighten, and the fate of everyone you’ve ever known hangs in the balance. Dynamic interactions influence character dialogue Arm yourself with the option to draw, stow, or fire your weapon during critical conversations, the power of choice extends beyond words and adds a layer of tension. Influence the narrative with the subtle threat of force or the restraint of diplomacy, shaping the evolving story in unexpected ways. Choose Violence or Eloquence to Guide the Fate of Your Crew The destiny of the 30,000 souls aboard the colony ship lies in your hands. Will you tread the path of violence, asserting dominance and control, or will you rely on eloquence and negotiation to sway the course of events? Maybe you’ll even take a bribe to make your accusations disappear… Brinkmanship offers a unique blend of strategic decision-making, where your choices echo across the vast expanse of space, dooming the ship you were born on delivering it to the world you’ve been promised. Brinkmanship was made by USC students and published through the USC Games Publishing Association. For more information, please visit our publishing page. To learn more about the USC Games program, the #1 game program in the world, please visit the website listed on the right side of the store page.

rows.name: LaughterLost
rows.short_description: LaughterLost takes you through a surreal journey of work and family life. Face psychological twists, narrative choices, puzzles, and unexpected unique confrontations! Will you break this dystopian cycle of everyday life?
rows.description_html: LaughterLost plunges you into a surreal journey through the complexities of work and family life in a dystopian world. Face psychological twists and turn the tide of your destiny through narrative decisions. Navigate challenging puzzles and unexpected unique confrontations! Each choice you make shapes your experience in this enthralling cycle of everyday trials. Will you uncover the path to perseverance or succumb to the pressures of this warped existence? Explore the depths of LaughterLost and discover if you can survive. Will you break this dystopian cycle of life? Engaging Narrative Story Engage in narrative decisions that will make or break you, in your journey through family and work life. Can you defend your livelihood in this cruel, unforgiving world? Solve Intricate Puzzles Navigate intricate puzzles that challenge your problem-solving skills in this surreal and dystopian world. Solving puzzles advances you through the narrative while you discover the mysteries of this cycle of everyday existence. BECOME the Final Boss Confront unique and intense confrontations that epitomize the distinctive challenges of your character's dystopian journey. Test your skills against unexpected foes, introducing dramatic twists in an already twisted world Message from Mix Studio: 'Exploring the diverse facets of laughter inspired by the theme, our team discussed various ways and meanings of smiling, embarking on a journey to dissect its complexities. We pondered the nuances of genuine laughter born from humor and joy, juxtaposed with the façade of artificial smiles often worn in social settings or to mask inner turmoil. Our exploration led us to the perspective of a middle-class worker facing the imminent threat of job loss. In this narrative, we unveiled different kinds of smiles: the obligatory smile in the presence of superiors, the strained smiles concealing stress, and the genuine moments of joy shared with loved ones, such as his daughter. Our main goal is to discover the multifaceted nature of smiles and delve into broader societal themes. Through gameplay, we aim to provoke contemplation on labor challenges and the pervasive drinking culture prevalent in China.'

rows.name: Lake Minnewaska
rows.short_description: Lake Minnewaska is a narrative driven first person fishing game. Fish, explore, and uncover the secrets of Lake Minnewaska as you guide Sosa's journey in becoming a better father.
rows.description_html: Cast your line and join Sosa on an emotional journey as he navigates the mystical waters of Lake Minnewaska to fish and reconnect with his daughter. Lake Minnewaska is a narrative driven first person fishing game. Fish, explore, and uncover the secrets of Lake Minnewaska as you guide Sosa's journey in becoming a better father. Embark on a Personal Journey Join Sosa on his quest to reconnect with his family. Learn more about Sosa and his daughter Rue while uncovering the mystical secrets of the lake. Fish up Fantastical Creatures Search for the correct fishing hole based on clues in your journal and then fight to reel in the fish you've hooked. Tire out all sorts of fish by pulling your rod in the opposite direction and then reel them in to add them to your journal. Catch all the types of fish in the lake to complete Rue's fishlist. Explore Extreme Environments Travel through a variety of lush, stormy, and mystical environments all while listening to a jazzy soundtrack. Get caught up in the ambience of the lake and the vibrant colors of the fishing holes you visit. Lake Minnewaska is an Advanced Games Project (AGP), a student-run game out of the University of Southern California, where students from the USC School of Cinematic Arts and USC School Viterbi School of Engineering, collaborate on large projects from all over USC, including Thorton and Marshall. This project is Lloyd Campbell III's MFA thesis capstone at USC in which he to tell an emotional story through a narrative-heavy fishing game. Lake Minnewaska was made over the course of a year by a team of 35 students.

AI Generation garbage from early access has been addressed to generate better responses. Features Over 2000 base items for when you are stranded with no internet Languages other than English! rows.name: Split Personality Doctor: Prologue
rows.short_description: A doctor who suddenly gains the ability to shrink his body enters the patient’s body to treat them.
rows.description_html: Add official version to wishlist [Split Personality Doctor: Prologue] is a free demo version of some content of [Split Personality Doctor] About the Game A doctor in a small town suddenly gained the ability to shrink his body, so he shrunk his body into various patients' bodies and treated diseases by eliminating the virus in the patients' bodies. Dominating Summon Combat: Although the Doctor himself has some attack ability, he mainly needs to fight through summons. Cooperate with summons to trigger skills. Each summon has its own special attack mode, which can be upgraded and synthesized to create a more powerful summon. The Doctor can choose a base weapon, and different summons will activate different characteristics of the weapon, such as ejection, explosion, burning, freezing, etc. Easy to use (only need to control the direction of movement), super refreshing, roguelikes, fast pace (no more than 30 minutes per game). Hundreds of items and summons, build different combinations.

rows.name: Duel of games
rows.short_description: In the real world, the Game of the Year is about who is more fun to play,while in the gaming world,the Game of the Year is about who can fight better.In order to compete for the title of Game of the Year,games transform into fighters and engage in combat.Duel of classic game protagonists,pvp/pve/eve
rows.description_html: problem Fixing If your Windows system cannot run the game properly, you can run wushowhide-1.diagcab included in the zip file to fix it. Selection Interface Click the button to dress up your mascot with a variety of available outfits. Touch your mascot to interact! There are many different reactions to discover. Click the button to select the mode, There are story mode, vs mode, counter mode available. Click on the arrow to switch between fighters, allowing you to view the fighter’s appearance, name, and skill settings. Each fighter has two exclusive skills and one universal skill for blocking. There are a total of 110 fighters available to use. (PLAYER1 can switch fighters by pressing the AD keys, while PLAYER2 can switch fighters by pressing the left and right keys.) Click on the arrow to switch between with and without props. There are a total of 110 props available to use. (PLAYER1 can switch between with and without items by pressing the J key, while PLAYER2 can switch between with and without items by pressing NumPad 1.) Click on the arrow to switch between PLAYER and COMPUTER, allowing you to play against a computer or watch a computer play against another computer(Cyber Beast-fighting). (PLAYER1 can switch between a real person and a computer by pressing the WS keys, while PLAYER2 can switch between a real person and a computer by pressing the up and down keys.) Click on the arrow to switch between BO(best of x), from BO1 to BO21. (PLAYER1 can switch between BO by pressing the KL keys, while PLAYER2 can switch between BO by pressing NumPad 2 and NumPad 3.) Click on the arrow to switch between full tutorial, only item tutorial, and no tutorial. Control Instructions PLAYER1 Move：WASD Skill：JK Def：L Item：;(Semicolon) PLAYER2 Move：↑↓←→(Directional keys) Skill：NumPad 12 Def：NumPad 3 Item：NumPad Enter Some skills have a CD (Cooldown) time. Many skills can be cast while moving with the directional keys to adjust the position of the spell cast. Flexible positioning, masterful use of skills, and skillful blocking are key to overcoming enemies.

rows.name: Cycles
rows.short_description: Cycles is a procedural music composition about appreciating a forest through all parts of its life cycle. Experience billions of unique generations of the piece.
rows.description_html: Cycles is a procedural music composition about appreciating a forest through all parts of its life cycle. What Is This? Cycles is an audiovisual composition. When you launch Cycles, you can view a performance of the piece. If you let it run, it will create a new performance, then another, infinitely; these are completely different generations of the piece. This is because Cycles is procedurally generated, every time (like a Minecraft world). Each generation is related, and may sound kind of similar, but might sound totally different. There are billions of possible generations—you don't have to watch every one, of course, but it's nice to think that the one you're watching has probably never been seen by anyone else. You can even share a nice one with a friend if you'd like. What Is This not? Cycles is non-interactive—there are hotkeys, if you'd like to view a specific generation, or ensure a specific visual mode, but the piece generates automatically. You can watch the performance, but you won't perform it yourself. Why Does It Exist? Two reasons—one practical, one philosophical. First, I am a composer, and suddenly game engines have become an extremely legitimate tool for composing music. Not just writing music for games—actually composing with the procedural tools inside an engine (in this case, Unreal Engine 5). Despite this, few composers are doing so. The second reason goes back to what the piece is about . Having lived in California for about a decade, I've found it challenging to see places I love burn in wildfires. I was excited to have the opportunity to create a work touching on this for Big Basin Redwood State Park (much of which burned in the 2020 CZU Lightning Complex fire), and immediately I thought that a procedural composition would be well-suited for this topic. Cycles continually generates new compositions, one after another—each iteration of the piece derives from the same source material and compositional rules, but the generation incorporates enough environmental chance that no two renderings are the same (and some are in fact very different). Surprisingly, this algorithmic, 'digital' feature represents the natural world quite closely. A forest that grows back after a fire is created from many of the same common inputs as the forest that came before it (species, weather, sun exposure, etc.); however, it won't grow back in exactly the same way. Recognizing these two aspects—the uniqueness of the moment in time, and the relationship to the same moment in other cycles—was helpful to me in appreciating fire as a natural part of a forest. I hope you'll enjoy the music I've created with this process.

rows.name: Frayed
rows.short_description: A free survival horror game set in a cornfield. Sneak around on the farm, solve puzzles and uncover the mysteries of the past! Try not to get lost in the corn...
rows.description_html: FRAYED is a free survival horror game set on a rural corn farm in the early 20th century. You play as George, a farmer who wakes up in a tool shed with no memories of how he got there. Your task is to complete the ritual and end the curse. GAMEPLAY FEATURES Traverse the corn Explore the farm and try not to get lost among the tall corn stalks. Watch your back and avoid loud noises. Something might find you. A tangible world Grab, throw, pull, push, turn. A tangible world of objects and puzzles are waiting for you to solve them. Uncover the mystery Read notes and investigate environmental details. What happened on the farm? Where is your brother William? The clues are there. Will you find them? Gameplay of 1-2 hours. Contains a Normal and Hardcore mode. About the developers Dream Jam Games are a small party of danish hobbyist game developers participating in occasional game jams whenever possible. Our games each seek to deliver a joyous experience delivered in small packages.

rows.name: Otto's Escape
rows.short_description: Help Otto escape a tall tower by individually controlling his jetpack's two boosters to steer and climb your way though 20 hazard-filled floors. Just try not to run out of fuel along the way!
rows.description_html: In Otto's Escape you fly a jetpack with just two buttons: one for your left booster and one for your right. There's no simple move up or move right button - that'd be too easy. To steer, you'll need to balance the thrust from those two boosters to get you moving in the right direction, all while fighting with gravity and an ever-shrinking fuel supply. The aim of the game is simple: reach the top of the tower and escape without running out of fuel, or you'll be sent right back to the ground. Piece of cake, right? Key features Ascend the tower 🚀 To escape the tower you'll need to clear 20 unique floors filled with an increasingly challenging assortment of hazards which will slow you down and drain your fuel if you fly too close. And some say the tower's so tall it reaches into outer space... Controller support 🎮 Otto's Escape's unique control scheme is best experienced with a controller featuring analog triggers - such as an Xbox or PlayStation controller - which will allow you to more finely control the thrust from your two boosters and steer with greater precision. Attempt stats 📊 Track your attempts with detailed stats screens as you edge closer to your first triumphant escape. And after that, why not try for a faster time? Achievements & leaderboards 🏆 Your first escape is only the start - Otto's Escape's achievements offer some of the game's hardest challenges, while in-game leaderboards allow you to see how your fastest time compares with others around the world.

rows.name: Fantasy Shootoff
rows.short_description: Fantasy Shootoff is a free PvPvE fantasy game where you fight against enemy creatures and bosses, use crazy weapons, experience a thrilling story, and hang out with your friends on one big map.
rows.description_html: About Fantasy Shootoff What Is Fantasy Shootoff? Fantasy Shootoff is a free PvPvE fantasy game where you fight against enemy npcs or have a duel with your friends on one big map filled with crazy weapons, story and much more. Play Single player and level up your character or jump into Multiplayer and kill enemies or just hang out. Fantasy Shootoff is constantly being updated so be ready. In Fantasy Shootoff there are seasons and chapters. Unlike most games, Fantasy Shootoff's seasons last for one whole year and in each season there is 7-8 chapters. Chapters are about 2-3 months long. rows.name: Moaisland
rows.short_description: Moaisland is a humorous and surreal, first-person, retro-styled, point-and-click adventure game starring the mysterious Moai statues of Rapa Nui (Easter Island).
rows.description_html: After a vicious storm, your boat crashes on a strange, little island. You awake, your boat no longer remotely near sea-worthy. As you come to, you hear a deep, rumbling voice in the distance and begin to notice strange, stone statues in unusual predicaments around the island. Stumble around the tiny 'Moaisland' and interact with its strange inhabitants. Some will need your help, while others might want nothing to do with you. It's up to you to explore this little island, discover secrets and undo the vandalism done unto the Moai. What will you uncover? SOLVE PUZZLES EXPLORE A STRANGE ISLAND HELP THE MOAI

rows.name: Playback Loop
rows.short_description: Carefully capture tracks of your actions, then play them back to solve puzzles with the aid of your recorded ghosts. Immerse yourself in a cerebral first-person puzzle platformer, where strategically thinking several steps ahead is the key to success.
rows.description_html: Carefully capture tracks of your actions, then play them back to solve puzzles with the aid of your recorded ghosts. Collaborate with your past self to complete each level, teaming up, destroying them, or using any strategy to reach the exit. Tackle intricate puzzles that challenge you to navigate formidable obstacles and utilize versatile mechanics to devise your solutions. Constantly think ahead, record, re-record, and manipulate your actions to create the perfect harmonies that will unlock the path to victory. Join our discord to let us know what you think of the game, leave bug reports, or anything else!

rows.name: The Vault
rows.short_description: A quick view into another world through the eyes of a single console.
rows.description_html: There's a world far beyond what our eyes comprehend, and luckily, somebody has been documenting it all. See if you can find a login to use, or what feature the Vault may be hiding. See if you can piece the world back together, and figure out what's under the surface of it all. This game console-based text simulator taking place in its own original world. All information that is accessible requires a decent amount of sluething to discover, but one thread may lead quickly into another. There are three main windows to take into consideration: the login page, the search page, and the informational pages. You are not expected to create an account while playing this game. Rather, you must use the logins of in-world characters in order to gain a higher clearance. Different information may be hidden from you based on your clearance level, decided at login. Search terms are also very strict, so it's best to know what you're looking for when trying to uncover something new. For any questions, information, or bugs to report, please tell us in the Discord:

rows.short_description: Welcome to 'VRLegs', where the thrill of parkour meets the immersive world of virtual reality. Step into a realm where your movements are fluid, intuitive, and empowering.
rows.description_html: Welcome to 'VRLegs', where the thrill of parkour meets the immersive world of virtual reality. Step into a realm where your movements are fluid, intuitive, and empowering. Our state-of-the-art locomotion system redefines how you move, jump, and traverse in the VR space, offering an unparalleled sensation of freedom. Challenge friends or team up in heart-pounding multiplayer tag matches. Navigate complex terrains, leap across buildings, and experience the exhilaration of real-time chases. As you master your environment, you'll discover new strategies, shortcuts, and moves to stay one step ahead or elude capture. Whether you're a parkour enthusiast or new to the world of VR, 'VRLegs' promises an adrenaline-pumping experience like no other. Join the revolution, find your rhythm, and let the chase begin! Visit the open world with complete freedom of your actions! Meet with your friends in multiplayer mode! Discover the unknown secrets! Play with an interactive environment! Race with your friends and show them who is the best! Change to different sizes and play with your friends! Wishlisting helps a bunch!

rows.name: YIIK Nameless Psychosis
rows.short_description: Experience a sneak peek of YIIK I.V! Step beyond Alex Eggleston's story and become the Nameless Child, a young girl pushed from a mysterious tower. Guide her through a surreal dimension where she must find a way to save both the Good Brother and the Bad Brother.
rows.description_html: Experience a sneak peek of YIIK I.V, a bold reimagining and expansion of YIIK: A Postmodern RPG! Step beyond Alex Eggleston's story and become the Nameless Child, a young girl pushed from a mysterious tower. Guide her through a surreal dimension where she must find a way to save both the Good Brother and the Bad Brother. Featuring: New Battle System: Say goodbye to minigames and load times! Engage in combat with a brand-new battle system built from the ground up. Clear dungeons and defeat monsters using your own blood as a weapon. Stack the deck in your favor with the power of the mysterious 'Karta.' Expanded Campaign: Experience a sprawling storyline that goes beyond Alex's world. Meet all-new characters and delve deeper into the lives of the supporting cast. Redesigned Mind Dungeon: Re-envisioned as a surreal open world, the Mind Dungeon is packed full of secrets, challenges, and lore to uncover. Level up instantly with one button press by talking to The Handsome Krow, your new and dramatic companion. Enhanced Animated Cutscenes: Immerse yourself in the narrative with fully voice-acted and animated cutscenes that breathe new life into the story. Original Soundtrack: YIIK I.V will contain over 100 new mind-bending original tracks, composed exclusively for the update. YIIK I.V will be released as a free update and made available to all owners of YIIK: A Postmodern RPG later this year. If Nameless Psychosis is your first experience with the world of YIIK and you're interested in wishlisting or purchasing the base game of YIIK: A Postmodern RPG, please scroll past System Requirements to the 'MORE FROM YIIK: A POSTMODERN RPG' section. A link to the original game page is available there!

rows.name: Mana Cycle
rows.short_description: Mana Cycle is a fast-paced puzzle party game with a unique twist on falling block mechanics, featuring strategic cycle-based piece-clearing. Compete with friends locally in thrilling multiplayer matches!
rows.description_html: Introducing Mana Cycle, the ultimate puzzle party game experience! Dive into a digital world of strategic block-dropping madness where strategy and reflexes collide. Mana Cycle offers a fresh twist on the classic falling block puzzle genre, combining elements of Tetris and Puyo-Puyo with its own unique mechanics. This game introduces the 'Cycle' mechanic, presenting players with an order that the pieces must be cleared ('spellcasted') in. Strategize your moves carefully as you clear pieces according to the ever-rotating cycle in the center of the screen. Features 7 playable characters, each with unique abilities. Settle into a variety of engaging game modes: - Story Mode , where you embark on a journey through puzzle-filled landscapes. -Challenge your limits in the Endless gamemode, dropping pieces for as long as you can. -Test your skills in the Arcade mode against a continuous onslaught of opponents. -Brave the unpredictable depths of the roguelite-inspired Gauntlet gamemode. -Hone your PvP skills against challenging AI opponents in local Player vs. CPU versus matches. -Challenge your friends in local multiplayer, either via the same keyboard or via controllers. Prepare for the ultimate puzzle showdown with Mana Cycle. Are you ready to master the art of the cycle?

rows.name: The Time Game
rows.short_description: The Time Game is a complex strategy card-game where you can bend the rules of time to outsmart your opponents! Play solo or online with friends!
rows.description_html: The Time Game is a complex strategy card-game where you can bend the rules of time to outsmart your opponents!  Play solo or online with friends! If you love Magic: The Gathering, or complex card games with card stacking mechanics, this is for you. Join our weekly multiplayer events on Discord. Background Play cards each turn, trying to survive deadly weapons and bombs. Cards stack up creating a complex chain of events, requiring you to predict future outcomes. Certain spaces on the board can give advantages while others will send you on an impromptu space-walk. Time is bent and logical strategy is created in the moment depending on the game state. The depth is seen in the course of rounds you survive in, resulting in a fight over abundant parts of the map while avoiding dangerous locations. Features Multiplayer, 2-4 Players. Singleplayer puzzles. Dynamic Board that changes each game. Plan out how the future will unfold by creating rifts in time and deploying time bombs as future explosives. Utilize futuristic technology such as time machines, rocketships, as well as cryogenic chambers. Collect Busted Cards From Spaces In Time, use them to tilt the scales in your favour.

rows.name: Inline: Out of Time
rows.short_description: Complete your delivery routes as fast as possible to appease your corporate overlord while still finding time to enjoy the sights of the retro-futuristic city and your banging tunes.
rows.description_html: 'Inline: Out of Time' is an adrenaline-fueled 2D platformer packed with high-speed deliveries, urban parkour, and rail-grinding. Join the ranks of the Inline Initiative as the newest recruit of the logistics company Parcel Dynamics. Immerse yourself in a thrilling race against the clock as you roller-skate through a retro-futuristic cityscape. Master every twist and turn as you optimize your delivery route with one goal in mind: SPEED. Experience fast-paced roller-skating action as you deliver packages through a variety of vibrant city environments. Embrace the challenge of mastering your routes by practicing maneuvers such as wall-jumps and long-distance package throws. Remember, speed is your #1 priority, so 'THIS SIDE UP' and 'FRAGILE' are just light suggestions! Enjoy our complimentary music player featuring a full soundtrack designed to enhance the relentlessly thrilling gameplay. Spanning genres including dance, techno, funk, and electronica, there is something for every speed demon. After completing your deliveries, feel free to pet any cats you find in the city. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Number Factory
rows.short_description: Build the ultimate number production empire! Automate generators, unlock powerful upgrades, and prestige for permanent bonuses. Compete on global leaderboards and watch your numbers grow to infinity in this addictive idle incremental game.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Number Factory - where numbers are your business, and infinity is just the beginning. Manage a cutting-edge facility dedicated to one purpose: producing the biggest numbers in the universe. Start small, automate everything, and watch your production soar to unimaginable heights. 🏭 Core Gameplay Pure Idle Progression - Your factory never stops working. Generators automatically produce numbers every second, even while you're away. Return to massive offline earnings and keep pushing toward the next milestone. Strategic Upgrades - Invest your numbers wisely in generators and multipliers. Each purchase compounds your growth, creating satisfying exponential progression that rewards smart planning. Prestige System - Hit your limit? Reset everything for powerful Prestige Points and Formula Energy. Unlock permanent bonuses that make each run faster and more rewarding than the last. ✨ Key Features 🌳 Extensive Prestige Tree Unlock dozens of powerful permanent upgrades across a sprawling prestige tree. Each node opens new strategies and multiplies your potential. Will you focus on raw production, prestige point gain, or unlock game-changing mechanics? 🎯 Challenge System Test your skills with special challenge modes that restrict your abilities for massive rewards. Complete challenges to unlock unique bonuses and prove your mastery. 🏆 Achievement Hunter's Paradise Track your progress with comprehensive achievements. From your first million to your billionth prestige, every milestone is celebrated with rewards and bragging rights. 💎 Crystal Economy Earn premium Crystals through gameplay and compete for monthly rankings. Spend them on powerful production multipliers or quality-of-life upgrades in the shop. 📊 Global Leaderboards Compete with players worldwide across multiple categories: - Highest Numbers - Who can reach the biggest number? - Most Prestiges - Speed and optimization mastery - Total Purchases - Complete dedication to the factory Monthly seasons keep competition fresh and give everyone a chance to climb the ranks. 🎮 Skills & Specialization Unlock and upgrade skills that define your playstyle. Boost production, increase prestige gains, or unlock powerful automation features. 📈 Deep Statistics Track everything from total playtime to production rates. Analyze your progress with detailed statistics and personal records. Every number tells a story. 🛒 Shop & Boosts Purchase permanent production multipliers, crystal packs, and supporter packs. rows.name: Cats, Guns & Robots Prologue
rows.short_description: Step into an exciting journey in Cats Guns & Robots, a rogue-like action game where you are the last hope for the world. In this outlaw-like action game, surviving enemy attacks in each room will require careful choices of upgrading your character abilities and features of weapons in your inventory.
rows.description_html: WISHLIST NOW! About the Game In this action rogue-like game, survive evil robot attacks, gain XP by killing them and upgrade your weapons and character for the next room. It's all about strategy, reflexes, and smart choices. Gain XP by killing evil robots and upgrade your character! Buy and upgrade your weapons and equipment! Exciting Action-Packed Roguelike Gameplay! Careful choice of weapons and character abilities will be the key to winning! THE STORY Humans and advanced robots have been living in peace and harmony for centuries. But everything was about to change with a group of powerful and evil robots declaring war on humanity. The evil robots, who began to think they no longer needed humans, gathered in the Net Building and produced mini robots to serve their wicked purposes. Then they launched a very devilish war on humanity at the most unexpected moment. The situation was awful… Only Paw Lab, the most advanced laboratory in the Catarsis universe, could stop them. Scientists of Paw Lab had been fearlessly trying to develop a new type of robot that could be their savior that could be controlled by mental power, but the tests had been failing and failing... The war was coming to an end and humanity was on the verge of extinction. Then something happened that no one expected! One night, the laboratory's cat, Nyx, while handling its catlike duties of eating, sleeping, and knocking things over , entered the pre-robot prototype. Those who came to the laboratory in the morning could not believe their eyes. Nyx was controlling the pre-robot that they had been testing for months but had failed to operate! Could the pre-robots prepared by the scientists, along with the cats, succeed in defeating the evil robots and their devilish army?

rows.name: BACKROOMS NO RETURN: Prologue
rows.short_description: Explore the poolrooms in a inmersive cooperative horror game. Immerse yourself in the story of scientists who are exploring the depths of the poolrooms and end up encountering various obstacles in order to find a way back to reality.
rows.description_html: SEE FULL VERSION About the Game Explore and face the dangers of the poolrooms in an immersive cooperative horror game. You play as a scientist whose mission is to explore the depths of the poolrooms for research purposes. You will soon realise that you have made a mistake and that there is no way out. Through escaping from various creatures you will have to find a way out of there. - Singleplayer & Co-op Multiplayer - Proximity Voice Chat - Host and join lobbies Play as a scientist whose goal is to explore the poolrooms. Finding a way back to reality will be your main goal. As part of their ongoing research into human consciousness, the Neuro-Bio-Psychology Laboratory (NBP) has developed a revolutionary new machine. That teleports you into another dimesion called Backrooms. It is up to you how long you stay there... With this technology, they can explore these dimensions in search for answers to this misterious dimension. This game is powered by Unreal Engine 5 and we have focused on getting the best graphics possible to give you more immersion. To make the levels more entertaining, you will have to complete a series of puzzles in order to continue. There are many different types of puzzles you will have to complete to continue your journe. The solution is not always obvious, but if you follow the trail of clues, then it should become clear what needs to happen next.

rows.name: OxRox
rows.short_description: Revive the boulder dash spirit with OxRox, a modern remake of the 2001 classic RoX with updated graphics, improved UI, controller support and Steam integration. Tackle new puzzles, compete on leaderboards, and explore bonus levels in this nostalgic yet fresh adventure.
rows.description_html: Welcome to OxRox, the modern remake of the 2001 classic RoX by Safrosoft, a beloved boulder dash clone that captivated players with its darker tone, engaging gameplay and challenging puzzles. OxRox reimagines this timeless experience for today's audience, blending the essence of the original with modern user experience, Steam integration and a contemporary touch. A Classic Reborn: At its core, OxRox remains true to the spirit of RoX, offering a casual experience filled with intricate puzzles, avoiding obstacles, outwitting enemies and strategizing against cascading boulders. Our goal was not to simply replicate, but to re-envision, crafting a game that feels both nostalgic and new. What Makes OxRox Stand Out? Modern Graphics and Sound: Beautifully updated visuals that bring the classic gameplay to life, accompanied by a captivating soundtrack that enhances the immersive experience. Enhanced Gameplay Mechanics: The gameplay now behaves completely deterministic. We also introduced new mechanics and gameplay elements, offering a fresh challenge to both veterans of the original and newcomers alike. Expansive Levels and Challenges: Discover a wide array of new levels, each designed to present a unique challenge that tests your wits and reflexes. From easy beginnings to hour-long puzzles, OxRox delivers a rich variety of experiences. Leaderboards and Cloud-Saved Progression: Compete with players worldwide through leaderboards for each level and enjoy the convenience of cloud-saved level progression, ensuring your achievements and progress are preserved across devices. Custom Creations and Community: With a powerful, user-friendly level editor, unleash your creativity by designing your own challenges and sharing them with the community via Steam Workshop. A Tribute and a Step Forward OxRox is a tribute to the legacy of RoX, reimagined with care, creativity, and modern innovation. Whether you're a long-time fan eager to relive the classic or a newcomer curious to experience it for the first time, OxRox offers an adventure that is both familiar and fresh.

rows.name: Puppet: Hide And Seek
rows.short_description: Puppet: Hide And Seek - is a 7 vs 1 multiplayer horror game where one player takes on the role of a brutal Killer and seven other players are Survivors trying to escape from the killer.
rows.description_html: Puppet: Hide And Seek - is a 7 vs 1 multiplayer horror game where one player takes on the role of a brutal Killer and seven other players are Survivors trying to escape from the killer. THE GAME: Hide And Seek - is a multiplayer horror game in (7 vs 1) mode, where one player takes on the role of a brutal Killer, and seven other players are Survivors trying to escape the killer. CAN YOU BE SAVED?? Multi-user features Take advantage of our in-game positional voice chat. Invite friends or find other players using the server browser. Hide and Seek Hide in closets, walls, bushes, houses, but remember the main thing is your life is at stake. Co-op Team up or hide alone to survive. Ship Live the allotted time and sail away into the sunset from this cursed island Play like everyone else or start stand out In the game you can choose a character to your taste. The goal of the Survivors in each game is to try not to get caught by the Killer and escape from the scene of the murders - it sounds easier than it really is.

rows.name: Hangul Shooter
rows.short_description: An alternate way for gamers to learn Korean. Shooting the enemies or playing the minigames—choose your fun starting point to learn a new language with anime aesthetic!
rows.description_html: An alternate way for gamers to learn Korean and Japanese. Shooting the enemies or playing the minigames—choose your fun starting point to learn a new language with anime aesthetic!    Here are the features:   1. The Less Boring Way  Learn the Korean alphabet (Hangul) and other alphabets in a fun gaming context. Quizzes and rote memorization aren’t for everyone because they encourage procrastination and eventually dropping out. So Hangul Shooter offers an alternative way that encourages you to learn because you used to , not because you need to.  2. Core Mechanics  Shoot the enemies with the correct bombs or sometimes avoid them. Use skills, master a class’s playstyle , or try the Practice Mode to clear all levels more easily!  Each level has four phases. The first two phases accustom you to the new letters, and the last two give you the “adrenaline boost”. The Rush Phase makes you think faster and turn your body left and right, and the Boss Phase tests your endurance. But still, you can skip these last two phases if they are too difficult!  Harder difficulty is also available for non-casual gamers and streamers who want to bang the table~.  3. Buy One, Get Two: The Minigames  Do you still like quiz-like games to learn a new language? The minigames offer classic experiences and even more alternative ways. You can also make a request if you want a specific minigame.  4. The Alphabets and Beyond (BETA)  There is a minigame to learn common vocabulary in Hangul Shooter. A way to learn essential grammar (for traveling) is also under development. But these features are experimental.  The goal is to learn the essentials to save time and learn relatively faster!    The catch:  At the current version, Hangul Shooter doesn't include a pronunciation feature. Therefore, it's good if you just want a quick start. And so, you can recognize the letters in manhwa/manga soon enough.

Traverse eerie liminal locales and evade lurking monsters to unravel the mysteries of this chilling 2D game with horror elements. Can you lead Ashley to safety, or will the shadows consume her?
rows.description_html: Step into the darkness with Ashley, a college dropout lost in a mysterious world devoid of light. Traverse eerie liminal locales and evade lurking monsters to unravel the mysteries of this chilling 2D game with horror elements. Can you lead Ashley to safety, or will the shadows consume her before she can leave this dark world? This Game Features: Story-driven gameplay in a dark and empty world. Solve puzzles to progress to try to find someone to help you get back home. Avoid monsters in the dark and navigate through familiar, yet unfamiliar locations. Impressive shaders and lighting effects for an enriching atmosphere. Original pixel art that visually enhances and adds charm to the experience.

rows.name: Astral Disorder
rows.short_description: As the lone maintenance worker on an unkempt space train station, navigate the chaos unleashed by a catastrophic crash and evade a relentless beast. Armed with scattered tools and state-of-the-art equipment, outsmart your pursuer and secure passage to safety aboard a distant escape pod.
rows.description_html: In Astral Disorder, you are the lone maintenance worker on an unkempt space train station. The facility has become mostly automated, decreasing the need for human workers. As the last remaining utility expert, your state-of-the-art equipment and tools used for navigation and repairs are strewn about the chaotic facility. After a devastating crash causing the station to start running on backup power, a monstrous entity unleashed by the crash starts its relentless pursuit. Your mission is clear: find a means of escape before this horrible beast overtakes you. This is a first-person game where the player will be avoiding a monster by using a variety of mobility abilities and intelligent tactics to get to places where it cannot reach. The player will explore the station looking for items or new abilities to help them reach their goal, an escape pod to escape from the creature. With the station in backup power, traditional methods of navigating the station are unavailable and the player must find access cards, vents, or reroute the backup power to doors to facilitate their escape. Features Relentless Pursuit: A beast relentlessly tracking your every move forces you to keep on the move and utilize all your tools and cunning to keep ahead of it. Dynamic Navigation: Navigate the varied environments within the space station with a variety of navigation methods to evade the monster including sliding, grappling, and wall-running. Mind-Bending Puzzles: Solve complex puzzles and obstacles by thinking quickly and strategically to reach new equipment and paths, all while ensuring the monster can't catch up. Destructible Environment: A destructible environment to open up new avenues of escape, but beware as new paths for you mean new paths for the monster to corner you.

rows.name: Limb From Limb
rows.short_description: The Raymond Mitchell Association personally invites you to join our new limb regrowth program. Engage in a game of chance against another patient, risking the loss of your fingers. We have provided items to aid in your success waiting to be uncovered as you traverse the game board.
rows.description_html: The Raymond Mitchell Association Welcomes You Limb From Limb is a card roulette game about surviving encounters against a monster with your fingers as a sacrifice for losing. Between encounters, navigate your way across a board of randomized events that forces you to consider what path you take out of this accursed experiment. Fighting Patient Zero Engage with a patient in a lethal card game of chance. Draw from a deck of 52 cards, some of which will cost you a finger to proceed. Collect Items Gather from a pool of 10 different items, each with its own personality and effect. Choose which items you want to take into the encounters, but be meticulous, as once-used items are gone forever. Escape Traverse through the hospital using a game board and your innate strategy to succeed in the RMA program. Each attempt brings a series of mixed events to define a new experience for every patient. Content Warning This game may potentially trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy. Player discretion is advised.

rows.name: Fallopian Frenzy! Come Again?
rows.short_description: Ten years ago (2014) I made my first game. This is that game. Mostly intact. I'm sorry.
rows.description_html: An endless swimmer that life itself depends upon! Developers Note: Hi, This game ain't great. I know it, you know it. BUT if you manage to get a score above 4200 the game will reward you with a FREE Steam key*. I'm just happy I will no longer have to awkwardly try and explain to people the first game I made many years ago, they can just experience it themselves. -adamvision Simply swim up and down on your way to victory. See how far you can go before being eliminated by popular methods of birth control. FEATURES: ✔ FREE TO PLAY ✔ Simple one button / touch controls ✔ 13 ridiculous sperm ✔ 5 Power ups ✔ Avoid the effective birth control, such as the pill, condoms, and more. ✔ Includes Educational Factoids Additional Credits: Brianna Flynn - Additional Art Song: 'Monkeys Spinning Monkeys' - Kevin MacLeod * While keys last / Limit one per steam ID. Giveaways subject to being stopped any time.
