Since graduation, I have used JS, JAVA, RUBY, etc., W7, W8, W10, Linux, etc. for PC, Apple, Android, and even Windows Phone for mobile phones, and Eclipse, VS, VSCode for coding, etc. I once heard that 'Zelda is the first in the world', the most played is LOL, I have bought a switch, most of the well-rated games in the steam warehouse are not developed by Chinese, and most of the national games have been scolded very badly, and the krypton is serious. At that time, I was thinking about why we couldn't develop our own programming language and be at the forefront of the world, why most games only wanted to change kryptonite and were scolded for being garbage, why we didn't have our own operating system. It happened that the Taiwu picture scroll came out before, and it received a lot of praise, and I realized that it was not that it could not be done, but that no one could do it, and as long as I worked hard to do it, I would definitely be able to do it. So, I decided to quit my job and develop games on my own, and as a game enthusiast and programmer, I felt that I could make a game. After resigning,Learn Unity and C# from 0,Start making games,4 years have passed in a flash.,In these 4 years, except for their own personal affairs.,A total of 2 years of time spent in the game.,In March 2024,Forced to helplessly,In the case of immaturity, the game will be launched directly.。 > was born, it was my debut novel, and its name was like this development experience, and when the game went live, I knew that my mission was accomplished, and I died without regrets. It has a lot of bugs and problems, but because it costs $2, there are almost no sales, so there are no reviews, and there are no problems that can be found. In May, I started working and continue to update the game's map, because I wanted more people to play the game, and I made it free later. After the free, there were more people playing, and there were more real reviews, all in red, and there were overwhelming negative reviews. I'm grateful for the bad reviews from some of these players, who will give a detailed description of what went wrong, and even send me a game log to my mailbox, and I've fixed a lot of bugs. Did I fail, I was a failure, a super failure, and a bunch of bad reviews and no recommendations made me ashamed to mention this game to others. Did I succeed, I succeeded, the moment the game hit the shelves, I knew, I succeeded, I succeeded in making this game. The first promotional video was on station b, and the happiest thing was that I found that there were several up who were also doing independent game development, and I was very touched at the time, I was not alone, there are many people who are doing the same thing towards the same goal as me, they are the heroes in my heart, even if I fall, there will be more people who will stand up,. I firmly believe that everyone can do well as long as they play to their strengths and concentrate on doing things. I firmly believe that at this moment, there must be someone developing China++, China system, China mobie system, and their success will surely build the cornerstone of China's strength. I firmly believe that we will have our own computer system, mobile phone system, programming language, and the games developed by Chinese people in the future will be full of creativity, and it will no longer be a bunch of bad reviews. I have never regretted my choice, like a martyr, even though he is still alive.

rows.name: King of Hell
rows.short_description: King of Hell is a 6-player, online, Arcade Party Game. You play against your friends in a arena filled with random Items and Jump'n Run obstacles. Try to knock your opponents into the lava to stash points and then climb up to the top platform, to score your points and become King of Hell!
rows.description_html: Lobby Select: Choose from 6 unique animal characters, to save them from hell and secure them a spot in heaven. Movement: Jump & use your staff to reach greater heights! Combat: Charge your staff to knock your opponents further away! Items: Use Mystery Boxes to get 1 out of 10 unique random Items to secure an advantage in movement, fights and climbing! Press G to get info and tips how to use collected items.

rows.name: Project: Ternion
rows.short_description: Ternion is the perfect game for anyone looking for a fast paced hero shooter where all heroes are tailored to unique play styles.
rows.description_html: Ternion is a fast paced 3v3 First Person Shooter where the objective is to eliminate the other team. Choose between 3 unique characters designed to fit different play styles. If you like shooting and having precise aim then pick Brawn who specializes in advanced recoil control. If you have good mechanics and can move around the map with ease then Brisk is the perfect pick for you. If you like outplaying your opponents by reading their next move choose Brain with the ability to see through the walls aswell as having remote explosives at your disposal you're sure to come out on top.

rows.name: Urban Nightmare
rows.short_description: Urban Nightmare is a Found Footage like First-Person Parkour game where you are trying to get to the heart of the city as fast as you can! Replay levels to see how quickly you can get to the end of each map in this 15 min experience game!
rows.description_html: This is an indie-student made found footage style game where you are a Free-Running, parkour expert who finds themselves lost in a city. Upon trying to find your way out, you find very disturbing body horror around different corners. By using your knowledge of free running, you hope that you can escape from this urban nightmare. How fast can you make it out of each level? HOW TO PLAY Mouse and Keyboard WASD - Move Mouse - Look Around Left Control - Crouch/Slide Space Bar - Jump Controller Left Stick - Move Right Stick - Look Around Left Trigger - Crouch/Slide Right Trigger - Jump

rows.name: Pet Crossing
rows.short_description: A cruiser came to a blue planet and found a planet with many ice-blocked caves, which contained frozen animals that were sent in before the catastrophe. Only paired animals could survive after thawing. The expedition team needs your wisdom to help match these animals and restore life to the planet.
rows.description_html: This is puzzle fighting game that can be played alone or in a team. It is exciting, tense, extremely addictive. The rule is to pair animals with a connection contains only 2 or less turns.

rows.name: ScarQuest
rows.short_description: Raise armies to dominate, seize, and reign over the planet as its ruler.
rows.description_html: Join ScarQuest now for a chance to earn extremely rare and valuable planetary land. In ScarQuest, you can construct a home base, select favorable terrains, cleverly arrange traps and towers, and punish those who dare your wrath. Train troops, conquer enemies, dominate the arena, and forge a fearsome reputation that echoes across the cosmos! -Manage and beautify your home base. Construct your base from numerous selections of buildings and upgrades to increase productivity and strengthen the number of your attacking troops. Hundreds of decorations are available to fashion your home base to your unique personal aesthetics. -Strengthen our defenses and annihilate incoming enemies. Combat tiles can be freely selected and arranged to build advantageous terrains. Customize the setup with a combination of traps, towers, and heroes to create an impenetrable fortress capable of adapting to any situation. -Online sieges and real-time reinforcements. If you happen to be online during a siege, you can enter a siege battle to disrupt your opponent using various support skills. You can even taunt your opponents with emojis to get a good laugh! -Train attacking troops and plunder resources. Powerful class-based heroes excelling in manipulating the battlefields are at your command! Equipped with decisive abilities like drawing enemy fire, team teleportation, sneak behind enemy lines, and much more, these heroes will give your army the edge to destroy enemy cores and pillage their resources. - Defeat the aliens and earn rich rewards. Defeating alien invasion fleets grants valuable rewards. The deadly aliens, however, are not easily trifled with. Be sure to strengthen your forces before challenging the mysterious aliens from beyond! Come join ScarQuest and begin your universal conquest! This game requires an internet connection to play.

rows.name: Magitech Requiem
rows.short_description: Equip various magitech, perks, and weaponry to fight against hordes of creatures beckoned to remind humanity of their hubris. Fight either alone or alongside up to two friends, and employ advanced tactics to defy the forces of fate.
rows.description_html: Magitech Requiem is a modern evolution of classic arcade shooters. Build your character through leveling, perks, and Magitech. Take up arms and fight the forces of uncreation, be it alone or with up to two friends. Lore In an alternate history, an incredible force known as Quintessence was discovered by alchemical practitioners in 198X. Shortly after the discovery of Quintessence, novel technologies termed 'Magitech' were developed for use in the industrial, scientific, and medical industries. But before Magitech could reach its full potential, mankind's hubris invoked the hunger of an otherworldly legion. As a Defier, you fight against entropy itself. Do you and your comrades have the grit to overcome the great filter?

rows.name: Pogo Rogue
rows.short_description: Bounce to the top in this skill based, roguelite action-platformer! Collect powerful items, pick unique weapons, and fight off a variety of enemies while navigating around with a fun, difficult, and unique movement system. Are you up for the challenge?
rows.description_html: Bounce to the top in this skill based, roguelite action-platformer! Collect powerful items, pick unique weapons, and fight off a variety of enemies while navigating around with a fun, difficult, and unique movement system. Are you up for the challenge? Master the unique Pogo Stick Movement mechanics! Find dozens of unique weapons, powerups, and items to customize your play through! Enjoy the Retro Vibe! Replay over and over again thanks to the procedural generation! Features: Dozens of Weapons Dozens of Items Dozens of Powerups Unique Enemies Unique Movement System Procedural Generation Boss Fights Pogo Rogue was developed by students in the Division of Games at the University of Utah

rows.name: No Bugs On My Windshield
rows.short_description: Don't let them touch your windshield!
rows.description_html: No Bugs On My Windshield is an arcade style game with no end, just you, your truck, and a bunch of bugs you need to blast with your turret, trying to achieve the highest score possible. Your scores can be used as points in the main menu to upgrade your truck, such as new gadgets, energy for said gadgets, and stats for your truck, such as fire rate and reload speed, so be sure to spend them! A great game for those wanting a quick distraction.
